local local_class = newclass('NightmareDemonShirePalworldSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDemonShirePalworld @
		Comment = 팰 연구소 진입 후, 동물 도와주기 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type NightmareDemonShirePalworldController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.nowhere = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.quest_name = 'sub_pal'

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	--self.available_stage_names = {}

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		after_opening = 2,
		find_researcher = 3,
		interact_researcher = 4,
		help_researcher = 5,
		minigame_animal = 6,
		done = 7
	}
	--
	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.quest_progress_key = 'sub_pal_s1_progress_save'

	self.minigame_animal_door_name = 'sub_pal_s1_door_3'

	self.minigame_clear_event = 'minigame_clear'

	self.minigame_item = nil
	self.minigame_item_id = 21246

	self.event_range = {
		inst = nil,

		create = function(this, pos, color, size_v2)
			local show_type = CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.NONE
			this.inst = attack_range_util.create_rect_by_color_key(color, pos, size_v2, show_type)

			attack_range_util.show(this.inst, 0)
			attack_range_util.setup_by_position(this.inst, pos, 0)
		end,

		set_active_state = function(this, is_active)
			if is_active then
				this.inst:Show(0)
			else
				this.inst:Hide()
			end
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			this:set_active_state(false)
			this.inst = nil
		end
	}
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local quest_progress = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.quest_progress_key)

	if quest_progress ~= -1 then
		self.current_state = quest_progress
	end

	self:field_setting(self.current_state)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrownEndEvent))

	if self.minigame_item then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.minigame_item)
	end

	if self.event_range.inst ~= nil then
		self.event_range:dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) and
			self.current_state == self.states.minigame_animal and
			e.Params[0] == self.minigame_clear_event then

		self.current_state = self.states.done

		sp_util.start_scene(self.after_minigame_animal_scene, self)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ThrownEndEvent) then
		local npc = e.Target
		local npc_name = e.Target.Name
		local minigame_data = self.controller.minigame_animal_data[npc_name]

		if self.current_state == self.states.minigame_animal and
				minigame_data ~= nil and
				zone_util.contains_fo('sub_pal_s1_animal_eating_zone', e.Target, true) then

			if minigame_data.is_eating then
				return
			end

			minigame_data.is_eating = true
			npc.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

			start_coroutine(function()
				yield_return_func(self.controller.npc_eating_routine, self, npc, get_field_object('sub_pal_s1_basket'))

				local is_all_eating = true

				-- 모든 동물들이 밥을 먹었다면
				for _, data in pairs(self.controller.minigame_animal_data) do
					if data.is_eating == false then
						is_all_eating = false
						return
					end
				end

				if is_all_eating then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.minigame_clear_event }))
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local npc = e.FieldObject
	local npc_name = e.FieldObject.Name
	local minigame_data = self.controller.minigame_animal_data[npc_name]

	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_pal_opening_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_opening

		sp_util.start_scene(self.rabbit_opening_scene, self)
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.after_opening and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_pal_s1_opening_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.find_researcher

		sp_util.start_scene(self.find_researcher_scene, self)
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.help_researcher and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_pal_s1_animal_lab_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.minigame_animal

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrownEndEvent), 'on_event')

		sp_util.start_scene(self.before_minigame_scene, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state >= self.states.find_researcher and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.controller.characters.researcher()) then

		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_researcher_scene, self)
	end
end

function local_class:field_setting(quest_progress)
	local researcher_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_pal_s1_researcher_pos')

	if quest_progress == 1 then
		local pink_rabbit = self.controller.characters.pink_rabbit()

		character_util.set_position(pink_rabbit, field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_pal_s1_rabbit_pos'))
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(pink_rabbit, { dir = 'down', sfx = false })
	elseif quest_progress == 2 then
		local rabbit = self.controller.characters.pink_rabbit()

		local pos = researcher_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)

		character_util.set_position(rabbit, pos)
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(rabbit, { dir = 'up', sfx = false })

		self:set_auto_quest_marker(self.controller.characters.researcher())

	elseif quest_progress == 4 then
		local researcher = self.controller.characters.researcher()

		character_util.add_listener(researcher, self.controller)

		character_util.set_position(researcher, researcher_pos)
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(researcher, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

		self:set_auto_quest_marker(self.controller.characters.researcher())

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('sub_pal_s1_door_1', false))

	elseif quest_progress == 5 then
		local researcher = self.controller.characters.researcher()
		local researcher_minigame_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_pal_s1_lab_researcher_pos')

		self:animal_lab_setting()

		character_util.set_position(researcher, researcher_minigame_pos)
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(researcher, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

		self:set_auto_quest_marker(researcher)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('sub_pal_s1_door_1', false))
	end

	if quest_progress < 3 then
		--빨간색 표시된 도어 개방된 상태
		--NPC 배치
		--파란원(연구원) (nightmare_ds_demon_researcher)(left,danaged,sleep)
		local researcher = self.controller.characters.researcher()

		character_util.set_position(researcher, researcher_pos)
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(researcher, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
		scene_util.set_anim(researcher, self, 'sleep')
		scene_util.set_emotion(researcher, self, 'damaged')

		--(1)(nightmare_ds_hedgehog_brown)(down,idle,idle)
		local hedgehog = self.controller.characters.hedgehog()
		local hedgehog_pos = researcher_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5)

		character_util.set_position(hedgehog, hedgehog_pos)
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hedgehog, { dir = 'down', sfx = false })

		--(2)(nightmare_ds_wolf_basic)(down,idle,idle)
		local wolf = self.controller.characters.wolf()
		local wolf_pos = researcher_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5)

		character_util.set_position(wolf, wolf_pos)
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(wolf, { dir = 'down', sfx = false })

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('sub_pal_s1_door_1', false))
	end
end

function local_class:rabbit_opening_scene()
	local rabbit = self.controller.characters.pink_rabbit()
	--(1)( 토끼 )(nightmare_ds_rabbit_pink)(down,idle,idle)

	--컨트롤 뺏기며 bgm 볼륨 0.6으로 조정, 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
	--
	--카메라 0.5초간 (1)(토끼) 위치까지 이동
	camera_util.move_async(rabbit.Position, 0.5)
	--(1)(down,idle,idle)(jump1회) + (notice) 이모티콘 버블

	character_util.normal_jump(rabbit, '01_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(
			rabbit,
			self,
			'down',
			nil,
			nil,
			'notice'
	)

	--오른쪽으로 속도 7 (run) 애니메이션 사용하면서  [GIMMICK]stair_down 까지 이동
	do
		local pos = get_field_object('sub_pal_enter_lab_stair').Position

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_hurt_01')
		wp_util.move_async(rabbit, pos, 7, nil, { run = true })
	end

	--이동 끝나면 토끼 (right,idle,idle) 상태로 알파페이드로 사라지면서 1초간 카메라 플레이어에게 복귀
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(rabbit, 0, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	do
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_pal_s1_researcher_pos') + vector(0, 0, -0.5)

		character_util.set_position(rabbit, pos)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(rabbit, 1, 0)

		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(rabbit, { dir = 'up', sfx = false })
	end

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.quest_progress_key, 2)

	self:set_auto_quest_marker(self.controller.characters.researcher())

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--컨트롤 해제
end

function local_class:find_researcher_scene()
	local researcher = self.controller.characters.researcher()
	local hedgehog = self.controller.characters.hedgehog()
	local wolf = self.controller.characters.wolf()
	local rabbit = self.controller.characters.pink_rabbit()

	--컨트롤 뺏기며 bgm 볼륨 0.6으로 조정, 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local door_name = 'sub_pal_s1_door_1'

	--카메라 연구원 위치까지 1초간 이동
	camera_util.move_async(researcher.Position, 1)

	--동물 (1)(2)(3)(right,idle,idle)(jump1회)
	do
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hedgehog, 'right')
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(wolf, 'right')
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(rabbit, 'right')

		character_util.normal_jump(hedgehog, '01_player_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(wolf, '01_player_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump_async(rabbit, '01_player_jump_01')
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door_name, false))

	--동물 (1)(2)(3) 속도 7 (left) 방향으로 (run) 애니메이션 사용해서 쭉 이동
	do
		local offset = vector(-10, 0, 0)

		wp_util.move(hedgehog, hedgehog.Position + offset, 7, nil, { run = true })
		wp_util.move(wolf, wolf.Position + offset, 7, nil, { run = true })
		wp_util.move_async(rabbit, rabbit.Position + offset, 7, nil, { run = true })
	end

	--그리드 밖에서 소멸한다.
	do
		character_util.set_position(hedgehog, self.nowhere)
		character_util.set_position(rabbit, self.nowhere)
		character_util.set_position(wolf, self.nowhere)
	end

	--이동 1초 후 빨간색 표시된 도어 다시 닫힘
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(door_name, false))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--동물들 이동 1초 후 연구원(shake0.03 /0.5초)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(researcher, 0.03, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--연구원(left,tired,seat) 상태
	scene_util.set_anim(researcher, self, 'seat')
	scene_util.set_emotion(researcher, self, 'tired')

	--카메라 1초간 플레이어에게 이동 컨트롤 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	character_util.add_listener(researcher, self.controller)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:interact_researcher_scene()
	local researcher = self.controller.characters.researcher()
	local lord = get_party_leader()

	--컨트롤 뺏기며 bgm 볼륨 0.6으로 조정, 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_name)

	--연구원 인터랙트시 플레이어 우측 1칸 옆에 0.5초간 정렬
	do
		local pos = researcher.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)

		wp_util.move_async(lord, pos, 4, nil)
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(lord, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.find_researcher then

		--연구원(여)(left,damaged,seat): 동물도 돌보면서 연구를 어떻게 하라는거야!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				researcher,
				self,
				'left',
				'seat',
				'damaged',
				'nm_ds_palworld_s1_1'
		)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		--연구원(여)(left,mad,seat): 내버려두면 혼자서 밥도 못챙겨먹는 애들인데!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				researcher,
				self,
				'left',
				'seat',
				'mad',
				'nm_ds_palworld_s1_2'
		)

		--연구원 마리오 점프로 기상 후 0.5초 대기
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
		character_util.mario_jump_new(researcher, 'left', 0.5, 0.5)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--연구원(여)(right,idle,idle) 0.5초
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(researcher, 'right')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--연구원(여)(right,scared,embarrassed): 배, 백작님?!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				researcher,
				self,
				'right',
				'embarrassed',
				'scared',
				'nm_ds_palworld_s1_3'
		)

		--클로드(남)(left,idle,bomb_idle): 무슨 문제라도 있는 건가?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				lord,
				self,
				'left',
				'bomb_idle',
				'idle',
				'nm_ds_palworld_s1_4'
		)

		--연구원(여)(right,tired,idle): 그, 그게 원래는 동물을 돌봐주는 동료가 있었는데…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				researcher,
				self,
				'right',
				nil,
				nil,
				'nm_ds_palworld_s1_5'
		)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		--연구원(여)(right,scared,cast): 이렇게 살다간 얘네가 짐승인지 내가 짐승인지 모르겠다고 뛰쳐 나가서…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				researcher,
				self,
				'right',
				'cast',
				'scared',
				'nm_ds_palworld_s1_6'
		)

		--클로드(남)(left,idle,question): 연구소 쪽에 인력이 부족하다는 얘기가 사실이였나 보군.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				lord,
				self,
				'left',
				'question',
				'idle',
				'nm_ds_palworld_s1_7'
		)

		--클로드(남)(left,idle,nod 2회): 너희들은 데몬샤이어의 발전에 중요한 토대이니 도움이 필요하면 말하거라.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				lord,
				self,
				'left',
				'nod',
				'idle',
				'nm_ds_palworld_s1_8'
		)

		--연구원(여)(right,attack,cast): 가, 감사합니다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				researcher,
				self,
				'right',
				'cast',
				'attack',
				'nm_ds_palworld_s1_9'
		)

		self.current_state = self.states.interact_researcher
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.quest_progress_key, 4)
	end

	--연구원(여)(right,tired,sing) : 그럼 혹시 지금 동물들 돌보는 걸 도와주실 수 있나요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			researcher,
			self,
			'right',
			'sing',
			'tired',
			'nm_ds_palworld_s1_10'
	)

	--연구원(여)(right,attack,relesae 2회): 연구가 곧 막바지여서 금방 끝날 거에요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			researcher,
			self,
			'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'attack',
			'nm_ds_palworld_s1_11'
	)

	--선택지
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--도와준다. (mercy)
		{ 'nm_ds_palworld_s1_12', 'mercy' },
		--대기시킨다. (normal)
		{ 'nm_ds_palworld_s1_13', 'normal' },
	})

	if result == 1 then

		character_util.remove_lua_listener(researcher, self.controller)

		self:animal_lab_setting()

		--도와준다. 선택시
		--클로드(남)(left,idle,nod 2회): 좋다. 안내해라.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				lord,
				self,
				'left',
				'nod',
				'idle',
				'nm_ds_palworld_s1_16'
		)
		--연구원(여)(right,attack,salute): 넵! 따라오시죠!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				researcher,
				self,
				'right',
				'salute',
				'attack',
				'nm_ds_palworld_s1_17'
		)
		--연구원 0.5초간 좌측 1.5칸 (walk)로 이동 후
		do
			local pos = researcher.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0)

			wp_util.move_async(researcher, pos, 4, nil)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_equipping_01')
		--연구원(left,idle,eat) 1초
		scene_util.play_wait_action(
				researcher,
				self,
				'left',

function local_class:animal_lab_setting()

		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, anim)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, emo)

		npc.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	end

	do
		local function marker_pos(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_pal_s1_animal_pos_' .. number)
		end
		character_util.set_position(goat, marker_pos(1))
		character_util.set_position(pony, marker_pos(2))

		npc_setting(goat, 'left', 'sleep', 'tired')
		npc_setting(pony, 'left', 'sleep', 'tired')
		npc_setting(black_rabbit, 'right', 'sleep', 'tired')

				  notforinven = true, showoncharacter = false, skip_text = true })

		self.controller.minigame_animal_data[pony.Name].pos = marker_pos(2)
		self.controller.minigame_animal_data[black_rabbit.Name].pos = marker_pos(3)

-- ========================================================
--               팔 충돌 상태
-- ========================================================
local pal_crash_state = {
	ethereal = 1,
	npc = 2
}

-- ========================================================
--               팔 충돌 상태
-- ========================================================
local pal_type = {
	white_goat = 1,
	black_rabbit = 2,
	pony = 3
}

--#region PalManager
-- ========================================================
--               소유하고 있는 팔 관리하는 매니저
-- ========================================================
local pal_manager = newclass('PalManager')

function pal_manager:init(pals)
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version
	self.all_pals = { table.unpack(pals) }
	self.following_pals = { table.unpack(pals) }

	-- 팔들이 따라다니고 있는 상태인지.
	self.are_pals_following = false

	self.pal_crash_behaviour_by_state = {
		[pal_crash_state.ethereal] = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance,
		[pal_crash_state.npc] = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	}

	self.following_iter = linq(self.following_pals)
	self.all_pals_iter = linq(self.all_pals)

	self.is_eat_food_data = {}

	self.is_action_stopped = false
end

function pal_manager:add_following_pal(pal_type)
	local following_in_battle_state = CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone
	local pal = self.all_pals[pal_type]

	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(pal, user_party, false, following_in_battle_state)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pal)

	self.following_pals[pal_type] = pal
end

function pal_manager:remove_following_pal(pal_type)
	local pal = self.all_pals[pal_type]
	character_util.convert_to_npc(pal)

	self.following_pals[pal_type] = nil
end

function pal_manager:set_pals_following_player()
	self.all_pals_iter:foreach(function(type)
		local pal = self.all_pals[type]
		if self:is_eat_food_pal(pal) == false then
			self:add_following_pal(type)
		end
	end)
	self.are_pals_following = true
end

function pal_manager:set_pals_not_following_player()
	self.following_iter:foreach(function(type)
		local pal = self.all_pals[type]
		if self:is_eat_food_pal(pal) == false then
			self:remove_following_pal(type)
		end
	end)
	self.are_pals_following = false
end

function pal_manager:remove_pals_anim()
	character_util.remove_group_anim(self.following_iter:to_array())
end

function pal_manager:set_pal_crash_state(pal_crash_state)
	self.following_iter:foreach(function(_, pal)
		pal.CrashBehaviour = self.pal_crash_behaviour_by_state[pal_crash_state]
	end)
end

function pal_manager:get_all_pals()
	return self.all_pals
end

function pal_manager:get_following_pals()
	return self.following_iter:to_array()
end

function pal_manager:get_first_pal()
	if user_party.Count == 1 then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local fo = user_party[1]
	local fo_name = fo.Name
	local pal_name_prefix = 'sub_pal_'

	return pal_type[fo_name:gsub(pal_name_prefix, '')], fo
end

function pal_manager:align_pals_with_marker(marker_name_fmt, move_speed, move_duration)
	move_speed = lua_helper.get_or_default(move_speed, nil)
	move_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(move_duration, nil)

	self.following_iter:foreach(function(_, pal)
		local marker = field_util.get_marker(marker_name_fmt:format(pal.Name))
		local wp = { marker.position }
		wp_util.move(pal, wp, move_speed, move_duration, { last_direction = marker.direction })
	end)
end

function pal_manager:align_pals_at_event_area_boundary()
	local align_marker_name = '%s_boundary_align_pos'
	self.all_pals_iter:foreach(function(_, pal)
		if self:is_eat_food_pal(pal) == false then
			local wp = { field_util.get_marker_pos(align_marker_name:format(pal.Name)) }
			local wp_data = {
				last_direction = 'up'
			}

			character_util.convert_to_npc(pal)
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(pal, wp, 4, nil, self, nil, wp_data)
		end
	end)
end

function pal_manager:align_pals_at_rock(rock)
	local align_marker_fmt = '%s_%s_align'

	self.all_pals_iter:foreach(function(_, pal)
		local align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(align_marker_fmt:format(pal.Name, rock.Name))
		wp_util.move(pal, { align_pos }, 5, nil, { last_direction = 'right', end_callback = function()
			character_util.set_anim(pal, { name = 'eat', sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
		end })
	end)
end

function pal_manager:cancel_pals_action()
	self.is_action_stopped = true

	self.all_pals_iter:foreach(function(_, following)
		if self:is_eat_food_pal(following) == false then
			character_util.stop(following)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(following)
		end
	end)
end

function pal_manager:play_pal_job_complition_reaction()
	self.is_action_stopped = false
	self:set_pal_crash_state(pal_crash_state.ethereal)
	self:set_pals_not_following_player()

	-- (right,smile,happy) + (happy) 이모티콘 버블 재생
	local pals = self.all_pals_iter:to_array()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.set_group_anim(pals, self, 'happy')
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(pals, self, 'smile')

	local emoticons = {}

	self.all_pals_iter:foreach(function(_, pal)
		table.insert(emoticons, character_util.show_emoticon(pal, nil, 'happy'))
	end)

	local wait_duration = 2.5
	local time_passed = 0

	while (time_passed < wait_duration) and not self.is_action_stopped do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(pals)

	linq(emoticons):foreach(function(_, emoticon)
		emoticon:Dispose()
	end)

	if not self.is_action_stopped then
		self:set_pals_following_player()
	end

	self:set_pal_crash_state(pal_crash_state.npc)
end

function pal_manager:debug_set_pals_at_player()
	self.following_iter:foreach(function(_, pal)
		character_util.set_position(pal, get_party_leader().Position)
	end)

	self:set_pals_following_player()
end

function pal_manager:is_eat_food_pal(pal)
	local boolean = false

	if self.is_eat_food_data[pal.Name] ~= nil then
		boolean = true
	end

	return boolean
end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractCancelEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.researcher()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.found_wyvern
		self:add_rock_interact()
		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_found_wyvern, self)
	elseif self.current_state > self.states.none and
			self:is_interactable_rock(e.Target) then
		self.pal_manager:cancel_pals_action()
		self.pal_manager:set_pal_crash_state(pal_crash_state.ethereal)
		self.pal_manager:set_pals_not_following_player()
		self.pal_manager:align_pals_at_rock(e.Target)

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.rescued_wyvern and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmicks.door_1()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.door_opened
		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_open_s2_door, self)

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.door_opened and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmicks.silver_ore()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.picked_silver_ore
		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_mining_silver_ores, self)

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.picked_silver_ore then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.researcher()) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_creating_iron_ingots, self)
			return true
		end

		if string.find(e.Target.Name, self.pal_name_prefix) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_order_stop_eating, self, e.Target)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.creating_iron_ingot and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.researcher()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_creating_bazooka, self)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_cancel_event(e)
	if self:is_interactable_rock(e.Target) then
		self.pal_manager:cancel_pals_action()
		self.pal_manager:remove_pals_anim()
		self.pal_manager:set_pals_following_player()
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_finish_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.found_wyvern and self:is_interactable_rock(e.Target) then
		start_coroutine(self.pal_manager.play_pal_job_complition_reaction, self.pal_manager)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_03')
		self.fx:obj_smoke():Instantiate(e.Target.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		e.Target.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

		if self:had_all_gimmicks_destroyed() then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_wyvern_rescued, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state > self.states.none and self.current_state < self.states.creating_iron_ingot then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_pal_s2_out_of_event_area') then
			self.pal_manager:set_pals_not_following_player()
			self.pal_manager:align_pals_at_event_area_boundary()
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_pal_s2_entered_event_area') then
			self.pal_manager:cancel_pals_action()
			self.pal_manager:set_pals_following_player()
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.picked_silver_ore then
		local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
		local zone_name_pattern = 'sub_pal_food_zone_'

		if e.FullEnter and zone_name:find(zone_name_pattern) ~= nil and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then

			local resource_type = zone_name:gsub(zone_name_pattern, ''):gsub('_%d', '')
			local pal_food = self.pal_foods[self.sprite_id[resource_type]]

			if pal_food ~= nil and not pal_food:is_slot_occupied() then
				local pal_type, pal = self.pal_manager:get_first_pal()

				if pal_type ~= nil and pal ~= nil then
					self.pal_manager.is_eat_food_data[pal.Name] = true
					start_coroutine(self.pal_moves_to_food, self, pal_type, pal, pal_food)
				end
			end
		end

		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.found_wyvern and self:had_all_gimmicks_destroyed() then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_wyvern_rescued, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_auto_quest_marker(target)
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('palworld', {
		{ zone = 'main_field_1', target = get_field_object('sub_pal_enter_lab_stair') },
		{ zone = 'main_field_2', target = get_field_object('passage_exit_2') },
		{ zone = 'main_field_3', target = get_field_object('passage_exit_4') },
		{ zone = 'main_field_4', target = get_field_object('passage_exit_6') },
		{ zone = 'main_field_5', target = target },
	})
end

function local_class:enable_door_1_interactable()
	local door = self.gimmicks.door_1()
	door.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:create_star_piece_effect()
	if self.star_piece_effect == nil then
		local pos = get_field_object('sub_pal_bazooka_rock_3').Position
		self.star_piece_effect = self.fx.star_piece_effect():Instantiate(pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_star_piece_effect()
	if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:place_sprites()
	local marker_names = {
		'sub_pal_silver_ore_1',
		'sub_pal_silver_ore_2',
		'sub_pal_silver_ore_3',
		'sub_pal_silver_ore_4',
		'sub_pal_iron_ingot_1',
		'sub_pal_iron_ingot_2',
		'sub_pal_iron_ingot_3',
		'sub_pal_iron_ingot_4',
	}

	local create_item = function(marker, id)
		return drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(marker),
			itemid = id,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			showonecharacter = false
		})
	end

	for i = 1, #marker_names do
		local resource_type = marker_names[i]:gsub('sub_pal_', ''):gsub('_%d', '')
		local resource_id = self.sprite_id[resource_type]
		self.sprites:add_item(resource_id, create_item(marker_names[i], resource_id))
	end

	local fal_food_marker_names = {
		'sub_pal_water_mineral',
		'sub_pal_canned_soup',
		'sub_pal_corn',
	}

	for i = 1, #fal_food_marker_names do
		local resource_type = fal_food_marker_names[i]:gsub('sub_pal_', ''):gsub('_%d', '')
		local resource_id = self.sprite_id[resource_type]
		self.pal_foods[self.sprite_id[resource_type]] = pal_food(create_item(fal_food_marker_names[i], resource_id))
	end
end

function local_class:place_pals()
	local init_required_pals = {
		self.characters.hedgehog(),
		self.characters.wolf(),
		self.characters.pink_rabbit()
	}

	local marker_fmt = '%s_pos'

	for _, pal in ipairs(init_required_pals) do
		local marker = field_util.get_marker(marker_fmt:format(pal.Name))
		character_util.set_position_from_marker(pal, marker)
		scene_util.set_anim(pal, self, 'eat')
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_sprites()
	self.sprites:dispose_all()
	self.sprites = nil

	for k, v in pairs(self.pal_foods) do
		v:dispose()
		v = nil
	end

	self.pal_foods = nil
end

function local_class:init_wyvern_setting()
	local wyvern = self.characters.wyvern()
	character_util.set_scale_factor(wyvern, wyvern.Name, 2)
	character_util.set_position(wyvern, field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_pal_s2_wyvern_pos'))
	character_util.set_direction(wyvern, 'left')

	scene_util.set_anim(wyvern, self, 'sleep')
	scene_util.set_emotion(wyvern, self, 'tired')
end

function local_class:init_rescued_pals()
	-- 이전 섹션에서 사용 되었던 화로나 테슬라 등의 효과는 유지되지 않는다.
	local goat = self.characters.white_goat()
	goat.Electrocutable = CS.Oak.NonElectrocutable.Instance

	local pony = self.characters.pony()
	pony.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.NonCombustibleBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:init_researcher_setting()
	local researcher = self.characters.researcher()
	scene_util.set_emotion(researcher, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(researcher, self, 'cast')
	character_util.set_position(researcher, field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_pal_s2_reseacher_pos'))
	character_util.set_direction(researcher, 'down')
	character_util.add_listener(researcher, self)
end

function local_class:is_interactable_rock(target)
	return linq(self.gimmicks.rocks()):any(function(rock, _)
		return lua_helper.reference_equals(rock, target)
	end)
end

-- 이벤트 존 안에 모든 기믹이 파괴되어 있는지 확인
function local_class:had_all_gimmicks_destroyed()
	local target_zone = field:GetZone(self.wyvern_gimmick_area)
	local field_objects = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(target_zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local num_gimmicks = 0

	local gimmick_prefix = 'GIMMICK'
	local rock_prefix = 'sub_pal_rock_'

	for i = 0, field_objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo_name = field_objects[i].Name

		if fo_name:find(gimmick_prefix) or fo_name:find(rock_prefix) then
			num_gimmicks = num_gimmicks + 1
		end
	end

	return num_gimmicks == 0
end

--#region 연출
function local_class:scene_found_wyvern()
	local vampire_lord = get_party_leader()
	local researcher = self.characters.researcher()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--팔로우 동물들의 홀더블 상태 제거
	self:exit_monster_setting()

	--동물들이 연구소 밖에 나가지 못하게 하는 로직 멈춤
	self.controller.is_control_animals_in_lab = false
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove(researcher.Name)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(researcher, self)

	-- 0.5초간 클로드 연구원 우측에 정렬
	character_util.move_to_async(vampire_lord, researcher.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 0.5, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(vampire_lord, 'down')

	-- 정렬 끝난 후 1초간 카메라 4칸 하단으로 이동 0.5초 대기 1초간 다시 플레이어에게 복귀
	camera_util.move_async(vampire_lord.Position + vector(0, 0, -4), 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 연구원(여)(down,damaged,idle): 으윽…! 이래서 대형 동물은 들이지 말자고 한 건데!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'down', nil, 'damged', 'nm_ds_palworld_s2_1')

	-- 클로드 (left) 방향
	character_util.set_direction(vampire_lord, 'left')

	-- 연구원(여)(right,tired,cast): 또 혼자 놀다가 벽을 다 무너뜨리고 갇혀버린 모양이에요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'right', 'cast', 'tired', 'nm_ds_palworld_s2_2')

	-- 연구원(여)(right,attack,relesae 2회): 제가 치료제를 준비하는 동안 길을 좀 열어주시겠어요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'attack',
			'nm_ds_palworld_s2_3')

	-- 클로드(left,idle,bomb_idle): 저정도 잔해면 시간이 좀 걸릴 것 같군.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, 'left', 'bomb_idle', nil, 'nm_ds_palworld_s2_4')

	-- 연구원(여)(right,attack,idle)(jump1회): 그건 걱정마세요!
	character_util.normal_jump(researcher, '01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'right', nil, 'attack', 'nm_ds_palworld_s2_5')

	-- 연구원 클로드 (up) 방향
	character_util.set_group_direction({ researcher, vampire_lord }, 'up')

	local pal_move_marker_name = '%s_s2_move_1_%s'
	local num_ended = 0
	local move_end_key = 'move_end'
	local pal_iter = linq(self.pal_manager:get_all_pals())
	local num_rescued_pals = 3

	-- 상단에 구출했던 동물들이 해당 대열로 속도 4 (walk) 애니메이션으로 내려온다.
	-- (1)(pasture_pet_fluffy_goat#pasture_pet_fluffy_goat_white)(파란 양)
	-- (2)(pasture_pet_pony#pasture_pet_pony_day)(불 말)
	-- (3)(pasture_pet_rabbit#pasture_pet_rabbit_ghost)(토끼)
	pal_iter:foreach(function(_, pal)
		local wp = { field_util.get_marker_pos(pal_move_marker_name:format(pal.Name, 'dest')) }
		local wp_data = {
			end_callback = function()
				num_ended = num_ended + 1
			end
		}
		character_util.set_position(pal, field_util.get_marker_pos(pal_move_marker_name:format(pal.Name, 'start')))
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(pal, wp, 4, nil, self, move_end_key, wp_data)
	end)

	while num_ended ~= num_rescued_pals do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 클로드 (left) 방향
	character_util.set_direction(vampire_lord, 'left')

	-- 연구원(여)(right,attack,cast): 이 동물들이 백작님을 도와줄 거에요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'right', 'cast', 'attack', 'nm_ds_palworld_s2_6')

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 해제 이 후 (1)(2)(3)이 클로드 뒤에 팔로우로 붙는다.
	self.pal_manager:set_pals_following_player()

	-- 컨트롤 해제 될 때 연구원 충돌안되는 상태로 상단 데스크 우측으로 0.5초간 이동 (walk) 애니메이션 (left,tired,eat) 상태가 된다.
	researcher.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- 원라인 대사: 내가 치료제를 어디다 뒀더라?
	researcher.Interactable.Talk = 'nm_ds_palworld_s2_7'

	local researcher_move_dest = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_pal_s2_researcher_desk_pos')
	local researcher_wp_data = {
		end_callback = function()
			self.researcher_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
				loop = true,
				parent = researcher,
				type_priority = 'event',
				player_priority = 'npc',
				max_distance = 4,
				volume = 0.5
			})

			scene_util.set_emotion(researcher, self, 'tired')
			scene_util.set_anim(researcher, self, 'eat')
			character_util.set_direction(researcher, 'left')
		end
	}
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(researcher, { researcher_move_dest }, nil, 0.5, self, nil, researcher_wp_data)

	self:set_auto_quest_marker(self.characters.wyvern())

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

-- ===========================================================
--                  굶주려 뒤져가고 있던 와이번 구출
-- ===========================================================
function local_class:scene_wyvern_rescued()
	self.current_state = self.states.rescued_wyvern

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local vampire_lord = get_party_leader()
	local wyvern = self.characters.wyvern()
	local researcher = self.characters.researcher()

	-- 클로드 와 동물들 좌측 정렬 위치까지 (walk) 애니메이션 속도 4로 이동
	-- 전원 (right,idle,idle)
	wp_util.move(vampire_lord, { field_util.get_marker_pos('vampire_lord_wyvern') }, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
	self.pal_manager:set_pals_following_player()
	self.pal_manager:cancel_pals_action()
	self.pal_manager:align_pals_with_marker('%s_creating_iron_ingot', 4)

	-- 상단에 연구원 경로따라 해당 위치까지 (walk) 애니메이션 속도 4로 이동
	-- (down,idle,idle)
	local researcher_pos = researcher.Position
	local researcher_wp = {
		researcher_pos + vector(0, 0, -2),
		researcher_pos + vector(-4.5, 0, -2),
		researcher_pos + vector(-4.5, 0, -4.5),
	}

	self.researcher_sfx:Stop()
	self.researcher_sfx = nil
	character_util.remove_anim(researcher)
	wp_util.move(researcher, researcher_wp, 4)

	-- 연구원 이동 경로에 pushable 있을 수 있으니
	-- 	카메라 1초간 빨간원(와이번) 위치로 이동

	camera_util.move_to_target_async(wyvern, 1, { end_target = wyvern })

	-- 와이번(shake0.03/0.5초)
	scene_util.normal_shake(wyvern, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 와이번(left,damaged,idle) 1초
	scene_util.set_emotion(wyvern, self, 'damaged')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 와이번이 (damaged) 표정 속도 2 (walk) 애니메이션으로 좌측 정렬 위치까지 이동
	character_util.remove_anim(wyvern)

	do
		local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_03', loop = true})

		wp_util.move_async(wyvern, { field_util.get_marker_pos('wyvern_rescue_move_dest') }, 2, nil)

		sfx:Stop()
		sfx = nil
	end

	-- 와이번 이동 끝나면 (left,damaged,sleep)
	scene_util.set_anim(wyvern, self, 'sleep')

	-- 연구원(여)(down,tired,relesae 2회): 얘도 여기서 또 한 며칠을 굶은 거 같네…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'tired',
			'nm_ds_palworld_s2_8')

	-- 연구원(여)(left,tired,sing): 백작님 마지막으로 하나만 더 부탁드리겠습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'left', 'sing', 'tired', 'nm_ds_palworld_s2_9')

	-- 클로드(남)(right,sleep_deep,nod 2회): 이제 마지막인가… 알겠다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			'sleep_deep',
			'nm_ds_palworld_s2_10')

	local card_key = nil
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(researcher, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1, sfx_name = function()
		card_key = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = researcher.Position,
			target = vampire_lord.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0),
			itemid = self.sprite_id.ticket,
			notforinven = true,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			showoncharacter = true,
			skip_text = true
		})
	end })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	if (card_key ~= nil) then
		drop_item_util.consumed(card_key, vampire_lord)
	end

	-- 연구원(여)(up,idle,release 2회): 저기 위쪽에 창고가 있어요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil,
			'nm_ds_palworld_s2_11')

	-- 카메라 1초간 좌측 상단 빨간 화살표 표시된 도어까지 이동 후 0.5초 대기 1초간 복귀.
	local door = self.gimmicks.door_1()
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(door, 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 연구원(여)(left,idle,idle): 저 창고에 광석이 있을거에요! 그걸 가져와주세요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'left', nil, nil, 'nm_ds_palworld_s2_12')

	-- 연구원(여)(left,smile,cast): 동물들이 가져오는 걸 도와줄테니 금방 끝나실거에요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true },
			'smile',
			'nm_ds_palworld_s2_13')

	-- 연구원(여)(left,tired,eat) 으로 변경 후 플레이어 컨트롤 해제
	self.researcher_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		loop = true,
		parent = researcher,
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc',
		max_distance = 4,
		volume = 0.5
	})

	scene_util.set_emotion(researcher, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(researcher, self, 'eat')

	-- 원라인: 자, 얼른 약먹고 밥먹자.
	researcher.Interactable.Talk = 'nm_ds_palworld_s2_14'

	self:enable_door_1_interactable()
	self.pal_manager:set_pals_following_player()

	-- 컨트롤 해제 시점에 하단 [1]번 스프라이트에 서브 퀘스트 마커

	researcher.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self:set_auto_quest_marker(self.gimmicks.silver_ore())

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

-- ===========================================================
--                  은 원석 획득
-- ===========================================================
function local_class:scene_mining_silver_ores()
	-- 최적화 필요
	local party_iter = linq({ get_party_leader() }):concat(linq(self.pal_manager:get_following_pals()))
	local party = party_iter:to_array()

	-- 클로드와 동물 (1)(2)(3) 스프라이트 주변에 정렬
	local marker_name_fmt = 'silver_ore_%s'
	local num_aligned = 0
	local num_party_member = user_party.Count
	local sfx = nil

	party_iter:foreach(function(_, fo)
		local marker = field_util.get_marker(marker_name_fmt:format(fo.Name))
		local wp = { marker.position }
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fo, wp, nil, 0.5, self, nil,
				{
					last_direction = marker.direction,
					end_callback = function()
						scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'eat')
						num_aligned = num_aligned + 1
					end,
				})
	end)

	while num_aligned ~= num_party_member do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)
	sfx:Stop()
	sfx = nil

	local silver_ores = self.sprites:get_items(self.sprite_id.silver_ore)
	linq(silver_ores):foreach(function(idx, ore)
		drop_item_util.consumed(ore, party[idx])
	end)

	character_util.remove_group_anim(party)

	self.sprites:clear_items(self.sprite_id.silver_ore)

	-- 이 후 연구원에게 서브 퀘스트 마커가 찍힌다.
	local researcher = self.characters.researcher()
	character_util.add_listener(researcher, self)

	self:set_auto_quest_marker(self.characters.researcher())

	self.gimmicks.silver_ore().ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
end

-- ===========================================================
--                  은 주괴 제작
-- ===========================================================
function local_class:scene_creating_iron_ingots()

	local vampire_lord = get_party_leader()
	local researcher = self.characters.researcher()
	local pals = self.pal_manager:get_following_pals()
	local wyvern = self.characters.wyvern()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	-- 연구원 좌측으로 해당 대열로 1초간 정렬
	self.pal_manager:align_pals_with_marker('%s_creating_iron_ingot', nil, 1)
	wp_util.move_async(vampire_lord, { field_util.get_marker_pos('vampire_lord_wyvern') }, 1, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	-- 모든 동물을 소지하고 있지 않을 경우
	if #pals < 3 then
		self.researcher_sfx:Stop()
		self.researcher_sfx = nil

		-- 연구원(left,tired,question): 동물을 창고에 놓고 오신 모양이에요…!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'question', loop = false },
				{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
				'nm_ds_palworld_s2_15')

		-- 연구원(left,tired,release 2회): 창고로 돌아가서 다시 데려와주세요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
				nil,
				'nm_ds_palworld_s2_16')

		-- 연구원 다시 (left,tired,eat) 상태
		self.researcher_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
			loop = true,
			parent = researcher,
			type_priority = 'event',
			player_priority = 'npc',
			max_distance = 2,
			volume = 0.3
		})
		scene_util.set_anim(researcher, self, 'eat')

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

		return
	end

	-- 모든 동물을 소지하고 있을 경우
	self.current_state = self.states.creating_iron_ingot

	-- 연구원(left,smile,cast): 좋아요! 제대로 챙겨오셨군요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	self.researcher_sfx:Stop()
	self.researcher_sfx = nil
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'left', 'cast', 'smile', 'nm_ds_palworld_s2_17')

	-- 연구원(left,smile,release2회): 자, 이제 가져온 광석을 저 앞에다 두세요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'smile',
			'nm_ds_palworld_s2_18')

	-- 동물 (1)(2)(3) (down,idle,idle)(jump1회) 클로드(down,idle,attack)
	character_util.set_direction(vampire_lord, 'down')
	character_util.group_normal_jump(pals, '01_small_jump_01')

	local silver_ores = {}
	local silver_ore_marker_name = 'sub_pal_silver_ore_creating_iron_%d'

	local create_iron_ingot = function(from, to)
		local silver_ore = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = self.sprite_id.silver_ore,
			pos = from,
			target = to,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			showonecharacter = false
		})

		return silver_ore
	end

	linq(pals):foreach(function(idx, pal)
		character_util.set_direction(pal, 'down')
		character_util.normal_jump(pal)
		local silver_ore = create_iron_ingot(
				pal.Position,
				field_util.get_marker_pos(silver_ore_marker_name:format(idx)))
		table.insert(silver_ores, silver_ore)
	end)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(vampire_lord, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx_name = function()
		-- 동시에 dropitemutil 로 광석을 1개씩 각 4개 (상단에 겹쳐있던 상태와 동일하게) 를 하단 네모 위치로 던짐
		local silver_ore = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = self.sprite_id.silver_ore,
			pos = vampire_lord.Position,
			target = field_util.get_marker_pos(silver_ore_marker_name:format(4)),
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			showonecharacter = false
		})

		table.insert(silver_ores, silver_ore)
	end })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 연구원(down,mad,release 2회): 뭐해, 와이번! 빨리 일어나서 일해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(researcher, {dir = 'down', sfx = false})
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'mad',
			'nm_ds_palworld_s2_19')

	-- 와이번(left,damaged,idle) sleep->idle 전환속도 0.1 배
	scene_util.set_emotion(wyvern, self, 'damaged')

	scene_util.set_anim_async(wyvern, self, { name = 'idle', scale = 0, mix_duration = 1 })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 와이번(left,attack,victory)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dragon_02')
	scene_util.set_emotion(wyvern, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(wyvern, self, 'victory')

	-- 와이번 위치에서 좌측으로 FX_Flamethrower 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fire_06')
	local flame = self.fx.flamethrower():Instantiate(wyvern.Position + vector(-0.25, 0.1, 0.7))
	flame.transform.eulerAngles = vector(0, -107, 0)
	-- 출력 2초 지난 후 fx_dead 와 함께 각 광석 위치에 iron_ingot 로 변경됨
	wait_for_sec(2)

	local iron_ingots = {    }
	linq(silver_ores):foreach(function(_, ore)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01', 0.5)
		self.fx.dead():Instantiate(ore.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

		local ingot = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = self.sprite_id.iron_ingot,
			pos = ore.Position,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			showonecharacter = false,
			skip_text = true
		})

		table.insert(iron_ingots, ingot)

		ore:ConsumeComplete()
		ore = nil
	end)

	silver_ores = nil

	-- 변경되고 1초 후 FX_Flamethrower 제거 와이번 (left,tired,sleep)으로 변경
	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.set_emotion(wyvern, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(wyvern, self, 'sleep')

	flame:Dispose()
	flame = nil

	-- 연구원(smile, success): 좋아요! 이제 준비는 끝났어요!
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(researcher, {dir = 'left', sfx = false})
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'left',
			'success',
			'smile',
			'nm_ds_palworld_s2_20')

	-- 연구원 [1] 번 위치까지 (walk) 1초간 이동 후 (left,idle,eat) 철주괴를 획득한다.
	local researcher_wp_name = 'sub_pal_creating_ingots_researcher_wp_%d'
	local researcher_wp = {
		field_util.get_marker_pos(researcher_wp_name:format(1)),
		field_util.get_marker_pos(researcher_wp_name:format(2)),
	}
	wp_util.move_async(researcher, researcher_wp, nil, 1, {
		last_direction = 'left'
	})

	for i = 1, #iron_ingots do
		drop_item_util.consumed(iron_ingots[i], researcher)
	end

	do
		local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
		scene_util.set_anim(researcher, self, 'eat')
		wait_for_sec(1)
		sfx:Stop()
		sfx = nil
	end

	-- 이 후 상단으로 [2]위치까지 속도 7로 이동 후
	researcher_wp = {
		field_util.get_marker_pos(researcher_wp_name:format(1)),
		field_util.get_marker_pos(researcher_wp_name:format(3)),
	}
	wp_util.move_async(researcher, researcher_wp, 7, 1)

	-- 연구원(down,smile,release 2회): 발명품의 준비는 다 끝났어요! 성능을 보여드릴게요!
	-- 이때 클로드 (up)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_direction(vampire_lord, 'up')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'smile',
			'nm_ds_palworld_s2_21')

	-- 연구원 속도 7로 우측 이동 시작 빨간색 표시한 도어 개방
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.gimmicks.door_2().Name))
	wp_util.move(researcher, { researcher.Position + vector(7, 0, 0) }, 7, nil, {
		last_direction = 'right',
		end_callback = function()
			character_util.set_position(researcher,
					field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_pal_researcher_creating_bazooka'))
			scene_util.set_anim(researcher, self, 'eat')
		end
	})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.pal_manager:set_pals_not_following_player()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	-- 연구원 이동 1초 후 플레이어 컨트롤 해제
	-- 동물들 더이상 팔로워로 따라붙지 않음.
end

-- ===========================================================
--                  바주카 제작
-- ===========================================================
function local_class:scene_creating_bazooka()
	local vampire_lord = get_party_leader()
	local researcher = self.characters.researcher()
	local rabbit = self.characters.pink_rabbit()
	local hedgehog = self.characters.hedgehog()
	local wolf = self.characters.wolf()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	quest_marker_util.remove(researcher.Name)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(researcher, self)
	researcher.Interactable.Talk = ''

	-- 연구원 인터랙트시 클로드 0.5초간 좌측 1칸 옆에 정렬
	character_util.move_to_async(vampire_lord, researcher.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(vampire_lord, 'right')

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 연구원 (1)(2)(3) 동물 애니메이션 (idle)로 변경
	-- 이때 iron_ingot 각각 4개가 모두 fx_dead와 함께 사라지고
	-- 중앙에 qc_android_bazooka 로 변경된다.
	character_util.remove_group_anim({ researcher, rabbit, hedgehog, wolf })


	linq(self.sprites:get_items(self.sprite_id.iron_ingot)):foreach(function(_, ingot)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01', 0.5)
		self.fx.dead():Instantiate(ingot.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	end)

	self.sprites:dispose_items(self.sprite_id.iron_ingot)

	local bazooka = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = self.sprite_id.bazooka,
		pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_pal_bazooka_pos'),
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		showonecharacter = true,
		sprscale = 0.8,
		skip_text = true
	})

	-- 연구원(여)(right,smile,idle)(jump1회): 좋았어! 완성이야!
	character_util.normal_jump(researcher, '01_small_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'right',
			nil,
			'smile',
			'nm_ds_palworld_s2_22')

	-- 클로드(남)(right,idle,bomb_idle): 그게 이번에 만든 발명품인가?
	character_util.set_direction(researcher, 'left')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle',
			nil,
			'nm_ds_palworld_s2_23')

	-- 이때 연구원(left)

	-- 연구원(여)(left,smile,nod2회): 네, 맞습니다! 놀라울정도로 강력한 무기에요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			'smile',
			'nm_ds_palworld_s2_24')

	-- 연구원(여)(left,attack,release 2회): 지금바로 성능을 보여드리겠습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'attack',
			'nm_ds_palworld_s2_25')

	-- 이때 (2)(3)(right) 방향
	character_util.set_group_direction({ wolf, rabbit }, 'right')

	-- 연구원이 0.5초간 0.5칸 우측 이동 후
	character_util.move_distance_async(researcher, vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.5, nil, true, true)

	-- 연구원(여)(right,attack,eat) 0.5초
	do
		local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clang_01',
												 loop = true,
												 type_priority = 'event',
												 player_priority = 'npc',
		})
		scene_util.play_wait_action(researcher, self, 'right', 'eat', 'attack', 0.5)

		sfx:Stop()
		sfx = nil
	end

	-- 해당 1초 동안 하단 연출 진행
	-- (1)(고슴도치)가 (left,tired,idle) 상태
	scene_util.set_emotion(hedgehog, self, 'tired')

	-- y 높이 1의 점프로 바주카 위치까지 이동
	-- 1초 동안 고슴도치 scale 100->50
	-- 이동할때 좌측 방향으로 1회전
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_02')
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(self.resize_character, self, hedgehog, 1, 0.5, 0.5),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.spine_rotate(hedgehog, -360, 1)
			character_util.jump_move(hedgehog, bazooka.Position, 4, 0, nil, nil)
		end)
	})

	-- 이동 끝나면 fx_get 과 함께 소멸
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_comic_01')
	self.fx.get():Instantiate(hedgehog.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	character_util.set_active_state(hedgehog, 'disabled')

	-- 이때 클로드(right,attack,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(vampire_lord, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(vampire_lord)

	-- 연구원(여)(right,attack,eat) 0.5초
	-- 이때 바주카가 연구원에게 흡수됨
	drop_item_util.consumed(bazooka, researcher)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 연구원(여)(right,attack,rifle_reload / loopX): 자… 발사!
	-- 손에 바주카를 들고 있음
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_03')
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(researcher, '[base]weapon1', 'qc_android_bazooka')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false },
			nil,
			'nm_ds_palworld_s2_26')

	local is_hedgehog_moving = true

	-- 연구원(여)(right,attack,rifle_shoot 1회)
	-- 해당 애니메이션 재생 시작부터 타임 스케일 0.2
	local time_mod_key = 'sub_pal'
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_04')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
	time_util.mod(time_mod_key, 0.2)
	scene_util.set_anim(researcher, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false })

	local hedgehog_move = function()
		-- fx_obj_smoke 와 함께 연구원 앞에 (1) 동물 생성
		local smoke_fx = self.fx.obj_smoke():Instantiate(vector(47.5, 0.25, 95.55))
		smoke_fx.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 1, 0.5)

		-- 고슴도치 (right,damaged,idle) 1초에 우측으로 2회 회전함
		scene_util.set_emotion(hedgehog, self, 'damaged')

function local_class:resize_character(fo, start_scale, end_scale, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local current_scale = start_scale + (end_scale - start_scale) * progress

		fo.transform.localScale = vector(current_scale, current_scale, current_scale)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class NightmareDemonShireRecordChamberController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('NightmareDemonShireRecordChamberController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 현재 서브 퀘스트 id
	self.cur_quest_id = 409

	-- 메인 퀘스트 id
	self.main_quest_id = 406

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = false,
		NormalSectionCount = 1,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	self.teleport_pos = {
		inside_event_area  = 1,
		outside_event_area  = 2,
	}

	self.zone_names = {
		inside_event_area  = 'record_chamber_magic_circle_1',
		outside_event_area  = 'record_chamber_magic_circle_2',
	}

	self.gimmicks = {
		elevator_on_1st_floor = function() return get_field_object('record_chamber_elevator_outer_1') end,
		elevator_on_13th_floor = function() return get_field_object('record_chamber_elevator_outer_2') end,
	}

	--npc
	self.npc = {
		goat_girl = function()
			return get_character('goat_girl')
		end,
	}

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		leader_align      = function(floor, pos_idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('record_chamber_' .. floor .. '_align_' .. pos_idx)
		end,

		magiccircle      = function(in_n_out, pos_idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('record_chamber_magic_circle_' .. in_n_out .. '_' .. pos_idx)
		end,

		floor_arrival_point      = function(floor_state)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('record_chamber_magic_' .. floor_state .. '_floor_stair')
		end,
	}



	-- fx 이펙트
	self.fx = {
		cached_inst = {},

		teleport = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('MagicCircle_AppearIdle')
		end,

		cache = function(this, fx)
			table.insert(this.cached_inst, fx)
		end,

		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if type_util.is_function(load_func) and
						name ~= 'load_all' and
						name ~= 'cache' and
						name ~= 'dispose' then

					load_func()
				end
			end
		end,

		dispose = function(this, clear_table)
			for i = 1, #this.cached_inst do
				this.cached_inst[i]:Dispose()
				this.cached_inst[i] = nil
			end

			if clear_table then
				this.cached_inst = nil
			end
		end
	}

	-- 엘리베이터 지하 17층 선택 시도 이벤트 본 것인지 체크
	self.passed_select_17_floors_below_1 = false
	self.passed_select_17_floors_below_2 = false

	self.exited_choose_state_at_1_floor = false

	-- 엘리베이터 오브젝트 애니메이터 캐싱할 리스트
	self.elevator_animator_list = nil
	self.elevator_animator_state_name_list = { 'wall_rift_wall_up', 'obj_rift_chain_up', 'obj_lift_chain_down',
											   'obj_rift_cogwhee', 'obj_rift_chain_up', 'obj_rift_chain_down',
											   'obj_rift_cogwhee', 'obj_rift_chain_down', 'obj_rift_chain_up', 'obj_rift_cogwhee' }

	-- 엘리베이터 바닥 애니메이터
	self.elevator_floor_ani = nil

	self.first_use_elevator = true

	-- 엘리베이터 선택지 중 안으로 들어가지 않는 선택지 고른 상황 체크
	self.is_entering_elevator  = false

	-- 이전에 쿠로 파티 탈퇴한 적이 있는지 체크
	self.has_left_party_before  = false

	self.amb_loop_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.elevator_animator_list = nil
	self.elevator_floor_ani = nil

	if self.fx ~= nil then
		self.fx:dispose(true)
	end

	if self.amb_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.amb_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.amb_loop_sfx = nil
	end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmicks.elevator_on_1st_floor()) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmicks.elevator_on_13th_floor()) then
		local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.cur_quest_id)

		if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.play_no_elevator_notice, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.zone_names.inside_event_area) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_magic_circle, self, self.teleport_pos.outside_event_area)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.zone_names.outside_event_area) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_magic_circle, self, self.teleport_pos.inside_event_area)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self:set()
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:set()
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.cur_quest_id)

	if quest_progress ~= nil and not quest_progress.IsComplete then
		-- 엘레베이터 애니메이션 캐싱
		self.elevator_animator_list = {}
		local elevator_anim_count = 10
		for i = 1, elevator_anim_count do
			local cargo_elevator = get_field_object('record_chamber_elevator_obj_' .. i)
			local animator = cargo_elevator:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

			table.insert(self.elevator_animator_list, { elevator_anim = animator, anim_state = self.elevator_animator_state_name_list[i] })
		end

		-- 엘레베이터 애니메이터 세팅
		local layer = field.Tilemap.Transform:Find('obj_rift').gameObject
		local elevator_object = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(layer.transform, 'floor_rift_1')
		self.elevator_floor_ani = elevator_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	else
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('record_door_1', true))
	end

	self.fx:cache(self.fx:teleport():Instantiate(self.markers.magiccircle('in', 1)))
	self.fx:cache(self.fx:teleport():Instantiate(self.markers.magiccircle('in', 2)))
end

function local_class:interact_elevator(first_interact, current_floor, is_floor_destruction_condition_met)
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local goat_girl = self.npc.goat_girl()
	local move_key = 'align_party'
	local duration = 1

	self.exited_choose_state_at_1_floor = false

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, self.markers.leader_align((current_floor == 1)  and 1 or 3, 1), nil,
			duration, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'up' })

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party[i], leader) then
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(user_party[i], self.markers.leader_align((current_floor == 1)  and 1 or 3, 1) + vector(0, 0, -1 * i), nil,
					duration, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		end
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 내레이션 박스
	-- 어느 층으로 가시겠습니까?
	local nar_data = {
		key = 'nm_ds_record_chamber_elevator_1_1'
	}

	-- 엘리베이터 선택지
	local choose_data = {}

	if not self.passed_select_17_floors_below_1 then
		-- 지하 17층
		table.insert(choose_data, { 'nm_ds_record_chamber_elevator_1_2', 'normal' })
	end

	-- 13층 or 1층
	local select_floor_stringkey = (current_floor == 1)  and 3 or 5
	table.insert(choose_data, { 'nm_ds_record_chamber_elevator_1_' .. select_floor_stringkey, 'normal' })

	-- 물러난다.
	table.insert(choose_data, { 'nm_ds_record_chamber_elevator_1_4', 'normal' })

	local choose_result = field_ui_util.show_narration_talk_branch_async(nar_data, choose_data)

	if (choose_result == 2 and self.passed_select_17_floors_below_1) or choose_result == 3 then
		--물러난다.
		-- 컨트롤 해제.
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

		self.exited_choose_state_at_1_floor = true

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

		return
	end

	-- 클로드 up, idle, attack 1회
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')

	if choose_result == 1 then
		if not self.passed_select_17_floors_below_1 then
			self:select_17_floors_below()

			-- 컨트롤 해제.
			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

			self.exited_choose_state_at_1_floor = true

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

			return
		else
			self.is_entering_elevator = true

			if not is_floor_destruction_condition_met then

				end
			end
		end
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		self.is_entering_elevator = true

		if not is_floor_destruction_condition_met then
			if first_interact then
				self:select_13_floors_for_the_first()
			else
				self:take_elevator_normal_situation((current_floor == 1)  and 13 or 1)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:enter_elevator()

function local_class:stop_elevator(fade_out_amb)
	local fade_out_sfx = lua_helper.get_or_default(fade_out_amb, true)

	-- 엘레베이터 멈춤 연출
	local time_passed = 0
	local stop_time = 2
	while time_passed < stop_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / stop_time
		local speed = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(1, 0, progress)
		for i = 1, #self.elevator_animator_list do
			self.elevator_animator_list[i].elevator_anim.speed = speed
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_02')

	if fade_out_sfx then
		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.amb_loop_sfx, 1)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.elevator_animator_list do
		self.elevator_animator_list[i].elevator_anim.speed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:move_elevator(ascend)

	for i = 1, #self.elevator_animator_list do
		local state_name = ascend == true and
				self.elevator_animator_list[i].anim_state or self.elevator_animator_list[i].anim_state .. '_revert'

		self.elevator_animator_list[i].elevator_anim:Play(state_name)
	end

	-- 엘레베이터 다시 재생 연출
	local time_passed = 0
	local stop_time = 2
	while time_passed < stop_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / stop_time
		local speed = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 1, progress)
		for i = 1, #self.elevator_animator_list do
			self.elevator_animator_list[i].elevator_anim.speed = speed
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.elevator_animator_list do
		self.elevator_animator_list[i].elevator_anim.speed = 1
	end
end

function local_class:break_elevator_floor(step)
	-- 1단계 부셔지는 연출 시작
	self.elevator_floor_ani:Play('rift_floor_break' .. step)
end

function local_class:take_elevator_normal_situation(selected_floor)
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	-- 탑승 층의 엘리베이터 문 처리
	local elevator_entrance = (selected_floor == 1)  and self.gimmicks.elevator_on_13th_floor() or self.gimmicks.elevator_on_1st_floor()
	local elevator_entrance_animator = elevator_entrance:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	elevator_entrance_animator:Play('open')

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	elevator_entrance_animator:Play('close')

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down', false)
	character_util.set_position(leader, self.markers.leader_align(2, 1))

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(leader, 1, 0)

	local min_accel_state = true
	start_coroutine(function()
		self:move_elevator(selected_floor > 1)

		min_accel_state = false
	end)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.amb_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_elevator_06', loop = true })

	-- 카메라 1초간 검게 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	while min_accel_state do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(4)

	self:stop_elevator()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(leader, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_position(leader, self.markers.leader_align((selected_floor == 1)  and 1 or 3, 1) + vector(0, 0, 2))

	elevator_entrance = (selected_floor == 1)  and self.gimmicks.elevator_on_1st_floor() or self.gimmicks.elevator_on_13th_floor()
	elevator_entrance_animator = elevator_entrance:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	elevator_entrance_animator:Play('close')

	wait_for_sec(0.35)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	elevator_entrance_animator:Play('open')

	wait_for_sec(0.35)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(leader, 1, 1)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, { leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -2) }, nil, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	elevator_entrance_animator:Play('close')

	-- 컨트롤 해제.
	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/audio:bgm_demonshire_main', state = 'field' })

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self:set_field_object()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	if self.fx ~= nil then
		self.fx:dispose(true)
	end

	if self.amb_loop_sfx_1 ~= nil then
		self.amb_loop_sfx_1:Stop()
		self.amb_loop_sfx_1 = nil
	end

	if self.amb_loop_sfx_2 ~= nil then
		self.amb_loop_sfx_2:Stop()
		self.amb_loop_sfx_2 = nil
	end

	self.inserted_robot_list = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmicks.elevator_on_1st_floor()) then
		start_coroutine(self.play_elevator_entry, self, 1)

		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmicks.elevator_on_13th_floor()) then
		start_coroutine(self.play_elevator_entry, self, 13)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'record_chamber_battle_1' then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.end_battle, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	for i = 1, self.enemy_robot_count do
		local enemy_robot = self.npc.neo_robot(i)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, enemy_robot) then
			local enemy_dir = {
				'right',
				'left',
				'left',
			}

			scene_util.set_direction(enemy_robot, enemy_dir[i], false)

			scene_util.set_anim(enemy_robot, self, { name = 'dead', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	for i = 1, self.holdable_robot_count do
		local static_robot = self.npc.static_neo_robot(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, static_robot) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.event_zone_names.check_holdable_obj then
				character_util.release_hold_object(user_party.Leader, static_robot)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_character_warp_01')

				self.fx.reset():Instantiate(static_robot.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5))
				command_util.execute_extinguish(nil, static_robot)

				if self.count_obj_elevator_inserted < 3 then
					start_coroutine(self.insert_holdable_obj, self, static_robot)
				end
			end
		end
	end

			scene_util.set_anim(blockade_neo_robot, self, { name = 'dead', scale = 99 })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:play_elevator_entry(current_floor)
	if self.controller.first_use_elevator then
		yield_return_func(self.controller.interact_elevator, self.controller, true, 1, false)

		if not self.controller.exited_choose_state_at_1_floor then
			start_coroutine(self.play_enemy_appearance, self)
		end
	else
		yield_return_func(self.controller.interact_elevator, self.controller, false, current_floor,
				(self.count_obj_elevator_inserted >= self.max_count_obj_elevator))

		if self.count_obj_elevator_inserted >= self.max_count_obj_elevator and self.controller.is_entering_elevator then
			start_coroutine(self.take_heavy_elevator_at_13th_floor, self)
		end
	end

	self.controller.is_entering_elevator = false
end

function local_class:enemy_robot_landing(enemy_robot, marker_index)
	start_coroutine(self.adjust_enemy_robot_shadow_size, self, enemy_robot, 1.5, 1, 0.5)

	character_util.move_to_async(enemy_robot, self.markers.enemy_robot(2, marker_index),
			0.5, nil, false, false)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)

	character_util.remove_anim(enemy_robot)

	enemy_robot.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

	-- FX_slime_buttbounce 이펙트.
	self.fx:slime_buttbounce():Instantiate(enemy_robot.Position)

	if marker_index < self.enemy_robot_count then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_01')
	end
end

function local_class:adjust_enemy_robot_shadow_size(enemy_robot, start_scale, end_scale, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

		local cur_scale = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_scale, end_scale, progress)

		enemy_robot.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

		leader:SetRotation(720, 0.7)

		character_util.move_to(leader, self.markers.leader_align(2, 1) + vector(0, -2, 0),

		for i = 1, self.enemy_robot_count do

			enemy_robot:SetRotation(720, 0.7)
			enemy_robot:SetScale(unity_class.vector3.zero, 0.7)

			character_util.move_to(enemy_robot, self.markers.enemy_robot(2, i) + vector(0, -2, 0),
					0.7, nil, false, false)
		end

		for i = 1, self.holdable_robot_count do
			local static_robot = self.npc.static_neo_robot(i)

			static_robot:SetRotation(720, 0.7)
			static_robot:SetScale(unity_class.vector3.zero, 0.7)

			character_util.move_to(static_robot, static_robot.Position + vector(0, -2, 0),
					0.7, nil, false, false)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		time_util.unmod(slow_key)

		keep_camera_shake = false
	end)

	while keep_camera_shake do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.amb_loop_sfx_2, 1)

	-- (카메라 shake 끝남과 동시에)1초간 검게 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 이 때, 카메라 포커스 지하 17층 기록보관소 앞부분으로 이동.
	-- 로봇 및 오브젝트들 배치는 아래 그림과 같이 설정.
	-- 로봇 애니메이션은 그대로 유지.
	-- 클로드 left, sleep_deep, prostrate로.

	leader:SetRotation(0, 0)
	leader:SetScale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	character_util.set_position(leader, self.markers.leader_align(4, 1))

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'prostrate')

	for i = 1, self.enemy_robot_count do
		local enemy_robot = self.npc.neo_robot(i)

		enemy_robot:SetRotation(0, 0)
		enemy_robot:SetScale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0)

		character_util.set_position(enemy_robot, self.markers.enemy_robot(4, i))
	end

	for i = 1, self.holdable_robot_count do
		local static_robot = self.npc.static_neo_robot(i)

		static_robot:SetRotation(0, 0)
		static_robot:SetScale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0)

		character_util.set_position(static_robot, self.markers.elevator_obj(4, i))
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')

	self.controller.amb_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_factory_01', loop = true })

	-- 1초간 검게 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 클로드 2회 shake 하고 일어난다.
	scene_util.shake_and_wakeup(leader, 'right', 2, nil, true)

	-- 클로드 left, idle, idle 1초
	scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
			'left',
			nil,
			nil,
			1)

	-- 클로드 right, idle, idle 1초
	scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
			'right',
			nil,
			nil,
			1)

	-- 클로드(right, sleep_deep, idle) : 지하로 떨어졌군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_record_chamber_basement_1_1', skip = true })

	-- 클로드(up, idle, idle) : 이곳은… 오랜만이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self,
			{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_record_chamber_basement_1_2', skip = true })

	-- 컨트롤 해제.
	-- 이후에는 어디서든 엘리베이터 작동 불가.

	-- 컨트롤 해제.
	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

	self.controller:complete_quest()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareLilithTowerVentLoader')

function local_class:init()
	self.game_name = 'VentMiniGame'
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- 해당 미니게임 C# 인스턴스는 MiniGameManager에서 알아서 Dispose될 것이므로 따로 호출하지 않음
end

function local_class:load_async()
	local data_key = stage.Name

	-- 미니게임 로드
	mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.game_name)

	local is_loaded = false

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.game_name, data_key, function()
		is_loaded = true
	end)

	while not is_loaded do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

	end

	self.quest_spec = nil

function local_class:set_pre_npc_data(section_state, enter_point, cur_section)
	local pre_npc_data = cur_section.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	local enter_stage = lua_helper.get_or_default(enter_point, false)

	for i = 1, #pre_npc_data do
		local npc = get_character(pre_npc_data[i].name)

		if pre_npc_data[i].only_work_enter_point and not enter_stage then
			goto continue
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].remove_lv_ui ~= nil and pre_npc_data[i].remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if pre_npc_data[i].pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if pre_npc_data[i].fly ~= nil and pre_npc_data[i].fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, pre_npc_data[i].pos, isFlying)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, pre_npc_data[i].dir, false)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, cur_section, pre_npc_data[i].emo)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].anim ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, cur_section, { name = pre_npc_data[i].anim })
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].keep_shake ~= nil and pre_npc_data[i].keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, pre_npc_data[i].shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', pre_npc_data[i].sorting_layer)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].tint_color then
			character_util.add_fade_color(npc, pre_npc_data[i].tint_color_key,
					pre_npc_data[i].tint_color, 1, 0)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].interaction then
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		end
		if pre_npc_data[i].interaction_in_section then
			character_util.add_listener(npc, self)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].string ~= nil and type_util.is_string(pre_npc_data[i].string) then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = pre_npc_data[i].string
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(pre_npc_data[i].talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = pre_npc_data[i].talk_sfx
		end

		:: continue ::
	end
end
