function local_class:play_ball_kid_routine()
	local kid_boy = self.get_play_room_kid_boy(2)
	local kid_girl = self.get_play_room_kid_girl(1)

	--공을 서로 주고받는 꼬마(남)2 & 꼬마(여)1 NPC 루틴
	--꼬마(남)2 NPC 오른쪽엔 공 스파인이 배치되어 있음.
	--꼬마(남)2 NPC가 (right, idle, gauntlet_kick) 자세 1회와 동시에 오른쪽에 있던 공 스파인 (right, idle, walk) 자세로 우측으로 3칸 이동후 정지.
	--gauntlet_kick 자세 타이밍에 맞춰 공 스파인에 FX_hit 이펙트 출력.
	--대기 0.5초
	--꼬마(여)1 NPC가 (left, idle, gauntlet_kick) 자세 1회와 동시에 왼쪽에 있던 공 스파인 (left, idle, walk) 자세로 좌측으로 3칸 이동후 정지.
	--gauntlet_kick 자세 타이밍에 맞춰 공 스파인에 FX_hit 이펙트 출력.
	--대기 0.5초
	--반복.

	-- 환경음 재생
	self.amb_1_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_kid_playground_01', volume = 0.3, max_distance = 10,
			  play_pos = self.get_playroom_center_pos(), loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })

	local start_pos = kid_boy.Position + vector(0.35, 0, 0)
	local end_pos = kid_girl.Position + vector(-0.35, 0, 0)

	self.is_play_ball = true
	start_coroutine(self.play_ball_kids, self, kid_boy, kid_girl, start_pos, end_pos)
end

-- 서로 공을 번갈아가며 차는 연출
function local_class:play_ball_kids(kid_1, kid_2, start_pos, end_pos)
	local cur_start_pos = start_pos
	local cur_end_pos = end_pos
	local is_target_first_kid = true
	local duration = 1

	local soccer_ball = self.get_play_room_soccer_ball()

	local spine_controller = soccer_ball.UnityGameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	local base_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	spine_controller:SetAnimation(base_track, 'walk', true)

	while self.is_play_ball do
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(cur_start_pos + vector(0, 0.25, 0))
		if is_target_first_kid then
			character_util.remove_emotion(kid_2)
			character_util.set_emotion(kid_1, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_anim(kid_1, { name = 'gauntlet_kick', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '01_bounce_head_01',
				parent = kid_1,
				loop = false,
				type_priority = 'event',
				player_priority = 'npc',
				max_distance = 4
			})
			spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		else
			character_util.remove_emotion(kid_1)
			character_util.set_emotion(kid_2, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_anim(kid_2, { name = 'gauntlet_kick', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '01_bounce_head_01',
				parent = kid_2,
				loop = false,
				type_priority = 'event',
				player_priority = 'npc',
				max_distance = 4
			})
			spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		end

		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration and self.is_play_ball do
			local cur_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, cur_start_pos.x, cur_end_pos.x - cur_start_pos.x, duration)
			soccer_ball.Position = vector(cur_x, 0, start_pos.z)
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if not self.is_play_ball then
				return
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		cur_start_pos = cur_start_pos == start_pos and end_pos or start_pos
		cur_end_pos = cur_end_pos == end_pos and start_pos or end_pos
		is_target_first_kid = is_target_first_kid == false

		if not self.is_play_ball then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:interact_minigame_player()
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	local kid = self.get_play_room_kid_boy(1)
	local trouble_shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	--오딜 그레모리 각각 right 방향으로 지정된 타일에 정렬.
	local move_key = 'party_align_1'

	--오딜은 ■타일 위치로, 그레모리는.■타일 위치로.
	local party_align_pos_list = {
		kid.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
		kid.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
	}

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(user_party[i],
				party_align_pos_list[i + 1],
				nil,
				1,
				self, move_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	--꼬마(남)1 NPC한테 출력되던 ‘FX_starpiece_in_character’ 이펙트 off.
	if self.starpiece_effect ~= nil then
		self.starpiece_effect:Dispose()
		self.starpiece_effect = nil
	end

	--플레이어가 꼬마(남)1 NPC 인터렉트 시, 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	if not self.kid_first_interact then
		self.kid_first_interact = true

		--꼬마(남)1 (left, idle, jump 1회) : 앗! 못 보던 누나들이다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

		character_util.normal_jump_async(kid, true)

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_1', skip = true })

		--꼬마(남)1 (left, idle, idle) : 누나들도 공놀이 하러 온거야?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_2', skip = true })

		--오딜 (right, idle, idle) : 아니, 공놀이엔 딱히 관심 없어. 우린 지금 일 중이거든.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_3', skip = true })

		--오딜 (right, idle, idle) : 신경쓰지 말고 너희끼리 놀고 있으라고.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_4', skip = true })

		--꼬마(남)1 (left, doyagao, idle) : 헤~ 누나들, 관심이 없는게 아니라… 겁먹은거 아냐?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ name = 'doyagao' },
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_5', skip = true })

		--꼬마(남)1 (left, doyagao, release) : 다 큰 어른이 어린애한테 질까봐 무서워서 내빼는거지? 솔직하게 말해!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'release' },
				{ name = 'doyagao' },
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_6', skip = true })

		--그레모리 (right, smile, idle) : 이런 당, 당돌한 꼬맹이를 봤나…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ name = 'smile' },
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_7', skip = true })

		--그레모리 (right, smile, idle) : 오, 오딜. 한번 본, 본때를 보여줘야 하지 않겠어?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ name = 'smile' },
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_8', skip = true })

	elseif self.kid_first_interact and not self.is_mini_game_fail then
		--이후 플레이어가 꼬마(남)1 NPC 재인터렉트 시, 하단의 대화 이벤트 진행.
		--꼬마(남)1 (left, idle, idle) : 공놀이에 도전하러 온거야?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_13', skip = true })

	elseif self.kid_first_interact and self.is_mini_game_fail then
		--꼬마(남)1 (left, idle, idle) : 다시 도전하러 온거야?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_16', skip = true })
	end

	--선택지 출력
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--『한 번 해보자고.』
		{ 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_choose_1_1', 'mercy' },
		--『지금은 바빠서 이만.』
		{ 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_choose_1_2', 'normal' },
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		if not self.is_mini_game_fail then
			--『한 번 해보자고.』
			--오딜 (right, doyagao, cross_arm) : 잠깐 몸도 풀겸… 한번 해보자고.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')

			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
					nil,
					{ name = 'cross_arm' },
					{ name = 'doyagao' },
					{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_9', skip = true })

			--꼬마(남)1 (left, doyagao, idle) : 좋아! 하지만 쉽지 않을걸?
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')

			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
					nil,
					nil,
					{ name = 'doyagao' },
					{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_10', skip = true })

			--꼬마(남)1 (left, doyagao, release 2회) : 옆 방으로 따라와!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
					nil,
					{ name = 'release' },
					{ name = 'doyagao' },
					{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_11', skip = true })

		elseif self.is_mini_game_fail then
			--꼬마(남)1 (left, doyagao, release) : 좋아! 옆 방으로 따라와!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
					nil,
					{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
					{ name = 'doyagao' },
					{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_17', skip = true })
		end

		--1초에 걸쳐 화면 페이드 인.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		--플레이어 미니게임 장소로 이동.

		-- 미니게임 불러옴
		local is_mini_game_load_complete = false
		self.minigame = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)

		mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, self.available_stage_name, function()
			is_mini_game_load_complete = true
		end)

		-- 미니게임이 로드 다되면
		while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		-- 미니게임 시작
		mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		if not self.is_mini_game_fail then
			--『지금은 바빠서 이만.』
			--꼬마(남)1 (left, doyagao, cross_arm) : 헤헤! 거봐, 역시 겁먹었지!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')

			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
					nil,
					{ name = 'cross_arm' },
					{ name = 'doyagao' },
					{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_12', skip = true })

			self.starpiece_effect = self.fx.starpiece_effect():Instantiate(kid.Position,
					unity_class.quaternion.identity, kid.Transform)
		elseif self.is_mini_game_fail then
			--꼬마(남)1 (left, doyagao, cross_arm) : 헤헤! 포기하는 것도 방법이야~
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')

			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
					nil,
					{ name = 'cross_arm' },
					{ name = 'doyagao' },
					{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_18', skip = true })

			self.starpiece_effect = self.fx.starpiece_effect():Instantiate(kid.Position,
					unity_class.quaternion.identity, kid.Transform)
		end

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_interact_kid

		--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

		return
	end
end

function local_class:mini_game_clear_scene()
	local kid = self.get_play_room_kid_boy(1)
	local trouble_shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()

	--미니게임 클리어 이후
	self:mini_game_out_setting()

	--꼬마(남)1 (left, tired, idle) : 헉… 헉… 누나, 진짜 빠르다..!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_19', skip = true })

	--꼬마(남)1 (left, tired, idle) : 어떻게 하면 그렇게 공을 잘 다룰 수 있는거야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_20', skip = true })

	--오딜 (right, smile, idle) : 형사 시절 때 동료들이랑 공 좀 차고 놀았거든.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_21', skip = true })

	--오딜 (right, smile, bomb_idle) : 뭐, 간만에 재밌었어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_22', skip = true })

	--오딜 idle 표정 전환.

	--꼬마(남)1 (left, idle, idle) : 우우… 조금 분하지만… 나도 재밌었어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_23', skip = true })

	--꼬마(남)1 (left, idle, release 2회) : 같이 놀아줬으니까, 답례로 이걸 줄게!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_db_s1_24', skip = true })

	--꼬마(남) NPC get 자세로 스타피스를 왼쪽 대각선 상단 1칸에 떨굼.
	scene_util.set_anim(kid, self, { name = 'get' })

	local star_piece = get_field_object('dribble_ball_starpiece')
	local start_pos = kid.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 0)
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, start_pos)

	--스타피스가 땅에 떨어진 뒤에 하단의 대사 출력.
	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid)

	--꼬마(남)1 (left, idle, idle) : 다음에 또 놀자, 누나!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
			nil,

	end
end

function local_class:deactivate_light()
	for i = 1, #self.light do
		local light = get_field_object(self.light[i].name)
		light.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end
end

function local_class:switch_light(index)
	local light = get_field_object(self.light[index].name)

	if self.light[index].item ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.light[index].item)
	end

	if self.light[index].effect ~= nil then
		self.light[index].effect:Dispose()
	end

	if self.light[index].color == self.light_color.off then
		self.light[index].color = self.light_color.red
		self.light[index].item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = light.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
											  itemid = self.light_color.red, notforinven = true,
											  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})
		self.light[index].effect = self.fx.light_red():Instantiate(light.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
	elseif self.light[index].color == self.light_color.red then
		self.light[index].color = self.light_color.blue
		self.light[index].item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = light.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
											  itemid = self.light_color.blue, notforinven = true,
											  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})
		self.light[index].effect = self.fx.light_blue():Instantiate(light.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))

	elseif self.light[index].color == self.light_color.blue then
		self.light[index].color = self.light_color.green
		self.light[index].item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = light.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
											  itemid = self.light_color.green, notforinven = true,
											  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})
		self.light[index].effect = self.fx.light_green():Instantiate(light.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
	else
		self.light[index].color = self.light_color.red
		self.light[index].item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = light.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
											  itemid = self.light_color.red, notforinven = true,
											  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})
		self.light[index].effect = self.fx.light_red():Instantiate(light.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
	end
end

function local_class:interact_light(index)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(get_party_leader(), self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_enhance_light_01')
	self:switch_light(index)

	if self:check_light() then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_light_turn_on_01')
		self.cleared_light_puzzle = true
		self:remove_field_tint(1)
		self:deactivate_light()
		self:door_open()
	end
end

function local_class:check_light()
	for i = 1, #self.light do
		if self.light[i].color ~= self.puzzle_answer[i] then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:door_open()
	local door = self.get_door()
	local start_pos = door.Position
	local end_pos = door.Position + vector(0, 0, -2)
	local duration = 1.5

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(door.Position, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	door:Shake(0.04, duration)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_02')
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		door.Position = lerp_pos
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	door.Position = end_pos
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
end

function local_class:door_close()
	local door = self.get_door()
	door.Position = door.Position + vector(0, 0, 2)
end

function local_class:dispose_light()
	for i = 1, #self.light do
		if self.light[i].item ~= nil then
			drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.light[i].item)
			self.light[i].item = nil
		end
	end
end
--endregion light puzzle

-- 필트 틴트 세팅
function local_class:set_field_tint(duration)
	if not self.already_set_field_tint then
		self.already_set_field_tint = true
		field:Tint(self.field_tint_key, unity_class.color.black, duration, 0.3)
	end
end

-- 필드 틴트 끄기
function local_class:remove_field_tint(duration)
	if self.already_set_field_tint then
		self.already_set_field_tint = false
		field:RemoveTint(self.field_tint_key, duration)
	end
end

-- 아이템 인터랙트 이벤트
function local_class:interact_membership_scene()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_plitvice_01')
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_narr_1' })

		self.entered_carpenter_talk_zone = true
		start_coroutine(self.carpenter_talk_scene, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, odile, 'scent_carpenter_block') then
		self.entered_carpenter_block_zone = true
		-- 인부 블락 이벤트
		if (self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none or
				self.current_section_state == self.section_state.entered_staff_zone) and
				not self.blocking_carpenter then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.carpenter_blocking_scene, self, false)

		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.interacted_staff then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.passed_carpenter
			sp_util.start_scene(self.carpenter_blocking_scene, self, true)
		end

	-- 스태프 독백 이벤트
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, odile, 'scent_store_1') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.entered_staff_zone
		start_coroutine(self.entered_staff_zone_scene, self)
	-- 가게 이벤트
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, odile, 'scent_store_2') and
			not self.entered_store_talk_zone then
		self.entered_store_talk_zone = true
		start_coroutine(self.store_talk_scene, self)
	-- 조향사 이벤트
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, odile, 'scent_perfumer_event') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.passed_carpenter then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.entered_perfumer_zone
		sp_util.start_scene(self.entered_perfumer_zone_scene, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, odile, 'scent_shop') and
			self.shop_sfx == nil then
		self.shop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01', loop = true, volume = 0.2 })
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local odile = get_party_leader()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, odile, 'scent_shop') and
			self.shop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.shop_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.shop_sfx = nil
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	-- 배틀 종료 후 엔딩
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_perfumer()) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.entered_perfumer_zone then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.ending
		sp_util.start_scene(self.ending_scene, self)
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event()
	self.stage_ended = true
end
--endregion event

function local_class:pre_setting()

function local_class:set_monster_dummy()
	local monster_count = 12
	local goblin_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('scent_goblin_dummy')
	local orc_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('scent_orc_dummy')
	local dir = {
			'right', 'right', 'right', 'right', 'left', 'right',
			'right', 'left', 'left', 'right', 'right', 'left',
	}

	local pos = {
			goblin_pos + vector(-0.6, 0, 0),
			goblin_pos + vector(0, 0.01, 0),
			goblin_pos + vector(0.6, 0.02, 0),
			goblin_pos + vector(-0.3, 0.3, 0.2),
			goblin_pos + vector(0.6, 0.31, 0.2),
			goblin_pos + vector(0, 0.6, 0.4),
			orc_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			orc_pos + vector(0, 0.01, 0),
			orc_pos + vector(1, 0.02, 0),
			orc_pos + vector(-0.5, 0.3, 0.2),
			orc_pos + vector(0.3, 0.31, 0.2),
			orc_pos + vector(0.2, 0.6, 0.4),
	}

	-- dynamic
	for i = 1, monster_count do
		local monster = self.controller.dynamic_npc:get(i)
		character_util.add_color(monster, monster.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.6, 0)
		character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'visible')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(monster, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_position(monster, pos[i])
		character_util.set_direction(monster, dir[i])
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(monster, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	-- 연출용
	local goblin = get_character('scent_goblin')
	character_util.add_color(goblin, goblin.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.6, 0)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(goblin, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	local orc = get_character('scent_orc')
	character_util.add_color(orc, orc.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.6, 0)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(orc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
end

function local_class:carpenter_talk_scene()
	local carpenter_1 = self.get_carpenter(1)
	local carpenter_2 = self.get_carpenter(2)

	-- 직원 휴게실 청소는 다 했나?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_1' })

	if self.stage_ended or self.blocking_carpenter then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = false, parent = carpenter_2 })
	scene_util.set_anim(carpenter_2, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1, sfx_name = false })
	if self.stage_ended or self.blocking_carpenter then
		return
	end

	-- 응. 먼지 한톨 없이 깨끗하다고.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_2' })

	if self.stage_ended or self.blocking_carpenter then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = false, parent = carpenter_2 })
	scene_util.set_anim(carpenter_2, self, 'question')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.stage_ended or self.blocking_carpenter then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(carpenter_2)
	scene_util.set_direction(carpenter_2, 'up')
	-- 그나저나… 요즘 이 안쪽에서 뭔가 이상한 소리 같은거 나지 않아?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_3' })

	if self.stage_ended or self.blocking_carpenter then
		return
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(carpenter_2, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(carpenter_1, self, 'bomb_idle')
	-- 이상한 소리…? 피곤해서 헛것이라도 들은거 아냐?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_4' })
end

function local_class:carpenter_blocking_scene(passed)
	local odile = get_party_leader()
	local carpenter_1 = self.get_carpenter(1)
	local carpenter_2 = self.get_carpenter(2)

	self.blocking_carpenter = true

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_2)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(carpenter_1)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(carpenter_2)
	scene_util.set_direction(carpenter_1, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(carpenter_2, 'down', false)

	character_util.normal_jump(carpenter_2, '01_small_jump_01')
	-- 거기, 멈추세요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carpenter_2, self, nil, nil, nil, 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_5')

	wp_util.move_async(carpenter_2,
			{ carpenter_2.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0),
			  carpenter_2.Position + vector(1.5, 0, -1) },
			  3, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	-- 이쪽은 직원 외 출입이 금지되어 있습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carpenter_2, self, nil, nil, nil, 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_6')
	-- 이만 돌아가주세요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carpenter_2, self, nil, 'release', nil, 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_7')

	if passed then
		self:carpenter_pass_scene()
	else
		local return_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter('scent_carpenter_block', odile, 'down')

		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					wp_util.move_async(carpenter_2,
							{ carpenter_2.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
							  carpenter_2.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 1) },
							  3, nil)
				end,
				function()
					wp_util.move_async(odile, return_pos, nil, 0.5)
				end
		)

		scene_util.set_direction(carpenter_1, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(carpenter_2, 'left', false)
	end

	self.blocking_carpenter = false

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:carpenter_pass_scene()
	local odile = get_party_leader()
	local carpenter_1 = self.get_carpenter(1)
	local carpenter_2 = self.get_carpenter(2)

	-- 직원증 카드를 보여준다.
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_8', 'normal' }
	})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')
	character_util.look_at(odile, carpenter_2)
	local card = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = odile.Position,
												  target = carpenter_2.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.2),
												  itemid = self.staff_card_id, notforinven = true,
												  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.5 })

	scene_util.set_anim_async(odile, self, { name = 'release', count = 1 })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	card.ConsumeTarget = carpenter_2
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	-- 어, 이건… 직원증 카드잖아?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carpenter_2, self, nil,
			{ name = 'question', keep = true },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_9')

	-- 차림새를 보아하니 타워 직원 같지는 않은데…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carpenter_2, self, nil, nil, nil, 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_10')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_2)

	-- 신입인가 보지, 그냥 비켜줘 이 사람아.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carpenter_1, self, 'right', 'release', nil, 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_11')
	-- 괜히 트러블 나서 좋을 거 없다고.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carpenter_1, self, nil, nil, nil, 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_12')
	-- 미안합니다, 지나가시죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carpenter_2, self, nil, { name = 'nod', count = 1 }, nil, 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_13')

	wp_util.move_async(carpenter_2,
			{ carpenter_2.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			  carpenter_2.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 1) },
			  3, nil)

	-- 웬만하면 그냥 비켜 줘. 저번에 직원한테 잘못 걸려서 감봉된 친구 소식 들었지?
	carpenter_1.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_14'
	-- 조금 걱정되긴 하는데…
	carpenter_2.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_lt_heavenly_scent_15'
end

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	self.item_type = {
		umbrella = 'lop_umbrella',
		battery = 'lop_battery',
		bomb = 'lop_bomb',
		picket = 'lop_picket'
	}

		drop_item = nil,

		initialize = function(this)
			local fo = get_field_object(self.item_type.battery)
			fo.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '01_bounce_head_01'
		end,

		set_consume_target = function(this, target)
			this.drop_item.ConsumeTarget = target
			this.drop_item = nil
		end,

		create_drop_item = function(this)
			local fo = get_field_object(self.item_type.battery)
			local item_spec = {
				itemid = 21131,
				sprscale = 0.75,
				pos = fo.Position,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				skip_text = true,
				showoncharacter = true
			}

			this.drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item(item_spec)
		end,
		
		place_item = function(this)
			this:create_drop_item()
			local init_pos_marker_name = 'lop_pickable_%s_init_pos'
			local marker_name = string.format(init_pos_marker_name, self.item_type.battery)
			local init_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(marker_name)
			local fo = get_field_object(self.item_type.battery)
			character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'enabled')
			fo.Position = init_pos

			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(init_pos + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
		end,

		reset_item = function(this)
			this:dispose()
			local fo = get_field_object(self.item_type.battery)
			character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'disabled')
			fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			if this.drop_item ~= nil then
				this.drop_item:ConsumeComplete()
				this.drop_item = nil
			end
		end
	}

	self.pickable_bomb = {
		drop_item = nil,

		initialize = function(this)
			this:place_item()
			this:create_drop_item()

			local fo = get_field_object(self.item_type.bomb)
			fo.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '01_bounce_head_01'
		end,

		set_consume_target = function(this, target)
			this.drop_item.ConsumeTarget = target
			this.drop_item = nil
		end,

		create_drop_item = function(this)
			local fo = get_field_object(self.item_type.bomb)
			local item_spec = {
				itemid = 21132,
				sprscale = 1,
				pos = fo.Position,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				skip_text = true,
				showoncharacter = true
			}

			this.drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item(item_spec)
		end,
		
		place_item = function(this, pos)
			local init_pos_marker_name = 'lop_pickable_%s_init_pos'

			local init_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(marker_name)
			local fo = get_field_object(self.item_type.bomb)
			fo.Position = init_pos
			field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.enabled)
		end,

		reset_item = function(this)
			this:dispose()
			this:place_item()
			this:create_drop_item()
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			if this.drop_item ~= nil then
				this.drop_item:ConsumeComplete()

				end
			end

		dispose_all = function(this)
			for _, inst in ipairs(this.instances) do
				inst:Dispose()
			end

			this.instances = nil
		end
	}

		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle') 
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)
	
	if quest_util.is_available_section(self.current_section) then
		self.current_section:exit()
	end

	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
	
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	
	self:dispose_battery_on_shelf()
	self:remove_battery_twinkle_fx()

	self.boss_room_smokes:dispose_all()
	self.boss_room_smokes = nil
	
	self.pickable_items:dispose_all()
	self.pickable_items = nil

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')

local local_class = newclass('NightmareLilithTowerLiesOfPSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LiesOfP @
		Comment = LiesOfP 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.available_stage_name = 'nightmare_lilithtower_5'

	--state
	self.section_state = {
		before_exit_interact = 1,
		before_stargazer_interact = 2,
		next_section = 3,
		done = 99,
	}
	self.current_state = self.section_state.before_exit_interact

	--fo
	self.get_exit = function()
		return get_field_object('bar_inner_exit')
	end

	--npc
	self.get_trouble_shooter = function()
		return get_character('trouble_shooter')
	end

	self.get_mad_scientist = function()
		return get_character('mad_scientist')
	end

	self.get_stargazer = function()
		return get_character('stargazer')
	end

	self.get_pinocchio = function()
		return get_character('pinocchio')
	end

	--fx
	self.fx = {
		aura_skill = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_AuraSkill_Cast')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.saved_exit_interact = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self:pre_setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_exit_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_exit()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.exit_interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_stargazer_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_stargazer()) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.next_section
		sp_util.start_scene(self.stargazer_interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false

end
--endregion

function local_class:exit_interact_scene()
	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(380)

	if main_quest_progress.IsComplete then
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
	else
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.6)
	end


	local exit = self.get_exit()
	local shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()

	do
		--오딜&그레모리(up, idle, idle) 1초간 이미지와 같이 정렬
		local wp_key = 'player_align'
		local duration = 1
		local align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bar_outer_exit_pos')

		camera_util.move(align_pos, duration)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shooter, align_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(scientist, align_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--exit(일반 말풍선): 이곳은 위대한 약속의 성역이다. 네 존재를 증명하라.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(exit, 'nightmare_lt_lop_s1_1')

	--exit(일반 말풍선): 너는 누구인가?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(exit, 'nightmare_lt_lop_s1_2')

	--선택지
	--(normal) 인형
	local branch_data = {
		{ 'nightmare_lt_lop_s1_choose_1', 'normal' },
		{ 'nightmare_lt_lop_s1_choose_2', 'normal' },
	}

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event(branch_data)

	if result == 1 then
		--인형 선택시
		--exit(일반 말풍선): 인형은 재난의 씨앗.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(exit, 'nightmare_lt_lop_s1_3')

		--exit(일반 말풍선): 바는 외부 인형을 환영하지 않는다. 돌아가라.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_02')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(exit, 'nightmare_lt_lop_s1_4')

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		if main_quest_progress.IsComplete then
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		elseif main_quest_progress.InnerProgress < 10 then
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)
		end

		--이벤트 종료
	elseif result == 2 then
		--인간 선택시
		--exit(일반 말풍선): 위대한 약속 4항 : 모든 인형은 거짓을 부정한다.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(exit, 'nightmare_lt_lop_s1_5')

		--exit(일반 말풍선): 크라트 칵테일 바는 당신을 환영합니다.
		music_player_util.play_multiple_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01', '01_small_key_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(exit, 'nightmare_lt_lop_s1_6')

		--0.65초간 서큘러 페이드 아웃
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.65, 'linear')

		--exit의 타겟 마커 위치로 오딜&그레모리 이동
		local exit_align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bar_inner_exit_pos')
		party_util.align_to_target(exit_align_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 'down', 0)
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

		local main_quest_event_controller = get_quest_event_controller('NightmareLilithTowerMainController')
		main_quest_event_controller:stop_stage_5_loop_sound()

		--0.65초간 서큘러 페이드 인
		--music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_steampunk_basement_02', state = 'event'})
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.65, 'linear')

		--연출용 exit 정상화
		exit.Interactable = self.saved_exit_interact
		self.saved_exit_interact = nil

		--스테이트 진행
		self.current_state = self.section_state.before_stargazer_interact
	end
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local current_user_state = user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	local is_holding = current_user_state ~= nil
		and lua_helper.type_compare(current_user_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)

	if is_holding then
		return
	end

	for _, type in pairs(self.item_type) do
		local item = get_field_object(type)

		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, item, self.item_placing_area_name) then
			self.is_item_staying_in_area = true

			if not self.is_item_routine_running then
				self.is_item_routine_running = true
				start_coroutine(self.wait_until_entered_pickable_item_stops, self, type)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	for _, type in pairs(self.item_type) do
		local item = get_field_object(type)

		if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, item, self.item_placing_area_name) then
			self.is_item_staying_in_area = false
			self:show_exit()
		end
	end
end


function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target_name = e.Target.Name
	local is_trash_bin = string.find(target_name, self.trash_bin_name_prefix)

	if is_trash_bin then
		local is_empty = string.find(target_name, 'empty')
		local dir = string.match(target_name, ".*_(.*)")

		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, dir)

		self:remove_trash_bin_interactable_and_effect(e.Target)

		if self.is_interacting_trash_bin == false then
			self.is_interacting_trash_bin = true
			sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_picking_trash_bin, self, is_empty)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmicks.bar_cabinet()) then
		if self.is_interacting_cabinet == false then
			self.is_interacting_cabinet = true
			sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_tackle_to_cabinet, self)
		end
	end
end

		self.thrust_sfx:Stop()

	end

-- [ 시스템 ] - 라피스 공격 연출 시 사용
function local_class:on_spine_event(_, _)
	local p = self.npcs.p()

	local reset = false

	local dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(p.Direction)

	--- 최대 카운트에 도달했을때
	if self.current_stab_count >= self.critical_count then
		if self.current_stab_level == 3 then
			reset = true
		end

		--- 레벨 조정
		self.current_stab_level = math.min(self.current_stab_level + 1, 3)
		--- 카운트 조정
		self.current_stab_count = self.current_stab_count % self.critical_count
	end

	--- 현재 카운트 증가
	self.current_stab_count = self.current_stab_count + 1

	--- 카운터 내림 연산
	local floor_count = math.floor(self.current_stab_count)

	local is_enhance = self.current_stab_level == 3 and self.current_stab_count >= self.critical_count or
		self.cwp_lv4_left > 0
	--- 레벨 업
	local is_level_up = self.current_stab_level > 1 and floor_count == 1 and not reset

	-- 오프셋
	local offset = 0.2 * dir_vector

	-- 레벨 업
	if is_level_up then
		--- 에셋 키
		local fx_pos = p.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0)
		self.fx_pool.continuous_stab_buff_by_lv(self.current_stab_level - 1):Instantiate(fx_pos)

		-- 강화 사운드 재생
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_matched_01')
	-- 일반 찌르기
	else
		--- 적당한 패턴 부여
		if floor_count == 2 or floor_count == 5 then
			offset = offset - 0.2 * (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * dir_vector)
		elseif floor_count == 3 or floor_count == 6 then
			offset = offset + 0.2 * (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * dir_vector)
		end
	end

	-- 이펙트 생성 위치
	local fx_pos = p.Bounds.center - offset

	-- 강화 찌르기
	if is_enhance then
		self.fx_pool.continuous_stab_critical():Instantiate(fx_pos)

		-- 강화 찌르기 사운드 재생
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_back_slash_01')
	else
		--- 에셋 키
		self.fx_pool.continuous_stab_by_lv(self.current_stab_level):Instantiate(fx_pos)
	end

	--- 강화타 관련 루틴
	if self.cwp_lv4_left > 0 then
		--- 강화타 횟수 감소
		self.cwp_lv4_left = self.cwp_lv4_left - 1
		--- 카운트 무조건 초기화
		self.current_stab_count = 0
	end
end

-- [ 시스템 ] -
function local_class:wait_until_entered_pickable_item_stops(type)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.6)

	self:remove_all_trash_bin_interactable()
	self:hide_exit()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.is_item_staying_in_area == false then
		self.is_item_routine_running = false
		self:set_all_trash_bin_interactable()
		return
	end

	local cached_leader = get_party_leader()

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	if type == self.item_type.umbrella then
		yield_return_func(self.scene_selected_umbrella, self)
	elseif type == self.item_type.bomb then
		yield_return_func(self.scene_selected_bomb, self)
	elseif type == self.item_type.battery then
		yield_return_func(self.scene_selected_battery, self)
	elseif type == self.item_type.picket then
		yield_return_func(self.scene_selected_signboard, self)
	end

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, cached_leader)

	self:show_exit()

	self.is_item_routine_running = false
end

function local_class:show_exit()
	local exit = get_field_object('bar_outer_exit')
	exit.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

	local move_info = CS.Oak.OpenPathInfo()
	move_info.OpenWaypoint = 'bar_outer_exit_pos'
	exit.Interactable = CS.Oak.ExitInteractable()
	exit.Interactable.MoveStage = move_info
end

function local_class:hide_exit()
	local exit = get_field_object('bar_outer_exit')
	exit.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
end

	character_util.set_group_direction({ ts, ms }, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(0.12)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_heavy_slash_02')

-- [ 연출 ] - 쓰레기통 뒤젹거림
function local_class:scene_picking_trash_bin(is_empty)
	local coin_id = 20836
	local apple_id = 20857
	local frypan_id = 20858
	local flower_id = 20859
	local umbrella_id = 21130

	local target = user_party.Leader
	local target_pos = target.Position
	local spawn_pos = target_pos + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
	local is_facing_left = target.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	local dir_factor = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_facing_left, 1, -1)

	local loop_sound_1 = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_04', loop = true })
	local loop_sound_2 = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	scene_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, self, 'eat')

	start_coroutine(self.drop_item_from_trash_bin, self,
		apple_id, spawn_pos, target_pos + vector(1.5 * dir_factor, 0, 0), is_empty)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	start_coroutine(self.drop_item_from_trash_bin, self,
			coin_id, spawn_pos, target_pos + vector(1 * dir_factor, 0, -0.8), is_empty)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	start_coroutine(self.drop_item_from_trash_bin, self,
		frypan_id, spawn_pos, target_pos + vector(0.8 * dir_factor, 0, 0), is_empty)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if is_empty then
		start_coroutine(self.drop_item_from_trash_bin, self,
			flower_id, spawn_pos, target_pos + vector(1.2 * dir_factor, 0, 0.2), is_empty)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')
		start_coroutine(self.drop_item_from_trash_bin, self,
			umbrella_id, spawn_pos, target_pos + vector(1.2 * dir_factor, 0, -0.2), is_empty)
	end

	loop_sound_1:Stop()
	loop_sound_2:Stop()

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	self.is_interacting_trash_bin = false
end

-- [ 연출 ] - 쓰레기통에서 아이템 꺼내는 연출
function local_class:drop_item_from_trash_bin(id, spawn_pos, target_pos)
	local is_umbrella = id == 21130
	local spr_scale = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_umbrella, 0.5, 1)

	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = spawn_pos,
		target = target_pos,
		itemid = id,
		sprscale = spr_scale,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		skip_text = true,
		showoncharacter = true
	})

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	if is_umbrella == false then
		drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(item, 0, 1)
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
	else
		self.controller.pickable_umbrella:set_drop_item(item)
		self.controller.pickable_umbrella:place_item(target_pos)
	end

-- [ 연출 ] - 수납장 위에서 조금씩 움직이는 배털 스프라이트 이동하는 루틴
function local_class:scene_slide_battery_on_shelf()

	local item = self.controller.battery_on_shelf

	if self.num_count_bar_cabinet_damaged < self.num_target_battery_moved_count then
		local move_dest = item.Position - vector(0, 0, 0.2)
		drop_item_util.shake(item, 'shelf_battery_moving', 0.03, 0.5)
		drop_item_util.move_to_async(item, move_dest, 0.5)
	else
		self:remove_bar_cabinet_interactable()

		local maker_name = 'lop_pickable_%s_init_pos'
		local marker_name = string.format(maker_name, self.item_type.battery)
		local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(marker_name)
		self:scene_battery_fall(item, target_pos)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')
		self:remove_trash_bin_twinkle_effect(item)
		self.controller:hide_battery_on_shelf()
		self.controller.picakble_battery:place_item()
	end
end

function local_class:scene_battery_fall(item, target_pos)
	local ground_offset = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'ground_offset', 0.125)
	local drop_start_offset =  lua_helper.get_value(data, 'drop_start_offset', 0.5)
	local initial_velocity = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'initial_velocity', 11)
	local initial_acceleration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'initial_acceleration', 28)
	local rotation_num = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'rotation_num', 3)

	local start_pos = item.Position
	local drop_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall()

	drop_calculator:SetParameters(initial_velocity, initial_acceleration,
			field:GetTileInfoAt(start_pos):GetHeightAt(start_pos) + drop_start_offset, 0)
	drop_calculator:ScaleTime(1.2)

	while not drop_calculator:IsDone() do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local drop_progress = drop_calculator:GetProgress()
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, drop_progress)

		local cur_pos = (start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress)

		local floor_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(cur_pos):GetHeightAt(cur_pos) + ground_offset
		drop_calculator:Proceed(dt, floor_height)

		item.Position = cur_pos

		local rotate_progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, drop_progress)
		local cur_rotation = rotate_progress * 360 * rotation_num

		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)
		item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

	-- RPG 발사 연출
		-- DemonworldMainPartASection18 407~ 참고
		-- 가디언테일즈 월드 12-8(#11) 튜링의 아지트 공략 (Guardiantales12-8)(ガーディアンテイルズ 12-8)
		-- P(left, smile, rifle_shoot, loop = false) 0.2초 대기
	character_util.set_direction(p, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(p, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(p, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	local proj_move_start_pos = p.Position + vector(-0.7, 0, 0.25)

	-- P 0.1초간 오른쪽으로 30 rotate
	character_util.spine_rotate(p, 30, 0.1)

	-- P 0.5초간 오른쪽으로 0.5칸 이동
	character_util.move_to(p, p.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.5, nil, false, false)

	-- 두 동작 모두 async 아님
	self.rocket_proj = self.fx_pool.iron_missile():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)

	-- P 기준 (-0.7, 0, 0.25) 위치를 “시작 지점” 으로 설정

	-- 시작 지점에 FX_Common_CannonFire 이펙트 출력
	self.fx_pool.muzzle_effect():Instantiate(proj_move_start_pos)

	-- 시작 지점에 FX_IronMissile_Proj 생성
	self.rocket_proj.transform.position = proj_move_start_pos

	-- 다음 동작 동시에 실행
	-- 카메라 줌인 (2, 1)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2, 1)

	-- 카메라 1초간 왼쪽으로 9칸 이동
	camera_util.move(p.Position + vector(-9, 0, 0), 0.8)

	-- FX_IronMissile_Proj 왼쪽으로 9칸 이동
	local distance = 9
	local move_duration = 1
	local hit_distance = 1
	local speed = distance / move_duration
	local rotate_speed = 90
	local direction = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	local proj_move_dest_pos = proj_move_start_pos + vector(-9, 0, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_missile_launch_02')
	while distance > hit_distance do
		local move_direction = direction * speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.rocket_proj.transform.position = self.rocket_proj.transform.position + move_direction

		local angle = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.forward, direction).eulerAngles.y
		self.rocket_proj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle, 0)

		coroutine.yield()

		local diff = proj_move_dest_pos - self.rocket_proj.transform.position
		distance = diff.magnitude
		direction = unity_class.vector3.RotateTowards(direction, diff.normalized,
			rotate_speed * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad * unity_class.time.deltaTime, 0)
	end

	-- 다음 동작 동시에 실행
	-- FX_IronMissile_Proj 제거
	self:dispose_rocket_proj()

	-- 카메라 shake (0.6, 0.7)
	camera_util.shake(0.6, 0.7)

	-- 카메라 줌아웃 (기본 크기, 0.1)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.1)

	-- FX_IronMissile_Proj 있던 위치에 fx_cwp_steam_princess_drone_explosion 이펙트 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_building_explosion_01')
	self.fx_pool.landing_effect():Instantiate(proj_move_dest_pos)

	-- P rotate 초기화
	character_util.spine_rotate(p, 0, 0)

	-- P&오딜&그레모리(left, surprise, idle, jump 1회)
	local npcs = { ts, ms, p }
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(npcs, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.group_normal_jump(npcs)

	-- 2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 카메라 0.5초간 P에게 이동
	camera_util.move_async(p.Position, 0.5)

	-- 0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- P(left, smile, rifle_idle): 이 화력… 이건 무조건 1티어 무기다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(p, self, 'left', 'rifle_idle', 'smile', 'nightmare_lt_lop_s2_18')

	-- P(left, attack, rifle_reload, loop = false): 딱 대라, 이 자식! 넌 죽었어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(p, self, 'left', { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false }, 'attack',
		'nightmare_lt_lop_s2_common_3')

	self:scene_entered_boss_room_with_bomb()
end

-- [ 연출 ] - 보스방 진입 후 공통 연출
function local_class:scene_entered_boss_room_common(run_anim, idle_anim, after_emo)
	local p = self.npcs.p()

	-- P(left, attack) 이미지의 화살표를 따라 7의 속도로 옆방으로 이동하기 시작
	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
	local p_dest = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_lies_of_p_pinocchio_pos') - vector(10, 0, 0)

	scene_util.set_anim(p, self, run_anim)
	character_util.move_to(p, p_dest, nil, 7, true, false)

	-- 이동 시작 0.5초 후 1초간 화면 페이드 아웃
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted'})
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	dash_sfx:Stop()

	character_util.stop(p)
	camera_util.move_async(field_util.get_marker_pos('lop_boss_room_center'), 0)

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true, parent = p })

	-- 3초간 카메라 옆방의 P 도착 위치와 보스 사이로 이동
	p_dest = field_util.get_marker_pos('lop_s2_boss_room_p_pos')
	character_util.set_position(p, p_dest + vector(7, 0, 0))
	character_util.move_to_async(p, p_dest, nil, 7, true, false)
	dash_sfx:Stop()

	-- 도착 후 P(left, doyagao)
	scene_util.set_anim(p, self, idle_anim)
	scene_util.set_emotion(p, self, after_emo)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local boss_title_duration = 2

	-- 보스 타이틀 출력
		-- 	title: 파티 인도자
		-- 	subtitle: 머리는 탈착식이랍니다
	screen_util.show_boss_title(
		'nightmare_lt_lop_s2_boss_title',
		'nightmare_lt_lop_s2_boss_subtitle',
		boss_title_duration,
		false
	)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_battle_boss', state = 'event'})

	-- 3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(boss_title_duration - 0.2)

end

-- [ 연출 ] - 우산 선택시 보스 방 연출
function local_class:scene_entered_boss_room_with_umbrella()
	self:scene_entered_boss_room_common('twohand_run', 'twohand_idle', 'doyagao')
	self:scene_failed_route_common()

	local p = self.npcs.p()
	local boss = self.npcs.party_master()

	self:set_p_uptown_girl_battle_style()

	-- P(left, attack, sword_attack_stab, shout 말풍선, 크기 1.2): 나의 이 무자비한 연속 찌르기에 당해서 말이야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_matched_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(p, self, 'left', nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true },
		{ key = 'nightmare_lt_lop_s2_5', scale = 1.2, skip = true })

	-- 라피스 1차 전용무기 일반공격 그대로 표현이 되야 함

	-- 카메라 6초간 왼쪽으로 2.5칸 이동 시작
	local cam_dest = field_util.get_marker_pos('lop_boss_room_center') - vector(2.5, 0, 0)
	camera_util.move(cam_dest, 6)

	-- P 공격 유지하면서 6초간 5칸 이동 시작
	local is_p_moving = true
	local p_dest = p.Position + vector(-5, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(p, p_dest,  nil, 6, self, nil,
		{
			end_callback = function()
				is_p_moving = false
			end
		})

	-- 2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 보스 1초간 이미지의 위치로 이동 시작
	-- 이동 완료 후 보스(down, idle, idle)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(boss, boss.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), nil,1, self, nil,
		{ last_direction = 'down' })

	-- P(surprise): 어… 어어? 피하면 안되는데
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	--scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(p, self, 'left', nil, { name = 'surprise', keep = true }, 'nightmare_lt_lop_s2_6')
	scene_util.set_emotion(p, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(p, 'nightmare_lt_lop_s2_6')

	-- P(scared) 1초 대기
	scene_util.set_emotion(p, self, 'scared')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- P(scared): 아니, 이거 왜 방향 전환이 안돼?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(p, self, 'left', nil, nil, 'nightmare_lt_lop_s2_7')

	-- 이 시점 이후 P 이동이 끝났을 때 다음 동작 진행
	while is_p_moving do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:scene_boss_attack()

	self:remove_p_uptown_girl_battle_style()

	-- 실패 연출로 연결
	self:scene_failed()
end

-- [ 연출 ] - 실패 연출
function local_class:scene_failed()
	self.controller:reset_battery_on_shelf()
	self.controller.pickable_items:reset_items()

	self.num_count_bar_cabinet_damaged = 0
	self:place_bar_cabinet_interactable()
	self:set_trash_bins_interactable_and_effect()
	self:reset_trash_bin_effect()
	self:remove_attachment_from_p()
	self:remove_custom_anim_from_p()
	self:reset_signboard_pos()

	local ts = user_party.Leader
	local ms = self.npcs.mad_scientist()
	local p = self.npcs.p()
	local star = self.npcs.stargazer()
	local boss = self.npcs.party_master()
	local revive_pos = star.Position + vector(0, 0, 1)

	character_util.set_direction(boss, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(boss, field_util.get_marker_pos('lop_s2_boss_pos'))

	-- 화면 가려진 동안 세팅

-- [ 연출 ] - 보스 깜빡거림
function local_class:boss_blink_routine()
	local boss = self.npcs.party_master()
	local peak_color = unity_color({ 0.5, 0, 0, 1 })

	-- 중복 루틴 방어
	local req_id = self.boss_blinking_req_id

	-- stop_kid_blinking을 호출하더라도 기존에 동작중이던 코루틴은 즉시 중지되지 않기 때문에 조건을 두개로 분리
	while req_id == self.boss_blinking_req_id and self.is_boss_blinking do
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(boss, peak_color, 1, 1, self.boss_blink_period)

		wait_for_sec(self.boss_blink_period / 3)

		if req_id ~= self.boss_blinking_req_id or not self.is_boss_blinking then
			break
		end

		if self.is_boss_blink_sfx_on then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bomb_count_tick_02')
		end

		wait_for_sec(self.boss_blink_period * 2 / 3)
	end
end

function local_class:start_boss_blinking()
	if self.is_boss_blinking then
		self:stop_boss_blinking()
	end

	self.boss_blinking_req_id = self.boss_blinking_req_id + 1
	self.is_boss_blinking = true

	start_coroutine(self.boss_blink_routine, self)
end

function local_class:stop_boss_blinking()
	local boss = self.npcs.party_master()

	self.is_boss_blinking = false
	boss.SpineController:RemovePulse(nil, 0)
end

-- [ 연출 ] - 성공 연출
function local_class:scene_succeed()
	-- 화면 가려진 동안 세팅
		-- 카메라 별바라기 1칸 위 지점으로 이동
		-- P(left, smile, idle) 이미지의 위치에 배치
		-- 오딜&그레모리(right, idle, idle) 이미지의 위치에 배치
		-- 아이템 3종 & 사인보드 초기 위치로 이동
	self:show_exit()
	self:remove_attachment_from_p()
	self:remove_custom_anim_from_p()
	self:remove_bar_cabinet_interactable()
	self.controller.pickable_items:dispose_all()
	self.controller:dispose_battery_on_shelf()

	local ts = user_party.Leader
	local ms = self.npcs.mad_scientist()
	local p = self.npcs.p()
	local star = self.npcs.stargazer()
	local p_stand_pos = star.Position + vector(0, 0, 1)

	-- 화면 가려진 동안 세팅
	-- 카메라 별바라기 1칸 위 지점으로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(p_stand_pos, 0)
	character_util.set_position(p, p_stand_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(p, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim(p)
	scene_util.set_emotion(p, self, 'smile')

	-- 오딜&그레모리(right, tired, idle) 이미지의 위치에 배치
	character_util.remove_group_emotion({ ts, ms })
	party_util.align_party(p_stand_pos + vector(1, 0, 0), 'right', 0, 'linear')

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 화면 1초간 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- P(right, smile, release): 덕분에 파티 인도자를 무찌를 수 있었습니다. 정말 감사합니다!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_steampunk_basement_02', state = 'event', volume = 0.6 })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(p, self, 'right', 'release', 'smile', 'nightmare_lt_lop_s2_42')

	-- P(right, smile, nod 2회): 역시 인간의 창의력이란 대단하군요…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(p, self, 'right', { name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'smile',
		'nightmare_lt_lop_s2_43')

	-- P(right, smile, eat): 이건 녀석이 흘린 전리품인데, 답례로 드리도록 하겠습니다.
	local eat_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(p, self, 'right', 'eat', 'smile', 'nightmare_lt_lop_s2_44')

	-- P(right, smile, get) 몸에서 스타피스 나와 P 위 1칸 지점에 배치
	local star_piece = get_field_object('lop_starpiece')
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, p.Position, p.Position + vector(0, 0, 1))

	wait_for_sec(1.25)

	-- P(right, smile, salute_china, loop = false): 그럼 전 이만 가보겠습니다. 아직도 사냥해야 할 자동인형들이 잔뜩이라서요.
	eat_sound:Stop()
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(p, self, 'right', { name = 'salute_china', loop = false }, 'smile',
		'nightmare_lt_lop_s2_45')

-- 기획서 링크: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sYQeJZNe9Cx5eNGrnKe2XPxRADGADLYm7TeX5fc2RrQ/edit
local local_class = newclass('NightmareLilithTowerMainSection10')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareLilithTowerMain @
		Comment = 보스전 @
		Index = 9 @
		NextSections = 10 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.boss_room_marker_name = 'lt_main_s10'

	self.available_stage_name = 'nightmare_lilithtower_5'

	self.boss_battle_group_name = 'nightmare_lt_main_s10_boss'
	
	self.zone_names = {
		boss_room = 's10_boss_battle',
		boss_room_entrance = 's10_boss_room_entrance'
	}

	self.cached_fake_androids = {
		two_hand = nil,
		one_hand = nil,
		bow = nil,
		clear = function(this)
			this.two_hand = nil
		this.one_hand = nil
			this.bow = nil
		end
	}

	self.section_state = {
		none = 0,
		boss_room_entered = 1,
		boss_defeated = 2
	}

	self.current_state = self.section_state.none

	self.characters = {
		mad_scientist = function()
			return get_character('mad_scientist')
		end,

		neo_fed_nifty = function()
			return get_character('neo_federation_nifty')
		end,

		neo_fed_shifty = function()
			return get_character('neo_federation_shifty')
		end,
		
		night_fake_android_two_hand = function()
			return get_character('boss_fakeknight_twohand' .. self:get_fake_knight_post_fix())
		end,

		night_fake_android_bow = function()
			return get_character('boss_fakeknight_bow' .. self:get_fake_knight_post_fix())
		end,

		night_fake_android_one_hand = function()
			return get_character('boss_fakeknight_onehand' .. self:get_fake_knight_post_fix())
		end,
	}

	self.fx_pool = {
		event_portalspawn_red_open = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_portalspawn_red_open')
		end,

		event_portalspawn_red_end = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_portalspawn_red_end')
		end,

		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,

		minotaur_buttbounce = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_minotaur_buttbounce')
		end,

		load_all = function(this)
			for k, func in pairs(this) do
				if k ~= 'load_all' then
					func()
				end
			end 
		end
	}

	self.fx_cache = {
		event_portalspawn_red_open = nil,

		dispose_all = function(this)
			for k, effect in pairs(this) do
				if k ~= 'dispose_all' then
					effect:Dispose()
					effect = nil
				end
			end 
		end
	}

	function self.get_battle_gate_by_idx(num)
		return 'battlegate_boss_' .. num
	end

	self.num_boss_battlegates = 8
	self.boss_battle_group_name = 'event_boss'
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
	self:change_stage_music()

	self.fx_pool:load_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local should_start_from_boss_battle = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(
		quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'should_start_from_boss_battle') ~= -1,
		true,
		false
	)

	if should_start_from_boss_battle then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.restarting_from_boss_battle, self)
	else
		
		self:set_auto_quest_marker_info()
		self:set_neo_fed_twin_android()
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.fx_cache:dispose_all()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state >= self.section_state.boss_room_entered then
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.zone_names.boss_room_entrance) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.boss_room_entered
		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_entered_boss_room, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)	
	if self.current_state >= self.section_state.boss_defeated then
		return true
	end

	if e.BattleGroupName == self.boss_battle_group_name then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.boss_defeated
		self:open_boss_battle_gates()
		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_boss_defeated, self)
		return true
	else
		--self:play_stage_music()
		return true
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:change_stage_music()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress ~= 9 then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async(
		{ name = 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/audio:bgm_lilith_terror_01', state = 'field' })
end

function local_class:set_auto_quest_marker_info()
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.characters.neo_fed_shifty() }
	})

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'lop_cam_background_deactive_zone', target = get_field_object('bar_outer_exit') }
	})

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'sewerage_field', target = get_field_object('ladder_left') }
	})
end

function local_class:get_fake_knight_post_fix()
	local is_male = user_util.has_knight_male()

	if is_male then
		return '_f'
	else
		return '_m'
	end
end

function local_class:set_neo_fed_twin_android()
	local active_state = 'enabled'
	local android_init_data = {
		{ 
			fo = self.characters.neo_fed_nifty(),
			marker_name = 's10_neo_twin_a_align_pos'
		},
		{
			fo = self.characters.neo_fed_shifty(),
			marker_name = 's10_neo_twin_b_align_pos'
		}
	}

	for i = 1, #android_init_data do 
		local android = android_init_data[i].fo
		local init_marker = field:GetMarker(android_init_data[i].marker_name)
		character_util.set_position(android, init_marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(android, 'up')
		character_util.set_active_state(android, active_state)
	end
end

		'nightmare_lt_main_s10_9_4')

	-- 오딜(up, idle, shoot): 이런 강자들의 안드로이드를 만들어서 뭘 할 생각인거지? 반란이라도 일으킬 셈인가?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self, 'up', 'shoot', nil,
		'nightmare_lt_main_s10_9_5')

	-- 시프티(down, idle, cast): 모든 것은 아버지의 계획대로. 저희는 그저 따를 뿐.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shifty, self, 'down', 'cast', nil,
		'nightmare_lt_main_s10_9_6')

	-- 시프티(down, sleep_deep, nod 2회): 그 끝에 무엇이 있는지는 저희도 알지 못합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shifty, self, 'down', { name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil,
		'nightmare_lt_main_s10_9_7')

	-- 오딜(up, idle, bomb_idle): 그래, 그 아버지란 놈의 계획에 이것도 포함되는건가?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self, 'up', 'bomb_idle', nil,
		'nightmare_lt_main_s10_9_8')

	-- 오딜(up, idle, release): 생체정보도 얻지 못한 채 이렇게 체포되는게?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self, 'up', 'release', nil,
		'nightmare_lt_main_s10_9_9')

	-- 니프티(down, sleep_deep, cross_arm): 뭔가 착각하고 계시는 것 같은데…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(nifty, self, 'down', 'cross_arm', 'sleep_deep',
		'nightmare_lt_main_s10_10')

	-- 다음 동작 동시에 실행
	local cam_move_duration = 0.7
	local cam_target_size = 3
	cam_align_pos = cam_align_pos + (unity_class.vector3.forward * 2)
	-- 카메라 줌인(0.7, 1)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(cam_target_size, cam_move_duration)
	-- 카메라 0.7초간 위로 2칸 이동
	camera_util.move_async(cam_align_pos, cam_move_duration)

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 카메라 shake(0.25, 0.2)
	camera_util.shake(0.25, 0.2)
	
	-- 니프티(down, idle, bomb_idle): 계획은 이미 성공했어요.
	self.controller:fade_stage_5_loop_sound(4)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(nifty, self, 'down', 'bomb_idle', nil,
		'nightmare_lt_main_s10_11')

	-- 양손검 짭기사 안드로이드 이미지의 방 바깥 위치에 배치
	local fake_knight_android_init_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_fake_knight_android_twohand_init_pos')
	character_util.set_position(fake_knight_android_two_hand, fake_knight_android_init_pos)
	character_util.set_active_state(fake_knight_android_two_hand, 'enabled')

	-- 양손검 짭기사 안드로이드(down, idle, twohand_run) 0.8초간 이미지의 방 안쪽 위치로 이동
	local fake_knight_stand_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_fake_knight_android_stand_pos')
	local fake_knight_move_duration = 0.8
	character_util.move_to(fake_knight_android_two_hand, fake_knight_stand_pos, fake_knight_move_duration, 
		nil, true, false)
	
	-- 니프티(down, idle, sword_attack_stab) 0.1초 대기
	scene_util.set_anim(nifty, self, { name = 'sword_attack_stab', sfx_name = '01_button_08',loop = false } )

	-- 카메라 줌인(2, 0.05)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2, 0.05)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 다음 동작 동시에 실행

	-- 카메라 0.15초간 아래로 1.5칸 이동
	cam_align_pos = cam_align_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.5)
	camera_util.move(cam_align_pos, 0.15)
	
	-- 양손검 짭기사 안드로이드(down, idle, twohand_attack, loop = false)
	scene_util.show_weapon(fake_knight_android_two_hand)
	scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight_android_two_hand, self, { name = 'twohand_attack', loop = false })

	-- 0.2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 타임스케일 0.07배로 슬로우
	local slow_motion_key = 's10_fake_knight'
	time_util.mod(slow_motion_key, 0.07)

	-- 0.05초 대기
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function() 
			while not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(fake_knight_android_two_hand.Position) do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_rise_01')
		end),

		util.cs_generator(function() 
			wait_for_sec(0.05)
		end),
	})

	-- 타임스케일 원복
	time_util.unmod(slow_motion_key)

	-- 0.03초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.03)

	-- 카메라 shake(0.4, 0.6)
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.6)

	-- 카메라 줌아웃(5, 0.1)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0.1)

	-- 짭기사 안드로이드 위치에 FX_minotaur_buttbounce 이펙트 생성
	music_player_util.play_multiple_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_01', '02_twohand_slash_04')
	self.fx_pool.minotaur_buttbounce():Instantiate(fake_knight_android_two_hand.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

	-- 오딜&그레모리(up, idle, dualgun_idle) 아래로 2칸정도 넉백
	scene_util.set_group_anim({ trouble_shooter, mad_scientist }, self, 'dualgun_idle')

	-- 넉백이기 때문에 정확한 위치로 갈 필요 없음
	local knock_back_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(direction_util.get_opposite(user_party.Leader.Direction))
	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
			'linear', true, knock_back_dir, nil, nil,
			nil, false, nil, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceTime,
			CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceDistance * 3)
	command_util.publish_knock_back(trouble_shooter.Owner, trouble_shooter, knock_back_info, trouble_shooter.Position)
	command_util.publish_knock_back(mad_scientist.Owner, mad_scientist, knock_back_info, mad_scientist.Position)

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 니프티(down, idle, bomb_idle): 이렇게 순도가 낮은 생체정보는 가급적 사용하지 않으려 했지만…
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
		{ 
			name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_demonworld_event_2',
			state = 'event',
			volume = 1,
		})
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(nifty, self, 'down', 'bomb_idle', nil,
		'nightmare_lt_main_s10_12')

		-- 니프티(down, idle, release): 상황이 이렇게 된 이상 어쩔 수 없죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(nifty, self, 'down', 'release', nil,
		'nightmare_lt_main_s10_13')

	-- 시프티(down, idle, nod 2회): 그럼 저희는 이만. 준비한 선물이 마음에 드셨으면 좋겠네요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shifty, self, 'down', { name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil,
		'nightmare_lt_main_s10_14')

	-- 니프티와 시프티 사이에 fx_event_potalspawn_red_open 생성
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_portal_08')
	local fx_spawn_pos = vector_util.half(nifty.Position + shifty.Position) + vector(0, 0.1, 0)
	self.fx_cache.event_portalspawn_red_open = self.fx_pool.event_portalspawn_red_open():Instantiate(fx_spawn_pos)
	
	-- 카메라 2초간 오딜&그레모리 중간 지점으로 이동
	cam_align_pos = vector_util.half(trouble_shooter.Position + mad_scientist.Position)
	camera_util.move(cam_align_pos, 2)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 오딜&그레모리(up, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ trouble_shooter, mad_scientist })

	-- 양손검 짭기사 안드로이드(down, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_emotion(fake_knight_android_two_hand)
	scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight_android_two_hand, self, 'twohand_idle')

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 니프티&시프티 캐릭터 비활성화
	character_util.set_group_active_state({ nifty, shifty }, 'disabled')

	-- fx_event_portalspawn_red_open 제거. 동시에 이 위치에 fx_event_portalspawn_red_end 생성
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_portal_11')
	self.fx_cache.event_portalspawn_red_open:Dispose()
	self.fx_cache.event_portalspawn_red_open = nil
	self.fx_pool.event_portalspawn_red_end():Instantiate(fx_spawn_pos)

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 오딜(left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(trouble_shooter, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_weapon(trouble_shooter)

	-- 그레모리(right, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(mad_scientist, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_weapon(mad_scientist)

	local fall_duration = 0.25

	-- 활 짭기사 안드로이드(right, idle, idle) 이미지의 위치로 떨어짐. 떨어지기 시작하는 시점부터 0.5초 대기
	fake_knight_android_init_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_fake_knight_android_bow_init_pos')
	scene_util.set_direction(fake_knight_android_bow, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight_android_bow, self, 'bow_idle')
	self:character_fall_from_sky_async(fake_knight_android_bow, fake_knight_android_init_pos, fall_duration)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 한손검 짭기사 안드로이드(left, idle, idle) 이미지의 위치로 떨어짐. 떨어지기 시작하는 시점부터 1.2초 대기
	fake_knight_android_init_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_fake_knight_android_one_hand_init_pos')
	scene_util.set_direction(fake_knight_android_one_hand, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight_android_one_hand, self, 'sword_idle')
	self:character_fall_from_sky_async(fake_knight_android_one_hand, fake_knight_android_init_pos, fall_duration)

	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	self:show_boss_title()

	-- 1초간 다음 동작 동시에 실행
	-- 카메라 줌인(4, 1)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(cam_move_duration)

	-- 1초간 카메라 오딜에게 이동. 카메라 오딜 팔로우.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(cam_move_duration)
	
	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(fake_knight_android_two_hand)

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ trouble_shooter, mad_scientist })

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'should_start_from_boss_battle', 1)

	-- 컨트롤 회복. 전투 시작.
	self:start_boss_battle()
end

function local_class:show_boss_title()
		-- 보스 타이틀 출력. 2초 대기
		-- title: 가디언 안드로이드
		-- subtitle: 갓 만들어진 신제품들 입니다
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_demonworld_boss', 
		state = 'combat', mix = 0 })
	screen_util.show_boss_title('nightmare_lt_main_s10_boss_title', 'nightmare_lt_main_s10_boss_sub_title', 2)
end

-- 스테이지 재시작시 여기서부터 시작
function local_class:restarting_from_boss_battle()
	self.current_state = self.section_state.boss_room_entered

	local ts = user_party.Leader
	local ms = self.characters.mad_scientist()
	
	character_util.set_position(ts, field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_ts_restart_pos'))
	character_util.set_position(ms, field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_ms_restart_pos'))

	-- 오딜(left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(ts, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(ts, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_weapon(ts)

	-- 그레모리(right, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(ms, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(ms, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_weapon(ms)

	local boss_init_info = {
		{
			fo = self.characters.night_fake_android_bow(),
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_fake_knight_android_bow_init_pos'),
			dir = 'right'
		},
		{
			fo = self.characters.night_fake_android_one_hand(),
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_fake_knight_android_one_hand_init_pos'),
			dir = 'left'
		},
		{
			fo = self.characters.night_fake_android_two_hand(),
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_fake_knight_android_stand_pos'),
			dir = 'down'
		}
	}

	local active_state = 'enabled'

	for i = 1, #boss_init_info do
		character_util.set_active_state(boss_init_info[i].fo, active_state)
		character_util.set_direction(boss_init_info[i].fo, boss_init_info[i].dir)
		character_util.set_position(boss_init_info[i].fo, boss_init_info[i].pos)
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:show_boss_title()

	wait_for_sec(1.75)

	self:start_boss_battle()

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ ts, ms })

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
end

function local_class:convert_fake_night_android_to_enemy(fake_night_android)
	character_util.convert_to_monster(fake_night_android, self.boss_battle_group_name, self.zone_names.boss_room)
	fake_night_android.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.Prostrate
end

-- 하늘에서 떨어지는 캐릭터 연출용 함수
function local_class:character_fall_from_sky_async(character, dest, duration)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(character, false)
	character_util.set_active_state(character, 'enabled')

	scene_util.show_weapon(character)

	character_util.set_position(character, dest + unity_class.vector3.up * 15)
	character_util.move_to_async(character, dest, duration, nil, false, false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	self.fx_pool:last_hit():Instantiate(dest + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

	character_util.set_active_shadow(character, true)

	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.1)
end

-- 보스 전투 종료시 이벤트 실행
function local_class:scene_boss_defeated()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	local trouble_shooter = user_party.Leader
	local mad_scientist = self.characters.mad_scientist()
	local fake_knight_android_bow = self.characters.night_fake_android_bow()
	local fake_knight_android_one_hand = self.characters.night_fake_android_one_hand()
	local fake_knight_android_two_hand = self.characters.night_fake_android_two_hand()

	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip('battle')
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async(
		{ name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_battle_normal_02', state = 'combat' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.convert_to_npc(fake_knight_android_bow)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(fake_knight_android_one_hand)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(fake_knight_android_two_hand)

	-- 캐릭터들 지정된 위치에 세팅
	-- 오딜(left, idle, cross_arm)
	character_util.set_position(trouble_shooter, field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_boss_room_ts_align'))
	character_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(trouble_shooter, self, 'cross_arm')

	-- 그레모리(right, tired, cast)
	character_util.set_position(mad_scientist, field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_boss_room_ms_align'))
	character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim(mad_scientist, self, 'cast')

	-- 짭기사 1(left, idle, prostrate)
	character_util.set_position(fake_knight_android_two_hand,
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_fake_knight_android_two_hand_after_boss'))
	character_util.set_direction(fake_knight_android_two_hand, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight_android_two_hand, self, 'prostrate')

	-- 짭기사 2(left, idle, prostrate)
	character_util.set_position(fake_knight_android_bow,
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_fake_knight_android_bow_after_boss'))
	character_util.set_direction(fake_knight_android_bow, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight_android_bow, self, 'prostrate')

	-- 짭기사 3(right, idle, prostrate)
	character_util.set_position(fake_knight_android_one_hand,
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_fake_knight_android_one_hand_after_boss'))
	character_util.set_direction(fake_knight_android_one_hand, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim(fake_knight_android_one_hand, self, 'prostrate')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	-- 화면 1초에 걸쳐 페이드인
	self.controller:play_stage_5_loop_sound(0.5, 10)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 그레모리(right, tired, cast): 이, 이겼다…
	scene_util.set_emotion(mad_scientist, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self, 'right', 'cast', nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s10_15')

	-- 그레모리(right, tired, release): 이 녀석들… 그 가짜 $name의 안드로이드라기엔 너, 너무 약한데…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self, 'right', 'release', nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s10_16')

	-- 그레모리(left, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'left', false)

	-- 오딜(left, idle, cross_arm): 아마 그 쌍둥이가 말했던대로 생체정보의 순도가 낮았기 때문이겠지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self, 'right', 'cross_arm', nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s10_17')

	-- 그레모리(left, smile, hold_loop): 그럼 이걸로 사, 사건 해결인건가…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self, 'left', 'hold_loop', nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s10_18')

	-- 그레모리(left, tired, cast)
	scene_util.set_anim(mad_scientist, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.set_emotion(mad_scientist, self, 'tired')
	
	-- 오딜(right, tired, bomb_idle): 아니지. 오히려 주동자들이 유유히 도주해 버렸으니…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self, 'right', 'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'nightmare_lt_main_s10_19')
	
	-- 오딜(right, idle, release): …일단 보고드리러 가자.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self, 'right', 'release', nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s10_20')

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ trouble_shooter, mad_scientist })

	self.controller:change_stage_5_volume(0.8)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:start_boss_battle()
	local bosses = {
		self.characters.night_fake_android_two_hand(),
		self.characters.night_fake_android_one_hand(),
		self.characters.night_fake_android_bow()
	}

	for i = 1, #bosses do
		self:convert_fake_night_android_to_enemy(bosses[i])
