local local_class = newclass('NightmareLilithTowerMainSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareLilithTowerMain @
		Comment = NightmareLilithTowerMain 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		entered_battle_zone = 2,
		clear_battle = 3
	}
	self.current_state = self.section_state.none

	self.available_stage_name = 'nightmare_lilithtower_1'

	-- npc
	self.get_trouble_shooter = function ()
		return get_character('trouble_shooter')
	end

	self.get_mad_scientist = function ()
		return get_character('mad_scientist')
	end

	self.get_android = function (idx)
		return get_character('s2_android_' .. idx)
	end
	self.android_count = 6

	self.battle_zone_name = 's2_battle'
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_battle_scene') and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.entered_battle_zone

		sp_util.start_scene(self.battle_scene, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_zone_name and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.entered_battle_zone then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.clear_battle
		sp_util.start_scene(self.clear_battle_scene, self)
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:battle_scene()
	local odile = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()
	local align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_battle_align')

	local android = {}
	for i = 1, self.android_count do
		table.insert(android, self.get_android(i))
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(android[6])
	-- 정지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android[5], self, nil, { name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s2_6')

	character_util.set_locked_dir(odile, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(odile, 'up')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(mad_scientist, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'up')

	wp_util.move(odile, align_pos, nil, 0.5)
	wp_util.move(mad_scientist, align_pos + vector(1, 0, 0), nil, 0.5)
	wp_util.move(android[5], android[5].Position + vector(1, 0, 0), nil, 1, { last_direction = 'down' })
	wp_util.move_async(android[6], android[6].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, 1, { last_direction = 'down' })

	-- 이곳은 승인된 인원만이 접근 가능한 구역입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android[5], self, nil, nil, nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s2_7')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	-- 허가되지 않은 사람은 지나갈 수 없습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android[6], self, nil, nil, nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s2_8')

	scene_util.set_anim(odile, self, 'cross_arm')
	-- 리리스 각하의 명령으로 이곳을 직접 조사하러 왔다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(odile, self, nil, nil, nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s2_9')
	-- 길 좀 비켜줬으면 하는데.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(odile, self, nil, nil, nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s2_10')
	character_util.remove_anim(odile)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	-- 허가되지 않은 인원은 출입을 금합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android[5], self, nil, nil, nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s2_11')

	character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'up')
	character_util.reset_locked_dir(mad_scientist)
	character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'left')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	-- 이 깡통 녀석들… 고, 고집이 좀 쎈데?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self, nil, 'bomb_idle', 'smile', 'nightmare_lt_main_s2_12')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(mad_scientist, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'up')

	-- 어서 비켜!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(odile, self, nil, 'release', 'attack', 'nightmare_lt_main_s2_13')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_03')
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = 1, #android do
		character_util.remove_anim(android[i])
		scene_util.set_emotion(android[i], self, 'attack')
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	-- 침입자 인식.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android[5], self, nil, nil, nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s2_14')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_02')
	scene_util.set_emotion(odile, self, 'attack')
	-- 제거 명령 수행.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android[6], self, nil, { name = 'relese', count = 2 }, nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s2_15')

	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)

	wp_util.move(android[1], { android[1].Position + vector(-3, 0, 0), android[1].Position + vector(-3, 0, -1) }, 2, nil)
	wp_util.move(android[2], android[2].Position + vector(-2, 0, 0), 2, nil)
	wp_util.move(android[3], android[3].Position + vector(-2, 0, 0), 2, nil)
	wp_util.move(android[4], { android[4].Position + vector(0, 0, 3), android[4].Position + vector(1, 0, 3) }, 2, nil)
	wp_util.move(android[5], android[5].Position + vector(0, 0, -4), 2, nil)
	wp_util.move(android[6], android[6].Position + vector(0, 0, -4), 2, nil)

	scene_util.set_emotion(mad_scientist, self, 'attack')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_soldiers_01')

	wp_util.move(mad_scientist, mad_scientist.Position + vector(0, 0, -4), 2, nil)
	wp_util.move_async(odile, odile.Position + vector(0, 0, -4), 2, nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.reset_locked_dir(mad_scientist)
	character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'right')

	character_util.reset_locked_dir(odile)
	character_util.set_direction(odile, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	-- 조심해 그레모리! 이 녀석들 우릴 공격할 생각이야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(odile, self, 'right', nil, nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s2_16')

	character_util.remove_emotion(odile)
	character_util.remove_emotion(mad_scientist)

	for i = 1, #android do
		character_util.remove_emotion(android[i])
		android[i].Interactable.Talk = ''
		character_util.convert_to_monster(android[i], self.battle_zone_name)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = 1, #android do
		command_util.publish_monster_notice(android[i], odile, 'battle')
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local key = 's2_battlegate_' .. i
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(key, true))
	end
end

function local_class:clear_battle_scene()
	local odile = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()
	local align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_battle_clear')
	local ended_air_spin = false

	local android = {}
	for i = 1, self.android_count do
		table.insert(android, self.get_android(i))
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local key = 's2_battlegate_' .. i
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(key, true))
	end

	character_util.set_anim(odile, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	character_util.set_position(odile, align_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(odile, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(mad_scientist, align_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'right')

	-- 모든 안드로이드 에어 스핀 종료까지 대기
	while not ended_air_spin do
		ended_air_spin = true
		for i = 1, #android do
			if android[i].ActiveState ~= active_state('disabled') then
				ended_air_spin =  false
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 안드로이드 revive
	for i = 1, #android do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(android[i])
		character_util.reset_all_state(android[i])

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = android[i]
		heal_info.target = android[i]
		heal_info.heal = android[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

		android[i].SpineController:Rotate(0, 0)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = 1, #android do
		android[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.set_position(android[i], field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_android_dead_' .. i))
		if i > 3 then
			character_util.set_direction(android[i], 'left')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(android[i], 'right')
		end
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(android[i], { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 안드로이드 녀석들… 다짜고짜 공격해 오다니.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(odile, self, nil, nil, nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s2_17')

	-- 각하 말씀대로 뭔가 수상한 낌새가 느껴지는걸.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(odile, self, nil, nil, nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s2_18')
	character_util.remove_anim(odile)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

return local_class

		sp_util.start_scene(self.android_scene, self)

	end

--endregion

function local_class:pre_setting()
	local diary_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_diary') + vector(0, 0.5, -0.2)
	self.diary = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = diary_pos,
		                                        itemid = self.diray_id, notforinven = true,
												sprscale = 1,
												lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
												skip_text = true })
	self.diary.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:android_scene()
	local odile = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()
	local nifty = self.get_nifty()
	local shifty = self.get_shifty()
	local android_1 = self.get_android(1)
	local android_2 = self.get_android(2)

	local computer_1 = get_field_object('s3_computer_1')
	local computer_2 = get_field_object('s3_computer_2')
	local chair = get_field_object('s3_chair')
	local desk = get_field_object('s3_desk')

	local align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_align')
	local desk_pos_1 = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_desk_1')
	local desk_pos_2 = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_desk_2')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	camera_util.move_async(align_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 1)

	-- 안드로이드 루틴
	start_coroutine(function()
		character_util.remove_anim(android_1)
		character_util.set_direction(android_1, 'down')
		command_util.publish_holdup(android_1, desk, android_1.Position, nil, true)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		wp_util.move_async(android_1, android_1.Position + vector(0, 0, 6), 2, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
		character_util.clear_holdup_state(android_1, desk)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01', 0.7)
		scene_util.set_anim(android_1, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })

		local duration = 0.5
		local time_passed = 0
		local progress = 0
		local start_pos = desk.Position
		local end_pos = desk_pos_1 + vector(-1, 0, 0)

		while time_passed < duration do
			progress = time_passed / duration
			desk.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

function local_class:enter()

	self.current_section_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.save_state_key)

	if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none
	end

	-- 섹션 시작 셋팅
	self:pre_setting()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.remote_control_item ~= nil then
		self.remote_control_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.remote_control_item = nil
	end

	if self.turing_android_attack_range_renderer ~= nil then
		self.turing_android_attack_range_renderer:Dispose()
		self.turing_android_attack_range_renderer = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.loop_sfx then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.s1_trailing_event_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.follow_neo_android

		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_follow_neo_android_area, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_interacting_with_the_vent and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.s1_find_vent_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.first_vent_interaction

		-- 처음으로 환풍구 상호작용 시 이벤트
		start_coroutine(self.enter_first_vent_event_zone, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.escape_from_vent and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.s2_technician_event_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.android_threaten_technician

		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_android_technician_area, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.slove_android_puzzle and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.s3_follow_event_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.follow_turing_android

		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_follow_turing_android_first_area, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_tracking_down and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.s3_start_tracking_in_area_1_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.tracking_area_1

		start_coroutine(self.enter_tracking_area_1, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.tracking_area_1 and
			(type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.s3_start_tracking_in_area_2_zone_name) or
					type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.s3_start_tracking_in_area_2_sub_zone_name)) and
			not self.s3_already_entered_tracking_area_2_zone then

		-- 그럴 확률은 거의 없겠지만 만약에 플레이어 캐릭터가 튜링 캐릭터보다 앞서서 두번째 구역에 도착했을 경우 체크할 플래그
		-- 이 플래그가 true면 튜링 캐릭터 2번째 구역 도착 후 바로 다음 루트로 이동하게 함
		self.s3_already_entered_tracking_area_2_zone = true

		start_coroutine(self.close_door_to_area_2, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.tracking_area_2 and
			(type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.s3_start_tracking_in_area_2_zone_name) or
					type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.s3_start_tracking_in_area_2_sub_zone_name)) and
			not self.s3_already_entered_tracking_area_2_zone then
		self.s3_already_entered_tracking_area_2_zone = true

		start_coroutine(self.enter_tracking_area_2, self, false)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.end_tracking and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.s3_enter_secret_meeting_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.find_android_secret_meeting

		sp_util.start_scene(self.discover_android_secret_meeting, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.vent_zone_name) then

		if self.current_section_state > self.section_state.staying_inside_the_vent then
			-- section state 백업
			self.backup_section_state = self.current_section_state
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.staying_inside_the_vent

			start_coroutine(self.change_quest_marker_by_current_section_state, self)
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.staying_inside_the_vent then

			start_coroutine(self.change_quest_marker_by_current_section_state, self)

		end
		return true
	elseif self.getting_out_of_the_vent then

		self.getting_out_of_the_vent = false

		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.vent_out_zone_1_name) then
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

			start_coroutine(self.change_quest_marker_by_current_section_state, self, false, true)
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.vent_out_zone_2_name) then
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

			if self.backup_section_state > self.section_state.staying_inside_the_vent then
				self.current_section_state = self.backup_section_state
			else
				self.current_section_state = self.section_state.escape_from_vent

				start_coroutine(function()
					quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.save_state_key, self.current_section_state)
				end)
			end

			start_coroutine(self.change_quest_marker_by_current_section_state, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave or not lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, e.FieldObject) then return false end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.vent_zone_name) then

		self.getting_out_of_the_vent = true

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)

	if e.BattleGroupName == 's2_battle_1' then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.clear_s2_battle_area, self)
		return true
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == 's3_battle_1' then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.clear_s3_battle_area, self)
			return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.loop_escape = true

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:wait_for_sec_to_stop(sec)
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < sec do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 모든 시간 기다리지 않고 탈출
		if self.loop_escape then
			return false
		end

		if self.is_detected then
			return false
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 기다림 완료
	return true
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	self.fx:load_all()

	self:set_quest_marker_list()

	self:set_pre_npc()

	self:set_pre_npc_data(self.current_section_state, true)

	if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.before_interacting_with_the_vent then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.s1_follow_neo_android_area_door_1, false))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.s1_follow_neo_android_area_door_2, false))
	end

	self:set_scene_data()

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.follow_turing_android then
		self:set_tracking_target_data()
	end

	--
	if self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.first_vent_interaction then
		local fake_vent = self.get_fake_vent_entry()
		local origin_vent = self.get_vent_entry()

		fake_vent.Position = origin_vent.Position
		fake_vent.ActiveState = active_state_type.enabled
		origin_vent.ActiveState = active_state_type.visible
	end

	self:change_quest_marker_by_current_section_state(true)
end

		[self.section_state.none] = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_quest_marker_1'),
		[self.section_state.before_interacting_with_the_vent] = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_quest_marker_2'),
		[self.section_state.escape_from_vent] = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_quest_marker_4'),

		[self.section_state.end_tracking] = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_quest_marker_6'),

function local_class:change_quest_marker_by_current_section_state(enter_stage, exit_vent_in_opposite)
	local enter = lua_helper.get_or_default(enter_stage, false)
	local opposite = lua_helper.get_or_default(exit_vent_in_opposite, false)

	if self.quest_marker_list[self.current_section_state] then
		if not enter then
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.main_quest_marker_name)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		-- 스테이지 진입 시 현재 섹션 스테이트가 first_vent_interaction 경우 퀘스트 마크를 환풍구 입구에 찍는다.
		local quest_mark_pos = nil
		if (enter or opposite) and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.staying_inside_the_vent then
			quest_mark_pos = self.quest_marker_list[self.section_state.before_interacting_with_the_vent]
		else
			quest_mark_pos = self.quest_marker_list[self.current_section_state]
		end

		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.main_quest_marker_name,
				self.main_quest_id, true, quest_mark_pos)
	else
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.main_quest_marker_name)

		if enter then
			if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.staying_inside_the_vent then
				self:set_vent_entrance_quest_marker()
			end
		else
			if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.staying_inside_the_vent then
				if exit_vent_in_opposite then
					self:set_vent_entrance_quest_marker()
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_vent_entrance_quest_marker()
	local quest_mark_pos = nil

	quest_mark_pos = self.quest_marker_list[self.section_state.before_interacting_with_the_vent]

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.main_quest_marker_name,
			self.main_quest_id, true, quest_mark_pos)
end

function local_class:set_pre_npc_data(section_state, enter_point)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	-- staying_inside_the_vent상태일때 스테이지 진입 시에는 예외로 이 다음 state npc 셋팅하도록 함
	if section_state == self.section_state.escape_from_vent then
		pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[self.section_state.android_threaten_technician]
	elseif section_state == self.section_state.slove_android_puzzle then
		pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[self.section_state.follow_turing_android]
	end

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	local enter_stage = lua_helper.get_or_default(enter_point, false)

	for i = 1, #pre_npc_data do
		local npc = get_character(pre_npc_data[i].name)

		if pre_npc_data[i].only_work_enter_point and not enter_stage then
			goto continue
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].remove_lv_ui ~= nil and pre_npc_data[i].remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if pre_npc_data[i].pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if pre_npc_data[i].fly ~= nil and pre_npc_data[i].fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, pre_npc_data[i].pos, isFlying)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, pre_npc_data[i].dir, false)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, pre_npc_data[i].emo)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].anim ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = pre_npc_data[i].anim })
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].keep_shake ~= nil and pre_npc_data[i].keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, pre_npc_data[i].shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', pre_npc_data[i].sorting_layer)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(pre_npc_data[i].tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, pre_npc_data[i].tint_color_key, pre_npc_data[i].tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].interaction then
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].string ~= nil and type_util.is_string(pre_npc_data[i].string) then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = pre_npc_data[i].string
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(pre_npc_data[i].talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = pre_npc_data[i].talk_sfx
		end

		:: continue ::
	end
end

function local_class:enter_follow_neo_android_area()
	local scene_info = self.scene_data[self.section_state.none]
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[self.section_state.none]

	if scene_info == nil or pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	local trouble_shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()
	local neo_android_1 = self.get_neo_android(1, 1)
	local neo_android_2 = self.get_neo_android(1, 2)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	local move_key = 'party_align_1'

	-- 1초에 걸쳐 화면 위쪽으로 5칸 이동 및 오딜, 그레모리 지정된 위치에 up 방향으로 정렬
	local party_align_pos_list = {
		self.get_trouble_shooter_align_pos(1, 1),
		self.get_mad_scientist_align_pos(1, 1),
	}

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(user_party[i],
				party_align_pos_list[i+1],
				nil,
				1,
				self, move_key)
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	party_util.set_direction('up')

	local camera_arrive_pos = self.get_s1_neo_android_pos(1, 1) + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

	-- 카메라 네오 안드로이드들 둘 사이로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(camera_arrive_pos, 1)

	-- 네오 안드로이드1 (right, idle, idle) : 접선 시간까지 얼마 남지 않았습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_android_1, self,
			'right',
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_1_1', skip = true })

	-- 네오 안드로이드1 (up, idle, idle) : 이쪽 길을 따라가면 목표 지점에 도달할 것 입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_android_1, self,
			'up',
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_1_2', skip = true })

	-- 이후 right 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(neo_android_1, 'right', false)

	-- 네오 안드로이드2 (left, idle, cross_arm) : 저희의 조사에 간섭하려는 자들이 있다고 전달 받았습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_android_2, self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'cross_arm' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_1_3', skip = true })

	-- 네오 안드로이드2 (left, idle, nod 1회) : 작업이 방해받지 않도록, 지나온 통로는 막아두는 것이 좋겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_android_2, self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1 },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_1_4', skip = true })

	-- 네오 안드로이드 1,2 NPC 위쪽으로 7칸 이동하며 화면에서 사라짐.
	move_key = 'android_move_1'

	for i = scene_info.neo_android_first_npc_idx, scene_info.neo_android_last_npc_idx do
		local npc = get_character(pre_npc_data[i].name)
		local npc_arrive_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos(
				'up', npc.Position,	1.5)

		wp_util.move(npc, npc_arrive_pos, 3, nil, { end_callback = function()
			character_util.set_position(npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
		end })
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.4)

	-- 네오 안드로이드 1,2가 위쪽으로 5칸 이동했을 때 열려있던 도어 닫힘.
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.s1_follow_neo_android_area_door_1, false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.s1_follow_neo_android_area_door_2, false))

	wait_for_sec(0.35)

	camera_util.move(trouble_shooter.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 3.5), 1)

	-- 오딜, 그레모리 위쪽으로 3.5칸 이동.
	move_key = 'party_align_2'

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(user_party[i],
				user_party[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 3.5),
				nil,
				1,
				self, move_key)
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 오딜 (up, idle, idle) : 이런… 놈들이 문을 닫고 가버렸어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			'up',
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_1_5', skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 오딜 right 방향 전환 1회. 0.5초 대기 이후 left 방향 전환 1회.
	scene_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'right', true)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'left', true)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 오딜 (left, idle, idle) : 아무래도 다른 길을 찾아보는게 좋겠네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			'left',
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_1_6', skip = true })

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_interacting_with_the_vent

	start_coroutine(self.change_quest_marker_by_current_section_state, self)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

function local_class:enter_first_vent_event_zone()
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	self.is_interacted = true

	local trouble_shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()

	party_util.set_direction('left')

	-- 오딜 캐릭터 jump 1회와 동시에 (notice) 이모티콘 표시.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'left', false)
	character_util.normal_jump(trouble_shooter, true)
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'notice')

	-- 오딜 (left, idle, idle) : 저건…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			'left',
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_1_7', skip = true })

	local move_key = 'party_align_1'

	local party_align_pos_list = {
		self.get_trouble_shooter_align_pos(1, 2),
		self.get_mad_scientist_align_pos(1, 2),
	}

	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_walk_03', loop = true })

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(user_party[i],
				party_align_pos_list[i+1],
				nil,
				1,
				self,
				move_key,
				{ last_direction = 'left' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	if self.loop_sfx then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
	end

	-- 오딜 (left, idle, idle) : 저번에 봤던 환풍구잖아.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_1_8', skip = true })

	-- 오딜 (left, idle, question 1초)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_wait_action(trouble_shooter, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'question' },
				nil,
				1)

	-- 오딜 (left, idle, idle) : 이걸 타고 반대편으로 넘어갈 수 있겠어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_1_9', skip = true })

	-- 그레모리 (left, idle, idle) : 오, 오딜… 네가 그, 그렇게나 음침한 곳을 좋아할 줄이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_1_10', skip = true })

	-- 그레모리 (left, smile, cast) : 아닌 척 해도 다 티난다고, 히히…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_1_11', skip = true })

	-- 오딜 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : 시끄러워, 그레모리.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_1_12', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mad_scientist)

	-- 커스텀 저장지점 추가
	-- 커스텀 스테이트 저장
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.staying_inside_the_vent

	start_coroutine(self.change_quest_marker_by_current_section_state, self)

	self:set_pre_npc_data(self.section_state.android_threaten_technician)

	do
		local leader = get_party_leader()
		local origin_vent = self.get_vent_entry()
		local fake_vent = self.get_fake_vent_entry()

		origin_vent.ActiveState = active_state_type.enabled
		fake_vent.ActiveState = active_state_type.disabled

		local cmd = CS.Oak.InteractCommand.Create(leader, origin_vent, leader.Position)

		command_util.publish_cmd(leader.Owner, cmd)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.is_interacted = false

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

	local move_key = 'party_align_1'

	-- 1초에 걸쳐 화면 위쪽으로 5칸 이동 및 오딜, 그레모리 지정된 위치에 up 방향으로 정렬

	camera_util.move_async(self.get_android_technician_pos(1) + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1)

	-- 네오 안드로이드 1 (right, idle, idle) : 이 구역은 관리자님의 명령 하에 조사가 진행되어야 합니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_android_1, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_1', skip = true })

	-- 네오 안드로이드 2 (right, idle, release) : 관계자 외 인원은 밖으로 나가주십시오.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_android_2, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_worker_03' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_2', skip = true })

	-- 기술자 (left, idle, bomb_idle) : 무슨 소리야…? 난 그냥 이곳 안드로이드들을 정비하러 온건데…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(technician, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_3', skip = true })

	-- 기술자 캐릭터 머리 위에 (notice) 이모티콘 표시.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(technician, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'notice')

	-- 기술자 (left, smile, idle) : 그보다… 너희 네오=페더레이션에서 왔다고 했지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(technician, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_4', skip = true })

	-- 기술자 (left, smile, sing) : 한번쯤 구동 매커니즘을 분석해보고 싶었어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(technician, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'sing', one_shot_sfx = '01_bad_fairy_01' },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_5', skip = true })

	-- 기술자 NPC 위쪽으로 0.5칸, 왼쯕으로 2칸 이동 이후 eat 자세 지속하여 진행.
	-- NPC의 이동 속도값은 3으로 수정
	local technician_move_list = {
		technician.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
		technician.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0.5),
	}
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(technician,
			technician_move_list,
			3,
			nil,
			self,
			move_key,
			{ last_direction = 'left', end_callback = function()
				scene_util.set_anim(technician, self, { name = 'eat' })

				-- 이후 sfx 재생
				-- 01_clang_01 + 03_equipping_01
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clang_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_equipping_01')
			end })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 네오 안드로이드 2 (right, idle, idle) : 경고합니다. 무분별한 접촉은 금지입니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_android_2, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_6', skip = true })

	-- 기술자 (left, smile, eat) : 동력 제어 장치도 깔끔하고, 최적화도 흠잡을데가 없어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(technician, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_7', skip = true })

	-- 기술자 (left, smile, eat) : 사이버로보틱스의 기술력은 정말 엄청나구나…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(technician, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_8', skip = true })

	-- 네오 안드로이드2 0.03값으로 1초동안 shake.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(neo_android_2, 0.03, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 네오 안드로이드 1,2,3,4 모두 mad 표정 전환.
	for i = 1, scene_info.neo_android_all_count do
		local android = self.get_neo_android(2, i)

		scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, 'mad')
	end

	-- 네오 안드로이드 2 (right, mad, idle) : 돌발 접촉 상황 발생.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_android_2, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'mad', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_9', skip = true })

	-- 기술자 (left, surprise, idle 자세로 jump 1회)
	character_util.remove_anim(technician)
	scene_util.set_emotion(technician, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(technician, true)

	-- 네오 안드로이드 2 (right, mad, release) : 프로그래밍에 따라, 접촉자를 제거 처리 하겠습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_android_2, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_10', skip = true })

	-- 기술자 (left, surprise, embarrassed) : 잠, 잠깐…! 살, 살려줘!!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(technician, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'embarrassed' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_11', skip = true })

	-- 기술자 NPC 오른쪽으로 6.5칸, 위쪽으로 4.5칸 run 자세로 이동 후 (right, idle, seat) 자세로 0.03값 지속 shake.
	-- 도망가는 이동속도는 7
	local technician_runaway_move_list = {
		technician.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
		technician.Position + vector(2, 0, 4),
	}

	wp_util.move(technician, technician_runaway_move_list, 7, nil, {
		run = true,
		play_sfx = '01_dash_01',
		end_callback = function()
			scene_util.set_direction(technician, 'right', false)
			scene_util.set_anim(technician, self, { name = 'seat' })

			character_util.remove_emotion(technician)

			character_util.shake(technician, 0.03, 999999)

			scene_info.backup_technician_talk_string = technician.Interactable.Talk
			technician.Interactable.Talk = ''
		end
	})

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 다시 플레이어에게로 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	wp_util.move(trouble_shooter, trouble_shooter.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 5.5, nil, { run = true })
	wp_util.move_async(mad_scientist, mad_scientist.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 5.5, nil, { run = true })

	-- 오딜 (right, attack, release) : [shout] 거기 멈춰!
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
	nil,
			{ name = 'release', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_negative_01' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
	{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_12', skip = true })

	-- 네오 안드로이드 1,2,3,4 left 방향 전환 후 0.5초 대기
	-- 네오 안드로이드들 왼쪽으로 방향 전환
	for i = 1, scene_info.neo_android_all_count do
		scene_util.set_direction(self.get_neo_android(2, i), 'left', false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 네오 안드로이드 1 (left, mad, idle) : 미확인 침입자, 발견.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.get_neo_android(2, 1), self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'mad', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_13', skip = true })

	-- 네오 안드로이드 4 (left, mad, cast2) : 처단! 처단하라!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.get_neo_android(2, 4), self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast2', keep = true, one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_worker_02' },
			{ name = 'mad', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_14', skip = true })

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.main_quest_marker_name)

	start_coroutine(function()
		for i = 1, scene_info.neo_android_all_count do
			local android = self.get_neo_android(2, i)

			if android ~= nil then
				character_util.convert_to_monster(android, 's2_battle_1', 's2_battle_1')
				command_util.publish_monster_notice(android, user_party.Leader, 'battle')

				character_util.remove_anim(android)
			end
		end
	end)

	for i = 1, scene_info.neo_android_all_count do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.get_neo_android(2, i))
	end
end

function local_class:clear_s2_battle_area()
	local scene_info = self.scene_data[self.section_state.android_threaten_technician]
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[self.section_state.android_threaten_technician]

	if scene_info == nil or pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	local trouble_shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()
	local technician = self.get_android_technician()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local party_align_pos_list = {
		self.get_trouble_shooter_align_pos(2, 2),
		self.get_mad_scientist_align_pos(2, 2),
	}

	-- 각 캐릭터들 재배치
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], party_align_pos_list[i + 1])

		scene_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'right', false)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(technician)
	character_util.set_position(technician, self.get_android_technician_pos(2))
	character_util.stop_shake(technician)

	scene_util.set_direction(technician, 'left', false)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 테스트
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 1초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 기술자 (left, idle, idle) : 고, 고마워… 하마터면 안드로이드 지옥으로 갈 뻔했어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(technician, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_15', skip = true })

	-- 대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 기술자 (left, idle, question) : 그러고보니… 너희 둘은 저번에 세이프하우스에서 봤던…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(technician, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'question', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_16', skip = true })

	-- 오딜 (right, idle, nod 1회) : 오딜이다. 리리스 각하의 명령으로 이곳을 조사하고 있는 중이지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1 },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_17', skip = true })

	-- 그레모리 (right, idle, cast) : 난, 그레모리… 또 만났네. 안, 안드로이드 덕후.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_18', skip = true })

	-- 기술자 (left, idle, idle) : 그랬구나. 갑자기 네오=페더레이션 안드로이드들이 공격하려 하길래 깜짝 놀랐어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(technician, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_19', skip = true })

	-- 기술자 (left, idle, cast) : 벨레누스님께 다시 한번 감사드려야겠어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(technician, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_20', skip = true })

	-- 기술자 (left, idle, idle) : 각, 각하의 명령으로 타워를 조사해야 한다고 했지? 그럼 이게 필요할 거야.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(technician, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_21', skip = true })

	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = vector(999, 0, 999),
		itemid = self.remote_control_item_num,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
	})

	-- 기술자 (left, idle, eat 자세 1초)
	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.play_wait_action(technician, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'eat' },
				nil,
				1)

	if self.loop_sfx then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end

	-- 기술자 release 1회 동작과 함께 Force_field_generator 아이템 오딜 캐릭터의 0.1칸오른쪽 위치로 fly하여 던짐.
	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(technician, 'release')

	scene_util.set_anim(technician, self, { name = 'release', count = 1 })

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.5)

	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_air_spin_01', loop = true })

	item.Position = technician.Position
	drop_item_util.throw_item(item, trouble_shooter.Position + vector(0.1, 0, 0))

	if self.loop_sfx then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end

	wait_for_sec((anim_duration * 0.5) + 0.5)

	-- 이후 아이템이 오딜 캐릭터에 습득됨.
	item.ConsumeTarget = trouble_shooter

	-- 기술자 (left, idle, release 2회) : 그걸로 타워의 안드로이드들을 조종 할 수 있어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(technician, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_22', skip = true })

	-- 오딜 (right, idle, nod 2회) : 고마워. 유용하게 쓸게.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2, one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_positive_01' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_23', skip = true })

	-- 나레이션 박스 출력
	-- 『이제 스테이지의 버려진 안드로이드를 조작할 수 있습니다.』
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_2_24' })

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	-- 이후 기술자 NPC 인터렉트 시, 하단의 원라인 대사 출력

	-- 기술자 (left, idle, idle) : 언젠가 사이버로보틱스에 한번 견학 가보고 싶다…
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(technician, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	technician.Interactable.Talk = scene_info.backup_technician_talk_string
	technician.Interactable.TalkSfx = '01_rustle_01'

	-- 커스텀 저장지점 추가
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.slove_android_puzzle

	start_coroutine(self.change_quest_marker_by_current_section_state, self)

	self:set_pre_npc_data(self.section_state.follow_turing_android)

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.save_state_key, self.current_section_state)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

function local_class:enter_follow_turing_android_first_area()
	local scene_info = self.scene_data[self.section_state.follow_turing_android]
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[self.section_state.follow_turing_android]

	if scene_info == nil or pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	local trouble_shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()
	local technician = self.get_android_technician()
	local turing_android = self.get_turing_android(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	local move_key = 'party_align_1'

	local door = get_field_object('follow_android_door_1')
	local door_animator = door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	door_animator:Play('open')
	door.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

	-- 1초에 걸쳐 화면 위쪽으로 5칸 이동 및 오딜, 그레모리 지정된 위치에 up 방향으로 정렬
	local party_align_pos_list = {
		self.get_trouble_shooter_align_pos(3, 1),
		self.get_mad_scientist_align_pos(3, 1),
	}

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(user_party[i],
				party_align_pos_list[i+1],
				nil,
				1,
				self,
				move_key,
				{ last_direction = 'down' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 오딜 (down, attack, jump 1회)와 동시에 (notice) 이모티콘 표시.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(trouble_shooter, true)
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			'notice')

	--오딜 (down, attack, release) : 저, 저 놈은…?!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_1', skip = true })

	-- 카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 아래쪽으로 6칸 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(vector(stage_camera.LookAtPosition.x, 0, turing_android.Position.z), 0.5)

	-- 대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 튜링 (down, attack, question) : 젠장. 접선 장소를 왜 하필 타워 내부로 한거야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(turing_android, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'question', keep = true, one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },

function local_class:enter_tracking_area_1()
	-- area 2에서 튜링 npc 트래킹하고 있다는 플래그라면 함수 탈출
	if self.current_tracking_area == self.tracking_area.area_2 then
		return
	end

	self.current_tracking_area = self.tracking_area.area_1

	start_coroutine(self.close_door_to_area_1, self)

	self.turing_android_on_patrol = true
	start_coroutine(self.patrol_turing_detect_process, self)

	self:target_begins_to_search_around(self.tracking_area.area_1)
end

function local_class:close_door_to_area_1()
	if not self.once_check_1_on_tracking_event then
		self.once_check_1_on_tracking_event = true

		local door = get_field_object('follow_android_door_1')
		local door_animator = door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		door_animator:Play('close')

		door.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_up_03')
	end
end

function local_class:enter_tracking_area_2(already_entered)
	self.current_tracking_area = self.tracking_area.area_2

	if not already_entered then
		start_coroutine(self.close_door_to_area_2, self)
	end

	self:target_begins_to_search_around(self.tracking_area.area_2)
end

function local_class:close_door_to_area_2()
	if not self.once_check_2_on_tracking_event then
		self.once_check_2_on_tracking_event = true

		local door = get_field_object('follow_android_door_3')
		local door_animator = door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		door_animator:Play('close')

		door.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_up_03')
	end
end

function local_class:target_begins_to_search_around(area_idx)
	local turing_android = self.get_turing_android(1)

	local move_end = false

	for i = 1, #self.tracking_target_data_list[area_idx] do
		local data_list = self.tracking_target_data_list[area_idx]

		if self.is_detected then
			return
		end

		if data_list[i].move_pos ~= nil and data_list[i].move_speed ~= nil then
			wp_util.move(turing_android,
					data_list[i].move_pos,
					data_list[i].move_speed,
					nil, { end_callback = function() move_end = true end })
		else
			move_end = true
		end

		while not move_end do
			if self.is_detected then
				return
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if self.is_detected then
			return
		end

		if data_list[i].move_end_func ~= nil then
			if not data_list[i].move_end_func(turing_android) then
				-- 발각 연출 함수
				return
			end
		end

		move_end = false
	end

	-- 2번째 구역가지 클리어했을 경우 컨트롤 불가능 이벤트 시작
	if area_idx == self.tracking_area.area_2 then
		self.turing_android_on_patrol = false
		self.current_tracking_area = self.tracking_area.not_tracking

		sp_util.start_scene(self.end_target_tracking, self)
	end
end

function local_class:patrol_turing_detect_process()
	local turing_android = self.get_turing_android(1)

	if self.turing_android_attack_range_renderer == nil then
		self.turing_android_attack_range_renderer = CS.Oak.GhostGuardAttackRangeRenderer(turing_android,
				self.turing_android_sight_distance, self.turing_android_sight_angle)
	end

	self.turing_android_attack_range_renderer.AttackRange:Show(0)

	while self.turing_android_on_patrol do
		self.turing_android_attack_range_renderer:Update(turing_android)

		local detected = self:is_in_sight(turing_android, user_party.Leader,
				self.turing_android_sight_distance, self.turing_android_sight_angle)

		if detected then
			self.turing_android_on_patrol = false
			self.is_detected = true

			character_util.stop(turing_android)

			sp_util.start_scene(self.on_detected, self, turing_android)

			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.turing_android_attack_range_renderer ~= nil then
		self.turing_android_attack_range_renderer:Dispose()
		self.turing_android_attack_range_renderer = nil
	end
end

-- 감시병 발각시 연출
function local_class:on_detected(detecting_android)
	self.turing_android_attack_range_renderer.AttackRange:Hide()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	party_util.look_at(detecting_android)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'surprise' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'embarrassed' })
	party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detecting_android, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release', keep = true },
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_patrol_1', skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	local area_index = (self.current_section_state - self.section_state.tracking_area_1) + 1
	local reset_party_pos = self.get_s3_turing_android_reset_pos(area_index)
	local reset_party_dir = nil
	local reset_android_dir = nil

	local door_reset_animator_speed = 10
	local door_backup_animator_speed = 0
	local open_door_index = 0

	if area_index == self.tracking_area.area_1 then
		local door_1 = get_field_object('follow_android_door_1')
		local door_1_animator = door_1:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		door_backup_animator_speed = door_1_animator.speed
		door_1_animator.speed = door_reset_animator_speed
		door_1_animator:Play('open')

		local door_2 = get_field_object('follow_android_door_2')
		local door_2_animator = door_2:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		door_2_animator:Play('close')

		local door_3 = get_field_object('follow_android_door_3')
		local door_3_animator = door_3:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		door_3_animator:Play('close')

		door_1.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
		door_2.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		door_3.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

		open_door_index = 1

	elseif area_index == self.tracking_area.area_2 then
		local door_3 = get_field_object('follow_android_door_3')
		local door_3_animator = door_3:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		door_backup_animator_speed = door_3_animator.speed
		door_3_animator.speed = door_reset_animator_speed
		door_3_animator:Play('open')

		door_3.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

		open_door_index = 3
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(detecting_android)
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	if area_index == self.tracking_area.area_1 then
		reset_party_dir = 'down'

		reset_android_dir = 'left'

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_tracking_down

	elseif area_index == self.tracking_area.area_2 then
		reset_party_dir = 'left'

		reset_android_dir = 'left'

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.tracking_area_2
	end

	self.s3_already_entered_tracking_area_2_zone = false

	character_util.set_position(detecting_android,
			self.get_s3_turing_android_pos(1, area_index + 1, 1))
	scene_util.set_direction(detecting_android, reset_android_dir, false)

	party_util.position_party(reset_party_pos, reset_party_dir, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	local door = get_field_object('follow_android_door_' .. open_door_index)
	local door_animator = door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	door_animator.speed = door_backup_animator_speed

	self.is_detected = false

	self.once_check_1_on_tracking_event = false
	self.once_check_2_on_tracking_event = false

	self.turing_android_on_patrol = true
	start_coroutine(self.patrol_turing_detect_process, self)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

--- 오브젝트가 감시 범위에 포함되는지 체크
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target, distance, angle)
	if fo == nil then
		return false
	end

	if fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
		return false
	end

	if fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	if target.Position.y >= 1 then
		return false
	end

	local diff = target.Bounds.center - vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center)

	if diff.magnitude > distance then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0

	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized, direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)) > angle / 2 then
		return false
	end

	local full_diff = fo.Bounds.center - target.Bounds.center

	if field:IsAnythingBlocking(CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(target.Bounds.center, vector(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)),
			CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, vector_util.get_x0z(full_diff)) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:end_target_tracking()
	local scene_info = self.scene_data[self.section_state.follow_turing_android]
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[self.section_state.follow_turing_android]

	if scene_info == nil or pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	local trouble_shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()
	local turing_android = self.get_turing_android(1)

	if self.android_attack_range_renderer ~= nil then
		self.android_attack_range_renderer.AttackRange:Hide()
	end

	-- 이후 플레이어 컨트롤 강제되며, 카메라 1초에 걸쳐 튜링 NPC위치를 향해 패닝.
	-- 카메라 해당 위치 고정.
	camera_util.move_async(turing_android.Position, 1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 튜링 (down, idle, attack 1회)
	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(1.3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_itemdoor_open_04')
	end)

	scene_util.set_anim_async(turing_android, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

	local last_door = get_field_object('follow_android_door_4')
	local last_door_animator = last_door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	last_door_animator:Play('open')

	local door_2 = get_field_object('follow_android_door_2')
	local door_2_animator = door_2:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	door_2_animator:Play('open')

	local door_3 = get_field_object('follow_android_door_3')
	local door_3_animator = door_3:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	door_3_animator:Play('open')

	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	last_door.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

	door_2.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

	door_3.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

	-- 튜링 NPC 아래쪽으로 5칸 이동하며 화면에서 사라짐.

	wp_util.move(turing_android, self.get_s3_turing_android_pos(1, 4, 1),
			3.5,
			nil,
			{ last_direction = 'left' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 카메라 1초에 걸쳐 플레이어에게로 복귀.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.end_tracking

	start_coroutine(self.change_quest_marker_by_current_section_state, self)
end

function local_class:discover_android_secret_meeting()
	local scene_info = self.scene_data[self.section_state.find_android_secret_meeting]

	if scene_info == nil then
		return
	end

	local trouble_shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()
	local turing_android = self.get_turing_android(1)
	local neo_android = self.get_neo_android(3, 1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	-- 플레이어가 강제 트리거 존에 진입할 시, 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	-- 동시에  걸쳐 오딜, 그레모리 캐릭터가 각각 지정된 타일 위치에 down 방향 정렬

		self.get_trouble_shooter_align_pos(3, 2),
		self.get_mad_scientist_align_pos(3, 2),

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(user_party[i],
				party_align_pos_list[i+1],
				nil,
				1,
				self,
				move_key,
				{ last_direction = 'down' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 전투 시작 전 셋팅 원래대로
	character_util.set_active_state(turing_android, 'enabled')

			nil,
			nil,

			nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1 },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_11', skip = true })

	-- 네오 안드로이드1 (right, idle, nod 2회) : 알겠습니다. 조사 결과에 대해 보고해 주십시오.

			nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_12', skip = true })

	-- 튜링 안드로이드 (left, idle, cross_arm) : 조직원 전원이 샅샅이 뒤져봤지만 타겟을 찾는 데엔 실패했다.

			nil,
			{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_13', skip = true })

	-- 튜링 안드로이드 (left, idle, cross_arm) : 조사에 따르면… 아직 타겟은 타워 바깥으로 나간 흔적은 보이지 않더군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(turing_android, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_14', skip = true })

	-- 튜링 안드로이드 (left, idle, idle) : 좀 더 면밀히 찾아볼테니, 계속해서 타워 안을 뒤지고 있으라고.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(turing_android, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'idle' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_15', skip = true })

			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },

			nil,
			{ name = 'release' },
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_17', skip = true })

	-- 튜링 안드로이드 (up, idle, idle) : 쳇, 쥐새끼가 숨어들어왔을 줄이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(turing_android, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_18', skip = true })

	-- 튜링 안드로이드 (up, idle, release 2회) : [shout] 처리해!
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(turing_android, self,
	nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2, one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_negative_01' },
	nil,
	{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_19', skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.main_quest_marker_name)

	start_coroutine(function()
		for i = 1, scene_info.neo_android_all_count do
			local android = self.get_neo_android(3, i)

			if android ~= nil then
				character_util.convert_to_monster(android, 's3_battle_1', 's3_battle_1')
				command_util.publish_monster_notice(android, user_party.Leader, 'battle')

				character_util.remove_anim(android)
			end
		end

		character_util.convert_to_monster(turing_android, 's3_battle_1', 's3_battle_1')
		command_util.publish_monster_notice(turing_android, user_party.Leader, 'battle')

		field_ui_manager:SetUI(turing_android, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

		character_util.remove_anim(turing_android)
	end)
end

function local_class:clear_s3_battle_area()
	local trouble_shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()
	local turing_android = self.get_turing_android(1)
	local neo_android = self.get_neo_android(3, 1)

	local scene_info = self.scene_data[self.section_state.find_android_secret_meeting]

	if scene_info == nil then
		return
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_sorting_layer(turing_android, 'Default', -1)

	local party_align_pos_list = {
		self.get_trouble_shooter_align_pos(3, 3),
		self.get_mad_scientist_align_pos(3, 3),
	}

	-- 각 캐릭터들 재배치
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], party_align_pos_list[i + 1])

		scene_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'right', false)
	end

	local android = nil
	for i = 1, scene_info.neo_android_all_count do
		android = self.get_neo_android(3, i)

		if android ~= nil then
			character_util.set_active_state(android, 'enabled')

			character_util.set_position(android, self.get_s3_neo_android_pos(i, 2))

			scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = 'prostrate' })
			scene_util.set_direction(android, 'left', false)
		end
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(turing_android, 'enabled')

	character_util.set_position(turing_android, self.get_s3_turing_android_pos(1, 4, 1))

	scene_util.set_direction(turing_android, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(turing_android, self, { name = 'seat' })

	-- 카메라는 ‘튜링 안드로이드’를 중심으로 포커스.
	camera_util.move(turing_android.Position, 0)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	-- 1초에 걸처 화면 일반 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 오딜 (right, attack, cross_arm) : 순순히 불어, 튜링 안드로이드.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cross_arm' },
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_20', skip = true })

	-- 오딜 (right, attack, release) : 뒤에 있는 네오=페더레이션 놈들과 접선해서 뭘 꾸미고 있었는지!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_21', skip = true })

	-- 1초에 걸쳐 Stage Camera 3.5로 줌인.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_03')
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3.5, 1)

	-- 네오 안드로이드1 (left, idle, prostrate) : 긴급 상황.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_android, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'prostrate', keep = true, one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_worker_03' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_22', skip = true })

	-- 네오 안드로이드1 (left, idle, seat) : 입수한 모든 자료 인멸 후 소멸 절차에 돌입.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_android, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_23', skip = true })

	local is_all_androids_exploded = false
	-- 네오 안드로이드 1,2,3,4,5가 0.04값으로 shake 1초 후 FX_Explosion_Bomb_new 이펙트와 함께 제거.
	local andorid_shake_n_explosion = function(target)
		-- 01_rustle_01 + 03_dialogue_worker_03
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')

		character_util.shake(target, 0.04, 1)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')

		self.fx:explosion_bomb():Instantiate(target.Position)

		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

		character_util.set_position(target, vector(999, 0, 999))

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	-- 네오 안드로이드 1,2,3,4,5가 0.03값으로 shake 1초 후 FX_Explosion_Bomb_new 이펙트와 함께 제거.
	-- 순서 : 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 ( 각 순서마다 0.5초의 텀을 넣음 )
	-- FX_Explosion_Bomb_new 이펙트 출력될때마다 화면 0.3값으로 0.5초 shake.
	andorid_shake_n_explosion(self.get_neo_android(3, 1))

	-- 1번째 안드로이드 폭발했을 때 오딜 , 그레모리 (right, attack, jump 1회).
	scene_util.set_emotion(trouble_shooter, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(trouble_shooter, true)

	scene_util.set_emotion(mad_scientist, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(mad_scientist, false)

	andorid_shake_n_explosion(self.get_neo_android(3, 2))

	start_coroutine(function()
		andorid_shake_n_explosion(self.get_neo_android(3, 3))

		andorid_shake_n_explosion(self.get_neo_android(3, 4))

		andorid_shake_n_explosion(self.get_neo_android(3, 5))

		is_all_androids_exploded = true
	end)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_demonworld_event_8', state = 'event'})

	-- 오딜 (right, attack, idle) : 이, 이녀석들…! 자폭할 셈이야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_24', skip = true })

	while not is_all_androids_exploded do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 01_rustle_01 + 03_dialogue_worker_03
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')

	-- 튜링 안드로이드 0.04값으로 shake 하기 시작.
	character_util.shake(turing_android, 0.04, 99999)

	-- 튜링 안드로이드가 shake를 시작한지 0.7초가 지난 후 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	-- 오딜 (right, attack, release) : 그레모리! 저 녀석 붙잡아!!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_negative_01' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_25', skip = true })

	-- 슬로우 모션 진행. (타임 스케일 값: 0.5 / 총 연출은 2초에 걸쳐 진행)
	time_util.mod('catch_turing', 0.5)

	-- [0초 ~ 1초] Stage Camera가 값 3으로 줌인하는
	-- 동시에 오딜, 그레모리 (right, attack, prostrate) 자세로 튜링 안드로이드 NPC를 향해 jump.
	-- 오딜은 튜링안드로이드의 0.3칸 왼쪽 위치로 jump.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 1)

	-- 카메라 줌인과 동시에 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')

	-- 오딜 & 그레모리 right 방향으로 점프 sfx
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

	scene_util.set_anim(trouble_shooter, self, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.jump(trouble_shooter, 0.75, 1)
	character_util.move_to(trouble_shooter, turing_android.Position + vector(-0.6, 0, 0),
			1, nil, true, false)


	-- 그레모리는 튜링 안드로이드의 0.3칸 오른쪽 위치로 jump.
	scene_util.set_emotion(mad_scientist, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(mad_scientist, self, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.jump(mad_scientist, 0.75, 1)
	character_util.move_to_async(mad_scientist, turing_android.Position + vector(0.6, 0, 0),
			1, nil, true, false)

	-- 오딜, 그레모리 jump하여 튜링 안드로이드 위치에 착지하며 슬로우 모션 종료.
	time_util.unmod('catch_turing')

	-- 오딜, 그레모리가 jump하여 착지했을 때, 카메라 0.4값으로 1초 shake.
	-- 동시에 튜링 안드로이드 NPC쪽에 FX_hit 와 FX_lasthit 이펙트, Damage Squish, Red pulse 출력
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 1)

	-- 튜링 prostrate와 동시에 sfx 재생
	-- 02_hit_big_01 + 01_trip_03
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')

	self.fx:hit():Instantiate(turing_android.Position)
	self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(turing_android.Position)

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(turing_android)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(turing_android)

	-- 튜링 안드로이드 seat 자세에서 prostrate 자세로 전환.
	scene_util.set_anim(turing_android, self, { name = 'prostrate' })

	-- 오딜 0.04값으로 shake 하기 시작.
	character_util.shake(trouble_shooter, 0.04, 99999)

	-- 대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 그레모리 (left, idle, eat) : 꽈, 꽉 잡고 있어 오딜…!
	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = nil },
			{ name = 'eat', keep = true },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_26', skip = true })

	-- 대기 1초
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.stop_shake(trouble_shooter)

	-- 튜링 안드로이드 shake 종료에 1회 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_02')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 4 })

	-- 튜링 안드로이드 (left, damaged, prostrate 애니메이션 정지) 상태 전환.
	scene_util.set_emotion(turing_android, self, 'damaged')
	character_util.stop_shake(turing_android)
	character_util.set_anim_time_scale(turing_android, 0)

	-- 대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 그레모리 eat 애니메이션 정지 상태로 전환.
	character_util.set_anim_time_scale(mad_scientist, 0)

	if self.loop_sfx then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
	end

	-- 대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 그레모리 (left, attack, eat 애니메이션 정지) : 이, 이제야 얌전해 졌네…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_27', skip = true })

	-- 오딜 right 방향 고정한채로 1초에 걸쳐 왼쯕으로 1.5칸 백스텝.
	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_walk_03', loop = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(trouble_shooter)
	wp_util.move_async(trouble_shooter, trouble_shooter.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
			nil, 1, { locked_dir = 'right' })

	if self.loop_sfx then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 4 })

	-- 오딜 (right, attack, idle) : 설마 자폭까지 하려들 줄은…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_28', skip = true })

	-- 오딜 (right, attack, idle) : 대체 뭘 숨기고 있길래 이런 짓까지 하는거지…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,

			nil,

	-- 오딜 (right, idle, question 1초)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_30', skip = true })

	-- 그레모리 (left, idle, eat 애니메이션 정지) : 무, 문제 없다고.

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_31', skip = true })

	-- 그레모리 (left, idle, eat 1초)
	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	character_util.set_anim_time_scale(mad_scientist, 1)

	-- 동시에 튜링 안드로이드 (left, vr, prostrate) 자세로 0.03값 shake 지속
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clang_01')

	character_util.shake(turing_android, 0.03, 99999)
	scene_util.set_anim(turing_android, self, { name = 'prostrate' })

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self,
			nil,

			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s4_3_32', skip = true })

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.available_stage_name = 'nightmare_lilithtower_3'

	--state
	self.section_state = {
		before_shifty_zone_enter = 1,
		after_shifty_zone_enter = 2,
		done = 99,
	}
	self.current_state = self.section_state.before_shifty_zone_enter

	--marker state
	self.quest_marker_state = {
		before_vent_in = 1,
		vent_finish = 2,
		interact_exit = 3,
		done = 99,
	}
	self.current_marker_state = self.quest_marker_state.before_vent_in
	self.quest_marker_key = 1

	--npc
	self.get_trouble_shooter = function()
		return get_character('trouble_shooter')
	end

	self.get_mad_scientist = function()
		return get_character('mad_scientist')
	end

	self.get_nifty = function()
		return get_character('nifty')
	end

	self.get_shifty = function()
		return get_character('shifty')
	end

	self.neo_android = function(num)
		return get_character('s5_neo_android_' .. num)
	end

	--door
	self.door = {
		name = 's6_open_door_',
		count = 2,
		open = function(this)
			for num = 1, this.count do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(this.name .. num, true))
			end
		end,
	}
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent), 'on_exit_interact_teleport_start_event')

	--진행도 불러오기
	local custom_data = stage_progress_util.get_custom_data_int(self.quest_marker_key, -1)
	if custom_data ~= -1 then
		self.current_marker_state = custom_data
	end

	self:quest_marker_with_progress()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent))

end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	--벤트 최초 탈출
	if self.current_marker_state == self.quest_marker_state.before_vent_in and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'vent_finish_enter_zone') then
		self.current_marker_state = self.quest_marker_state.vent_finish
		stage_progress_util.set_custom_data(self.quest_marker_key, self.current_marker_state)
		self:quest_marker_with_progress()
		return true
	end

	--쌍둥이 안드로이드 대화
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_shifty_zone_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's5_twins_talk_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.after_shifty_zone_enter
		sp_util.start_scene(self.twins_talk_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_exit_interact_teleport_start_event(e)
	--엑시트 최초 이동
	if self.current_marker_state == self.quest_marker_state.vent_finish and
			e.ExitHandleName == '1F_emergency_exit' then
		self.current_marker_state = self.quest_marker_state.interact_exit
		stage_progress_util.set_custom_data(self.quest_marker_key, self.current_marker_state)
		self:quest_marker_with_progress()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

local local_class = newclass('NightmareLilithTowerMainSection8')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareLilithTowerMain @
		Comment = 가짜 가디언 추락한 곳 CCTV 룰 확인함 @
		Index = 7 @
		NextSections = 8 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_specs

	self.available_stage_name = 'nightmare_lilithtower_4'

	-- 오딜
	self.get_trouble_shooter = function()
		return get_character('trouble_shooter')
	end

	-- 그레모리
	self.get_mad_scientist = function()
		return get_character('mad_scientist')
	end

	-- 테러리스트 리더
	self.get_terrorist_leader = function()
		return get_character('s8_terrorist_leader')
	end

	-- 관리자
	self.get_fairy = function()
		return get_character('fairy_a')
	end

	-- 가짜 가디언
	self.get_fake_knight = function()
		if user_util.has_knight_male() then
			return get_character('fake_knight_female')
		end

		return get_character('fake_knight_male')
	end

	-- 기계실 exit
	self.get_exit_outer = function()
		return get_field_object('machine_room_outer')
	end

	self.get_exit_inner = function()
		return get_field_object('machine_room_inner')
	end

	self.is_in_zone = {
		fake_knight_event = false
	}

	self.cctv_usb_item_id = 21110
	self.wait_before_get_usb = true

	---@type SpineCharacterDissolver
	self.dissolver = nil

	self.fx = {
		glitch_effect_screen = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_nightmare_lt_glitch_effect_screen')
		end,
		glitch_effect = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_nightmare_lt_glitch_effect_no_white')
		end,
		crt_filter = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_nightmare_lt_crt_filter')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_all()

	self.dissolver = get_or_create_global_table('utils/SpineCharacterDissolver')
	self.dissolver:load_async('ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/theatres/dissolve', 'dissolve_material_container')
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_item_get_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.get_terrorist_leader(), true)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.cctv_usb ~= nil then
		self.cctv_usb:ConsumeComplete()
		self.cctv_usb = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if (not self.is_in_zone.fake_knight_event) and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's8_fake_knight_event') then
		self.is_in_zone.fake_knight_event = true

		start_coroutine(self.cctv_usb_check_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()

	if self.wait_before_get_usb and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Getter, mad_scientist) and e.Item.ItemId == self.cctv_usb_item_id then
		self.wait_before_get_usb = false

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local exit_outer_fo = self.get_exit_outer()
	local exit_inner_fo = self.get_exit_inner()

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, exit_outer_fo) then
		start_coroutine(self.quest_marker_routine, self, false)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, exit_inner_fo) then
		start_coroutine(self.quest_marker_routine, self, true)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:quest_marker_routine(inner)
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	if inner then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.get_exit_outer(), false)
	else
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.get_terrorist_leader(), true)
	end
end

	local function mad_scientist_scene()
		-- 그레모리 연출

		--그레모리(right, tired, cast) 1초 대기
		--그레모리(up, idle, idle) 1초 대기

		wait_for_sec(1)

		scene_util.set_emotion(mad_scientist, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(mad_scientist, self, { name = 'cast' })

		})

	self.cctv_usb.ConsumeTarget = mad_scientist

	--그레모리가 아이템 획득
	while self.wait_before_get_usb do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.cctv_usb = nil

	--그레모리(left, attack, cast) 0.5초 대기
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.eat_loop_sfx)
	scene_util.set_anim(mad_scientist, self, { name = 'cast' })

	--그레모리(up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(mad_scientist, { dir = 'up', sfx = false })

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_main_s8_4_2', skip = true })

	--그레모리(left, idle, cast): 조, 좋아. 어디보자…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'idle' },

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
