function local_class:register_intro_npcs_shooter_helpers()
	local pattern_info = { columns = 1 }
	local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
	local proj_spec = proj_data:GetSpec('proj_rifle_nt'):Clone()
	
	local shooters = {
		self.intro_dynamic_npcs.turing_android_3,
		self.intro_dynamic_npcs.turing_android_4,
		self.intro_dynamic_npcs.turing_android_5
	}

	for i = 1, #shooters do
		local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, shooters[i])
		local shooter_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
				ps, proj_spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)
		table.insert(self.shooter_helpers, shooter_helper)
	end
end

-- [함수 시그니처]
function local_class:play_turing_android_shoot_dir_at_pos()
	self.keep_turing_shooting_routine = true
	self.shooter_target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_turing_shooting_target_pos')

	local muzzle_start_pos_adj = vector(0.2, 0, 0.1)
	local delay = 0.03
	
	local shooters = {
		self.intro_dynamic_npcs.turing_android_3,
		self.intro_dynamic_npcs.turing_android_4,
		self.intro_dynamic_npcs.turing_android_5
	}

	local num_helpers = #self.shooter_helpers
	local num_sounds = num_helpers - 1
	local sfx_info = { sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_01', volume = 0.3, loop = false, parent = shooters[i] }

	while self.keep_turing_shooting_routine do
		for i = 1, num_helpers do
			local dir_vec_diff = unity_class.vector3.up
			local shooter_bound_center = shooters[i].Bounds.center
			local target_direction = (self.shooter_target_pos - shooter_bound_center + dir_vec_diff).normalized
			local muzzle_pos = shooters[i].Bounds.center + muzzle_start_pos_adj
	
			if i <= num_sounds then
				music_player_util.play_sfx(sfx_info)
			end

			self.shooter_helpers[i]:ShootDirectionAtPosition(muzzle_pos, target_direction)
			wait_for_sec(delay * 2)
		end
		wait_for_sec(delay)
	end
end

	-- 다음 동작 동시에 실행
	-- 화면 1초간 페이드인
	self.intro_loop_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_terror_01', loop = true })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ 
				name = 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/audio:bgm_lilith_terror_02',

			})
	
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	
	-- 카메라 빨간색 실선 위치로 8초간 이동
	local intro_cam_move_dest_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_intro_cam_move_dest_pos')
	camera_util.move_async(intro_cam_move_dest_pos, 8)
	
	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	
	local police = self.intro_dynamic_npcs.police_street_1
	
	-- 경찰 1(right, attack, hurt): 이런 젠장…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(police, self, 'right', nil, nil, 'nightmare_lt_main_s9_1')

	local attachment_name = 'walkie_talkie'
	-- 경찰 1(right, attack, twohand_idle) 0.3초 대기
	scene_util.set_anim(police, self, 'twohand_idle')
	
	-- electronic_terminal 장비
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(police, '[base]weapon1', attachment_name)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 경찰 1(right, attack, twohand_idle): 지원 요청! 지원 요청!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_02')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(police, 'nightmare_lt_main_s9_2')

	--  경찰 1(right, attack, twohand_idle): 현재 안드로이드들이 대거 폭주중! 현재 인원들 만으로는 막을 수 없습니다!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(police, 'nightmare_lt_main_s9_3')

	-- 경찰 1(right, attack, twohand_idle): 가용 가능한 인원 있다면 전부 지원 부탁드립니다!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(police, 'nightmare_lt_main_s9_4')

	-- 화면 1초간 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 타워쪽으로 넘어가 오딜 & 그레모리쪽 연출 재생

-- [함수 시그니처] - 스테이지 진입 후 연출: 오딜 & 그레모리
function local_class:scene_trouble_shooter_and_mad_scientist_intro()
	local cam_focus_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('intro_cam_focus_to_tower_pos')
	local cam_init_pos = cam_focus_pos + vector(0, 0, 3)
	camera_util.move_async(cam_init_pos, 0)

	-- 연출을 위한 상태로 세팅
	self:place_player_party_at_intro_scene()

	-- 화면 1초간 페이드 인
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
		{ 
			name = 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/audio:bgm_lilith_terror_02',
			state = 'event',
			volume = 0.6,
			mix = 5
		})
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 타워에서 쳐 기어나오는 오딜과 그레모리
	local trouble_shooter = user_party.Leader
	local mad_scientist = self.characters.mad_scientist()

	-- 오딜&그레모리(down, attack, walk) 이미지의 시작 위치에서 투명한 상태에서 0.5초간 서서히 드러남. 끝날 때까지 대기
	local party_spine_fade_duration = 0.5
	local party_spine_target_alpha = 1
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(trouble_shooter, party_spine_target_alpha, party_spine_fade_duration)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(mad_scientist, party_spine_target_alpha, party_spine_fade_duration)

	-- 카메라 1초간 오딜&그레모리 도착 위치로 이동
	camera_util.move(cam_focus_pos, 1)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 오딜&그레모리 이미지의 도착 위치로 5의 속도로 걸어감
	local player_party_move_dist_vec = vector(0, 0, -3)
	local player_party_move_speed = 5
	character_util.move_group_distance_async({ trouble_shooter, mad_scientist }, player_party_move_dist_vec, 
		nil, player_party_move_speed, true, true)

	-- 0.3초 대기

	character_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'left')

	-- 그레모리(right, tired, idle) 0.5초 대기

	scene_util.set_emotion(mad_scientist, self, 'tired')

	-- 오딜(left, idle, question)
	scene_util.set_anim(trouble_shooter, self, { name = 'question', loop = false })

	-- 그레모리(right, tired, release): 사, 사람들이…!

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self, 'right', 'release', 'tired',
		'nightmare_lt_main_s9_5')

	-- 그레모리(left, tired, cast)
	scene_util.set_anim(mad_scientist, self, 'cast')
		
	-- 오딜(left, idle, question): …예상은 했지만 생각보다 훨씬 더 막무가내로 움직이는군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self, 'left', 'question', nil,
		'nightmare_lt_main_s9_6')
	
	-- 오딜(left, attack, release): 어서 가자. 빨리 놈들을 막아야 해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trouble_shooter, self, 'left', 'release', 'attack',
		'nightmare_lt_main_s9_7')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mad_scientist)
	
	--스테이지 진입 연출. 컨트롤 회복.
	music_player:PlayStageIntroMusic()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1 })
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(trouble_shooter, self, 'victory_get')

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trouble_shooter)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

local local_class = newclass('NightmareLilithTowerMissingChildSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName =아이를 찾습니다 서브 이벤트  NightmareLilithTowerMissingChild @
		Comment = 아이를 찾습니다 서브 이벤트 NightmareLilithTowerMissingChild 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.available_stage_name = 'nightmare_lilithtower_3'

	--state
	self.section_state = {
		before_child_zone_enter = 1,
		after_child_zone_enter = 2,
		done = 99,
	}
	self.current_state = self.section_state.before_child_zone_enter

	--npc
	self.get_trouble_shooter = function()
		return get_character('trouble_shooter')
	end

	self.get_mad_scientist = function()
		return get_character('mad_scientist')
	end

	self.get_mother = function()
		return get_character('missing_child_mother')
	end

	self.get_kid = function(npc)
		return get_character('missing_child_kid_' .. npc)
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:pre_setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_child_zone_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'missing_child_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.after_child_zone_enter
		sp_util.start_scene(self.child_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

--존 진입 연출
function local_class:child_enter_scene()
	local shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()
	local mother = self.get_mother()
	local kid_1 = self.get_kid(1)
	local kid_2 = self.get_kid(2)
	local kid_3 = self.get_kid(3)
	local kid_group = { kid_1, kid_2, kid_3 }

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--1초간 방 중앙으로 카메라 이동
	camera_util.move(mother.Position, 1)

	do
		--오딜&그레모리 이미지의 위치로 1초간 정렬. (right, idle, idle)
		local duration = 1
		local wp_key = 'align_move'
		local shooter_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('missing_child_shooter_pos')
		local scientist_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('missing_child_scientist_pos')

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shooter, shooter_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key,
				{ last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(scientist, scientist_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key,
				{ last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--아이 1(right, attack, release): 여기 재미 없어! 숨바꼭질 하자! 숨바꼭질!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_kid_girl_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_1, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s1_1')

	--엄마(left, tired, cast): 여기서 숨바꼭질을 어떻게 하니…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mother, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s1_2')

	scene_util.set_direction(mother, 'down', false)

	--아이 2(up, idle, attack): 돈까스 먹는다고 했잖아! 나 배고파!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_kid_boy_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_2, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s1_3')

	--엄마(down, tired, cast): 식당이 문을 닫아서… 돈까스는 다음에 먹자, 응?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mother, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s1_4')

	--엄마(right, tired, cast)
	scene_util.set_direction(mother, 'right', false)

	--아이 3(left, attack, push): 로보트! 로보트 장난감 사줘!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_kid_girl_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_3, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'push', keep = true },
			nil,
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s1_5')

	--엄마(right, tired, cast): 얘는 갑자기 무슨 로보트야…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mother, self,
			'right',
			nil,
			nil,
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s1_6')

	do
		--다음 동작 동시에 실행
		local jump_end = false

		--카메라 shake(0.2, 1)
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 1)

		--엄마(down, scared, cast)
		scene_util.set_direction(mother, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(mother, self, 'scared')

		--아이들 mad
		scene_util.set_group_emotion(kid_group, self, 'mad')
		scene_util.set_group_anim(kid_group, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })

		--jump 2회
		start_coroutine(function()
			character_util.group_normal_jump_async(kid_group, '01_player_jump_01')
			character_util.group_normal_jump_async(kid_group, '01_player_jump_01')
			jump_end = true
		end)

		--아이들(shout 말풍선, 중앙 상단, 크기 1.4): 빼애애애액!!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(kid_1, 'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s1_7', true,
				{ scale = 1.4, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8), bubble_direction = 'none' })

		--점프 종료 까지 대기
		while not jump_end do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	--카메라 줌아웃(5, 0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_03')
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0.2)

	do
		--어머니 우왕좌왕하는 연출
		--아이들 이미지의 경로를 따라 6의 속도로 방 밖으로 달려나감
		local mother_action_end = false
		local speed = 6
		local wp_key = 'kid_move'

		local kid_1_wp = {
			kid_1.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
			kid_1.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, -2.5),
			kid_1.Position + vector(3.5, 0, -2.5),
			kid_1.Position + vector(3.5, 0, 0),
			screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', kid_1.Position + vector(3.5, 0, 0), 4),
		}
		local kid_2_wp = {
			screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', kid_2.Position, -2),
		}
		local kid_3_wp = {
			kid_3.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0),
			kid_3.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 1.5),
			kid_3.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, 1.5),
			kid_3.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, -2.5),
			kid_3.Position + vector(-1, 0, -2.5),
			screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', kid_3.Position + vector(-1, 0, -2.5), -2),
		}

		start_coroutine(function()
			--방향 전환과 함께 대사 실행
			local speech_end = false

			start_coroutine(function()
				--엄마(일반 말풍선): 얘, 얘들아! 잠깐만!
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mother, 'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s1_8', false)
				speech_end = true
			end)
			--엄마(down, scared, embarrassed) 1초 대기
			scene_util.set_anim(mother, self, 'embarrassed')
			wait_for_sec(1)

			--엄마(left, scared, embarrassed) 0.5초 대기
			scene_util.set_direction(mother, 'left', false)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			--엄마(right, scared, embarrassed) 0.5초 대기

function local_class:enter()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:pre_setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.first_kid_current_state < self.first_kid_state.clear then
		start_coroutine(self.hide_kid_eco_routine, self)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridMoveEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.thorn_manager:dispose()

	self.saved_damaged_behaviour = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.first_kid_current_state ~= self.first_kid_state.clear then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_kid(1)) then
			self.first_kid_current_state = self.first_kid_state.clear
			sp_util.start_scene(self.first_kid_interact_scene, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	if self.second_kid_current_state == self.second_kid_state.before_interact then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_kid(2)) then
			self.second_kid_current_state = self.second_kid_state.after_interact
			sp_util.start_scene(self.second_kid_interact_scene, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	if self.clear_count == 3 then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_mother()) then
			self.clear_count = self.clear_count + 1
			sp_util.start_scene(self.mother_interact_scene, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.third_kid_current_state == self.third_kid_state.finish_zone_enter and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, get_party_leader()) and
			lua_helper.type_compare(e.Info.sender.FieldObjectBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.SpikeBehaviour)) then
		self:hold_start_scene(self.spike_hit_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.third_kid_current_state == self.third_kid_state.before_first_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'missing_child_thorn_enter_zone') then
		self.third_kid_current_state = self.third_kid_state.kid_zone_enter
		sp_util.start_scene(self.third_kid_first_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.third_kid_current_state == self.third_kid_state.kid_zone_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'missing_child_thorn_finish_enter_zone') then
		self.third_kid_current_state = self.third_kid_state.finish_zone_enter
		sp_util.start_scene(self.third_kid_finish_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.third_kid_current_state == self.third_kid_state.finish_zone_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'missing_child_thorn_enter_zone') then
		self.third_kid_current_state = self.third_kid_state.clear
		self:hold_start_scene(self.third_kid_back_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_move_end_event(e)

			e.To.name == 'missing_child_first_kid_grid' then
		self:first_kid_state_by_grid(true)
		return true

	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)

			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'missing_child_first_kid_grid') then
		self:first_kid_state_by_grid(false)
		return true
	end

	return false

--가시 구역 첫 진입 이벤트 연출
function local_class:third_kid_first_enter_scene()
	local shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()
	local kid = self.get_kid(3)
	local player_group = { shooter, scientist }

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--오딜&그레모리(right, surprise, idle, jump 1회) 점프 끝날 때까지 대기
	scene_util.set_group_direction(player_group, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(player_group, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.group_normal_jump_async(player_group, '01_player_jump_01')

	--그레모리(right, surprise, release): 오딜! 저, 저기…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(scientist, self,
			nil,
			'release',
			nil,
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_37')

	do
		--카메라 1초간 아이에게 이동. 이후 아이 트래킹
		local duration = 1
		camera_util.move_async(kid.Position, duration, { end_target = kid })
	end

	--아이(right, smile, cast): 헤헤, 로보트 장난감…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
			nil,
			'cast',
			'smile',
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_38')

	character_util.remove_anim(kid)

	do
		--아이 2초간 오른쪽으로 3칸 이동
		local duration = 3

		wp_util.move_async(kid, kid.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), nil, duration)
	end

	--다음 동작 동시에 실행
	--카메라 shake(0.4, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.3)

	local siren_off_reserve = false
	--사이렌 효과 시작
	start_coroutine(function()
		local duration = 1.5
		local time_passed = 1.5
		local toggle = false

		while true do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if time_passed > duration then
				time_passed = time_passed - duration

				if toggle then
					field_util.remove_tint('siren', duration)
				else
					if siren_off_reserve then
						break
					else
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_siren_oneshot_04', 0.5)
						field_util.tint('siren', CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.6, 0, 0, 1), duration)
					end
				end

				toggle = not toggle
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)

	--아이(right, scared, cast, jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(kid, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(kid, self, 'cast')
	character_util.normal_jump(kid)

	--카메라(shout 말풍선, 중앙 상단, 크기 1.3): 침입자 확인! 침입자 확인!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(kid, 'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_39', true,
			{ scale = 1.3, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8), bubble_direction = 'none' })

	--카메라(shout 말풍선, 중앙 상단, 크기 1.3): 보안 시스템을 가동합니다!
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(kid, 'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_40', true,
			{ scale = 1.3, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8), bubble_direction = 'none' })

	do
		--하늘에서 가시블록 일괄 낙하 속도 0.5초
		--낙하속도 0.5초
		local start_height = 15
		local duration = 0.5

		self.thorn_manager:foreach(function(_, fo)
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		end)

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
			self.thorn_manager:foreach(function(_, fo)
				local height = start_height * (1 - progress)
				local pos = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position, height)
				fo.Position = pos
			end)
		end)
	end

	--카메라 shake(0.3, 0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_mech_land_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

	--아이(left, scared, embarrassed, jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_direction(kid, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(kid, self, 'embarrassed')
	character_util.normal_jump(kid, true)

	--블록이 땅에 떨어지고 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--아이(right, scared, cast) 0.5초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(kid, 'right', true)
	scene_util.set_anim(kid, self, 'cast')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--아이(left, scared, cast) 1초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(kid, 'left', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카메라 shake(0.3, 0.2)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

	--아이(left, cry, seat, shout 말풍선, 크기 1.2): 으아앙~ 엄마~
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(kid, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true },
			{ name = 'cry', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_41', skip = true, scale = 1.2 })

	--오딜(right, attack, idle)
	--그레모리(right, scared, cast)
	scene_util.set_emotion(shooter, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion(scientist, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(scientist, self, 'cast')

	--카메라 1.5초간 오딜에게 이동
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1.5)

	--그레모리(right, scared, cast): 저러다 다, 다치겠어…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(scientist, 'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_42')

	--그레모리(right, scared, cast)
	--오딜(right, attack, release): 어서 가서 도와주자!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shooter, self,
			nil,
			'release',
			nil,
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_43')

	--사이렌 꺼짐 예약
	siren_off_reserve = true

	--데미지 이벤트 구독
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(player_group)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

	wp_util.move_async(shooter, kid.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 4)

			{ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	--오딜(right, tired, eat): 그래, 그래. 이제 괜찮아…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shooter, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'eat', keep = true },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },

	--오딜(right, tired, eat): 누나랑 가자, 응?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shooter, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_45')

	--아이(right, cry, embarrassed): 싫어! 로보트! 로보트!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_kid_girl_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
			'right',
			'embarrassed',
			'cry',
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_46')

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	eat_sfx = nil

	--오딜&그레모리&아이(right, surprise, idle, jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_group_direction(all_group, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(all_group, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.remove_anim(shooter)
	character_util.remove_anim(kid)
	character_util.group_normal_jump(all_group, '01_player_jump_01')

	--카메라 shake(0.3, 0.2)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

	--카메라(shout 말풍선, 중앙 상단, 크기 1.3):격한 움직임을 감지하였습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(kid, 'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_47', true,
			{ scale = 1.3, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8), bubble_direction = 'none' })

	--카메라(shout 말풍선, 중앙 상단, 크기 1.3): 보안 레벨을 강화합니다!
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(kid, 'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_48', true,
			{ scale = 1.3, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8), bubble_direction = 'none' })

	--오딜&그레모리&아이(left, surprise, idle)
	scene_util.set_group_direction(all_group, 'left', true)

	do
		--카메라 1초간 맵 중앙으로 이동
		local duration = 1
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('missing_child_spike_center_pos')
		camera_util.move_async(pos, duration)
	end

	--이미지의 빨간 원 표시한 위치에 가시 블록 하나씩 더 떨어짐
	--낙하속도 0.5초
	local start_height = 15
	local spike_count = 2
	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(0.5, function(progress)
		local height = start_height * (1 - progress)
		for i = 1, spike_count do
			local manual_spike = self.get_manual_spike(i)
			local move_spike = self.get_move_spike(i)
			local pos = vector_util.get_x0z(move_spike.Position, height)
			manual_spike.Position = pos
		end
	end)

	--각 블록 도착 지점에 FX_lasthit 출력
	for i = 1, spike_count do
		local manual_spike = self.get_manual_spike(i)

		self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(manual_spike.Position)
	end

	--카메라 shake(0.3, 0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_mech_land_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

	--블록이 땅에 떨어지고 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--추가된 블록 이미지의 경로를 따라 2의 속도로 순회하기 시작함.
	for i = 1, spike_count do
		local manual_spike = self.get_manual_spike(i)
		local move_spike = self.get_move_spike(i)

		manual_spike.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		move_spike.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

		coroutine.yield(nil)
		message_system:SendSync(move_spike.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.SpikeResumeEvent.Create(nil))
	end

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카메라 1초간 오딜에게 이동
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--오딜(right, attack, idle)
	--그레모리(right, tired, cast)
	scene_util.set_group_direction(player_group, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(shooter, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion(scientist, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(scientist, self, 'cast')

	--아이(left, cry, seat, shout 말풍선): 으아아앙~
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(kid, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true },
			{ name = 'cry', keep = true },
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_49')

	--오딜(right, attack, idle): 이런…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(shooter, 'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_50')

	eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	--오딜(right, attack, eat): 상황이 더 심각해지기 전에 강제로라도 끌고 나가야겠어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shooter, self,
			nil,
			'eat',
			nil,
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_51')

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	eat_sfx = nil

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(player_group)

	--오딜 아이를 듬. hold 상태. 던질 수 없음.
	command_util.publish_holdup(shooter, kid, shooter.Position, nil, true)

	--클리어 전 까지 데미지 비헤이비어 제거
	shooter.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance

	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--표정 shear 값 조정
	kid.SpineController.ShearOffset = kid.Position.y

	self:disable_controls(get_party_leader())

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

--가시 구역 되돌아오는 연출
function local_class:third_kid_back_enter_scene()
	local shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()
	local kid = self.get_kid(3)
	local player_group = { shooter, scientist }

	--비헤이비어 재생성
	shooter.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.ManualCharacterDamagedBehaviour.Create()

	--이벤트 제거
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	do

--첫번째 아이 숨바꼭질 대사 연출
function local_class:hide_kid_eco_routine()
	local kid = self.get_kid(1)

	local next_state = self.first_kid_state.question_talk
	local wait_time = 1
	local time_passed = 0

	while self.first_kid_current_state ~= self.first_kid_state.clear do
		if self.first_kid_current_state == self.first_kid_state.smile_talk then
			self.first_kid_current_state = self.first_kid_state.wait
			next_state = self.first_kid_state.question_talk
			wait_time = 2

			--아이(일반 말풍선, 중앙 상단): 킥킥킥…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_kid_girl_shout_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, {
				key = 'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_1',
				skip = false,
				bubble_direction = 'none',
				viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8),
			})
		elseif self.first_kid_current_state == self.first_kid_state.question_talk then
			self.first_kid_current_state = self.first_kid_state.wait
			next_state = self.first_kid_state.smile_talk
			wait_time = 2

			--아이(일반 말풍선, 중앙 상단): 어디 숨었게…?
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, {
				key = 'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_2',
				skip = false,
				bubble_direction = 'none',
				viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8),
			})
		elseif self.first_kid_current_state == self.first_kid_state.wait then
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if time_passed > wait_time then
				time_passed = 0
				self.first_kid_current_state = next_state
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		else
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(kid)
end

function local_class:first_kid_state_by_grid(is_enter)
	if is_enter then
		self.first_kid_current_state = self.first_kid_save_state
	else
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_kid(1))
		self.first_kid_save_state = self.first_kid_current_state
		self.first_kid_current_state = self.first_kid_state.pause
	end
end

function local_class:first_kid_interact_scene()

	local scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()
	local kid = self.get_kid(1)

	scene_util.set_emotion(kid, self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_anim(kid)

	do
		--오딜&그레모리&아이 위쪽으로 0.5초간 1칸 이동
		local duration = 0.5
		local move_pos = vector(0, 0, 1)
		local wp_key = 'player_move'

		--오딜&그레모리는 뒷걸음질
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shooter, shooter.Position + move_pos,
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(scientist, scientist.Position + move_pos,
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(kid, kid.Position + move_pos,
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--아이(right, smile, sing): 헤헤, 들켰다…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
			nil,
			'sing',
			nil,
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_4')

	--아이(right, smile, cast2): 누나들 숨바꼭질 진짜 잘한다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
			nil,
			'cast2',
			nil,
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_5')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(scientist, self,
			nil,
			'cast2',
			'smile',
			'nightmare_lt_missing_child_s2_6')

	--오딜(left, idle, release): 가서 엄마를 찾는거야. 알았지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shooter, self,

			nil,

		wp_util.move_async(kid, kid_wp, speed, nil, { run = true })

		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(run_sfx, 1)
		run_sfx = nil
	end

	--첫번째 꼬마 클리어 세팅
	self.npc_by_custom_state_manager:set_npc_by_progress('kid_1', 'clear')
	self.npc_by_custom_state_manager:set_custom_state('kid_1')

	self.clear_count = self.clear_count + 1
	self:set_by_clear_count()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	local kid_clear_state = {
		self.first_kid_state.clear,
		self.second_kid_state.clear,
		self.third_kid_state.clear,
	}

	local kid_current_state_list = {
		'first_kid_current_state',
		'second_kid_current_state',
		'third_kid_current_state',
	}

	--커스텀 스테이트별 꼬마 npc 세팅
	local kid_count = 3
	for num = 1, kid_count do
		local npc_key = 'kid_' .. num
		if self.npc_by_custom_state_manager:clear_check(npc_key) then
			self.npc_by_custom_state_manager:set_npc_by_progress(npc_key, 'clear')
			self.clear_count = self.clear_count + 1

			--클리어 시 스테이트 완료 상태
			local state_name = kid_current_state_list[num]
			self[state_name] = kid_clear_state[num]
		else
			self.npc_by_custom_state_manager:set_npc_by_progress(npc_key, 'normal')
		end
	end

	self:set_by_clear_count()

	--첫번째 꼬마 레벨 제거
	local kid_1 = self.get_kid(1)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(kid_1, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	--세번째 꼬마 장소 오픈
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('missing_child_third_kid_door', true))

	--fx
	self.fx:load_all()

	--thorn
	if not self.npc_by_custom_state_manager:clear_check('kid_3') then
		self.thorn_manager:load()

		self.thorn_manager:foreach(function(num, fo)
			local init_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position, 15)
			fo.Position = init_pos
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end)

		local spike_count = 2
		for i = 1, spike_count do
			local fo = self.get_move_spike(i)
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

			message_system:SendSync(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.SpikeStopEvent.Create(nil))
		end
	end
end

--꼬마 npc 클리어 횟수에 따라 세팅
function local_class:set_by_clear_count()
	local mother_key = 'mother'

	if self.clear_count == 0 then
		self.npc_by_custom_state_manager:set_npc_by_progress(mother_key, 'first')
	elseif self.clear_count == 1 then
		self.npc_by_custom_state_manager:set_npc_by_progress(mother_key, 'second')
	elseif self.clear_count == 2 then
		self.npc_by_custom_state_manager:set_npc_by_progress(mother_key, 'second')
	elseif self.clear_count == 3 then
		self.npc_by_custom_state_manager:set_npc_by_progress(mother_key, 'last')

		--퀘스트 마커 지정
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('sub_missing_child', {})
	end
end


-- 걷기 상호작용만 가능하도록 하는 함수
function local_class:disable_controls(leader)
	-- 걷기, 상호작용만 가능하게 한다
	local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(leader, false)
	local enabling_control = CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Move | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact
	local disabled_control = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
			~ CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(enabling_control)

	player_state:DisableControls(disabled_control)
	message_system:SendSync(leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state))
end

function local_class:hold_start_scene(func, ...)
	local args = { ... }
	local routine = function()
		-- 이전 리더에 대한 정보를 미리 캐싱해둬야 해제가 가능함
		local cached_leader = get_party_leader()

		sp_util.enter_scene({ release_hold = false })

		yield_return_func(func, table.unpack(args))

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, cached_leader)
	end

	return start_coroutine(routine)
end

return local_class

		self.current_section:exit()
	end

	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

		self.starpiece_effect:Dispose()
		self.starpiece_effect = nil

end

		end
	end

		security.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	--방 중앙의 테슬라 코일 / 벨트 제거
	local tesla_num = 9

		if idx ~= 3 and idx ~= 4 then

		end

			unity_class.quaternion.identity, security_3.Transform)
end

	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	-- 기계실 푸시 블럭
	self.get_push_block = function()
		return get_field_object('sub_nonstop_push_block')
	end

	-- 기계실 의자
	self.get_chair = function(idx)
		return get_field_object('sub_nonstop_chair_' .. idx)
	end

	-- 기계실 화약통
	self.get_barrel = function(idx)
		return get_field_object('sub_nonstop_barrel_' .. idx)
	end

	-- 테슬라 코일
	self.get_tesla = function(idx)
		return get_field_object('sub_nonstop_tesla_' .. idx)
	end

	-- 컨베이어 밸트
	self.get_belt = function(idx)
		return get_field_object('sub_nonstop_belt_' .. idx)
	end

	-- 스타피스
	self.get_star_piece = function()
		return get_field_object('sub_nonstop_start_piece')
	end

	self.is_symmetry = {
		lever = false,
		brazier = false,
		push_block = false,
		sign_board = false,
		trash = false,
		barrel = false,

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	self:pre_setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local is_prev_section = self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 1

	if is_prev_section then
		self:play_dash_sfx(true)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	if self.seat_chair_fo ~= nil then
		self.seat_chair_fo = nil
	end

	self:play_dash_sfx(false)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local left_lever = self.get_lever('left')
	local chair_1 = self.get_chair(1)
	local chair_2 = self.get_chair(2)
	local security = self.get_security(3)
	local exit_outer_fo = self.get_exit_outer()
	local exit_inner_fo = self.get_exit_inner()

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.mini_game_clear and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, security) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.star_piece_event

		sp_util.start_scene(self.star_piece_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, left_lever) then
		self:lever_interact()

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, chair_1) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.jump_seat, self, chair_1, 1)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, chair_2) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.jump_seat, self, chair_2, 2)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, exit_outer_fo) then
		local outer_marker_dir = field_util.get_marker_dir('machine_room_outer_marker')
		local outer_marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('machine_room_outer_marker')

		start_coroutine(self.custom_exit_teleport, self, outer_marker_dir, outer_marker_pos, true)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, exit_inner_fo) then
		local inner_marker_dir = field_util.get_marker_dir('machine_room_inner_marker')
		local inner_marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('machine_room_inner_marker')

		start_coroutine(self.custom_exit_teleport, self, inner_marker_dir, inner_marker_pos, false)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local brazier = self.get_brazier()
	local push_block = self.get_push_block()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 난이도 관련으로 화로는 그냥 엔터, full_leave 로 체크함
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, brazier) and e.Zone.Name == 'sub_nonstop_brazier_check_zone' then
		self.is_symmetry.brazier = true

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, push_block, 'sub_nonstop_push_block_check_zone') then
		self.is_symmetry.push_block = true

		return true

	elseif self.current_section_state < self.section_state.mini_game_clear and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'sub_nonstop_event_zone') then
		self:play_dash_sfx(true)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local brazier = self.get_brazier()
	local push_block = self.get_push_block()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, brazier, 'sub_nonstop_brazier_check_zone') then
		self.is_symmetry.brazier = false

		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, push_block) and e.Zone.Name == 'sub_nonstop_push_block_check_zone' then

		self.is_symmetry.push_block = false

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, leader, 'sub_nonstop_event_zone') then
		self:play_dash_sfx(false)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:play_dash_sfx(zone_enter)
	local security_1 = self.get_security(1)

	if zone_enter then
		if self.security_dash_loop_sfx == nil then
			self.security_dash_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '01_dash_01',
				parent = security_1,
				loop = true,
				type_priority = 'loop',
				player_priority = 'npc',
				volume = 0.5
			})
		end

		if self.belt_loop_sfx == nil then
			self.belt_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '01_belt_01',
				parent = security_1,
				loop = true,
				type_priority = 'loop',
				player_priority = 'npc',
				volume = 0.5,
				fade_in_time = 3
			})
		end
	else
		if self.security_dash_loop_sfx ~= nil then
			music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.security_dash_loop_sfx)
			self.security_dash_loop_sfx = nil
		end
		if self.belt_loop_sfx ~= nil then
			music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.belt_loop_sfx, 3)
			self.belt_loop_sfx = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	local security_1 = self.get_security(1)
	local security_2 = self.get_security(2)
	local security_3 = self.get_security(3)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('sub_nonstop_tesla_door', true))

	-- exit 커스텀하게 사용하기 위함
	local exit_outer_fo = self.get_exit_outer()
	exit_outer_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	--방 입구를 향해 서브 퀘스트 마커
	local exit_inner_fo = self.get_exit_inner()
	exit_inner_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	quest_marker_util.show(self, self.quest_marker_key, exit_inner_fo, true)

	local right_lever = self.get_lever('right')
	local right_lever_animator = right_lever:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	right_lever_animator:Play('pull', -1, 0)

	local trash_num = 10

	for idx = 1, trash_num do
		local trash = self.get_trash(idx)
		table.insert(self.trash_list, trash)
	end

	--관리자 1(left, damaged, dash)
	scene_util.set_emotion(security_1, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(security_1, self, { name = 'dash' })

	--관리자 2(right, tired, run)
	scene_util.set_emotion(security_2, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(security_2, self, { name = 'run' })

	--관리자 3(right, smile, cast)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(security_3, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(security_3, self, 'smile')

	-- 컨베이어 벨트 위에 있기 때문에 원라인 인터렉트를 위해 히트박스 크기를 조절 함 
	security_1.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_oneline_1'
	security_1.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0.3, 0.4), vector(2, 1, 1.3))

	security_2.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_oneline_2'
	security_2.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0.3, 0.4), vector(2, 1, 1.3))

	security_3.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_oneline_3'

	-- 컨베이어 벨트 애니메이션 재생
	local conveyor_belt_num = 4

	for idx = 1, conveyor_belt_num do
		local conveyor_belt = self.get_belt(idx)
		local conveyor_animator = conveyor_belt:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		conveyor_animator:Play('xmas_belt_rolling', -1, 0)
		conveyor_animator.speed = 3
	end

function local_class:jump_seat(chair_fo, chair_num)
	local trouble_shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()
	local seat_pos = chair_fo.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	local function jump_move(fo, pos, locked_dir, last_dir)
		local duration = 0.5
		scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, { name = 'get' })
		character_util.jump(fo, 1, duration)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

		wp_util.move_async(fo, pos, nil, duration,
				{ run = false, locked_dir = locked_dir, last_direction = last_dir })
	end

	if self.seat_chair_num == chair_num and self.is_symmetry.seat then
		--그레모리가 앉은 의자에 상호작용시 이벤트 시작
		--1초간 의자 앞에 이미지3과 같이 정렬. (up, idle, idle)
		local align_pos = chair_fo.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
		local duration = 1
		wp_util.move_async(trouble_shooter, align_pos, nil, duration, { run = false, last_direction = 'up' })

		--선택지
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--(normal) 그레모리를 일으킨다
			{ 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_choose_2_1', 'normal' },
			--(normal) 그만둔다
			{ 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_choose_2_2', 'normal' },
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--그레모리를 일으킨다 선택시
			self.is_symmetry.seat = false

			--그레모리(left, idle, get, mario_jump_async)
			--점프 시간동안 오딜 1칸 왼쪽 위치로 이동
			local jump_move_pos = trouble_shooter.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
			jump_move(mad_scientist, jump_move_pos, 'left', 'left')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

			character_util.remove_anim(mad_scientist)

			--그레모리(left, idle, idle) 0.5초 대기
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			--파티 멤버에서 그레모리 추가
			character_util.convert_to_party_member(mad_scientist, user_party, true)

			--컨트롤 회복. 이벤트 종료
		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			--그만둔다 선택시
			--컨트롤 회복. 이벤트 종료
		end
	else
		--빈 의자에 상호작용시 이벤트 시작
		local choose_list = {
			--(normal) 오딜이 앉는다
			{ 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_choose_1_1', 'normal' },
			--(normal) 그만둔다
			{ 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_choose_1_3', 'normal' },
		}

		local duration = 1
		if user_party[1] ~= nil then
			--그레모리가 파티 멤버에 있는 경우 표시
			--(normal) 그레모리가  앉는다
			table.insert(choose_list, 2, { 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_choose_1_2', 'normal' })

			--그레모리가 파티에 붙어있는 경우 이미지 1,
			local align_pos = {
				chair_fo.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, -1),
				chair_fo.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -1)
			}

			--1초간 의자 앞에 이미지와 같이 정렬. (up, idle, idle)
			local wp_key = 'wp_key'
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(trouble_shooter,
					align_pos[1], nil, duration, self, wp_key,
					{ run = false, last_direction = 'up' })

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(mad_scientist,
					align_pos[2], nil, duration, self, wp_key,
					{ run = false, last_direction = 'up' })

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
		else
			--그레모리가 파티에 붙어있지 않은 경우 이미지 2
			local align_pos = chair_fo.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)

			--1초간 의자 앞에 이미지와 같이 정렬. (up, idle, idle)
			wp_util.move_async(trouble_shooter, align_pos, nil, duration,
					{ run = false, last_direction = 'up' })
		end

		--선택지
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_list)

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--오딜이 앉는다 선택시
			--오딜(right, idle, get, mario_jump_async)
			--점프 시간동안 의자 위로 이동
			local cached_pos = trouble_shooter.Position
			jump_move(trouble_shooter, seat_pos, 'right', 'right')

			scene_util.set_anim(trouble_shooter, self, { name = 'seat' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

			--오딜(right, idle, seat) 1초 대기
			wait_for_sec(1)

			--완료 조건 체크
			local return_clear_check = self:clear_check()

			if return_clear_check then
				--완료 조건이 충족된 경우
				--완료 이벤트로 넘어감
				self:mini_game_clear_scene()
			else
				--아닌 경우
				--오딜(right, tired, seat): …이게 아닌가 보군.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
				scene_util.set_emotion(trouble_shooter, self, 'tired')
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trouble_shooter, 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_s2_1', true)

				character_util.remove_emotion(trouble_shooter)

				--오딜(left, idle, get, mario_jump_async)
				--점프 시간동안 초기 위치로 이동
				jump_move(trouble_shooter, cached_pos, 'left', 'left')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

				character_util.remove_anim(trouble_shooter)

				--오딜(left, idle, idle) 0.5초 대기.
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
				--컨트롤 회복. 이벤트 종료
			end

		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			if user_party[1] == nil then
				--그만둔다 선택시
				--컨트롤 회복. 이벤트 종료
			else
				self.is_symmetry.seat = true
				self.seat_chair_num = chair_num

				--그레모리가 앉는다 선택시
				--그레모리(left, idle, get, mario_jump_async)
				--점프 시간동안 의자 위로 이동
				jump_move(mad_scientist, seat_pos, 'left', 'left')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

				scene_util.set_anim(mad_scientist, self, { name = 'seat' })

				--그레모리(left, idle, seat) 1초 대기
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--파티 멤버에서 그레모리 제거
				character_util.convert_to_npc(mad_scientist)

				--컨트롤 회복. 이벤트 종료
			end
		elseif user_party[1] == nil and choose_result == 3 then
			--그만둔다 선택시
			--컨트롤 회복. 이벤트 종료 
		end
	end
end

function local_class:custom_exit_teleport(dir, pos, quest_marker_show)
	-- exit 할 때 그레모리가 파티원에 없으면 파티원으로 추가 해주고 exit 함
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()

	party_util.stop()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

	local fade_duration = 0.6
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(fade_duration, 'linear')

	if user_party[1] == nil then
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(mad_scientist, user_party, true)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mad_scientist)
		self.is_symmetry.seat = false
	end

	local outer_marker_dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(dir)

	for idx = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[idx]
		member.Position = pos - outer_marker_dir_vector * (idx * constants.dist_between_party_members)
		member.Direction = dir
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	if quest_marker_show then
		if self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.mini_game_clear then
			quest_marker_util.show(self, self.quest_marker_key, self.get_exit_inner(), true)
		end
	else
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_key)
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(fade_duration, 'linear')

	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function local_class:lever_interact()
	local left_lever = self.get_lever('left')
	local left_lever_animator = left_lever:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	local animation_name

	if self.is_symmetry.lever then
		self.is_symmetry.lever = false
		animation_name = 'push'
	else
		self.is_symmetry.lever = true
		animation_name = 'pull'
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gear_02')
	left_lever_animator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)
end

function local_class:clear_check()
	local function trash_check()
		local symmetry_trash_count = 0
		local symmetry_fail = false

		for idx, trash in pairs(self.trash_list) do
			if trash.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
				if idx < 4 then
					symmetry_trash_count = symmetry_trash_count + 1
				else
					symmetry_fail = true
				end
			end
		end

		self.is_symmetry.trash = false

		if symmetry_trash_count == 3 then
			if not symmetry_fail then
				self.is_symmetry.trash = true
			else
				self.is_symmetry.trash = false
			end
		end
	end

	local function barrel_check()
		local barrel_num = 2
		local barrel_count = 0

		for idx = 1, barrel_num do
			local barrel = self.get_barrel(idx)

			if barrel.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
				barrel_count = barrel_count + 1
			end
		end

		if barrel_count == 2 then
			self.is_symmetry.barrel = true
		else
			self.is_symmetry.barrel = false
		end
	end

	local function sign_board_check()
		local sign_board = self.get_sign_board()

		if sign_board.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
			self.is_symmetry.sign_board = true
		else
			self.is_symmetry.sign_board = false
		end
	end

	trash_check()
	barrel_check()
	sign_board_check()

	local mini_game_clear = true

	for _, is_success in pairs(self.is_symmetry) do
		if not is_success then
			mini_game_clear = false
		end
	end

	if mini_game_clear then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:mini_game_clear_scene()
	local tesla = self.get_tesla(5)
	local trouble_shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.mini_game_clear

	--완료 이벤트
	--다음 동작 동시에 실행
	--카메라 2초간 그리드 중앙으로 이동
	local camera_pos = tesla.Position + vector(0, 0, -4)
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, 2)

	--카메라 2초간 방 전체를 담도록 줌아웃
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5.5, 2)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--다음 동작 동시에 실행
	--카메라 1초간 기본 크기로 줌인
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)

	--카메라 1초간 테슬라 코일로 이동
	local camera_pos = tesla.Position
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)

function local_class:star_piece_event_setting()
	local security_1 = self.get_security(1)
	local security_2 = self.get_security(2)
	local security_3 = self.get_security(3)

	--관리자 1(left, idle, prostrate): 드르렁… 쿨…
	security_1.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_oneline_4'
	security_1.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1, 1, 1))

	--간헐적으로 카메라 밖에서 애니메이션 세팅 시 prostrate 믹스에서 문제가 생김

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(security_1, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_anim(security_1, self, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.remove_emotion(security_1)

	--관리자 2(right, idle, prostrate): 드르렁… 쿨…
	security_2.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_oneline_5'
	security_2.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1, 1, 1))

	scene_util.set_anim(security_2, self, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.remove_emotion(security_2)

	--관리자 3(right, smile, cast)
	--간헐적으로 카메라 밖에서 애니메이션 세팅 시 prostrate 믹스에서 문제가 생김

	scene_util.set_emotion(security_3, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(security_3, self, { name = 'cast' })

	--문 옆의 테슬라 코일 활성화 되어있음

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create('sub_nonstop_tesla_3'))

		chair.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

function local_class:star_piece_event()
	local security_3 = self.get_security(3)
	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()

	local trouble_shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()
	local mad_scientist = self.get_mad_scientist()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(security_3, self.controller)
	--관리자 3과 상호작용시 이벤트 시작

	local wp = {
		security_3.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
		security_3.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
	}

	local wp_key = 'wp_key'
	local duration = 1
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(trouble_shooter,
			wp[1], nil, duration, self, wp_key,
			{ run = false, last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(mad_scientist,
			wp[2], nil, duration, self, wp_key,
			{ run = false, last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--관리자 3(right, smile, cast): 해냈구나! 정말 고마워!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(security_3, 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_s2_4', true)

	--관리자 3(right, smile, hold_loop): 설비들은 완전히 정상 작동 중이야. 런닝머신을 뛰지 않고도 말이야…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_mvp_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(security_3, self, { name = 'hold_loop' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(security_3, 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_s2_5', true)

	--관리자 3 몸에서 스타피스 나와 관리자 3 아래 1칸 지점에 배치
	local star_piece_pos = security_3.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 0)
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, star_piece_pos)

	if self.controller.starpiece_effect ~= nil then
		self.controller.starpiece_effect:Dispose()
		self.controller.starpiece_effect = nil
	end

	--관리자 3(right, smile, idle): 이건 보답이야. 받아줘.
	character_util.remove_anim(security_3)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(security_3, 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_s2_6', true)

	--관리자 3(right, smile, bomb_idle): 하하, 긴장이 풀리니까 갑자기 피곤해지네… 그럼 난 이제…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(security_3, self, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(security_3, 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_s2_7', true)

	--관리자 3(right, smile, dead): 밀린 잠을 좀… 자야겠어…
	--관리자 3(right, smile, dead)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(security_3, self, { name = 'dead', loop = false })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(security_3, 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_s2_8', true)

	--관리자 3(right, smile, dead): 드르렁… 쿨…
	security_3.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_lt_nonstop_oneline_6'

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('sub_nonstop_tesla_door', false))

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	--컨트롤 회복. 이벤트 종료
	quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0)
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.nobody_grandpa_zone_name) and
			self.epilogue_list[self.epilogue_quest_id.nobody].state == self.epilogue_state.none then

		self.epilogue_list[self.epilogue_quest_id.nobody].state = self.epilogue_state.play

		start_coroutine(self.play_nobody_grandpa_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.tea_time_grandma_zone_name) and
			self.epilogue_list[self.epilogue_quest_id.tea_time].state == self.epilogue_state.none then

		self.epilogue_list[self.epilogue_quest_id.tea_time].state = self.epilogue_state.play

		start_coroutine(self.play_tea_time_grandma_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.life_is_beautiful_zone_name) and
			self.epilogue_list[self.epilogue_quest_id.life_is_beautiful].state == self.epilogue_state.none then

		self.epilogue_list[self.epilogue_quest_id.life_is_beautiful].state = self.epilogue_state.play

		start_coroutine(self.play_life_is_beautiful_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.workaholic_zone_name) and
			self.epilogue_list[self.epilogue_quest_id.workaholic].state == self.epilogue_state.none then

		self.epilogue_list[self.epilogue_quest_id.workaholic].state = self.epilogue_state.play

		start_coroutine(self.play_workaholic_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.police_zone_name) and
			self.epilogue_list[self.epilogue_quest_id.police].state == self.epilogue_state.none then

		self.epilogue_list[self.epilogue_quest_id.police].state = self.epilogue_state.play

		start_coroutine(self.play_police_event, self)

		return true

		return true
	end

	return false

function local_class:set_npc_data(npc, pos, dir, anim, emo)
	if pos ~= nil then
		character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
	end

	if dir ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_direction(npc, dir, false)
	end

	if emo ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self.handler, emo)
	end

	if anim ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self.handler, { name = anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
	end
end

function local_class:play_nobody_grandpa_event()
	local grandpa = self.get_nobody_grandpa()
	local male = self.get_nobody_male()
	local female = self.get_nobody_female()
	local center = self.get_nobody_grandpa_center()

	if self.epilogue_list[self.epilogue_quest_id.nobody].complete then
		-- 할아버지 (right, attack, idle) : 몇 번이고 덤비라 그래! 또 테러를 일으킨다면 저번처럼 다 처리해줄 테니까!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_male_shout_01', max_distance = 6,
									 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', play_pos = center })

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(grandpa, self.handler,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_nobody_1_1', skip = false })

		-- 여자 (left, smile, seat) : 너무 멋있어요, 할아버지!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01', max_distance = 6,
									 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', play_pos = center })

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(female, self.handler,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_nobody_1_2', skip = false })

		-- 할아버지 bubblegum 표정 전환
		-- 이후 풍선껌이 한번 터진 이후 눈 감고 있는 해당 표정 유지.
		scene_util.set_emotion(grandpa, self.handler, { name = 'bubblegum', loop = false })

		wait_for_sec(1.2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_pop_01', max_distance = 6,
									 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', play_pos = center })

		-- 대기 1.5초
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		-- 남자 (left, smile, seat) : 오오! 또 뭔가 보여주시려는건가?
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', max_distance = 6,
									 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', play_pos = center })

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(male, self.handler,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_nobody_1_3', skip = false })

		-- 대기 0.5초
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 할아버지 sleep 표정 전환 이후 0.5초 대기.
		scene_util.set_emotion(grandpa, self.handler, { name = 'sleep' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_sleep_01', max_distance = 6,
									 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', play_pos = center })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 남자 (left, tired, seat) : 그게 아니라 졸리신가 보네…
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02', max_distance = 6,
									 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', play_pos = center })

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(male, self.handler,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_nobody_1_4', skip = false })

		-- 여자 (left, smile, seat) : 냅둬. 주무시는 모습도 얼마나 멋져?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(female, self.handler,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_nobody_1_5', skip = false })

		-- 이후 해당 NPC의 마지막 대사를 원라인으로 출력.
		-- 할아버지 NPC는 “음냐… 나 때는 말이야…” 대사 출력.

		female.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		grandpa.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()

		male.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_lt_nobody_1_4'
		female.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_lt_nobody_1_5'
		grandpa.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_lt_nobody_1_6'

		male.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_negative_02'
		female.Interactable.TalkSfx = '01_swing_01'
		grandpa.Interactable.TalkSfx = '01_sleep_02'
	else
		-- 남자 (left, smile, seat) : 여기서 같이 커피 마시니까 너무 좋다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(male, self.handler,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_nobody_2_1', skip = false })

				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'nightmare_lt_nobody_2_2', skip = false })

		female.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()

		male.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_lt_nobody_2_1'
		female.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_lt_nobody_2_2'

		female.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_positive_01'

function local_class:take_a_sip(target, anim_count, sound_pos)
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(target, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(target, '[base]weapon2', self.cup_sprite_vertical)

	start_coroutine(function()

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.6)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_drinking_02', max_distance = 12,
									 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', play_pos = sound_pos })
	end)

	scene_util.set_anim_async(target, self.handler, {
		name = 'dualgun_attack_right', upper = true, count = anim_count, scale = 0.2
	})

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(target, '[base]weapon1', self.cup_sprite)
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(target, '[base]weapon2', 'empty')

	scene_util.set_anim(target, self.handler, { name = 'unique/seat_hold_cup', upper = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)
end

function local_class:play_workaholic_event()
	local workaholic_1 = self.get_workaholic_npc(1)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local event_center_pos = vector(36.5, 0, 37)
	local max_dist = 49

	local play_sfx_for_dist = function(sfx_name)
		local sqr_dist = vector_util.sqr_distance(leader.Position, event_center_pos)

		if sqr_dist < max_dist then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(sfx_name)
		end
	end

	--차장 (right, tired, eat) : 아… 하기 싫어.
	play_sfx_for_dist('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.get_workaholic_npc(3), self.handler,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_workaholic_1', skip = false })

	--사원2 (left, tired, eat) : 불타는 금요일에 야근을 해야 된다니…!
	play_sfx_for_dist('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.get_workaholic_npc(5), self.handler,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_workaholic_2', skip = false })

	--부장 (down, attack, idle) : 다들 표정들이 왜 그런가요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(workaholic_1, self.handler,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_workaholic_3', skip = false })

	--부장 (down, attack, release) : 요즘 얼마나 불경기인지 알면서, 고작 야근 때문에 그러십니까?!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(workaholic_1, self.handler,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_workaholic_4', skip = false })

	--부장 (down, attack, idle) : 열정을 다해서! 회사를 위해 노력을 하란 말입니다!
	play_sfx_for_dist('01_male_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(workaholic_1, self.handler,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_workaholic_5', skip = false })

	--부장 NPC 1초동안 0.03값으로 shake.
	play_sfx_for_dist('01_phone_receive_01')
	character_util.shake(workaholic_1, 0.03, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--부장 캐릭터 (left, idle, twohand_idle) 자세로 mall_phone 아이템을 손에 듬.
	play_sfx_for_dist('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(workaholic_1, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(workaholic_1, '[base]weapon1', self.phone_sprite)
	scene_util.set_anim(workaholic_1, self.handler, { name = 'twohand_idle' })

	--부장 (left, idle, twohand_idle) : 응? 여보세요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(workaholic_1, self.handler,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_workaholic_6', skip = false })

	--부장 (left, smile, twohand_idle) : 아! 오늘 저녁 약속 말이지? 문제 없다고!
	play_sfx_for_dist('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(workaholic_1, self.handler,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_workaholic_7', skip = false })

	--부장 (left, smile, twohand_idle) : 오늘 빨리 퇴근할거니까 좀만 기다려, 자기~
	play_sfx_for_dist('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(workaholic_1, self.handler,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nightmare_lt_workaholic_8', skip = false })

	--이후 각 NPC 인터렉트 가능하도록 변경.
	--플레이어 각 NPC 인터렉트 시, 하단의 원라인 대사 출력
	--부장 (left, smile, twohand_idle) : 오늘 빨리 퇴근할거니까 좀만 기다려, 자기~
	--차장 (right, tired, eat) : 아… 하기 싫어. 03_dialogue_bad_01
	--과장 (left, tired, eat) : 야간수당도 제대로 안챙겨주면서… 03_dialogue_sadness_01
	--사원1 (right, tired, eat) : 진짜 블랙기업이 따로 없네! 03_dialogue_angry_01
	--사원2 (left, tired, eat) : 불타는 금요일에 야근을 해야 된다니…! 03_dialogue_negative_02
	--사원3 (right, tired, eat) : 설마 주말에도 출근하라는건 아니겠지? 03_dialogue_sadness_02
	local workaholic_npc_num = 6

	local talk_sfx_list = {
		'',
		'03_dialogue_sadness_01',
		'03_dialogue_bad_01',
		'03_dialogue_angry_01',
		'03_dialogue_negative_02',
		'03_dialogue_sadness_02'
	}

	for idx = 1, workaholic_npc_num do
		self.get_workaholic_npc(idx).Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		self.get_workaholic_npc(idx).Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_lt_workaholic_online_' .. idx
		self.get_workaholic_npc(idx).Interactable.TalkSfx = talk_sfx_list[idx]
	end

	self.epilogue_list[self.epilogue_quest_id.workaholic].state = self.epilogue_state.complete

	stage_progress_util.set_custom_data_async(self.epilogue_list[self.epilogue_quest_id.workaholic].custom_key, true)
end

local local_class = newclass('NightmareQueenCastleAndroidHateHeatSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareQueenCastleAndroidHateHeat @
		Comment = @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type NightmareQueenCastleAndroidHateHeatController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.main_quest_id = 459

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = { 'nightmare_queencastle_4' }

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_load = 1,
		active_quest = 2,
		before_find_android = 3,
		before_interact_android = 4,
		after_interact_android = 5,
		before_get_box = 6,
		after_box = 7,
		done = 99
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_load

	self.section_name_pre_fix = 'hate_heat_'

	self.get_twins_a = function()
		return get_character('twins_android_maid')
	end

	self.get_twins_b = function()
		return get_character('twins_android_b_maid')
	end

	self.dynamic_npcs = setmetatable({
		npc_name_prefix = self.section_name_pre_fix,

		npc_count = 7,

		data = {
			[self.section_name_pre_fix .. 1] = 'nightmare_qc_android_worker',
			[self.section_name_pre_fix .. 2] = 'nightmare_qc_android_worker',
			[self.section_name_pre_fix .. 3] = 'nightmare_qc_android_worker',
			[self.section_name_pre_fix .. 4] = 'nightmare_qc_android_worker',
			[self.section_name_pre_fix .. 5] = 'nightmare_qc_android_worker',
			[self.section_name_pre_fix .. 6] = 'nightmare_qc_android_worker',
			[self.section_name_pre_fix .. 7] = 'nightmare_qc_android_worker',
		},

		container = nil,
	}, {
		__index = {
			load_async = function(this)
				if this.container ~= nil then
					return
				end

				local spec_data = {}

				for npc_name, spec_name in pairs(this.data) do
					spec_data[npc_name] = spec_name
				end

				this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(spec_data)
			end,

			dispose = function(this)
				if this.container == nil then
					return
				end

				load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)

				this.container = nil
			end,

			get_android = function(this, index)
				return this.container[this.npc_name_prefix .. index]
			end,

			foreach_android = function(this, action)
				for i = 1, this.npc_count do
					action(this:get_android(i))
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		field_fire = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_field_fire')
		end,
	})

	self.event_range = {
		inst = nil,

		create = function(this, pos, color, size_v2)
			local show_type = CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.NONE
			this.inst = attack_range_util.create_rect_by_color_key(color, pos, size_v2, show_type)

			attack_range_util.show(this.inst, 0)
			attack_range_util.setup_by_position(this.inst, pos, 0)
		end,

		set_active_state = function(this, is_active)
			if is_active then
				this.inst:Show(0)
			else
				this.inst:Hide()
			end
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			this:set_active_state(false)
			this.inst = nil
		end
	}

	self.is_damaged = false

	self.camera_grid_name = 'hate_heat'

	self.request_gird_leave = false

	self.ice_cream_id = 20163
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
	self.dynamic_npcs:load_async()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()
	local main_quest = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.main_quest_id)

	if main_quest == nil then
		return false
	end

	if main_quest.InnerProgress > 1 then
		self.current_state = self.states.active_quest

		self:setting()
	else
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil

	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()

	if self.event_range.inst ~= nil then
		self.event_range:dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then

		self:on_interact_event(e)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_find_android and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.section_name_pre_fix .. 'start_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.before_interact_android

		sp_util.start_scene(self.find_android_scene, self)
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.before_get_box and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e,
					get_field_object(self.section_name_pre_fix .. 'box'),
					self.section_name_pre_fix .. 'box_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.after_box

		self.event_range:dispose()

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene({release_hold = false})

			self:return_box_scene()

			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
		end)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

	if self.current_state < self.states.before_get_box and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.dynamic_npcs:get_android(1)) or
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.dynamic_npcs:get_android(2)) then

		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_android_scene, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local box = get_field_object(self.section_name_pre_fix .. 'box')
	if not self.is_damaged and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, box) and
			string.find(e.Info.sender.Name, 'hate_heat_fire') then
		self.is_damaged = true

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene({ release_hold = false })

			local player = get_party_leader()

			--게임오버 조건
			--[gimmick]box를 유저가 들어올린채로 포탄을 피격했을시 이벤트 재생
			--다음 동작 동시에
			--플레이어 캐릭터 표정 (surprise) 상태
			scene_util.set_emotion(player, self, 'surprise')

			--[gimmick]box 에 FX_field_fire 부착
			local fire = self.fx.field_fire()
					:Instantiate(box.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, box.Transform)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01')

			--1초 대기

			wait_for_sec(1)

			do
				local duration = 0.8

				--0.8초 서큘러 페이드 아웃
				screen_util.fade_out_async(duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

				if lua_helper.type_compare(player.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
					if lua_helper.reference_equals(player.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget, box)then
						character_util.release_hold_object(player, box)
					end
				end

				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				party_util.align_party(self.dynamic_npcs:get_android(1).Position, 'left', 0.1, 'linear')

				box.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.section_name_pre_fix .. 'android_box_pos')

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)

				fire:Dispose()

				--0.5초 대기
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
				--0.8초 서큘러 페이드 아웃

				screen_util.fade_in_async(duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
				--다음 동작 동시에
				--하단 대열로 복귀
				--오브젝트에 붙어있던 FX_field_fire제거
				--오브젝트 원래 위치로 복귀
			end

			self.is_damaged = false

			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, player)
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if self.current_state < self.states.active_quest and e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 2 then
		self.current_state = self.states.active_quest

		self:setting()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.camera_grid_name) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.before_get_box then
			self.request_gird_leave = false

			if self.event_range.inst == nil then

				local pos = self.dynamic_npcs:get_android(1).Position + vector(0.5, 0, -1)

				self.event_range:create(pos, 'green', vector(2, 2))
			end
		end

		local current_party = get_user_party()

		for i = 1, current_party.Count - 1 do
			field_object_util.set_active_state(current_party[i], active_state_type.visible)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.camera_grid_name) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.before_get_box and
				self.request_gird_leave == false then

			self.request_gird_leave = true

			start_coroutine(function()
				local time_passed = 0
				local duration = 5

				while true do
					if self.request_gird_leave == false or time_passed > duration then
						break
					end

					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

					coroutine.yield()
				end

				if self.request_gird_leave then
					self.event_range:dispose()
				end
			end)
		end

		local current_party = get_user_party()

		for i = 1, current_party.Count - 1 do
			field_object_util.set_active_state(current_party[i], active_state_type.enabled)
		end
	end
end

		scene_util.set_emotion(android_6, self, 'damaged')

		character_util.set_position(android_7, damaged_android_pos + vector(2.5, 0, -2.5))

		scene_util.set_emotion(android_7, self, 'damaged')

		android_7.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle

	self.current_state = self.states.before_find_android
end

function local_class:find_android_scene()
	local android_1 = self.dynamic_npcs:get_android(1)
	local android_2 = self.dynamic_npcs:get_android(2)

	character_util.add_listener(android_1, self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(android_2, self.controller)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	--카메라 0.5초간 안드로이드 1에게 이동
	do
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.section_name_pre_fix .. 'android_find_pos')

		camera_util.move_async(pos, 0.5)
	end

	--안드로이드 1 (right, idle, bomb_idle) : 드디어 기다리던 물건이 도착했다고 합니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			android_1,
			self,
			'right',
			'bomb_idle',
			nil,
			'nm_qc_hateheat_1'
	)

	--안드로이드 2 (left, idle, release 2화): 빨리 가서 확인하도록 하죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			android_2,
			self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil,
			'nm_qc_hateheat_2'
	)

	--안드로이드 1,2 우측으로 속도 4 이동 (walk 애니메이션)
	do
		local pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', android_1.Position, 2)
		local end_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.section_name_pre_fix .. 'android_interact_pos')

		wp_util.move(android_1, pos, 4, nil, { end_callback = function()
			character_util.set_position(android_1, end_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))
			scene_util.set_direction(android_1, 'down', false)
		end })

		wp_util.move(android_2, pos, 4, nil, { end_callback = function()
			character_util.set_position(android_2, end_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
			scene_util.set_direction(android_2, 'down', false)
		end })
	end

	--이동 1초후
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카메라 0.5초간 플레이어(니프티) 에게 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
	--컨트롤 해제
end

function local_class:interact_android_scene()
	local android_1 = self.dynamic_npcs:get_android(1)
	local android_2 = self.dynamic_npcs:get_android(2)

	local twins_a = self.get_twins_a()
	local twins_b = self.get_twins_b()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	--속도 4로 해당 대열 정렬
	party_util.align_party(android_1.Position, 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	--(니)니프티 (right, idle, idle)(39, 0, 6.5)
	--(시)시프티 (right, idle, idle)(38, 0, 6.5)
	scene_util.set_direction(android_1, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(android_2, 'left', false)

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_android then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_interact_android

		--안드로이드 1(left, idle, bomb_idle): 멀쩡한 안드로이드가 아직 남아있었군요.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				android_1,
				self,
				'left',
				'bomb_idle',
				nil,
				'nm_qc_hateheat_3'
		)

		--안드로이드 2(left, idle, release 2회) : 드디어 지원 병력이 온 것입니까?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				android_2,
				self,
				'left',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
				nil,
				'nm_qc_hateheat_4'
		)

		--니프티 (right, idle, idle) : 무슨 문제라도 있습니까?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				twins_a,
				self,
				'right',
				nil,
				nil,
				'nm_qc_hateheat_5'
		)

		--안드로이드 1(left, idle, idle): 고온의 환경에서 안드로이드들을 버티게 해주는 물품이 배달이 되어야 했습니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				android_1,
				self,
				'left',
				nil,
				nil,
				'nm_qc_hateheat_6'
		)

		--안드로이드 2(left, idle, release 2회) : 그런데 그 물건이 잘못된 위치에 배달되어 버렸습니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				android_2,
				self,
				'left',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
				nil,
				'nm_qc_hateheat_7'
		)

		--다음 동작 동시에
		--안드로이드 1,2 (right, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(android_1, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(android_2, 'right', false)

		--카메라 2초간 우측 끝에 오브젝트 위치까지 이동
		--오브젝트 ([gimmick]box)
		do
			local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.section_name_pre_fix .. 'android_box_pos')

			camera_util.move_async(pos, 2)
		end

		--0.8초 페이드 아웃
		do
			local duration = 0.8

			screen_util.fade_out_async(duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

			--0.5초대기
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			--0.8초 페이드 인
			screen_util.fade_in_async(duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		end

		--카메라 다시 플레이어 (니프티) 에게 복귀된 상태
		--다음 동작 동시에
		--안드로이드 1(left, idle, bomb_idle): 저런 위치면 배달전에 주소가 맞는지 확인해봐야 하는 것 아닙니까?
		scene_util.set_direction(android_2, 'left', false)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
				android_1,
				self,
