---@class WeaponNpcBattleLogic
local local_class = newclass('WeaponNpcBattleLogic')

function local_class:init()
	self.is_battle = false

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		blink = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Blink')
		end,
	})

	--니프티
	self.get_twins_android = function()
		return get_character('twins_android')
	end
	self.get_twins_android_maid = function()
		return get_character('twins_android_maid')
	end

	--시프티
	self.twins_android_b = function()
		if get_party_leader() == self.get_twins_android() then
			return get_character('twins_android_b')
		else
			return get_character('twins_android_b_maid')
		end
	end

	self.save_weapon = nil

	self.leader_custom_idle_anim = nil
	self.leader_custom_walk_anim = nil
	self.leader_custom_run_anim = nil

	self.is_pause_remove_weapon = false
end

--region CustomOption
function local_class:load()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent), 'on_battle_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_battle_end_event')

	metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor(self.fx):load_async()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self.leader_custom_idle_anim = leader.CustomIdleAnimationName
	self.leader_custom_walk_anim = leader.CustomWalkAnimationName
	self.leader_custom_run_anim = leader.CustomRunAnimationName

	self.save_weapon = {
		normal = {},
		costume = {}
	}

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.SummonCharacterGenerator.Instance:GenerateLocal(get_party_leader()))

	self:first_remove_equipment()
end

--endregion CustomOption

--region Event
function local_class:on_battle_start_event(_)
	if self.is_battle then
		return false
	end

	self.is_battle = true
	--start_coroutine(self.convert_non_party_member, self)
	start_coroutine(self.convert_npc_setting_battle_start, self)

	return true
end

--엔드가 두번 불릴 경우 웨펀이 세팅 안되는 문제 있음
--싸우다 그리드를 나갈경우 (없다고 보면된다)
function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	if self.is_pause_remove_weapon then
		return
	end

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 리더가 포함되어 있지 않은 전투라면 return
	if not e:IsCharacterInBattle(leader) then
		return false
	end

	-- 리더가 사망해서 끝난 전투라면 리셋해주지 않음
	if leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	-- 전투 끝나면 파티원 다시 숨겨줌
	self.is_battle = false

	-- 전투가 종료 되었을 때 캐릭터의 Battle Action Cancel
	leader.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

	self:convert_npc_setting_battle_end()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_equipment_changed_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 전투 중이거나 리더가 아니면 return
	if self.is_battle or not lua_helper.reference_equals(leader, e.Target) then
		return false
	end

	-- EquipmentChangedEvent 구독 해지 후 ControllerBlockEvent 한번 발행했다가 풀어줌
	start_coroutine(function()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.EquipmentChangedEvent))

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ControllerBlockEvent.Create(false, CS.Oak.ControllerBlockReason.ControllerSetting))
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ControllerBlockEvent.Create(true, CS.Oak.ControllerBlockReason.ControllerSetting))

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		message_system:SendSync(leader, CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviourResetEvent.Instance)
	end)

	return true
end

--endregion Event
function local_class:first_remove_equipment()
	while get_party_leader().IsChangingEquipment do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.save_weapon.normal.weapon1 = self.get_twins_android().Weapon1
	self.save_weapon.normal.weapon2 = self.get_twins_android().Weapon2

	self.get_twins_android():SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, nil)
	self.get_twins_android():SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, nil)

	if self.get_twins_android_maid() then
		self.save_weapon.costume.weapon1 = self.get_twins_android_maid().Weapon1
		self.save_weapon.costume.weapon2 = self.get_twins_android_maid().Weapon2

		self.get_twins_android_maid():SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, nil)
		self.get_twins_android_maid():SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, nil)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_equipment(target_npc)
	if get_party_leader() == self.get_twins_android() then
		self.save_weapon.normal.weapon1 = target_npc.Weapon1
		self.save_weapon.normal.weapon2 = target_npc.Weapon2
	else
		self.save_weapon.costume.weapon1 = target_npc.Weapon1
		self.save_weapon.costume.weapon2 = target_npc.Weapon2
	end

	while target_npc.IsChangingEquipment do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	target_npc:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, nil)
	target_npc:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, nil)
end

function local_class:show_equipment(target_npc, save_weapon1, save_weapon2)
	target_npc.CustomIdleAnimationName = self.leader_custom_idle_anim
	target_npc.CustomWalkAnimationName = self.leader_custom_walk_anim
	target_npc.CustomRunAnimationName = self.leader_custom_run_anim

	target_npc:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, save_weapon1)
	target_npc:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, save_weapon2)
end

--배틀 시작 시
function local_class:convert_npc_setting_battle_start()
	local twins_android = get_party_leader()
	local twins_android_b = self.twins_android_b()

	local weapon1 = get_party_leader() == self.get_twins_android() and
			self.save_weapon.normal.weapon1 or self.save_weapon.costume.weapon1
	local weapon2 = get_party_leader() == self.get_twins_android() and
			self.save_weapon.normal.weapon2 or self.save_weapon.costume.weapon2

	self.fx.blink():Instantiate(twins_android.Position)

	start_coroutine(function()
		self:show_equipment(get_party_leader(), weapon1, weapon2)

		self.fx.blink():Instantiate(twins_android_b.Position)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(twins_android_b, active_state_type.disabled)
	end)
end

--배틀 종료 시
function local_class:convert_npc_setting_battle_end()
	local twins_android = get_party_leader()
	local twins_android_b = self.twins_android_b()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.EquipmentChangedEvent), 'on_equipment_changed_event')

	start_coroutine(function()
		self:remove_equipment(get_party_leader())

		local target_dir = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(twins_android.Direction) * -1

		field_object_util.set_active_state(twins_android_b, active_state_type.enabled)

		twins_android_b.Position = twins_android.Position + target_dir

		self.fx.blink():Instantiate(twins_android_b.Position)
	end)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.EquipmentChangedEvent))
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local gb_wait_state = newclass('GBWaitState', gb_state_base)
local gb_attack_state = newclass('GBAttactState', gb_state_base)

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareQueenCastleGhostBuster @
		Comment = @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type NightmareQueenCastleGhostBusterController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = { 'nightmare_queencastle_2' }

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		meet_the_ghost_buster = 2,
		ghost_buster_is_chasing = 3,
		ending = 4,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.character = setmetatable({
		spec = {
			--니프티
			twins_android = 'twins_android',
			--시프티
			twins_android_b = 'twins_android_b',

			ghost_buster = 'gb_ghost_buster',
		}
	}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			return get_character(this.spec[key])
		end
	})

	self.marker = {
		camera_pos = function(scene_idx, pos_idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('gb_camera_' .. scene_idx .. '_' .. pos_idx)
		end,

		twins_android = function(scene_idx, pos_idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('gb_twins_android_' .. scene_idx .. '_' .. pos_idx)
		end,

		twins_android_b = function(scene_idx, pos_idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('gb_twins_android_b_' .. scene_idx .. '_' .. pos_idx)
		end,

		ghost_buster = function(scene_idx, pos_idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('gb_ghostbuster_' .. scene_idx .. '_' .. pos_idx)
		end,

		ghost_buster_weapon = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('gb_ghostbuster_weapon')
		end,
	}

	self.gimmicks = {
		enter_door = function(num) return get_field_object('ghost_buster_area_door_' .. num) end
	}

	self.zone_name = {
		enter_area = 'ghost_buster_enter_zone',
	}

	self.grid_name = {
		ending_area = 'ghost_buster_ending',
	}

	self.items = {
		sprite_id = {
			ghost_buster_weapon = 21528,
		},
		data = nil,
		add_item = function(this, item_id, unique_id, pos, target_pos, scale, create_on_character, dont_show_loot_text, drop_type, local_scale)
			if this.data == nil then
				this.data = {}
			end

			create_on_character = lua_helper.get_or_default(create_on_character, false)
			target_pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(target_pos, nil)
			local_scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(local_scale, nil)
			drop_type = lua_helper.get_or_default(drop_type, nil)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = pos,
				item_id = item_id,
				spr_scale = scale,
				unique_id = unique_id,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				show_on_character = create_on_character,
				skip_text = dont_show_loot_text,
				drop_type = quest_drop_item_drop_type.Physics,
				target = target_pos
			})

			if local_scale ~= nil then
				item.SpriteTransform.localScale = local_scale
				item.ShadowTransform.localScale = local_scale
			end

			table.insert(this.data, item)
		end,
		pop_item = function(this, unique_id)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for i, item in ipairs(this.data) do
					if item.UniqueId == unique_id then
						local pop_item = item

						table.remove(this.data, i)

						return pop_item
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end,

		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for i = 1, #this.data do
					quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.data[i])
					this.data[i] = nil
				end

				this.data = nil
			end
		end
	}

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		thunder = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_main_s24_reaper_thunder')
		end,

		cloud_thunder = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_gimmick_cloud_thunder')
		end,

		red_portal = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_gimmick_portal_red_open')
		end,

		red_portal_end = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_gimmick_portal_red_end')
		end,

	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	-- 소회와 첫 상호작용 대화한 것 체크
	self.talked_to_ghost_buster = false

	self.gb_state_id = 0

	self.gb_state = nil

	-- 소히 state 풀
	self.gb_state_pool = nil

	self.path_find_done = false

	self.is_active_gb_routine = true
	self.activate_gb = true

	self.star_piece_name = 'ghost_buster_starpiece'

	--소히 추적 배경음
	self.chase_bgm_sfx = nil
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:set()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.gb_state_pool = {
		wait = gb_wait_state(self, self.character.ghost_buster),
		chasing = gb_chasing_state(self, self.character.ghost_buster),
		attack = gb_attack_state(self, self.character.ghost_buster),
	}

	self:change_ghost_buster_state('wait')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.gb_state then
		self.gb_state:exit()
		self.gb_state = nil
	end

	if self.gb_state_pool ~= nil then
		for _, state in pairs(self.gb_state_pool) do
			state:dispose()
			state = nil
		end

		self.gb_state_pool = nil
	end

	self.is_active_gb_routine = false

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.character.ghost_buster) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.meet_the_ghost_buster then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_ghost_buster, self, false)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.enter_area) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.none then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_ghost_buster_area, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.grid_name.ending_area) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.ghost_buster_is_chasing then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_ending_grid, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:align_twins(speed, duration, scene_idx, pos_idx, move_args)
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android
	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b

	pos_idx = lua_helper.get_or_default(pos_idx, 1)

	local move_end_key = 'twin_align'
	local arrive_pos = self.marker.twins_android(scene_idx, pos_idx)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android, arrive_pos, speed, duration, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = move_args.last_dir, run = move_args.run })

	arrive_pos = self.marker.twins_android_b(scene_idx, pos_idx)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twin_b, arrive_pos, speed, duration, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = move_args.last_dir, run = move_args.run })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)
end

function local_class:set()
	self.items:add_item(self.items.sprite_id.ghost_buster_weapon, 'ghost_buster_weapon',
			self.marker.ghost_buster_weapon(), nil, 0.5, false)
end

function local_class:enter_ghost_buster_area()
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android
	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b
	local ghost_buster = self.character.ghost_buster

	self.current_state = self.states.meet_the_ghost_buster

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	-- 속도 4로 다음 대열로 정렬
	-- (1) 니프티 (down, idle, idle) (-42, 0, -72)
	-- (2) 시프티 (down, idle, idle) (-41, 0, -72)
	self:align_twins(4, nil, 1, 1, { last_dir = 'down', run = false })

	scene_util.set_group_direction({ twins_android, twin_b }, 'down', false)

	--니프티 (down, idle, release 2회): 저길 보십시오.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_1_1')

	--소히 쪽으로 0.5초간 카메라 이동
	camera_util.move_async(ghost_buster.Position, 0.5)

	--1초대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--0.5초간 플레이어 (니프티) 에게 카메라 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--니프티 (down, idle, idle): 안드로이드 이외의 존재. 가디언의 동료인 것 같습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_1_2')

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle) 0.5초
	scene_util.play_wait_action(twin_b, self,
			{ dir = 'left' },
			nil,
			nil,
			0.5)

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle) 0.5초
	scene_util.play_wait_action(twin_b, self,
			{ dir = 'right' },
			nil,
			nil,
			0.5)

	--시프티 (down, idle, nod 2회): 다행히 주변에 가디언의 모습은 보이지 않는군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, { dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_1_3')

	--시프티 (down, idle, question): 지금 상황이면 가디언의 동료를 저희가 먼저 회수할 수 있겠군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'question' }, nil, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_1_4')

	-- 니프티 (down, idle, release 2회): 그러면 가디언의 행동을 제약할 수 있을겁니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_1_5')

	character_util.add_listener(ghost_buster, self)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:interact_ghost_buster(reset)
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android
	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b
	local ghost_buster = self.character.ghost_buster

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	if not reset then
		sp_util.enter_scene()

		-- 0.5초간 해당 대열로 정렬
		--(1) 니프티 (right, idle, idle)(-42.5, 0, -76.5)
		--(2) 시프티 (right, idle, idle)(-43.5, 0, -76.5)
		self:align_twins(2, nil, 2, 1, { last_dir = 'right', run = false })
	end

	if not self.talked_to_ghost_buster then
		-- 니프티 (right, idle, eat) 1초
		local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
		scene_util.set_anim(twins_android, self, { name = 'eat' })

		-- 니프티 (eat) 시작 0.5초 후 소히(left, sleep_deep, prostrate) (shake0.03 / 0.5초)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		scene_util.shake(ghost_buster, 0.03, 0.5)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 다음 동작 동시에
		-- 니프티, 시프티 (right, attack, idle) (jump 1회)
		scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(twins_android, self, 'attack')
		character_util.remove_anim(twins_android)
		character_util.normal_jump(twins_android, '01_jump_01')
		eat_sfx:Stop()

		scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(twin_b, self, 'attack')
		character_util.remove_anim(twin_b)
		character_util.normal_jump(twin_b, false)

		-- 소히 (damaged) 표정으로 마리오점프 기상
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(ghost_buster, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.remove_anim(ghost_buster)
		character_util.mario_jump_async(ghost_buster, 'left')

		--0.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--소히 (right, idle, question): 여긴… 어디지?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.remove_emotion(ghost_buster)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				'question', nil, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_1')

		--시프티(right, tired, cast): 깨어났습니다….
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
		character_util.remove_emotion(twins_android)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, 'right',
				'cast', 'tired', 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_2')

		--소히 (left, tired, bomb_idle): 너희들은 뭐야?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'left',
				'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_3')

		--소히 (left, attack, idle) (jump 1회) 0.5초
		scene_util.set_direction(ghost_buster, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(ghost_buster, self, 'attack')

		--소히 (left, attack, release 2회): 외형을 보니… 신형 안드로이드인가?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_4')

		--니프티 (left, idle, bomb_idle)(말풍선 크기 0.8x0.8): 다행히 적대적으로 보이진 않는군요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'bomb_idle' }, nil, { key = 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_5', skip = true, scale = 0.8 })


		-- 니프티 (right, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'right', false)

		--소히 (left, smile, release 2회): 너희들! 혹시 잠깐만 관찰해봐도 될까?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_6')

		--소히 (left, doyagao, sing): 좀 본다고 닳는 것도 아닐 거 아냐?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'left',
				'sing', 'doyagao', 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_7')

		--니프티 (left, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'left', false)

		-- 시프티(right, idle, cast)(말풍선 크기 0.8x0.8): 니프티, 이건 좋은 기회일지 모릅니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, 'right',
				'cast', nil, { key = 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_8', skip = true, scale = 0.8 })

		--니프티 (left, idle, nod 2회)(말풍선 크기 0.8x0.8): 동의합니다. 가디언의 동료를 포섭하기 좋은 기회입니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, { key = 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_9', skip = true, scale = 0.8 })

		--니프티 (right, idle, bomb_idle): 알겠습니다. 대신 저희의 요구를 조금 들어줄 수 있으십니까?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'right',
				'bomb_idle', nil, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_10')

		--소히 (left, idle, bomb_idle): 뭐, 이 천재가 못하는 건 없으니까. 뭐든 요구해보라고.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'left',
				'bomb_idle', nil, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_11')

		self.talked_to_ghost_buster = true
	end

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--맘껏 보셔도 됩니다. (mercy)
		{ 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_12', 'mercy' },
		--잠깐 작전타임입니다. (brutal)
		{ 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_13', 'brutal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 2 then
		-- 니프티 (right, idle, bomb_idle): 잠깐만 고민 좀 하고 있겠습니다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'right',
				'bomb_idle', nil, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_14')

		-- 소히 (left, idle, bomb_idle): 뭐, 내 도움을 받을 천재일우의 기회니까 열심히 고민해봐.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'left',
				'bomb_idle', nil, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_15')

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

		if reset then
			character_util.add_listener(ghost_buster, self)
		end

		self.current_state = self.states.meet_the_ghost_buster

		-- 컨트롤 해제
		return
	end

	--니프티 (right, idle, bomb_idle): 알겠습니다. 관찰을 허락합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_16')

	--소히 (left, smile, sing): 그래! 좋았어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'left',
			'sing', 'smile', 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_17')

	--소히 0.5초간 좌측으로 0.5칸 이동
	wp_util.move_async(ghost_buster, ghost_buster.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), nil, 0.5)

	--소히 (left, idle, eat) 1초
	local clang_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clang_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.set_direction(ghost_buster, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(ghost_buster, self, 'eat')

	--이후 (eat) 유지
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--니프티 (right, damaged, idle) (shake0.03 /0.5초)
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(twins_android, self, 'damaged')

	scene_util.shake(ghost_buster, 0.03, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--다음 동작 동시에

	--소히 (left, idle, idle)
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(clang_sfx)
	scene_util.set_direction(ghost_buster, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ghost_buster)

	--니프티(right, attack, release 2회) : 자, 잠깐만! 어디까지 건드시는 겁니까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_18')

	--소히 (left, doyagao, sing): 왜 튕기고 그래?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'left',
			'sing', 'doyagao', 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_19')

	--소히 (left, doyagao, bomb_idle): 안드로이드를 관찰하겠다는 건 당연히 내부까지 라는 게 상식이잖아?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', 'doyagao', 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_20')

	--니프티, 시프티 1초간 좌측 2칸 뒷걸음
	local move_end_key = 'twin_move'
	local arrive_pos = twins_android.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android, arrive_pos, nil, 1, self, move_end_key, { locked_dir = 'right' })

	arrive_pos = twin_b.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twin_b, arrive_pos, nil, 1, self, move_end_key, { locked_dir = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	--니프티 (left, idle, cast)[0.8x0.8 말풍선]: 만약 내부까지 관찰당한다면 저희의 정보가 새나갈 겁니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
	{ name = 'cast' }, nil, { key = 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_21', skip = true, scale = 0.8 })

	--시프티 (right, idle, bomb_idle)[0.8x0.8 말풍선]: 맞습니다. 그것만큼은 막아야 합니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' }, nil, { key = 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_22', skip = true, scale = 0.8 })

	-- 니프티, 시프티 (right, attack, idle)(jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(twins_android, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(twins_android, '01_small_jump_01')

	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(twin_b, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(twin_b, false)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted'})

	-- 소히(left, idle, cross_arm): 너희… 역시 수상해.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_ready_01' }, nil, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_23')

	--소히(left, greed, release 2회): 도대체 얼마나 좋은 기술을 가지고 있길래 숨기려 드는 거야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, { name = 'greed', keep = true }, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_24')

	--니프티 (left, attack, release 2회): 도, 도망칩시다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_04')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_2_25')

	if not reset then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(ghost_buster, self.controller)

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twins_android)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twin_b)

	self.chase_bgm_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_pet_bite_loop_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('ghost_buster_area_door_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('ghost_buster_area_door_2', false))

	self.current_state = self.states.ghost_buster_is_chasing

	start_coroutine(self.ghost_buster_loop, self)

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		self:change_ghost_buster_state('chasing')
	end)
end

-- 소히를 추격 상태로 바꿈
function local_class:enter_ending_grid()
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android
	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b
	local ghost_buster = self.character.ghost_buster

	local wait_end = false

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.chase_bgm_sfx:FadeOut(3)

		wait_for_sec(3)

		wait_end = true
	end)


	self:change_ghost_buster_state('wait')

	local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	self:align_twins(6, nil, 3, 1, { last_dir = 'left', run = true })

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(run_sfx)

	self.is_active_gb_routine = false

	-- 시프티 (left, idle, release 2회): 더이상 도망칠 곳이 없습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_ghost_buster_s1_3_1')

	local start_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', self.marker.ghost_buster(3, 1), 1.5)

	character_util.set_position(ghost_buster, start_pos)

	while not wait_end do
		coroutine.yield()

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

-- 소히 행동 루프
function local_class:ghost_buster_loop()
	while self.is_active_gb_routine do
		if self.activate_gb then
			self:update_ghost_buster_state(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.gb_state then
		self.gb_state:exit()
		self.gb_state = nil
	end

	if self.gb_state_pool ~= nil then
		for _, state in pairs(self.gb_state_pool) do
			state:dispose()
			state = nil
		end
		self.gb_state_pool = nil
	end
end

-- 소히 업데이트
function local_class:update_ghost_buster_state(dt)
	if self.gb_state then
		self.gb_state:update(dt)
	end
end

-- ammi state 변경
function local_class:change_ghost_buster_state(next_state, data)
	self.gb_state_id = self.gb_state_id + 1

	if self.gb_state then
		self.gb_state:exit()
		self.gb_state = nil
	end

	self.gb_state = self.gb_state_pool[next_state]
	self.gb_state:enter(data)
end

-- 길찾기
function local_class:find_path(pos, speed, key)
	self.path_find_done = false
	local default_anim_scale_speed = 6
	local anim_scale = speed / default_anim_scale_speed
	local waypoint = {}

	field.PathFinder:FindNormalPath(self.character.ghost_buster, pos, 100, self.character.ghost_buster, key, nil,
			function(path, req_key)
				-- 현재 state id가 받은 시점과 다르면 실행하지 않고 폐기
				if req_key == self.gb_state_id then
					self.path_find_done = true
					for i = 1, path.Count - 1 do
						table.insert(waypoint, path[i])
					end

					wp_util.move(self.character.ghost_buster, waypoint, speed, nil)
				end
			end)
end


--region ammi_state_base
function gb_state_base:init(controller, character)
	self.controller = controller
	self.chaser = character

	self.time_passed = 0
end

function gb_state_base:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.character = nil
end

function gb_state_base:exit()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function gb_state_base:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end
--endregion

--region ammi_wait_state
function gb_wait_state:init(controller, character)
	self.super:init(controller, character)
	self.chaser = character
end

function gb_wait_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function gb_wait_state:enter(data)
end

function gb_wait_state:exit()
	self.super:exit()
end

function gb_wait_state:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)
end
--endregion

--region gb_chasing_state
function gb_chasing_state:init(controller, character)
	self.super:init(controller, character)

	-- 소히 추격 state
	self.chasing_state = {
		-- 일반적인 등속 이동
		normal_chasing = 1,
	}
	self.current_chasing_state = self.chasing_state.normal_chasing
	self.chasing_speed = 5
	self.chasing_state_time_passed = 0
	self.recent_chasing_state = nil
end

function gb_chasing_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function gb_chasing_state:enter(data)
	self.path_find_time_passed = 0.1

	self.current_chasing_state = self.chasing_state.normal_chasing
	self.chasing_state_time_passed = 0

	scene_util.set_anim(self.chaser, self.controller, 'run')

	self.controller.path_find_done = true
end

function gb_chasing_state:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	character_util.stop(self.chaser)

	self.controller.path_find_done = true

	character_util.remove_anim(self.chaser)
end

function gb_chasing_state:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	-- 플레이어와의 거리가 공격 범위보다 짧으면 attack 상태 전환
	local player_distance = unity_class.vector3.Distance(user_party.Leader.Position, self.chaser.Position)
	if player_distance <= 0.5 then
		self.controller:change_ghost_buster_state('attack')

		return
	end

	-- path_find 완료 시점부터 시간 증가
	if self.controller.path_find_done then
		self.path_find_time_passed = self.path_find_time_passed + dt

		if self.path_find_time_passed >= 0.1 then
			start_coroutine(self.controller.find_path, self.controller,
					user_party.Leader.Position, self.chasing_speed, self.controller.gb_state_id)
			self.path_find_time_passed = 0
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--region gb_attack_state
function gb_attack_state:init(controller, character)
	self.super:init(controller, character)
	self.chaser = character
end

function gb_attack_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function gb_attack_state:enter(data)
	sp_util.start_scene(self.controller.catch_by_ghost_buster, self.controller)

	self.controller:change_ghost_buster_state('wait')
end

function gb_attack_state:exit()
	self.super:exit()
end

function gb_attack_state:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)
end
--endregion

return local_class

		neo_leader = function()
			return get_character('neo_leader')
		end,
		twins_android = function()
			return get_character('twins_android')
		end,
		twins_android_b = function()
			return get_character('twins_android_b')
		end,
	}

	-- dynamic_npc
	local dynamic_android_name_pre_fix = 'main_s1_dynamic_android_'

	self.dynamic_npcs = setmetatable({
		npc_name_prefix = dynamic_android_name_pre_fix,

		npc_count = 4,

		data = {
			[dynamic_android_name_pre_fix .. 1] = 'nightmare_qc_android_worker',
			[dynamic_android_name_pre_fix .. 2] = 'nightmare_qc_android_worker',
			[dynamic_android_name_pre_fix .. 3] = 'nightmare_qc_android_carpenter',
			[dynamic_android_name_pre_fix .. 4] = 'nightmare_qc_android_bunny',
		},

		container = nil,
	}, {
		__index = {
			load_async = function(this)
				if this.container ~= nil then
					return
				end

				local spec_data = {}

				for npc_name, spec_name in pairs(this.data) do
					spec_data[npc_name] = spec_name
				end

				this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(spec_data)
			end,

			dispose = function(this)
				if this.container == nil then
					return
				end

				load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)

				this.container = nil
			end,

			get_android = function(this, index)
				return this.container[this.npc_name_prefix .. index]
			end,

			foreach_android = function(this, action)
				for i = 1, this.npc_count do
					action(i, this:get_android(i))
				end
			end
		}
	})

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		office_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_office_pos')
		end,
		heaven_hold_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_heaven_hold_pos')
		end,
		camera_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_camera_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		neo_leader_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_neo_leader_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		twins_android_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_twins_android_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		twins_android_b_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_twins_android_b_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		android_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_android_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		android_dir = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_dir('s1_android_pos_' .. number)
		end
	}

	-- fx
	self.fx = setmetatable({
		glitch_effect_screen = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_glitch_effect_screen')
		end,
		crt_filter = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_nightmare_lt_crt_filter')
		end,
		event_portalspawn_red_open = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_portalspawn_red_open')
		end,
		event_portalspawn_red_end = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_portalspawn_red_end')
		end,
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.scene_exit_check = false
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()
	sp_util.start_scene(self.start_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()

	self.scene_exit_check = true

	if not is_unity_null(self.office_scene) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.office_scene)
		self.office_scene = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.neo_fed_office) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.neo_fed_office)
		self.neo_fed_office = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.heaven_hold) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.heaven_hold)
		self.heaven_hold = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:start_scene()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	music_player_util.stop_bgm_manager()

	self:lilith_office_scene()
	self:neo_field_office_scene()
	self:heaven_hold_scene()
	self:haven_hold_in_scene()

	music_player_util.start_bgm_manager()
end

function local_class:lilith_office_scene()
	-- 로딩바 지우기
	camera_util.move_async(self.markers.camera_pos(1), 0)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--lilith 프리팹 출력
	self.office_scene = nil
	local bundle_path = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/theatres/lilith'
	local prefab_name = 'lilith'

	self.office_scene = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder, bundle_path, prefab_name)
	--좌표 x -300 / z -300
	self.office_scene.transform.localPosition = self.markers.office_pos()
	--스케일 x 1.3 / y 1.3 / z 1.3
	self.office_scene.transform.localScale = vector(1.3, 1.3, 1.3)
	self.office_scene.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	--창틀(lilith_window_frame)은 제거 상태
	self.office_scene.transform:Find('lilith_window_frame').gameObject:SetActive(false)

	-- 이미지 로더용
	local asset_bundle_path = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/theatres/lilith'
	local asset_bundle
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.AssetBundleManager.Instance.LoadAssetBundleAsync,
			CS.Foundations.AssetBundleManager.Instance, asset_bundle_path, function(res)
				asset_bundle = res
			end)

	-- 리리스 사무실 세팅
	local image_infos = {
		city_skyline = {
			target_name = 'lilith_city/skyline',
			asset_name = 'lilith_city_skyline.png',
			layer_name = 'Under Effects',
			order = 3
		},
		city_bottom = {
			target_name = 'lilith_city/bottom',
			asset_name = 'lilith_city_bottom.jpg',
			layer_name = 'Under Effects',
			order = 3
		},
		orb = {
			target_name = 'lilith_orb/orb_01',
			asset_name = 'lilith_orb_01.png',
			layer_name = 'Under Effects',
			order = 2
		},
		floor_1 = {
			target_name = 'lilith_floor/lilith_floor_01',
			asset_name = 'lilith_floor.jpg',
			layer_name = 'Top Effects',
			order = 4
		},
		floor_2 = {
			target_name = 'lilith_floor/lilith_floor_02',
			asset_name = 'lilith_floor.jpg',
			layer_name = 'Top Effects',
			order = 4
		}
	}

	for key, info in pairs(image_infos) do
		local target_obj = self.office_scene.transform:Find(info.target_name).gameObject
		yield_return_func(asset_bundle.LoadAssetAsync, asset_bundle, info.asset_name, function(texture_bytes)
			if texture_bytes then
				local texture = CS.UnityEngine.Texture2D(2, 2, CS.UnityEngine.TextureFormat.RGBA32, false)
				texture.wrapMode = CS.UnityEngine.TextureWrapMode.Mirror
				if CS.UnityEngine.ImageConversion.LoadImage(texture, texture_bytes.bytes, true) then
					local rect = CS.UnityEngine.Rect(0, 0, texture.width, texture.height)
					-- 텍스쳐를 스프라이트로 생성
					local sprite = CS.UnityEngine.Sprite.Create(texture,
							rect,
							vector(0.5, 0.5),
							100,
							0,
							CS.UnityEngine.SpriteMeshType.Tight,
							unity_class.vector4.zero,
							false)

					-- 새 오브젝트를 만들어서 SpriteRenderer를 붙여줌
					local sprite_renderer = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(target_obj,
							typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))

					if sprite_renderer then
						sprite_renderer.sprite = sprite
						if info.layer_name ~= nil then
							sprite_renderer.sortingLayerName = info.layer_name
						end

						if info.order ~= nil then
							sprite_renderer.sortingOrder = info.order
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	-- 프리팹 내 이미지들 소팅레이어 정렬
	local sorting_info = {
		chair = {
			target_name = 'lilith_chair',
			layer_name = 'Top Effects',
			order = 5
		},
		desk_1 = {
			target_name = 'lilith_desk/lilith_desk_01',
			layer_name = 'Top Effects',
			order = 8
		},
		desk_2 = {
			target_name = 'lilith_desk/lilith_desk_02',
			layer_name = 'Top Effects',
			order = 8
		},
		sky = {
			target_name = 'lilith_sky',
			layer_name = 'Under Effects',
			order = 1
		},
		cloud_1 = {
			target_name = 'lilith_cloud/left',
			layer_name = 'Under Effects',
			order = 2
		},
		cloud_2 = {
			target_name = 'lilith_cloud/right',
			layer_name = 'Under Effects',
			order = 2
		},
		orb_2 = {
			target_name = 'lilith_orb/orb_02',
			layer_name = 'Under Effects',
			order = 3
		},
		orb_3 = {
			target_name = 'lilith_orb/orb_03',
			layer_name = 'Under Effects',
			order = 2
		},
		sun = {
			target_name = 'lilith_sun',
			layer_name = 'Under Effects',
			order = 2
		},
		castle = {
			target_name = 'lilith_castle/castle',
			layer_name = 'Default',
			order = 4,
		},
	}

	for key, info in pairs(sorting_info) do
		local target = self.office_scene.transform:Find(info.target_name):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))
		target.sortingLayerName = info.layer_name
		target.sortingOrder = info.order
	end

	local back_grounds = {}

	table.insert(back_grounds, self.office_scene.transform:Find('lilith_sky').transform)
	table.insert(back_grounds, self.office_scene.transform:Find('lilith_cloud').transform)
	table.insert(back_grounds, self.office_scene.transform:Find('lilith_sun').transform)
	table.insert(back_grounds, self.office_scene.transform:Find('lilith_orb').transform)
	table.insert(back_grounds, self.office_scene.transform:Find('lilith_star').transform)

	local bg_end_pos = {
		vector(0, 17.52 - 2, 2.3),
		vector(0, 13.81 - 2, 1.5),
		vector(-1.05, 14.81 - 2, 1.5),
		vector(0, 16.81 - 2, 1.5),
		vector(0, 14.31 - 2, 1.5),
	}

	for i = 1, #back_grounds do
		back_grounds[i].localPosition = bg_end_pos[i]
	end

	--카메라 세팅
	--위치 x -300 / z - 281
	camera_util.move_async(self.markers.camera_pos(1), 0)
	--줌 -2.8
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2.8, 0)

	--동시 연출
	--fx_cp12_lilith_city_portal_open_slow 출력
	local portal_fx = self.office_scene.transform:Find('fx_cp12_lilith_city_portal_open_slow').transform
	portal_fx.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	portal_fx.transform.localPosition = vector(-2, 0, 2.2)

	--lilith_castle의 castle, fx_cp12_lilith_city_castle_firesmoke 투명도 1초에 걸쳐 0에서 1로 전환
	local castle_base = self.office_scene.transform:Find('lilith_castle').transform
	local castle = castle_base:Find('castle').transform
	local castle_sprite = castle:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))
	castle_sprite.color = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 0 })

	local castle_smoke_fx = self.office_scene.transform:Find('lilith_castle/fx_cp12_lilith_city_castle_firesmoke').transform
	castle_smoke_fx.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	--검은색 화면 출력한 상태로 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--12챕터와 동일하게 15초에 걸쳐 이동
	local sprite_alpha_fade = function(fo, target_alpha, duration)
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_color = fo.color
		local end_color = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, target_alpha })

		while time_passed < duration and not self.scene_exit_check do
			fo.color = unity_class.color.Lerp(start_color, end_color, time_passed / duration)
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	local sprite_move = function(fo, move_vec, duration)
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = fo.transform.localPosition
		local end_pos = start_pos + move_vec

		while time_passed < duration and not self.scene_exit_check do
			fo.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, time_passed / duration)
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	start_coroutine(sprite_alpha_fade, castle_sprite, 1, 1)
	start_coroutine(sprite_move, castle_base, vector(-2, 0, 1.5), 15)
	castle_smoke_fx.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	--위 연출 시작하고 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--화면 shake 0.05세기로 2초간 출력
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 2)

	--검은 화면에서 3초에 걸쳐 fade in
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_qc_13')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(3, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(3)

	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_communication_error_01', loop = true, volume = 0.6, fade_in_time = 3 })
	--shake 0.1세기로 0.5초 출력
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
	--아래 이펙트는 0.8초에 걸쳐 서서히 출력
	--화면에 fx_nightmare_lt_crt_filter 이펙트 생성
	local crt_filter_screen = self.fx.crt_filter():Instantiate(
			stage_camera.transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.Transform)
	--화면에 fx_cw_glitch_effect_screen 이펙트 생성
	local glitch_effect_screen = self.fx.glitch_effect_screen():Instantiate(stage_camera.Transform.position,
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.Transform)
	--화면 틴트 처리. RGB(0, 180, 0)
	local field_tint_in_duration = 0.8
	local field_tint_key = 'office_tint'
	field_util.tint(field_tint_key, unity_color({ 0, 0.7, 0, 1 }), field_tint_in_duration)
	--2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--론 (up, idle, idle) (0.7배): 돌아왔군요, 저 불길한 물건이.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.characters.neo_leader(), 'nm_qc_main_s1_1', true,
			{ viewport_pos = vector(0.65, 0.5), scale = 0.7 })

	--2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tv_off_02')
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(loop_sfx)
	--화면 0초에 걸쳐 fade out
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.scene_exit_check = true
	coroutine.yield()

	-- office 리소스 제거
	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.office_scene)
	self.office_scene = nil

	field_util.remove_tint(field_tint_key, 0)
	crt_filter_screen:Dispose()
	glitch_effect_screen:Dispose()
end

function local_class:neo_field_office_scene()
	local neo_leader = self.characters.neo_leader()
	local twins_android = self.characters.twins_android()
	local twins_android_b = self.characters.twins_android_b()
	local neo_leader_pos = self.markers.neo_leader_pos(1)

	-- neo npc 세팅
	--론 (up, idle)
	character_util.set_position(neo_leader, neo_leader_pos)
	--니프티 (up, idle, idle)
	character_util.set_position(twins_android, self.markers.twins_android_pos(1))
	--시프티 (up, idle, idle)
	character_util.set_position(twins_android_b, self.markers.twins_android_b_pos(1))
	character_util.set_group_direction({ neo_leader, twins_android, twins_android_b }, 'up')
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ neo_leader, twins_android, twins_android_b })

	--악몽 13-5에 등장한 사이버로보틱스 집무실 출력
	local bundle_path = 'ondemand/v2_65_queencastle/tilesets'
	local prefab_name = 'nightmare_qc_cyberrobotics_office'

	self.neo_fed_office = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder, bundle_path, prefab_name)

	--론 위치 1.4칸 위에 생성
	self.neo_fed_office.transform.position = neo_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.4)
	--localRotation (30, 0, 0)
	self.neo_fed_office.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(30, 0, 0)

	--카메라 론 포커스로 출력
	camera_util.move_async(vector_util.get_x0z(neo_leader_pos, 2), 0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

	--2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_amb_computer_01', loop = true, volume = 0.8, fade_in_time = 5 })
	--2초에 걸쳐 fade in
	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--fade in 완료되면 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--론 (up, idle, idle): 그분이 말씀하신 최후가… 임박했다는 거겠죠.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_02')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(neo_leader, 'nm_qc_main_s1_2')

	--론 (up, idle, idle) 상태로 (silence) 이모티콘 출력
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(neo_leader, nil, 'silence')

	--론 (up, idle, idle): 상태를 보니 뭔가 계획된 상태로 되찾아 온 것 같지는 않지만….
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(neo_leader, 'nm_qc_main_s1_3')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--론 (up, idle, jump 1회) 끝날 때까지 대기
	character_util.normal_jump(neo_leader, '01_jump_01')
	character_util.move_to_async(neo_leader, vector_util.get_x0z(neo_leader.Position), 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	--론 (left, idle, walk) 0.5초간 오른쪽 1.2칸 이동
	wp_util.move_async(neo_leader, neo_leader.Position + vector(1.2, 0, 0), nil, 0.5)

	--동시 연출
	wait_all_lua(
			{
				--카메라 2초간 y축 -1 이동
				camera_util.move_async, vector_util.get_x0z(neo_leader_pos, 1), 2
			},
			{
				--론 (down, idle, walk) 2초간 아래쪽으로 1.5칸 이동
				wp_util.move_async, neo_leader, neo_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), nil, 2
			}
	)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--론 (down, idle, idle): 저런 게 마왕 님의 손에 온전히 들어가면 매우, 매우 귀찮아질 거예요.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(neo_leader, 'nm_qc_main_s1_4')

	--론 (down, smile, bomb_idle): 무슨 말인지… 잘 알겠죠?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_leader, self, 'down',
			'bomb_idle',
			'smile',
			'nm_qc_main_s1_5')

	--대사 완료 후 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 z축만 -302.5 위치로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(neo_leader_pos + vector(0, 1, -2.5), 1)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--니프티 (up, idle): 네, 아버지. 걱정 마세요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android, 'nm_qc_main_s1_6')

	--시프티 (up, idle): 문제없이 수행하겠습니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android_b, 'nm_qc_main_s1_7')

			'nm_qc_main_s1_18')

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android_b, 'nm_qc_main_s1_19')

	--니프티 (left, idle, idle): 가능한 방법으로는 동력원의 차단, 제어 기능의 제한이 있습니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android, 'nm_qc_main_s1_22')

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle): 동의합니다. 일단 통제 시스템에 접근해 방법을 결정한 필요가 있겠군요.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android_b, 'nm_qc_main_s1_23')

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android, 'nm_qc_main_s1_24')

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android_b, 'nm_qc_main_s1_25')

	--시프티(right, sleep_deep, cross_arm): 오래전에 만든 구닥다리 데이터를 저희 시스템에 패치하는 게 찝찝하네요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			'cross_arm',
			'sleep_deep',
			'nm_qc_main_s1_26')

	--니프티(left, idle, bomb_idle) : 그들도 아버지의 설계를 기반으로 하니, 거부감을 가질 필요는 없습니다.

			'bomb_idle',

			'nm_qc_main_s1_27')

			nil, nil, 'silence')

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle): 추락 피해를 점검 하기 위해 움직이는 기체들이 있을 겁니다.

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			'idle',
			'idle',
			'nm_qc_main_s1_29')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--이후 컨트롤 해제
	self.controller:progress_section()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(loop_sfx, 4)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })
end

return local_class

	self.dynamic_npcs = setmetatable({
		npc_name_prefix = dynamic_android_name_pre_fix,

		npc_count = 4,

		data = {
			[dynamic_android_name_pre_fix .. 1] = 'nightmare_qc_android_meteor',
			[dynamic_android_name_pre_fix .. 2] = 'nightmare_qc_android_worker',
			[dynamic_android_name_pre_fix .. 3] = 'nightmare_qc_android_worker',
			[dynamic_android_name_pre_fix .. 4] = 'nightmare_qc_android_worker',
		},

		container = nil,
	}, {
		__index = {
			load_async = function(this)
				if this.container ~= nil then
					return
				end

				local spec_data = {}

				for npc_name, spec_name in pairs(this.data) do
					spec_data[npc_name] = spec_name
				end

				this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(spec_data)
			end,

			dispose = function(this)
				if this.container == nil then
					return
				end

				load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)

				this.container = nil
			end,

			get_android = function(this, index)
				return this.container[this.npc_name_prefix .. index]
			end,

			foreach_android = function(this, action)
				for i = 1, this.npc_count do
					action(this:get_android(i))
				end
			end
		}
	})

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		twins_android_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_twins_android_pos')
		end,
		twins_android_b_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_twins_android_b_pos')
		end,
		android_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_android_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		battle_android_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_battle_android_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		battle_android_dir = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_dir('s2_battle_android_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		android_after_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_android_after_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		android_after_dir = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_dir('s2_android_after_pos_' .. number)
		end
	}

	-- quest_marker
	self.quest_marker = {
		key = 'main_quest',
		add = function(this, data)
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.key, data)
		end,
		remove = function(this)
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(this.key)
		end
	}
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent), 'on_battle_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(self.setting_npc, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.quest_marker:remove()

	self.section_exit = true

	self.dynamic_npcs:foreach_android(function(npc)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)
		character_util.stop(npc)
	end)
	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_android_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.android_zone
		start_coroutine(self.android_move_routine, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state <= self.states.android_zone and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_battle_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.battle_zone
		sp_util.start_scene(self.battle_zone_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.battle_zone and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, get_party_leader()) and
			e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Assassinate | CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee then
		self.current_state = self.states.battle_start
		self:battle_start()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_start_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.battle_zone and e ~= nil and e.StartedBattle ~= nil then
		self.current_state = self.states.battle_start
		self:battle_start()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.battle_start then
		for i = 1, self.battle_npc_count do
			local android = self.characters.battle_android(i)

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.fo, android) then
				android.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions()
				character_util.set_side_direction(android)
				scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'prostrate')

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.battle_start and e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.battle_end_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

function local_class:setting_npc()
	for i = 1, self.battle_npc_count do
		local npc = self.characters.battle_android(i)

		character_util.set_position(npc, self.markers.battle_android_pos(i))
		character_util.set_direction(npc, self.markers.battle_android_dir(i))
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, i > 1 and { name = 'carpenter_hammer', sfx_name = function()
			if i < self.battle_npc_count then
				return
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_mining_01', parent = npc, volume = 0.5 })
		end } or 'idle')
	end

	self.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'main_field',
			target = self.characters.battle_android(1)
		},
	})

	self.dynamic_npcs:load_async()

	self.dynamic_npc_loaded = true
end

--빨간 존에 진입하면 비강제 연출 진행
function local_class:android_move_routine()
	while not self.dynamic_npc_loaded and not self.section_exit do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.section_exit then
		return
	end

	--각 NPC a, b, c, 위치로 직선 이동
	--(idle, run)
	--6의 속도
	local androids = { self.dynamic_npcs:get_android(1),
					   self.dynamic_npcs:get_android(2),
					   self.dynamic_npcs:get_android(3),
					   self.dynamic_npcs:get_android(4)
	}
	local start_pos = self.markers.android_pos(1)
	local corner_pos = self.markers.android_pos(2)
	local end_pos = self.markers.android_pos(4)

	for i = 1, #androids do
		local android = androids[i]

		character_util.set_position(android, start_pos + vector(0, 0, 1 - i))
		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'run')

		local wp = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(android, end_pos, { z = start_pos.z + (corner_pos.z - start_pos.z) })

		wp_util.move(android, wp, 6, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })
	end

	local wait_duration = 1.5
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < wait_duration and not self.section_exit do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--노란색 네모 위치 진입 시 이동하면서 대사 출력
	--1번 NPC (right, idle, run)[대사 한번에 출력]: 조금만 더 서두르겠습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_worker_04', parent = androids[1] })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_05', parent = androids[1] })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(androids[1], { key = 'nm_qc_main_s2_0', type_speed = 0 })
end

function local_class:battle_zone_event()
	local twins_android = self.characters.twins_android()
	local twins_android_b = self.characters.twins_android_b()
	local battle_androids = {}
	for i = 1, self.battle_npc_count do
		table.insert(battle_androids, self.characters.battle_android(i))
	end

	self.quest_marker:remove()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
	--빨간 네모 위치 니프티, 시프티 진입 시 정렬
	--3의 속도
	do
		local wp_key = 'twins_wp'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android, self.markers.twins_android_pos(),
				3, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android_b, self.markers.twins_android_b_pos(),
				3, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 1번 NPC 위치로 포커스 이동
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(battle_androids[1], 1)

	--1번 NPC (right, idle, release 3회 이후 idle): 할 일이 많습니다. 서둘러야 해요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battle_androids[1], self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 3 },
	'idle',
	'nm_qc_main_s2_1')

	--2번 NPC (right, idle, carpenter_hammer): 대체 언제 쉴 수 있는 거죠?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(battle_androids[2], 'nm_qc_main_s2_2')

	--1번 NPC (right, idle, carpenter_hammer): 여기 끝나면 휴게실 통로도 작업해야 합니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(battle_androids[1], 'nm_qc_main_s2_3')

	--3번 NPC (left, idle, idle): 휴게실이요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battle_androids[3], self, 'left',
			'idle',
			'idle',
			'nm_qc_main_s2_4')

	--0.5초 뒤 3번 NPC (right, idle, carpenter_hammer) 출력
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(battle_androids[3], 'right')
	--2 ~ 5번 NPC 현재 애니메이션에서 타임 스케일 2로 조정
	for i = 2, self.battle_npc_count do
		character_util.remove_anim(battle_androids[i])
		scene_util.set_anim(battle_androids[i], self, { name = 'carpenter_hammer', scale = 2, sfx_name = function()
			if i < self.battle_npc_count then
				return
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_mining_01', parent = battle_androids[1], volume = 0.5 })
		end })
	end
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--카메라 니프티 포커스로 1초에 걸쳐 이동
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle): 전방에 헤븐홀드 안드로이드 발견.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android, 'nm_qc_main_s2_5')

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle): 제압해서 데이터를 확인해 보죠.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android_b, 'nm_qc_main_s2_6')

	--이후 컨트롤 해제
	--전투 진행
	--안드로이드 암살 가능하며 암살 시 전투 진행
	--NPC 사이트에 들어가면 전투 시작
	for i = 1, self.battle_npc_count do
		character_util.convert_to_monster(battle_androids[i], self.battle_group_name, 's2_battle_zone')
		character_util.set_death_type(battle_androids[i], 'etherealprostrate')
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:battle_start()
	local stage_event_controller = get_stage_event_controller('NightmareQueenCastle1Controller')
	stage_event_controller.script.is_pause_remove_weapon = true

	for i = 1, self.battle_npc_count do
		local npc = self.characters.battle_android(i)

		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
		command_util.publish_monster_notice(npc, get_party_leader(), 'battle')
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.characters.battle_android(1),
			{ key = 'nm_qc_main_s2_6_1', type_speed = 0 })

	for i = 1, self.battle_gate_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('s2_battle_gate_' .. i))
	end
end

function local_class:battle_end_event()
	local stage_event_controller = get_stage_event_controller('NightmareQueenCastle1Controller')

	local twins_android = self.characters.twins_android()
	local twins_android_b = self.characters.twins_android_b()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
	-- 전투 끝나면 0.5초에 걸쳐 fade out
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1.25)

	--TODO: 안전장치로 연계기 모드 풀어봄
	time_util.unmod(CS.Oak.ISupportBattleActionExtensions.DeclareKey)

	stage_event_controller.script.is_battle = false
	stage_event_controller.script.is_pause_remove_weapon = false
	stage_event_controller.script:remove_equipment(get_party_leader())

	-- battle gate open
	for i = 1, self.battle_gate_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('s2_battle_gate_' .. i, false))
	end

	-- NPC 배치
	for i = 1, self.battle_npc_count do
		local npc = self.characters.battle_android(i)

		character_util.convert_to_npc(npc)
		coroutine.yield()

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_position(npc, self.markers.android_after_pos(i))
		character_util.set_direction(npc, self.markers.android_after_dir(i))
		character_util.add_color(npc, npc.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.7, 0)
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false })
		npc.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	character_util.set_position(twins_android, self.markers.android_after_pos(1) + vector(-2, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(twins_android_b, self.markers.android_after_pos(1) + vector(-1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_group_direction({ twins_android, twins_android_b }, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim(twins_android_b, self, 'eat')
	field_object_util.set_active_state(twins_android_b, active_state_type.enabled)
	-- 0.25초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 0.5초에 걸쳐 fade in
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--fade in 되고 1.5초간 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--시프티 (right, idle, eat): 내부 지도 데이터 발견, 패치 진행하겠습니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android_b, 'nm_qc_main_s2_7')

	--시프티, 니프티 shake (0.03 1.5초)
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)
	character_util.remove_anim(twins_android_b)
	scene_util.shake(twins_android, 0.03, 1.5, false)
	scene_util.shake(twins_android_b, 0.03, 1.5, '01_beep_02')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle): 지도 데이터 패치 완료.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_beep_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android, 'nm_qc_main_s2_8')

	--니프티 (right, idle, vr) shake (0.03, 1초간 출력)
	scene_util.set_emotion(twins_android, self, 'vr')
	scene_util.shake(twins_android, 0.03, 1, '01_button_select_item_01')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--0.4초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	--니프티 (right, idle, vr): 현재 위치에서 가장 가까운 제어 콘솔 확인.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	character_util.set_direction(twins_android_b, 'left')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android, 'nm_qc_main_s2_9')

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle): 데이터 센터를 목적지로 등록하겠습니다.
	character_util.remove_emotion(twins_android)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android, 'nm_qc_main_s2_9_1')

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle): 좋습니다. 바로 이동하면 되겠습니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android_b, 'nm_qc_main_s2_10')

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle): 그런데 시프티, 최근에 부품 교체가 있었습니까?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android, 'nm_qc_main_s2_10_1')

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle): 왜 그러시죠…?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android_b, 'nm_qc_main_s2_10_2')

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle): 그립감이 조금 달라진 것 같은데….
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android, 'nm_qc_main_s2_10_3')

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle): 제 몸무게 늘었다는 말입니까?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android_b, 'nm_qc_main_s2_10_4')

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle): 그런건 아니고 예전과 달리 조준하는 느낌이 달라진 것 같습니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android, 'nm_qc_main_s2_10_5')

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle): 부품 교체는 없었습니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android_b, 'nm_qc_main_s2_10_6')

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle): 니프티의 조준 시스템이 구식이라 그런 것 같군요.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android_b, 'nm_qc_main_s2_10_7')

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle): 구식이라뇨. 제 시스템은 최첨단으로….
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android, 'nm_qc_main_s2_10_8')

	--화면 shake 0.03 세기로 지속 1.5초간 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.03, 1.5)
	--니프티, 시프티 현재 상태에서 (question) 이모티콘 출력
	character_util.show_group_emoticion_async({ twins_android, twins_android_b }, nil, 'question')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle): 미세한 진동이 감지됩니다.
	character_util.remove_emotion(twins_android)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android, 'nm_qc_main_s2_11')

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle): 이 정도의 세기는 생활 진동에 가깝습니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android_b, 'nm_qc_main_s2_12')

	--니프티 (right, tired, idle) 지속 출력
	scene_util.set_emotion(twins_android, self, 'tired')
	--시프티 (left, idle, idle): 임무에 영향을 줄 정도의 변수는 아니라고 판단됩니다. 속행하죠.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(twins_android_b, 'nm_qc_main_s2_13')

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state == self.states.fake_knight_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_fake_knight_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.data_center_event

		sp_util.start_scene(self.fake_knight_event, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.data_center_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_data_center_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.data_center_interact_event

		sp_util.start_scene(self.data_center_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

	local computer = self.get_computer()

	if self.current_state == self.states.data_center_interact_event  then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, computer) then
			self.current_state = self.states.done

		end

local local_class = newclass('NightmareQueenCastleMainSection4')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareQueenCastleMain @

		Index = 3 @

]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type NightmareQueenCastleMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'nightmare_queencastle_1'

	 --섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_enter_control_room = 2,

		before_assistance = 4,
		in_exit_lobby_first_time = 5,
		in_assistance = 6,
		done = 99
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	self.character = {
		twins_android = function()
			return get_character('twins_android')
		end,
		twins_android_b = function()
			return get_character('twins_android_b')
		end,
		neo_leader_hologram = function()
			return get_character('neo_leader_hologram')
		end,
		assistance = function()
			return get_character('assistance')
		end
	}

	self.fo = {
		exit_control_room = function()
			return get_field_object('exit_control_room_outside')
		end,
		console = function()
			return get_field_object('main_s4_console')
		end,
		exit_lobby = function()
			return get_field_object('exit_lobby')
		end
	}

	self.marker = {
		assistance_pivot = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s4_assistance_pivot')
		end
	}

	self.quest_marker = {
		key = 'main_quest',
		add = function(this, data)
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.key, data)
		end,
		remove = function(this)
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(this.key)
		end
	}

	self.fx = {
		scan = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_qc_wall_mural_scan')
		end
	}

	self.res_holder = nil
	self.exit_interactable_cached = nil

	self.used_exit_lobby_key = 's4_used_exit_lobby'
	self.used_exit_lobby_val = 1
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor(self.fx):create_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'control_room',
			target = self.fo.console()
		},
		{
			zone = 'main_field',
			target = get_field_object('exit_control_room_outside')
		}
	})

	local used_exit_lobby_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress,
			self.used_exit_lobby_key)

	do
		if used_exit_lobby_state ~= self.used_exit_lobby_val then
			--재입장이 아닌 경우
			--컨트롤룸 들어오는 exit 선택시 이벤트 발동하도록
			local exit_control_room = self.fo.exit_control_room()
			self.exit_interactable_cached = exit_control_room.Interactable
			exit_control_room.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

			--로비로 나가는 exit 선택시 이벤트 발동하도록
			local exit_lobby = self.fo.exit_lobby()
			exit_lobby.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

			--처음부터 시작
			self.current_state = self.states.before_enter_control_room
		else
			--재입장인 경우
			--컨트롤 룸에서 로비로 나간 경우에는 다시 시작 시 컨트롤 룸 들어오는 연출 스킵하도록
			self.current_state = self.states.before_assistance
		end

		--공통적으로 콘솔 선택 시 이벤트 발동하도록
		local console_fo = self.fo.console()
		console_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	do
		local assistance = self.character.assistance()
		local neo_leader = self.character.neo_leader_hologram()

		--neo_leader는 나중에 tint 해제도 해줘야 하고,
		--현재 characterplacecontroller에서 소환 시 disabled 상태로 만들 수 없어 소환까지 여기서 관리
		neo_leader.Position = self.marker.assistance_pivot() + unity_class.vector3.right * 2
		neo_leader.Direction = direction_constants.left
		field_object_util.set_active_state(neo_leader, active_state_type.disabled)

		character_util.add_color(assistance, assistance.Name, unity_class.color.black,
				0.5, 0)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(assistance, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_position(assistance, self.marker.assistance_pivot() + unity_class.vector3.right * 4)

		character_util.set_direction(assistance, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(assistance, self, 'empty')
		scene_util.set_anim(assistance, self, 'prostrate')
		character_util.set_sorting_layer(assistance, 'Default', -1)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.quest_marker:remove()

	self.current_state = self.states.done
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil

	if self.worldmap_controller ~= nil then
		self.worldmap_controller = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_enter_control_room and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.fo.exit_control_room()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_enter_control_room

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self:enter_control_room_scene()

			local exit = self.fo.exit_control_room()
			exit.Interactable = self.exit_interactable_cached

			self.current_state = self.states.before_assistance
		end)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.before_assistance and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.fo.console()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_assistance

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()

			self:assistance_scene()

			self.controller:progress_section()

			self.worldmap_controller:new_open_stage()

			CS.Oak.TeleportPartyStageLogic.Execute('exit_lobby', stage.Name, nil, false)

			sp_util.exit_scene({
				show_ui = false,
				reset_party = false,
				vincible = false,
				show_weapon = false
			}, self.character.twins_android())
		end)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.before_assistance and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.fo.exit_lobby()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_exit_lobby_first_time

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()

			--나가기 상태 저장 후 나가야 함
			quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress,
					self.used_exit_lobby_key, self.used_exit_lobby_val)

			CS.Oak.TeleportPartyStageLogic.Execute('exit_lobby', stage.Name, nil, false)

			sp_util.exit_scene({
				show_ui = false,
				reset_party = false,
				vincible = false,
				show_weapon = false
			}, self.character.twins_android())
		end)

	end

	return false
end

function local_class:enter_control_room_scene()
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android()
	local twins_android_b = self.character.twins_android_b()

	local pivot_1 = field_util.get_marker_pos('exit_control_room_inside')
	local pivot_2 = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s4_enter_control_room_1')
	local pivot_3 = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s4_enter_control_room_2')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 4 })

	local ambient= music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_amb_ship_02',
		fade_in_time = 5,
		volume = 0.6,
		loop = true
	})

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.7, 'linear')

	--이동
	do
		--존 엔터 시 bgm이 바뀌기 때문에 이벤트가 끝나고 나서 존 엔터 이벤트를 발생시킨다

		character_util.set_position(twins_android_b, pivot_1 + unity_class.vector3.left)

		character_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(twins_android_b, 'right')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--중앙 제어실 진입 연출

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5.2, 0)

	--니프티 시프티 (right, idle, walk) 4초에 걸쳐 빨간색 화살표 방향대로 이동하여 회색 위치에 정렬
	--카메라는 니프티, 시프티 따라서 이동
	--목적지에 도착하면 니프티, 시프티 (right, idle, idle) 출력

			[twins_android] = pivot_2 + unity_class.vector3.right,

		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle): 잠깐.

	--0.5초 대기

	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'up', true)

	--1초 대기

	--니프티 (up, idle, idle): 상징적인 이미지의 나열을 확인.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s4_1_1')

	--니프티 (up, idle, idle): 헤븐홀드 건설에 참여했던 용사 케이든 님의 기록으로 추정됩니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s4_2')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--니프티 (left, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'left', false)

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle): 임무와 무관합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s4_3')

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle): 현재 우리는 잠입 상태입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',

	--시프티 (right, idle, bomb_idle): 목표와 위협 요소의 예측에 집중해 주세요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',

	--니프티 (left, tired, idle) 상태로 1초간 출력

			[twins_android_b] = pivot_3 + unity_class.vector3.left

		for fo, wp in pairs(wps) do
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fo, wp, 2,

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--도착하면 연출 진행

	--니프티 (up, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'up', false)

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle) 상태로 (question) 이모티콘 출력
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'question')

	--동시 연출
	do
		--시프티 (right, tired, idle)
		scene_util.set_emotion(twins_android_b, self, 'tired')

		--니프티 (right, left, idle): 이건 확인해야겠습니다.

	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android_b, 'up', false)

	--니프티 위로 1.5타일 이동

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'up',

end

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s4_11')

	--니프티 (left, tired, idle): 케이든 님이 직접 하신 기록은… 의미가 다릅니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'nm_qc_main_s4_12')

	--니프티 (left, tired, idle): 해당 기록만 스캔하겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'nm_qc_main_s4_12_1')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--니프티 (up, idle, idle) 상태에서 fx_qc_wall_mural_scan 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bunker_ui_03')
	self.fx.scan():Instantiate(twins_android.Position + vector(-1, 0, 2))
	wait_for_sec(3.2)

	--카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 4크기로 줌 인
	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0.5)

	--니프티 (left, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'left', false)

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle):이해 불가. 내용이 동일하면, 의미도 동일합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s4_13')

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle): 임무에만 집중했으면 좋겠군요, 니프티
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s4_13_1')

	--이후 컨트롤 해제
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(ambient, 3)

	--이 시점에 존 엔터 이벤트 발생
	field_object_util.set_active_state(twins_android, active_state_type.enabled)

function local_class:assistance_scene()
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android()
	local twins_android_b = self.character.twins_android_b()
	local neo_leader = self.character.neo_leader_hologram()
	local assistance = self.character.assistance()
	local console = self.fo.console()

	local pivot = self.marker.assistance_pivot()

	coroutine.yield()

	--케이든 조수 안드로이드 연출
	--NPC 배치
	--조수 안드로이드
	--(left, empty prostrate)
	--검은 틴트 50% 상태


	-- 인터렉트 시 위와 같이 정렬
	--2의 속도
	--(진행방향, idle, walk)

	--니프티 (up, idle, idle)
	--시프티 (up, idle, idle)

	do
		local wps = {
			[twins_android] = pivot + unity_class.vector3.right * 1.5,
			[twins_android_b] = pivot
		}

		for fo, wp in pairs(wps) do
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fo, wp, 2,
					nil, self, nil,
					{ last_direction = 'up' })
		end

		camera_util.move_async(pivot, 0.5)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

		camera_util.set_target(twins_android_b)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--니프티 (left, idle, idle) 출력

			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s4_13_2')

	--1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sfx)

	character_util.remove_anim(twins_android_b)

	twins_android_b.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

	--시프티 0.5칸 뒤로 1의 속도로 이동 후 (up, idle, idle) 출력
	wp_util.move_async(twins_android_b, twins_android_b.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5, 1,
			nil, { locked_dir = 'up' })

	--[gimmick]main_computer, open 애니메이션 출력

	--1초 대기

			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s4_14')

	--시프티 (up, idle, handgun_reload): 보안 시스템 구조 확인 중. 해제에 시간이 소요됩니다.
