	--니프티 (left, idle, cross_arm) 상태로 (silence) 이모티콘 출려

			nil, nil, 'silence')

	--니프티 (up, idle) 출력

	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'up', true)

	--1초 대기

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle) 출력

	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle) 상태에서 (notice) 이모티콘 출력

	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(twins_android, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'notice')

	--니프티 (right, idle, walk) 상태에서 2의 속도로 조수 안드로이드 왼쪽으로 0.5타일 이동
	wp_util.move_async(twins_android, assistance.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.5,
			2)

	scene_util.set_anim(twins_android, self, 'eat')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'up',

	--1초 대기

	--시프티 (up, idle, handgun_reload): 비상 동력의 차단이 선행되어야 접근이 가능할 것 같습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s4_19')

	--시프티 (up, idle, handgun_reload): 두 번째 목표인 동력원 차단을 위해 지하 원소 에너지 변전소의 위치를 검색합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'up',

	--니프티 (right, idle, run) 상태로 6의 속도로 조수 안드로이드 우측 0.5칸으로 이동하여 (left, idle, eat) 출력

	scene_util.set_anim(twins_android, self, 'eat')

		character_util.normal_jump(twins_android, '01_player_jump_01')

		--시프티 (right, idle, bomb_idle): 아버님께 보고 드리도록 하겠습니다.

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',

		key = neo_leader.Name,
		color = unity_color({ 0, 1, 1, 1 }),

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(neo_leader, 0, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		npc_count = 3,

		data = {
			[self.kaden_name] = 'nightmare_qc_kaden',
			[self.neo_leader_name] = 'nightmare_qc_neo_leader_past',
			[self.hero_ai_name] = 'nightmare_qc_hero_ai',
		},

		container = nil,
	}, {
		__index = {
			load_async = function(this)
				if this.container ~= nil then
					return
				end

				local spec_data = {}

				for npc_name, spec_name in pairs(this.data) do
					spec_data[npc_name] = spec_name
				end

				this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(spec_data)
			end,

			dispose = function(this)
				if this.container == nil then
					return
				end

				load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)

				this.container = nil
			end,

			get_npc = function(this, name)
				return this.container[name]
			end
		}
	})

	-- fx
	self.fx = setmetatable({
		crt_filter = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_nightmare_lt_crt_filter')
		end,
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})
end

function local_class:enter()
	if self.cs_controller.StartingInnerProgress == 4 then
		self:npc_setting()
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 해당 섹션에서 시작했을 때 npc 세팅
	if self.cs_controller.StartingInnerProgress == 4 then
		if not self.is_clear_quest then
			start_coroutine(self.stage_start_event, self, get_party_leader())
		else
			sp_util.start_scene(self.clear_scene, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

	return false
end

function local_class:npc_setting()
	local assistance = self.characters.assistance()
	local is_clear_quest, clear_count = get_stage_event_controller('NightmareQueenCastleObeliskController'):check_clear()
	self.is_clear_quest = is_clear_quest

	--NPC 배치
	field_object_util.set_active_state(assistance, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.set_position(assistance, self.markers.assistance_pos(1))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(assistance)

	if not is_clear_quest then
		character_util.set_direction(assistance, 'left')
		assistance.Interactable.Talk = 'nm_qc_main_s5_' .. (1 + clear_count)
	end

	--제어 콘솔 오브젝트는 open 애니메이션 상태로 유지
	local console = get_field_object('main_s4_console')
	local animator = console.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	animator:Play('open')
	animator.speed = 100
end

function local_class:stage_start_event(leader)
	local pos = leader.Position
	local direction = leader.Direction

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

	local walk_speed = 1
	local walk_duration = 0.5
	local start_position = pos - direction_util.to_vector3(direction) * (walk_duration * walk_speed)
	local cur_align_member_count = 0

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		local is_not_align = is_not_align_disable_member and member.ActiveState == active_state_type.disabled

		if not is_not_align then
			character_util.set_direction(member, direction)
			member.Position = start_position - direction_util.to_vector3(direction) *
					(CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * cur_align_member_count)

			local waypoints = {}
			table.insert(waypoints, pos - direction_util.to_vector3(direction) *
					(CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * cur_align_member_count))

			character_util.move_waypoint(member, waypoints, walk_speed, false, 'stop', 'floor', direction)
			cur_align_member_count = cur_align_member_count + 1
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 스테이지 인트로, BGM 재생
	music_player:PlayStageIntroMusic()

	--타이틀 발현에, BGM 재생, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_65_queencastle/audio:bgm_queencastle_hub',
										 state = 'field',  volume = 1, mix = 1 })

	-- 이름 출력
	screen_util.show_stage_title()

	-- 스테이지 인트로 시, 캐릭터 점프할 때 SFX 재생
	scene_util.show_weapon(leader)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	user_party:ResetControllers()

	-- 컨트롤 시작 이벤트
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
end

function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(self.progress_states, self, self.states.intro)
	--start_coroutine(self.progress_states, self, self.states.trial_of_courage_before)

	start_coroutine(self.load_background_fade_controller, self)

	if self.current_state == self.states.intro then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.intro_event, self)
	else
		screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')
		party_util.position_party(vector(0, 0, 0), 'left', 'linear')
		sp_util.start_scene(self.stage_entry, self)
	end

	self.entrance_magic_circle = self.fx.magic_circle():Instantiate(self.marker.entrance_magic_circle_pos(1))
	self.exit_magic_circle = self.fx.magic_circle():Instantiate(self.marker.exit_magic_circle_pos(1))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	self:dispose_all_dynamic_npc()

	self:dispose_typing_text()

	self:dispose_background_fade_controller()

	if self.push_block_sfx then
		self.push_block_sfx:Stop()
		self.push_block_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.entrance_magic_circle ~= nil then
		self.entrance_magic_circle:Dispose()
		self.entrance_magic_circle = nil
	end

	if self.exit_magic_circle ~= nil then
		self.exit_magic_circle:Dispose()
		self.exit_magic_circle = nil
	end

	if self.magnetic_effect ~= nil then
		self.magnetic_effect:Dispose()
		self.magnetic_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil

	self:dispose_amb_bunker_sfx()
	self:dispose_amb_ship_sfx()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.is_in_scene then
		return
	end

	local leader = self.npc.twins_android()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.zone_name.magnet_tutorial_zone) and
			self.current_state == self.states.magnet_tutorial_before then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.magnet_tutorial_event, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.zone_name.trial_of_courage_zone) and
			self.current_state == self.states.trial_of_courage_before then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.trial_of_courage_event, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.zone_name.entrance_magic_circle_zone) and
			self.current_state == self.states.entrance_magic_circle_before then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_entrance_magic_circle, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.zone_name.champion_memory_zone) and
			self.current_state == self.states.champion_memory_before then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.champion_memory_event, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.zone_name.kaden_memory_zone) and
			self.current_state == self.states.kaden_memory_before then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.kaden_memory_event, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.zone_name.exit_magic_circle_zone) and
			self.current_state == self.states.exit_magic_circle_before then
		start_coroutine(self.enter_exit_magic_circle, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:load_typing_text()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'ui/prologue', 'typing_text', function(prefab)
				self.typing_text_go = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				self.typing_text = self.typing_text_go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))

				self.typing_text.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 90, 1, 110)
				self.typing_text.Widget.topAnchor.relative = 0
				self.typing_text.Widget:UpdateAnchors()
				self.typing_text.Label.fontSize = 32
				self.typing_text.Label.color = unity_class.color.white
			end)
end

function local_class:dispose_typing_text()
	if not is_unity_null(self.typing_text_go) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.typing_text_go)
	end

	self.typing_text_go = nil

	self.typing_text = nil

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
	end

	self.res_holder = nil
end

function local_class:show_typing_text(key, wait, with_sfx)
	if wait then
		if with_sfx then
			start_coroutine(function()
				-- Progress = 0 실행까지 한프레임 대기
				coroutine.yield(nil)

				local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '03_dialogue_02', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
				})

				while self.typing_text.Progress < 1 do
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				sfx:Stop()
			end)
		end

		yield_return_func(self.typing_text.SetTypedText, self.typing_text,
				game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(key), 2000, 0.05)
	else
		start_coroutine_enumerator(self.typing_text:SetTypedText(
				game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(key), 2000, 0.05))
	end
end

function local_class:intro_event()
	local twins_android = self.npc.twins_android()
	local twins_android_b = self.npc.twins_android_b()

	--니프티 최종 위치 기준 (-7, 0, 0)
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.intro_pos()

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local amb_ship_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_amb_ship_03', loop = true, volume = 0.7, fade_in_time = 4 })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')


	--속도 4로 해당 위치 까지 정렬

	--(1)니프티 (left, idle, idle) (-7, 0, 0)
	--(2)시프티 (left, idle, idle) (-7, 0, -1)
	wp_util.move(twins_android, pivot_pos, 4)
	wp_util.move_async(twins_android_b, pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, -1), 4)

	--다음 동작 동시에

	--니프티(up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'up', false)
	--시프티(down, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android_b, 'down', false)

	--다음 동작 동시에

	--시프티(up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android_b, 'up', false)

	--니프티(down, idle, idle): 폐기된 안드로이드를 다량 보관하고 있는 곳 같습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s6_1')

	--시프티(up, idle, release 2회): 규격외에 작업이니 문제 사항 발생시 바로 이탈하도록 합시다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'up',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s6_2')

	--camera_util.return_to_leader(0.1)

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(amb_ship_sfx, 1)

	--컨트롤 해제
	self:stage_entry()
	self:progress_states(self.states.magnet_tutorial_before)
end

function local_class:stage_entry()
	local twins_android = get_party_leader()

	music_player:PlayStageIntroMusic()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	-- 사이드 디렉션이 아니라면
	local current_direction = twins_android.Direction
	if not direction_util.is_side(current_direction) then
		character_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'left')
	end

	-- SOUNDADDED: 스테이지 인트로 시, 캐릭터 점프할 때 SFX 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(twins_android, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(twins_android)
	character_util.set_direction(twins_android, current_direction)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:magnet_tutorial_event()
	local twins_android = self.npc.twins_android()
	local twins_android_b = self.npc.twins_android_b()

	self.is_in_scene = true

	--니프티 정렬 기준 (-23, 0, 0)
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.magnet_tutorial_pos()

	--빨간 존 진입시 강제 이벤트

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--속도 4로 정렬

	--(1) 니프티 (left, idle, idle) (-23, 0, 0)
	--(2) 시프티 (left, idle, idle) (-22, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move(twins_android, pivot_pos, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
	wp_util.move_async(twins_android_b, pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 0), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })

	--오브젝트 세팅

	--초록색 표기된 전자석 (power radios : 4)
	--파란색 표기된 테슬라 코어 : off 상태

	--다음 동작 동시에
	do
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

		--시프티, 니프티 (up, idle, idle) (jump 1회)
		scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'up', false)
		character_util.normal_jump(twins_android, '01_jump_01')

		scene_util.set_direction(twins_android_b, 'up', false)
		character_util.normal_jump(twins_android_b, false)

		--자막 출력
		--안드로이드의 이상 작동을 감지. 제압 장치를 자동합니다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ammi_02')
		self:show_typing_text('nm_qc_main_s6_3', true, true)
	end

	--다음 동작 동시에
	local magnet_end_pos = pivot_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 2)
	do

		--코어 테슬라 : on 으로 변경 전자석이 켜진다.
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create('s6_power_source_1'))

		--시프티 (left, attack, idle) (jump 1회)
		scene_util.set_direction(twins_android_b, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(twins_android_b, self, 'attack')
		character_util.normal_jump(twins_android_b)

		--니프티 (left, damaged,embarrassed) 상태로 (-24.5, 0, 2) 위치까지 끌려감
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_magnetic_01')
		self.magnetic_effect = self.fx.magnetic():Instantiate(twins_android.Position + vector(0, 0.375, 0),
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, twins_android.Transform)

		scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(twins_android, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(twins_android, self, 'embarrassed')

		--속도 값은 자석 끌어들이는 값과 동일하게 적용 부탁드립니다.)
		local fo = get_character('twins_android')
		local fo_center = fo.Bounds.center
		local magnet_center = magnet_end_pos

		local dur = 3
		local time_passed = 0

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(dur, function(progress)
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutExpo(time_passed, 0, 1, dur))
			local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(fo_center, magnet_center, progress)

			fo.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(pos)
		end)
	end

	--니프티 목표 위치 도착까지 대기

	--시프티 속도 4로 우측 2칸 이동
	--시프티 속도 4로 상단 1칸 이동
	character_util.remove_anim(twins_android_b)
	local twins_android_b_wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(twins_android_b,
			twins_android_b.Position + vector(2, 0, 1), true)
	wp_util.move_async(twins_android_b, twins_android_b_wp, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })

	--시프티가 pushable 블록을 위로 1칸 밀어 테슬라의 전력을 끊는다.
	local is_push_block = true
	start_coroutine(function()
		self:push_block_action(twins_android_b, 1, 1)
		is_push_block = false
	end)

	local magnetic_powered_on = self.object.magnetic().Electrocutable.IsPoweredOn

	--전력이 끊기거나, 블록을 다 밀때까지 대기
	while is_push_block and magnetic_powered_on do
		magnetic_powered_on = self.object.magnetic().Electrocutable.IsPoweredOn
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.magnetic_effect ~= nil then
		self.magnetic_effect:Dispose()
		self.magnetic_effect = nil
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_yuze_off_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

	--전자석이 꺼지면 0.5 초간 니프티 (right, damaged, prostrate) 상태로 (-24, 0, 2) 위치로 이동
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(twins_android, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(twins_android, self, 'prostrate')

	wp_util.move_async(twins_android, magnet_end_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 3)

	--블록을 다 안 밀었을 수도 있으니 대기.
	while is_push_block do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--시프티 0.5초간 좌측 3칸 이동 (run 애니메이션)
	local android_rush_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	wp_util.move_async(twins_android_b, twins_android_b.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0), nil, 0.5, { run = true })

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(android_rush_sfx)

	--니프티 (right, damaged, prostrate) (shake 0.03/ 0.5초)
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(twins_android, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(twins_android, self, 'prostrate')
	character_util.shake(twins_android, 0.03, 0.5)

	--니프티 (right, tired, seat) : 상상 이상의 자력입니다. 아무런 행동도 취할 수 없었습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'right',
			'seat', 'tired', 'nm_qc_main_s6_4')

	--다음 동작 동시에

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twins_android_b)

	--시프티 (left, idle, question) : 폐기된 안드로이드들을 손쉽게 옮기기 위한 장치같군요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'left',
			'question', 'idle', 'nm_qc_main_s6_5')


	--시프티(left, idle, release 2회): 조심하지 않으면 이 안드로이드들 사이에 파묻힐겁니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s6_6')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twins_android)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twins_android_b)

	--해당 이벤트 진행 이후 pushable 위치는 시프티가 옮겨 놓은 위치로 고정되어 재접속시 전자석이 꺼진 상태로 있음.

	--컨트롤 해제
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	self.is_in_scene = false

	self:progress_states(self.states.trial_of_courage_before)
end

function local_class:push_block_action(target, push_duration, count)
	local push_block = self.object.push_block()

	character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'push', upper = true })
	--character_util.shake(target, 0.02, 999)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(push_block.Position - target.Position))

	for _ = 1, count do
		local block_start_pos = push_block.Position
		local target_start_pos = target.Position
		local push_dist = 1 * dir

		local time_passed = 0

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'walk' })

		if not self.push_block_sfx then
			self.push_block_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
					{ sfx_name = '01_push_rock_unit_01', parent = target,
					  loop = false, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		end

		while time_passed < push_duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / push_duration)

			local cur_block_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(block_start_pos, block_start_pos + push_dist, progress)
			push_block.Position = cur_block_pos

			local cur_target_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(target_start_pos, target_start_pos + push_dist, progress)
			target.Position = cur_target_pos

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if self.push_block_sfx then
			self.push_block_sfx:Stop()
			self.push_block_sfx = nil
		end

		push_block.Position = block_start_pos + push_dist
		target.Position = target_start_pos + push_dist

		character_util.remove_anim(target)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target, true)
	character_util.stop_shake(target)
end

		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

	--region Fx
	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		magic_circle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_nm_qc_magic_circle_appear_idle')
		end,
		magic_circle_cancel = function()

	})

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	end

	do
		local statue_unbroken = self.get_fo.statue(1)
		local statue_broken = self.get_fo.statue(2)

		local save_statue_pos = statue_broken.Position

		statue_unbroken.Position = save_statue_pos

		statue_broken.Position = self.wait_pos
	end

	self.current_state = self.states.start_scene

	self:start_npc_setting()

	sp_util.start_scene(self.start_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.get_fo.altar(1).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	if self.typing_text_obj ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text_obj)
		self.typing_text_obj = nil
		self.typing_text = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state == self.states.start_scene and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.zone_name .. 1) then
		self.current_state = self.states.fake_knight_scene

		sp_util.start_scene(self.fake_knight_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.fake_knight_scene and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.zone_name .. 2) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.central_temple_roadblock, self)

		return true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.fake_knight_scene and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fo.altar(1)) then
		self.current_state = self.states.central_temple_interact_scene

		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

		start_coroutine(self.central_temple_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener
		local target_is_not_active = target_data.is_not_active
		local target_oneline_key = target_data.oneline_key
		local target_crash_behaviour = target_data.crash_behaviour

		if target_is_not_active then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		if target_crash_behaviour then
			target.CrashBehaviour = target_crash_behaviour
		end

		target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_oneline_key then
			target.Interactable.Talk = target_oneline_key
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, 0.03, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end
	end
end
--endregion Setting

			return field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s8_alter_pivot')
		end
	}

	}

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함

	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함

	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.in_boss

	sp_util.start_scene(function()
		self:boss_intro_scene()
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	update_util.remove_update(self, CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent, 'red_tint_update_routine')

	if self.siren_loop_sfx then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.siren_loop_sfx)
		self.siren_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	self.current_state = self.states.done
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.in_boss and
			e.BattleGroupName == self.boss_battle.group_name then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_after_boss

		if self.siren_loop_sfx then
			music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.siren_loop_sfx)
			self.siren_loop_sfx = nil
		end

		-- 전투 종료되면 틴트 제거
		update_util.remove_update(self, CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent, 'red_tint_update_routine')

		if self.tint_data.is_added then
			field:RemoveTint(self.tint_data.key, self.tint_data.duration)
		end

		start_coroutine(function()
			local twins_android = self.character.twins_android()
			local twins_android_b = self.character.twins_android_b()
			local boss_kaden_ai = self.character.boss_kaden_ai()

			sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

			--보안용 케이든 AI 처치 성공시 사망 모션 없이 페이드 아웃 0.8 초
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0.8, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			character_util.cancel_all_battle_actions(twins_android, true)
			character_util.cancel_all_battle_actions(twins_android_b, true)
			character_util.cancel_all_battle_actions(boss_kaden_ai, true)

			--TODO: 안전장치로 연계기 모드 풀어봄
			time_util.unmod(CS.Oak.ISupportBattleActionExtensions.DeclareKey)

			local stage_event_controller = get_stage_event_controller('NightmareQueenCastle6Controller')
			stage_event_controller.script.is_battle = false
			stage_event_controller.script.is_pause_remove_weapon = false
			stage_event_controller.script:remove_equipment(get_party_leader())
			field_object_util.set_active_state(twins_android_b, active_state_type.enabled)

			character_util.convert_to_npc(boss_kaden_ai)

			--다음 섹션으로 이동
			self.controller:progress_section()
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:red_tint_update_routine(dt)
	if self.tint_data.duration <= self.tint_data.time_passed then
		self.tint_data.time_passed = 0

		if self.tint_data.is_added then
			self.tint_data.is_added = false
			field:RemoveTint(self.tint_data.key, self.tint_data.duration)
		else
			self.tint_data.is_added = true
			field:Tint(self.tint_data.key, unity_color({ 1, 0.25, 0.25, 0.8 }), self.tint_data.duration)
		end
	end

	self.tint_data.time_passed = self.tint_data.time_passed + dt
end

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fake_knight, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_51')

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle) (silence) 이모티콘 버블
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(twins_android_b, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'silence')

	--짭기사 (right, attack, nod 2회): 할 수 있어! <b>그 녀석</b>에 대한 대책만 잘 세우면.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fake_knight, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'nm_qc_main_s8_52')

	--짭기사 (right, attack, bomb_idle): 예언의 힘 따위 빌리지 않고… 스스로 승리할 수 있다니까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fake_knight, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'attack', 'nm_qc_main_s8_53')

	--짭기사 (right, sleep_deep, idle): 그냥 얌전히 항복하고. 날 따라와.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fake_knight, self, 'right',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'nm_qc_main_s8_54')

	--짭기사 (right, idle, bomb_idle): 어차피 너희가 날 막을 수도 없겠지만, 시간은 아껴야지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fake_knight, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_55')

	--짭기사 (left, sleep_deep, idle): 그 외의 모든 것은 실패할 뿐이란 걸 명심해.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fake_knight, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = '01_walk_04' },
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'nm_qc_main_s8_56')


	--짭기사 퇴장
	--속도 4로 좌측 3칸 이동
	--속도 4로 하단 쭉 이동
	--그리드 밖에서 소멸
	do
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 11 })

		local wps = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(fake_knight,
				screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', fake_knight.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 3),
				true)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fake_knight, wps, 4,
				nil, self, nil,
				{
					end_callback = function()
						field_object_util.set_active_state(fake_knight, active_state_type.disabled)
					end
				})
	end

	--짭기사 출발 2 초 후
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--니프티, 시프티 속도4로 4.5칸 이동
	do
		local fos = {
			twins_android,
			twins_android_b
		}

		for i = 1, #fos do
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fos[i], fos[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 4.5, 4,
					nil, self, nil,
					{ last_direction = 'down' })
		end
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	--시프티 (slience) 이모티콘 버블
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(twins_android_b, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'silence')

	--시프티, 니프티 (down, idle, idle)
	--시프티 (down, idle, idle): 새로운 정보에 대해서, 의견이 있습니까?
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event',
										 name = 'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/audio:bgm_queenship_chamber', mix = 4 })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_57')

	--니프티 (down, sleep_deep): …현혹되어선 안됩니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'down',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'nm_qc_main_s8_58')

	--다음 동작 동시에
	--시프티 니프티 속도1로 3칸 이동 (walk 애니메이션)
	do
		local fos = {
			twins_android,
			twins_android_b
		}

		for i = 1, #fos do
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fos[i], fos[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 3, 1,
					nil, self, nil)
		end

		--시프티 (걸어가면서): 분석이 필요합니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, nil,
				nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_59')

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--다음 동작 동시에
	--니프티 (left, idle, eat) 1초 애니메이션 유지
	--시프티 (right, idle, eat) 1초 애니메이션 유지
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, volume = 0.5 })

	do
		scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(twins_android, self, 'eat')

		scene_util.set_direction(twins_android_b, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(twins_android_b, self, 'eat')

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	--시프티 (right, idle, eat): 제 판단에는, 케이든 님의 메모리 데이터보다 방금 얻은 정보가 훨씬 중요도가 높습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_60')

	--니프티 (left, sleep_deep, eat): 부정. 케이든 님은 최종 계획의 핵심 입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			nil,  'sleep_deep', 'nm_qc_main_s8_61')

	--시프티 (right, idle, eat): 그 자는 아버지를 믿지 못하는 자입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_62')

	--시프티 (right, sleep_deep, eat): 예언에 순응했기에 아직까지, 모습을 드러내지 않는 것일지도 모릅니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			nil,  'sleep_deep', 'nm_qc_main_s8_63')

	--니프티 (left, idle, eat): 당신은 아버지보다 가디언을 더 믿는다는 것인가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_64')

	--시프티 (right, idle, eat): … 부정.
	character_util.remove_emotion(twins_android_b)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_65')

	--시프티 (right, idle, eat): 다만 아버지의 계획을 실행하기에…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_66')

	--시프티 (right, idle, eat):  가디언의 제안을 받아들이는 것이 더 합리적이라는 판단입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_67')

	--니프티 (left, tired, eat): 동의하지 않습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'nm_qc_main_s8_68')

	--시프티 (right, idle, eat): 그러는 당신은 눈 앞의 가디언 보다 사라진 케이든 님을 더 신뢰하는 건가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_69')

	--니프티 (left, attack, eat): 가디언의 말은 논리적이지 않았고, 어떠한 증거도 없었습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'nm_qc_main_s8_70')

	--시프티 (right, idle, eat): 그가 가진 정확한 정보가 저에게는 증거로 판단되었습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_71')

	--니프티 (left, sleep_deep, eat): 부정. 현혹되어선 안됩니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			'eat', 'sleep_deep', 'nm_qc_main_s8_72')

	--다음 동작 동시에
	do
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sfx)

		--니프티 (left, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'left', false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twins_android)

		--시프티 (right, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(twins_android_b, 'right', false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twins_android_b)

		local item_info = {
			id = 21526,
			key = 'main_ic_blueprint_usb'
		}

		--K.A.I 위치에서 해당 스프라이트가 시프티, 니프티 중앙 (0, 0, 0)으로 떨어진 후 니프티가 습득
		--ic_blueprint_usb
		local drop = function(qte_item_info, start_pos, end_pos)
			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				item_id = qte_item_info.id,
				pos = start_pos,
				unique_id = qte_item_info.key,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				skip_text = true,
			})

			quest_drop_item_util.rotate(item, 1080, 0.75)

			quest_drop_item_util.move_async(item, end_pos, {
				duration = 0.75,
				y_move = function(progress)
					return math.sin(math.pi * progress) * 2.3
				end
			})

			return item
		end

		local consume_async = function(item, target)
			quest_drop_item_util.consumed(item, target)

			while item.ConsumeTarget do
				coroutine.yield()
			end
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')

		local item = drop(item_info, hero_ai.Position, (twins_android.Position + twins_android_b.Position) / 2)

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		consume_async(item, twins_android)

		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end

	--니프티, 시프티 (silence) 이모티콘 버블
	character_util.show_emoticon(twins_android_b, nil, 'silence')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'silence')

	--니프티 (left, idle, idle): 이 정도로 결론의 차이가 나다니….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_73')

	--시프티 (right, idle, release 2회): 결론이 합치되지 않는다면 보고도 따로 진행할 것을 제안 합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_74')

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle): 결과에 대한 판단은, 아버지 께서 내려주실 것 입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_75')

	--니프티 (left, idle, nod 2회): 동의 합니다. 지금은 귀환을 우선하겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_76')

	--니프티, 시프티 속도4 아래쪽으로 이동 시작
	do
		local fos = {
			twins_android,
			twins_android_b
		}

		for i = 1, #fos do
			wp_util.move(fos[i], fos[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 20, 4)
		end

		--1초 대기
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--알파 페이드 아웃 0.8초
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.8, unity_class.color.black)

		for i = 1, #fos do
			character_util.stop(fos[i])
		end
	end

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)
end

function local_class:neo_office_scene()
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android()
	local twins_android_b = self.character.twins_android_b()
	local neo_leader = self.dynamic_npcs:get('neo_leader')
	local door = self.dynamic_npcs:get('door')

	local twins = { twins_android, twins_android_b }

	local office_pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s8_office_pivot')
	local office_outside_pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s8_office_outside_pivot')

	--이벤트 시작 전 세팅
	do
		--캐릭터 이미지와 같이 세팅
		character_util.set_position(twins_android, office_pivot + unity_class.vector3.back * 4)
		character_util.set_position(neo_leader, office_pivot)

		--카메라 론 4.5칸 위 지점에서 대기
		camera_util.set_position(neo_leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 4.5, true)

		--니프티(up, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'up', false)

		--론(up, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(neo_leader, 'up', false)

		--의자 뒤에 배치되어 앉아있는 것 처럼 보여야 함
		--카메라 기본 크기
	end

	--맵
	do
		--사이버로보틱스 집무실
		local bundle_path = 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/tilesets/lilithtower'
		local prefab_name = 'Cyberrobotics_office'

		self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

		self.neo_fed_office = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder, bundle_path, prefab_name)

		--localRotation (30, 0, 0)
		self.neo_fed_office.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(30, 0, 0)

		--론 위치 1.4칸 위에 생성
		self.neo_fed_office.transform.position = neo_leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 1.4
	end

	--다음 동작 동시에 실행
	do
		--1초간 화면 페이드인
		screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black)

		--카메라 3초간 론 1.5칸 아래 지점으로 이동
		camera_util.move_async(neo_leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 1.5, 3)

		--끝날 때까지 대기
	end

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--론 집무실에 니프티와 론
	--론(up, idle, idle) : 정말로 장합니다. 안드로이드 카이의 메모리라니.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_leader, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_77')

	--론(up, idle, idle): 인간의 기억 정보는 해독이 대단히 힘든 편이지만… 정말 귀중한 것을 찾아왔어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_leader, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_78')

	--니프티(up, idle, nod 2회): 감사합니다, 아버지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'up',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_79')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--악몽 13챕터 5스테이지 연출과 동일하게 이동
	do
		character_util.normal_jump_async(neo_leader, '01_jump_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

		-- 론(left, idle, walk) 0.5초간 왼쪽으로 1.2칸 이동
		wp_util.move_async(neo_leader, neo_leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 1.2, nil, 0.5)

		-- 다음 동작 동시에 실행
		-- 카메라 1초간 아래로 1칸 이동
		camera_util.move(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + unity_class.vector3.back, 1)

		-- 론(down, idle, walk) 0.5초간 아래로 1칸 이동
		wp_util.move_async(neo_leader, neo_leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 2.6, nil, 1)

		-- 론(right, idle, walk) 0.5초간 오른쪽으로 1.2칸 이동
		wp_util.move_async(neo_leader, neo_leader.Position +unity_class.vector3.right * 1.2, nil, 0.5)

		scene_util.set_direction(neo_leader, 'down', false)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	--론 (down, idle, idle): 가디언에 대한 정보도 잘 들었습니다. 흥미로운 정보였어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_leader, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_80')

	--론 (down, idle, question): 그런데 굳이 따로 보고를 한다는 건….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_leader, self, 'down',
			'question', nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_81')

	--니프티 (up, idle, idle): 의견의 차이가 좀 크게 발생했습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_82')

	--론(down, idle, idle): 그것도 흥미롭군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_leader, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_83')

	--론(down, idle, nod 2회): 시프티를 불러 주시죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_leader, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_84')

	--니프티(up, idle, nod 2회): 네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'up',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_main_s8_85')

	--니프티 속도 1로 하단으로 이동 시작
	wp_util.move(twins_android, twins_android.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 20, 1)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--페이드 아웃 0.8초
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.8, unity_class.color.black)

	do
		character_util.stop(twins_android)

		--사이버로보틱스 집무실 복도
		local bundle_path = 'ondemand/v3_18_nightmare_queencastle/theatres'
		local prefab_name = 'nightmare_Cyberrobotics_office'

		self.neo_fed_office_outside = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder, bundle_path, prefab_name)

		--localRotation (30, 0, 0) (임시)
		self.neo_fed_office_outside.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(30, 0, 0)

		--문 위치에 (nightmare_qc_door) 배치
		--문 위치 (300, 0, -100.6)
		character_util.set_position(door, office_outside_pivot + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.6)

		--문 스케일 조정 ( 1.15 x 1.15 )
		door.transform.localScale  = vector(1.15, 1.15, 1)

		--문 스파인이 원화 뒤로 가도록 수정 (원화 문 부분이 투명으로 뚫려있어서 해당 부분으로 문이 보이도록 수정)
		character_util.set_sorting_layer(door, 'Default', -2)

		--원화 위치 (300, 0, -98.5) 로 수정
		self.neo_fed_office_outside.transform.position = office_outside_pivot + unity_class.vector3.forward * 1.5

		camera_util.set_position(office_outside_pivot)

function local_class:interpolation_move_async(fo, position, duration, interpolation)
	local interpolation_func = interpolations_constants[lua_helper.get_or_default(interpolation, 'linear')]

	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local time_passed = 0

	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = interpolation_func(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
		fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, position, progress)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	fo.Position = position
end

return local_class

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.wind_fan_sfx)

		self.wind_fan_sfx = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractFinishEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_finish_event(e)
	local interact, cb, key, info = self.interact_npc:is_interact(e.Target)

	if interact then
		start_coroutine(function()
			--폭발 연출
			self:junk_bomb(info)

			if type_util.is_function(cb) then
				cb(self, key, info, e)
			end
		end)

		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if self.reset_data.grid_1.reset_pos and
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.reset_data.grid_1.grid_name) then
		start_coroutine(self.reset_target, self, self.reset_data.grid_1)

		return true
	elseif self.reset_data.grid_2.reset_pos and
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.reset_data.grid_2.grid_name) then
		start_coroutine(self.reset_target, self, self.reset_data.grid_2)

		return true
	elseif self.reset_data.grid_3.reset_pos and
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.reset_data.grid_3.grid_name) then
		start_coroutine(self.reset_target, self, self.reset_data.grid_3)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

	self.interact_npc:load()

	do
		local wind_fan_pos = self.get_fo.s1_wind_fan(5).Position + vector(1, 0, 0)

		self.wind_fan_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_aircraft_loop_01', loop = true,
														 play_pos = wind_fan_pos, max_distance = 10 })
	end
end

end

	self:custom_callback(key, info)
end

function local_class:custom_callback(key, info)

end

--big or small
function local_class:junk_bomb(info)
	local npc = info.npc
	local fo = info.fo

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')

	self.fx.dead():Instantiate(fo.Position + vector(0, 0, 0))

	fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)
end

function local_class:reset_target(reset_data)
	local fo = reset_data.target()
	local reset_pos = reset_data.reset_pos
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	character_util.release_hold_object(leader, fo)

	local fx_reset = self.fx.reset()

	self.fx.reset():Instantiate(fo.Position)

	fo.Position = reset_pos

	self.fx.reset():Instantiate(fo.Position)

	fo.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
end

return local_class

		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareQueenCastleSectorDesertSlave @
		Comment = 바람의 신전 첫 번째 고철 이벤트 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type NightmareQueenCastleSectorDesertSlaveController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'nightmare_queencastle_3'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		first_scrap_metal_scene = 2,
		second_scrap_metal_scene = 3,
		ending = 4
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	--region Character
	self.get_character = {
		--니프티
		twins_android = function()
			return get_character('twins_android')
		end,
		--시프티
		twins_android_b = function()
			return get_character('twins_android_b')
		end,
		--android_npc (hold_up 용)
		s2_scrap_metal_android_npc = function(number)
			return get_character('s2_scrap_metal_android_npc_' .. number)
		end,
		--전일담 용 npc
		prologue_npc = function(number)
			return get_character('prologue_npc_' .. number)
		end,
	}
	--endregion Character

	--region Marker
	self.get_marker_pos = {
		center = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_center_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		quest_marker = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_quest_marker_pos_1')
		end
	}
	--endregion Marker

	--region Sprite
	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			heavy_part = 21525,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

	--region Fx
	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,
	})

	self.fx_list = nil
	--endregion Fx

	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.zone_name = 's2_zone_'

	-- 메인 퀘스트 id
	self.main_quest_id = 458
	--endregion Etc

	self.is_stage_end = false
	self.prologue_enter = false
end

	if self.current_state == self.states.first_scrap_metal_scene and

function local_class:prologue_enter_scene()
	local npc_1 = self.get_character.prologue_npc(1)
	local npc_2 = self.get_character.prologue_npc(2)

	--2번 NPC (up, idle, idle): 추락의 피해가 크네요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, { key = 'nm_qc_sector_ds_prologue_1', skip = false })

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	--2번 NPC (left, idle, idle): 이를 대비할 수 있는 충격 흡수 슈트가 필요하겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil, nil, { key = 'nm_qc_sector_ds_prologue_2', skip = false })

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	--2번 NPC (left, sleep_deep, idle): 누구나 착용할 수 있는… 프리 사이즈….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'left',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', { key = 'nm_qc_sector_ds_prologue_3', skip = false })

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	--2번 NPC (right, sleep_deep, idle): 어떠한 충격이라도 막을 수 있는 형태의 디자인…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil, 'sleep_deep', { key = 'nm_qc_sector_ds_prologue_4', skip = false })

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	--2번 NPC (sleep_deep, idle) 상태에서 left, right 0.3초 간격으로 반복 5회 진행
	do
		local count = 5
		local toggle = false

		scene_util.set_direction(npc_1, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc_1, self, 'sleep_deep')

		for _ = 1, count do
			if self:wait_for_sec(0.3) then
				return
			end

			if toggle then
				scene_util.set_direction(npc_1, 'left', false)
			else
				scene_util.set_direction(npc_1, 'right', false)
			end

			toggle = not toggle
		end
	end

	--1.5초 대기
	if self:wait_for_sec(1.5) then
		return
	end

	--2번 NPC (left, greed, idle): 생각났다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil, 'greed', { key = 'nm_qc_sector_ds_prologue_5', skip = false })

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end


	--2번 NPC (left, greed, eat) 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_equipping_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_1, self, 'greed')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_1, self, 'eat')

	--3번 NPC fx_dead와 함께 출력
	local npc_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('prologue_center_pos') + vector(0.5, 0, -1.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	self.fx.dead():Instantiate(npc_pos)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(npc_2, active_state_type.enabled)
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_2, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_2, self, { name = 'idle', loop = false })
	character_util.spine_rotate(npc_2, 90, 0)

	npc_1.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 1)
	npc_2.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 0)

	npc_2.Position = npc_pos
	npc_2.SpineController.TimeScale = 0

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc_1, field_ui_type.character_stats)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc_2, field_ui_type.character_stats)

	--이후 비강제 이벤트 종료
end

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener
		local target_is_not_active = target_data.is_not_active
		local target_oneline_key = target_data.oneline_key
		local target_crash_behaviour = target_data.crash_behaviour

		if target_is_not_active then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		if target_crash_behaviour then
			target.CrashBehaviour = target_crash_behaviour
		end

		target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_oneline_key then
			target.Interactable.Talk = target_oneline_key
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, 0.03, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:wait_for_sec(duration)
	local s = unity_class.time.time
	while not self.is_stage_end and unity_class.time.time - s < duration do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	return self.is_stage_end
end

--endregion Setting

local local_class = newclass('NightmareQueenCastleSectorDesertSlaveSection4')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareQueenCastleSectorDesertSlave @
		Comment = @
		Index = 3 @
		NextSections = 4 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type NightmareQueenCastleSectorDesertSlaveController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.available_stage_names = 'nightmare_queencastle_3'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		before_junk_interact = 2,
		after_junk_interact = 3,
		after_fan_enter = 4,
		back_zone_enter = 5,
		finish_fan_area = 6,
		back_finish_area = 7,
		after_interact_obelisk = 8,
		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.npc = {
		--니프티
		twins_android = function()
			return get_character('twins_android')
		end,
		twins_android_armored = function()
			return get_character('twins_android_armored')
		end,

		--시프티
		shifty = function()
			return get_character('twins_android_b')
		end,
	}

	self.gimmick = {
		obelisk = function()
			return get_field_object('switch_obelisk')
		end,
	}

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.fan = {
		name_data = {
			's1_wind_fan_5',
			's1_wind_fan_6',
		},

		set = function(this)
			for i = 1, #this.name_data do
				local fo = get_field_object(this.name_data[i])
				fo.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectBehaviour.Instance
				fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			end
		end,
	}

	self.shake = {
		is_shake = false,
		sfx = nil,

		set = function(this)
			if this.is_shake then
				return
			else
				this.is_shake = true
			end

			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				local npc = user_party[i]
				character_util.shake(npc, 0.03, 99999)
			end

			if this.sfx == nil then
				this.sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '01_rustle_01',
					loop = true,
					type_priority = 'loop',
					player_priority = 'player'
				})
			end
		end,

		remove = function(this)
			if not this.is_shake then
				return
			else
				this.is_shake = false
			end

			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				local npc = user_party[i]
				character_util.stop_shake(npc)
			end

			this:stop_sfx()
		end,

		stop_sfx = function(this)
			if this.sfx ~= nil then
				this.sfx:Stop()
				this.sfx = nil
			end
		end,
	}

	--연출용 아이템
	self.belt_item = nil
	self.quest_marker_name = 'sector_desert_slave'
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	--quest marker
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo('junk_6', self.cs_controller.QuestId,
			true, self.controller.interact_npc:get_fo('junk_6'))

	self.current_state = self.states.before_junk_interact
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.belt_item)
	self.belt_item = nil

	self.shake:stop_sfx()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.finish_fan_area and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.gimmick.obelisk()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self.current_state = self.states.after_interact_obelisk

			quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
			self:obelisk_interact_scene()

			--이후 클리어
			-- 스테이지 완료.
			self.controller:complete_hidden_quest_default()
			CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToLobby(true)
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.after_junk_interact and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's1_zone_3') then
		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene(nil)
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

			self.current_state = self.states.after_fan_enter

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
			self:fan_enter_scene()
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

			--바람 기믹 해제
			self.fan:set()

			local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_finish_center_pos')
			quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name,
					self.cs_controller.QuestId, true, marker_pos)

			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			self:change_follow_npc_and_state()
		end)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.after_fan_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_left_back_enter_zone') then
		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

			self.current_state = self.states.back_zone_enter

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
			self:area_back_enter_scene(e.Zone.Name, 'right')
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

			self.current_state = self.states.after_fan_enter

			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			self:change_follow_npc_and_state()
		end)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.after_fan_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_down_back_enter_zone') then
		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

			self.current_state = self.states.back_zone_enter

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
			self:area_back_enter_scene(e.Zone.Name, 'up')
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

			self.current_state = self.states.after_fan_enter

			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			self:change_follow_npc_and_state()
		end)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.after_fan_enter and
			(type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_fan_finish_enter_zone_1') or
					type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_fan_finish_enter_zone_2') or
					type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_fan_finish_enter_zone_3')) then
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self.current_state = self.states.finish_fan_area

			quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
			self:fan_area_finish_scene()
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

			quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.quest_marker_name,
					self.cs_controller.QuestId, true, self.gimmick.obelisk())
		end)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.finish_fan_area and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_finish_back_enter_zone') then
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self.current_state = self.states.back_finish_area

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
			self:finish_back_enter_scene(e.Zone.Name, 'left')
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

			self.current_state = self.states.finish_fan_area
		end)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.after_fan_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_fan_area_zone') then
		self.shake:set()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.after_fan_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_fan_area_zone') then
		self.shake:remove()

		return true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:junk_interact_scene(info)
	local twins_android = self.npc.twins_android()
	local shifty = self.npc.shifty()

	--해당 인터렉트 대상 중간을 기준으로 좌 nightmare_qc_heavy_part (임시) rock, 우  ic_blueprint_usb 1타일 간격으로 배치

	--qc_nihgtmare_heavy_part (임시)rock 좌측 0.5칸으로 1의 속도로 이동
	local heavy_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = info.fo.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
		item_id = 21525,
		spr_scale = 0.7,
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = true,
	})

	local usb_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = info.fo.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
		item_id = 21519,
		spr_scale = 1,
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = true,
	})

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	do
		local speed = 1

		--qc_nihgtmare_heavy_part (iron_ingot)좌측 0.5칸으로 1의 속도로 니프티 이동
		--시프티도 같이 이동하여 니프티 뒤 1타일에 정렬
		--도착 후 (right, idle, idle)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android, info.fo.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 1.5,
				speed, nil, self, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shifty, info.fo.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 2.5,
				speed, nil, self, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	do
		local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

		scene_util.set_anim(twins_android, self, 'eat')

		quest_drop_item_util.consumed(heavy_item, twins_android)

		--스트링 출력 끝나고 1초 대기
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim(twins_android)

		eat_sfx:Stop()
		eat_sfx = nil
	end

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle): 마지막 하나까지 모았습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shifty, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_ds_s4_1')

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle) 상태에서 (question) 이모티콘 출력
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'question')

	--ic_blueprint_usb 좌측으로 0.5칸으로 1의 속도로 이동
	wp_util.move_async(twins_android, twins_android.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 1.5, 1)

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle): 케이든 님을 관찰한 영상 데이터 같습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_ds_s4_2')

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle): 파괴된 안드로이드가 들고 있었나 봅니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_ds_s4_3')

	--니프티 (left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'right', false)

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle): 임무와 상관없는 일입니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shifty, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_ds_s4_4')

	--시프티 (right, idle, release 3회 후 idle): 서둘러 에너지 스위치를 차단하러 가야합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shifty, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 3 }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_ds_s4_4_1')

	--니프티 (left, idle, idle): 혹시 모르니 회수해 두겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_ds_s4_5')

	do
		local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

		scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(twins_android, self, 'eat')

		quest_drop_item_util.consumed(usb_item, twins_android)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim(twins_android)

		eat_sfx:Stop()
		eat_sfx = nil
	end
	--이후 컨트롤 해제
	--퀘스트 마커 갱신
end

function local_class:fan_enter_scene()
	local twins_android = self.npc.twins_android()
	local shifty = self.npc.shifty()
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_start_pos') + unity_class.vector3.forward

	do
		local speed = 4

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android, center_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				speed, nil, self, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shifty, center_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
				speed, nil, self, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

		camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 1)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'right', false)

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle): 좋습니다. 모은 부품을 꺼내볼까요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shifty, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_ds_s4_6')

	--니프티 (right, idle, attack 1회 후 idle)
	scene_util.set_anim(twins_android, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx_name = '01_throw_01' })

	--모션으로 nightmare_qc_heavy_part (임시) rock를 시프티 좌측 0.5타일 위치로 y축 최대 1의 높이로 포물선 모양으로 4의 속도로 모두 투척
	local item_data = {}
	do
		local offset = {
			vector(0.1, 0, 0.1),
			vector(0.1, 0, -0.1),
			vector(0, 0, 0),
			vector(-0.1, 0, 0.1),
			vector(-0.1, 0, -0.1),
		}
		for i = 1, 5 do
			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = twins_android.Position,
				target = center_pos + offset[i],
				item_id = 21525,
				spr_scale = 0.7,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				show_on_character = false,
			})

			table.insert(item_data, item)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	--5종 모두 투척하고 아래와 같이 정렬
	do
		local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clang_01', loop = true })

		--시프티 (left, idle, eat) 3초간 출력
		scene_util.play_wait_action(shifty, self,
				nil,
				'eat',
				nil,
				3)

		eat_sfx:Stop()
		eat_sfx = nil
	end

	--부품 아이템 위치로 fx_dead와 함께 무게 벨트 아이템 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	self.fx.dead():Instantiate(twins_android.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))

	for i = 1, #item_data do
		quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(item_data[i])
	end

	item_data = {}

	--nightmare_qc_heavy_belt (임시) tanker_armor
	local belt_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = center_pos,
		item_id = 21521,
		spr_scale = 1,
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = false,
	})

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle): 급한 대로 땜질해서 만들었습니다. 착용하시죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shifty, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_ds_s4_7')

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle) (question) 이모티콘 출력

function local_class:zone_back_move_async(zone_name, dir)
	local offset = 0.4
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local npc = user_party[i]
		local adder = 1 + i * offset
		local return_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone_name, npc, dir, adder)
		local locked_dir = direction_util.to_str(npc.Direction)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, return_pos, 2, nil, self, nil, { locked_dir = locked_dir })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
end

	--2번 NPC (left, mad, release 2회 후 idle): 담당 업무를 두고 지원부터 간 겁니까?

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.7)

	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(android_worker_2, self, 'left',

	--1초 대기

	--잔해 오브젝트(임시: wall_in2_stone1) 2개 0.3초에 걸쳐 y축 20에서 0의 위치까지 이동
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.3
	local falling_info = {
		{
			object = falling_stone_1,
			start_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0.5, 20, 0.5),
			end_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5),
		},
		{
			object = falling_stone_2,
			start_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0.5, 20, -1.5),
			end_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -1.5),
		}
	}

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		for i = 1, #falling_info do
			local falling_object = falling_info[i].object
			local falling_start_pos = falling_info[i].start_pos
			local falling_end_pos = falling_info[i].end_pos

			falling_object.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(falling_start_pos,
					falling_end_pos, time_passed / duration)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, #falling_info do
		local falling_object = falling_info[i].object
		local falling_end_pos = falling_info[i].end_pos

		falling_object.Position = falling_end_pos
	end

	--동시 출력

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(android_worker_2, 0, 0)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'left',

	--니프티 (left, idle, idle): 깔린 안드로이드는 완파됐겠네요.

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_in_s1_5')

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'right', false)

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle): 일단 진입로 확보를 위해 처리 방법이 필요하겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'left',

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type NightmareQueenCastleSectorInnuitController
	self.controller = controller

	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		destroy_wreck = 2,
		end_battle = 3,
		show_fake_knight = 4,
	}

	self.character = metatable_helper.inherit({

			twins_android = 'twins_android',
			twins_android_b = 'twins_android_b',
			android_meteor = 'android_meteor',
		}
	}, function(this, key)

	end)

	self.marker = metatable_helper.inherit({
		spec = {

			wreck_pos = 's2_wreck_pos',
		}
	}, function(this, key)
		return field_util.get_marker_pos(this.spec[key])
	end)

	self.get_android = function(index)
		return get_character('android_worker_' .. index)
	end

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		smoke_screen = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_SmokeScreen')
		end

end

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self:setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	if self.dynamic_npc then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_npc)
		self.dynamic_npc = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_destroy_wreck') then

		self.current_state = self.states.destroy_wreck

		sp_util.start_scene(self.destroy_wreck, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.end_battle and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_show_fake_knight') then

		self.current_state = self.states.show_fake_knight

		sp_util.start_scene(self.show_fake_knight, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.destroy_wreck and e.BattleGroupName == 's2_android_battle' then

		self.current_state = self.states.end_battle

		party_util.hide_field_ui_character_stats(0)

		sp_util.start_scene(self.end_battle, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:end_battle()
	local stage_event_controller = get_stage_event_controller('NightmareQueenCastle5Controller')

	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android
	local twins_android_b = self.character.twins_android_b

	character_util.cancel_all_battle_actions(twins_android, true)
	character_util.cancel_all_battle_actions(twins_android_b, true)

	--전투 끝나면 0.5초에 걸쳐 fade out
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--TODO: 안전장치로 연계기 모드 풀어봄
	time_util.unmod(CS.Oak.ISupportBattleActionExtensions.DeclareKey)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(twins_android_b, active_state_type.enabled)
	stage_event_controller.script.is_battle = false
	stage_event_controller.script.is_pause_remove_weapon = false
	stage_event_controller.script:remove_equipment(get_party_leader())

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	character_util.set_immortal(twins_android, false)

	--NPC 정렬
	--니프티 (right, idle, idle)
	--시프티 (left, idle, idle)

	--1번 NPC (left, idle, prostrate) 검은 틴트 70%
	--2번 NPC (right, idle, prostrate) 검은 틴트 70%
	--3번 NPC (left, idle, prostrate) 검은 틴트 70%
	--4번 NPC (right, idle, prostrate) 검은 틴트 70%
	--5번 NPC (left, idle, sleep) 검은 틴트 70%
	--6번 NPC (right, idle, prostrate) 검은 틴트 70%

	local android_data = {
		-- 1
		{
			pos_offset = vector(-1, 0, 0),
			dir = 'left',
			anim = 'prostrate'
		},
		-- 2
		{
			pos_offset = vector(-2, 0, -2),
			dir = 'right',
			anim = 'prostrate'
		},
		-- 3
		{
			pos_offset = vector(0, 0, -3),
			dir = 'left',
			anim = 'prostrate'
		},
		-- 4
		{
			pos_offset = vector(0, 0, 1.5),
			dir = 'right',
			anim = 'prostrate'
		},
		-- 5
		{
			pos_offset = vector(4, 0, 0.5),
			dir = 'left',
			anim = { name = 'sleep', loop = false }
		},
		-- 6
		{
			pos_offset = vector(4.5, 0, -3),
			dir = 'right',
			anim = 'prostrate'
		}
	}

	local target_pos = self.marker.destroy_wreck_align_pos

	for i = 1, 6 do
		local android = self.get_android(i)
		character_util.stop(android)
		character_util.convert_to_npc(android)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(android, active_state_type.enabled)
		android.Position = target_pos + android_data[i].pos_offset
		character_util.set_direction(android, android_data[i].dir)
		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, android_data[i].anim)
		character_util.add_color(android, android.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.7, 0)
	end

	character_util.stop(twins_android)
	twins_android.Position = target_pos + vector(1, 0, -1)
	character_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'right')

	character_util.stop(twins_android_b)
	twins_android_b.Position = target_pos + vector(2, 0, -1)
	character_util.set_direction(twins_android_b, 'left')

	--0.5초에 걸쳐 fade in
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--fade in 되고 1초간 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle): 너무 쉽게 전투를 선택하는 것 아닙니까?

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	return false
