function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's3_turn_on_switch') then

		self.current_state = self.states.turn_on_switch

		sp_util.start_scene(self.turn_on_switch, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.turn_on_switch and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's3_find_clue') then

		self.current_state = self.states.find_clue

		sp_util.start_scene(self.find_clue, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.find_clue and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.wrecks) then

		self.current_state = self.states.destroy_wreck

		sp_util.start_scene(self.destroy_wreck, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.destroy_wreck and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.temple_switch) then

		self.current_state = self.states.interact_temple_switch

		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_temple_switch, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	local twins_android_b = self.character.twins_android_b

	--3의 속도
	do
		local speed = 3

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android,
			wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(twins_android, switch.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), true),
			speed, nil, self, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android_b,
			wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(twins_android_b, switch.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0), true),
			speed, nil, self, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	--스위치 on 상태로 출력되고 2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--니프티 (left, tired, idle): 이쪽도 잔해로 막혀 있는 것 같습니다.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
		'bomb_idle', nil, 'nm_qc_sector_in_s3_2_1')

	--니프티 (right, idle, attack 1회 후 idle) 출력으로 물기믹 스위치 터치
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'right', false)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
		nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_in_s3_20')

		nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_in_s3_21')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',

	--니프티 (left, idle, idle): 일부 동의 합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',

	--시프티 (right, idle idle): 이견이 있습니까?

	--니프티 (left, idle, bomb_idle):  아버지께서 단일 개체를 완전히 부정하지는 않으시니까요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',

	--니프티 (left, idle, idle): 시스템 구축을 위한 특별한 단일 개체는 필요합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',

	--니프티 (left, idle, idle): 예를 들면 케이든 님이라던가….

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle): …….

--- 잔해 파괴 연출
function local_class:destroy_wreck()
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android
	local twins_android_b = self.character.twins_android_b

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local wreck_pos = self.marker.wreck_pos

	--잔해 인터렉트 시 위와 같이 정렬
	--니프티 (right, idle, idle)
	--시프티 (right, idle, idle)
	do
		local speed = 4

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android,
			wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(twins_android, wreck_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0)),
			speed, nil, self, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android_b,
			wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(twins_android_b, wreck_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0)),
			speed, nil, self, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--니프티 (right, idle, gauntlet_idle): 최대한 빨리 파괴하겠습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'right',
		'gauntlet_idle', nil, 'nm_qc_sector_in_s3_29')

	--니프티 (left, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'left')

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle): 잠깐.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
		nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_in_s3_30')

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle): 시간이 없으니 제가 하겠습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
		nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_in_s3_31')

	--시프티 (right, idle, idle): 제 뒤로 이동하는 것을 추천합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'right',
		nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_in_s3_32')

	--카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 시프티 포커스로 이동
	camera_util.move_to_target(twins_android_b, 0.5)

	--니프티 화살표 방향으로 이동
	--2의 속도
	--(idle, walk)
	--도착하면 (right, idle, idle)
	local wp = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(twins_android,
		twins_android.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0), { z = twins_android.Position.z + 1 })
	wp_util.move_async(twins_android, wp, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	local laser_effect
	local laser_spark_effect

	local laser_loop_sfx

	--QTE진행
	--실패 없음
	--15회 터치 시 클리어
	qte_play_util.tap(15, {
		tap_count_callback = function(tap_count)
			if tap_count == 1 then
				--1회 터치 시
				--동시 연출
				--카메라 0.3초에 걸쳐 3.8 크기로 줌인
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.8, 0.3)

				--시프티(right, idle, idle) 상태

				--시프티 눈에서 fx_nightmare_qc_twins_laser 출력
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_imperial_beam_01')
				laser_effect = self.fx.laser():Instantiate(twins_android_b.Position + vector(0.2, 0.03, 0.4))

				laser_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_light_laser_loop_01', loop = true })

				--잔해에는 시프티 눈에서 fx_nightmare_qc_twins_laser_spark출력
				laser_spark_effect = self.fx.laser_spark():Instantiate(wreck_pos + vector(-0.5, 1, -0.3))

				--시프티 shake 0.03세기로 지속 출력
				character_util.shake(twins_android_b, 0.03, 99999)

				--카메라 shake 0.05세기로 지속 출력
				camera_util.shake(0.05, 99999)

				--니프티 (right, surprise, idle) 출력
				scene_util.set_emotion(twins_android, self, 'surprise')

			elseif tap_count == 6 then
				--6회 터치 시
				--카메라 0.3초에 걸쳐 3.6크기로 줌인
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.6, 0.3)

			elseif tap_count == 12 then
				--12회 터치 시
				--카메라 0.3초에 걸쳐 3.4크기로 줌인
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.4, 0.3)
			end
		end
	})

	--15회 터치 시
	--카메라 0.3초에 걸쳐 4크기로 줌 아웃
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)

	--동시 연출
	if laser_effect then
		laser_effect:Dispose()
		laser_effect = nil
	end

	if laser_spark_effect then
		laser_spark_effect:Dispose()
		laser_spark_effect = nil
	end

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(laser_loop_sfx)

	--잔해 위치에 fx_common_smoke 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_building_explosion_01')
	self.fx.smoke_screen():Instantiate(wreck_pos)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	for i = 1, #self.wrecks do
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.wrecks[i], active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	--레이저 이펙트(발주 예정) 제거

	--시프티 shake 정지
	character_util.stop_shake(twins_android_b)

	--카메라 shake 0.3초간 0.1세기로 출력
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.1)

	--잔해 없는 상태로 출력되고 a 위치에 ic_blueprint_usb 배치
	self.usb_item:create(wreck_pos)

	--fx_common_smoke 제거되고 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android_b, 'left')

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle): 그런 게 있다면 처음부터 쓰지 그랬습니까?
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twins_android)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'right',
		nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_in_s3_33')

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle): 일정한 강도로 타격 시 잔해를 파괴할 수 있을 겁니다…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'left',
		nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_in_s3_34')

	--시프티 (left, idle, bomb_idle): 라고 하셨지 않습니까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'left',
		'bomb_idle', nil, 'nm_qc_sector_in_s3_35')

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle): 그래도… 외피에 흠집을 남기지 않을 수 있었습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'right',
		nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_in_s3_36')

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle): 복귀하면 제가 사용하던 흠집 제거제를 드리겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android_b, self, 'left',
		nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_in_s3_37')

	--니프티 (right, tired, idle): 무기에 사용하는 흠집 제거제는 필요 없습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'right',
		nil, 'tired', 'nm_qc_sector_in_s3_38')

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle): …….

		HasPreSection = false,
		NormalSectionCount = 3,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	self.active_stage_name = 'nightmare_queencastle_4'

	-- npc
	self.character = setmetatable({

function local_class:load_resource()
	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)

	self.fx:create_all()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	if main_quest ~= nil then
		if main_quest.InnerProgress >= 2 or main_quest.IsComplete then
			-- 섹션2 시작 지점에 있는 바위 비활성화
			field_object_util.set_active_state(self.object.s2_start_passege_rock_1, active_state_type.disabled)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(self.object.s2_start_passege_rock_2, active_state_type.disabled)

			-- activiy 연출용 박스 비활성화
			field_object_util.set_active_state(self.object.box_1, active_state_type.disabled)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(self.object.box_2, active_state_type.disabled)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(self.object.s2_combat_area_rock_1, active_state_type.disabled)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(self.object.s2_combat_area_rock_2, active_state_type.disabled)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(self.object.crossroad_rock_1, active_state_type.disabled)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(self.object.crossroad_rock_2, active_state_type.disabled)

			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s2_puzzle_door_2', false))
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s2_puzzle_door_3', false))

			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s2_cannon_area_door', false))
		end
	end

	if self.cs_controller.StartingInnerProgress ~= nil and self.cs_controller.StartingInnerProgress < 3 then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenPlayExitEvent), 'on_screen_play_exit_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GameOverEvent), 'on_game_over_event')
	end

	--region 포탄 탄매
	local count = 3
	for i = 1, count do
		local fo = get_field_object('androidwasher_' .. i)
		local fx_washer = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(fo.Transform, 'fx_nightmare_qc_washer')

		fx_washer.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end
	--endregion
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenPlayExitEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GameOverEvent))

	self.super:dispose()

	if self.fx_twinkle ~= nil then
		self.fx_twinkle:Dispose()
		self.fx_twinkle = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.active_stage_name then
		return
	end

	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)

	if main_quest ~= nil then
		if main_quest.InnerProgress >= 2 or main_quest.IsComplete then
			return
		end
	end

	if not self.is_blacked and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, get_party_leader()) and
			(string.find(e.Info.sender.Name, 'fireball') or string.find(e.Info.sender.Name, 'cannon')) then
		self.is_blacked = true

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

		self:turn_off_android()
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.active_stage_name then
		return
	end

	if self.active_black_gimmick and self.is_blacked and string.find(e.Target.Name, 'androidwasher_') then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

		if self.fx_twinkle ~= nil and string.find(e.Target.Name, 'androidwasher_1') then
			self.fx_twinkle:Dispose()
			self.fx_twinkle = nil
		end

		sp_util.start_scene(self.turn_on_android, self, e.Target)

	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_field_object('repair_cannon_1')) or
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_field_object('repair_cannon_2')) then

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

			--대포 작동시 강제 이벤트
			--대포앞에 NPC (left, surprise, idle)(jump 1회)
			--NPC (left, idle, attack)
			--대포 작동 멈춤
			--NPC (left, mad, release 2회): 당신 미쳤습니까?
			--NPC (left, idle, eat) 유지
			--컨트롤 해제
			local cannon = e.Target
			local android = nil
			local twins_a = get_party_leader()

			if cannon.Name == 'repair_cannon_1' then
				android = get_character('entrance_android_1')
			else
				android = get_character('entrance_android_4')
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(twins_a, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

			local cannon_controller = cannon.FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable()

			cannon_controller:turn_on()

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)

			scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, 'surprise')
			character_util.normal_jump_async(android, '01_player_jump_01')

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_03')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(android, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

			cannon_controller:turn_off()

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
					android,
					self,
					'left',
					{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
					'mad',
					'nm_qc_sector_field_1'
			)

			scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'eat')

			start_coroutine(function()
				local clang_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '01_clang_01',
					parent = android,
					loop = true,
					type_priority = 'loop',
					player_priority = 'npc'
				})

				-- 2회 재생을 위한 대기 시간
				wait_for_sec(0.92)

				music_player_util.stop_sfx(clang_loop_sfx)
			end)

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
		end)

	end
end

function local_class:on_screen_play_exit_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.active_stage_name then
		return
	end

	if self.is_blacked then
		local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
		player_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold)
		message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state))
	end
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.active_stage_name then
		return
	end

	if e.QuestId == self.quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 2 then
		self.active_black_gimmick = false

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenPlayExitEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GameOverEvent))
	end
end

function local_class:on_game_over_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.active_stage_name then
		return
	end

	if self.is_blacked then
		local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
		player_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold)
		message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state))
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)

	if main_quest ~= nil then
		if main_quest.InnerProgress <= 1 then
			self.fx_twinkle = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(self.object.android_washer_1.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
end

function local_class:turn_off_android()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { self.black_color_key }))
	--포탄에 맞으면 데미지와 함께 플레이어블 캐릭터 2체가 까맣게 변함 (니프티, 시프티)

	local android_a = self.character.twins_android
	local android_b = self.character.twins_android_b

	character_util.add_color(
			android_a,
			self.black_color_key,
			unity_class.color.black,
			0.8,
			0)

	character_util.add_color(
			android_b,
			self.black_color_key,
			unity_class.color.black,
			0.8,
			0)

	local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	player_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state))

	--해당 상태에서는 감시 시야에 걸리지 않음.
	--holdable 불가능
	--배틀 액션 사용 가능
	--인 게임 오브젝트로 체력 회복 및 기본 상태로 변경 가능
	--해당 상태는 3섹션 이후 작동하지 않음.
end

function local_class:turn_on_android(target)
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { self.black_color_key }))

	--탄매 세척기 (오브젝트 발주 예정)
	--특정 오브젝트에 인터랙트 시
	--오브젝트 방향에 따라 (left, right) 방향 전환 후 (eat) 애니메이션 1초
	--체력 회복
	--탄매 상태에서 처음 상태로 복귀
	--컨트롤 해제
	local android_a = self.character.twins_android
	local android_b = self.character.twins_android_b

	local default_color = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 })

	if target.Bounds.center.x > android_a.Bounds.center.x then
		scene_util.set_direction(android_a, direction_constants.right, false)
	else
		scene_util.set_direction(android_a, direction_constants.left, false)
	end

	local eat_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		parent = android_a,
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'loop',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	--오브젝트에 fx_nightmare_qc_washer 레이어(on) 상태로 전환
	local fx_washer = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(target.Transform, 'fx_nightmare_qc_washer')

	fx_washer.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	scene_util.play_wait_action(
			android_a,
			self,
			nil,
			'eat',
			nil,
			1
	)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_loop_sfx)

	fx_washer.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	--다음 동작 동시에
	--파티원을 포함한 2 캐릭터에 FX_heal_a 재생
	--파티원을 포함한 2 캐릭터에 fx_common_water_splash_out_shear 이펙트 재생

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
		heal_info.heal = party_member.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		heal_info.sender = party_member
		heal_info.target = party_member

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

		self.fx.heal():Instantiate(party_member.Position)
		self.fx.splash_out():Instantiate(party_member.Position)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_heal_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_02')

	character_util.add_color(
			android_a,
			self.black_color_key,
			default_color,
			1,
			0.5
	)

	character_util.add_color(
			android_b,
			self.black_color_key,
			default_color,
			1,
			0.5
	)

	self.is_blacked = false

	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.charcoal_event_1) and
			self.current_state == self.states.opening_scene then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.play_charcoal_area_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.charcoal_event_2) and
			self.current_state == self.states.charcoal_event_2 then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.play_guard_android_meeting_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.cleaning_event) and
			self.current_state == self.states.cleaning_event then
		start_coroutine(self.play_cleaning_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false

function local_class:align_twins(speed, duration, pos_idx, move_args)
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android
	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b

	pos_idx = lua_helper.get_or_default(pos_idx, 1)

	if move_args == nil then
		move_args = {}
	end

	local move_end_key = 'twin_align'
	local arrive_pos = self.marker.nifty(self.current_state, pos_idx)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android, arrive_pos, speed, duration, self, move_end_key, move_args)

	arrive_pos = self.marker.shifty(self.current_state, pos_idx)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twin_b, arrive_pos, speed, duration, self, move_end_key, move_args)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)
end

function local_class:play_intro_scene()
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android
	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	camera_util.move_async(self.marker.camera_pos(1, 2), 0.1)
	camera_util.move_async(self.marker.camera_pos(1, 1), 0.1)

	-- 니프티, 시프티 위치 셋팅
	twins_android.Position = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('up',
			self.marker.nifty(1, 1), 1)
	twin_b.Position = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('up',
			self.marker.shifty(1, 1), 1)

	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'down', false)

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = 'ondemand/v2_65_queencastle/audio:bgm_queencastle_temple', state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')

	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 기획서에 없으나 임의로 니프티, 시프티 아래로 내려옴
	local move_end_key = 'twin_align'

	local arrive_pos = self.marker.nifty(1, 1)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android, arrive_pos, 4, nil, self, move_end_key)
	arrive_pos = self.marker.shifty(1, 1)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twin_b, arrive_pos, 4, nil, self, move_end_key)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 니프티 (right, idle, idle): 평균 온도가 주변보다 훨씬 높은 구역입니다.
	-- 시프티 (left, idle, idle)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'left', false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_1_1')

	--니프티 (down, idle, idle): 용암과 열기 그리고…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_1_2')

	--카메라 1초간 (-9, 0, -5) 로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(self.marker.camera_pos(1, 2), 1)

	start_coroutine(function()
		local clang_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clang_01', loop = true })

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(clang_sfx)
	end)

	--안드로이드 A (left, idle, eat): 시설물이 오작동하지 않게 제대로 감시하고 있으십시오.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.character.entrance_android_1, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'eat', keep = true }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_1_3')

	--안드로이드 B (right, idle, idle): 당연합니다. 당신이 쓰러지면 제가 모든 일을 맡아야 하지 않습니까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.character.entrance_android_2, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_1_4')

	--카메라 1초간 (-1, 0, -10.5) 로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(self.marker.camera_pos(1, 3), 1)

	--안드로이드 E (down, idle, idle): 휴먼들은 왜 멀쩡한 부유성을 바닥에 떨구고 있는 겁니까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.character.entrance_android_5, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_1_5')

	--안드로이드 F (up, idle, idle): 저도 이해되지 않습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.character.entrance_android_6, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_1_6')

	--카메라 1초간 플레이어 (니프티) 에게 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--니프티 (right, idle, bomb_idle): 감시 병력의 밀도도 다른 곳에 비해 유독 많은 편입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_1_7')

	--시프티(left, idle, idle): 고열과 위험 시설들이 가득한 장소니 많은 인원이 배치되는 게 당연하죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_1_8')

	--시프티(left, idle, question): 주변이 고열의 액체로 둘러 쌓여 숨을 곳도 부족해보이니 주의합시다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'question', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_1_9')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1.5)
	scene_util.set_anim(twins_android, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	self.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'main_field',
			target = self.marker.quest_marker(1)
		},
	})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twins_android)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twin_b)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

function local_class:play_charcoal_area_event()
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android
	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b

	self.current_state = self.states.charcoal_event_1

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	self:align_twins(nil, 0.5)

	local staging_twins_android = self.character.staging_twins_android
	local staging_twins_android_b = self.character.staging_twins_android_b

	scene_util.hide_weapon(staging_twins_android)

	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'down', false)

	-- 0.5초간 카메라 (-25.5, 0, -18.5) 로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(self.marker.camera_pos(2, 1), 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--니프티 (up, idle, idle) 1초
	--시프티 (right, idle, idle) 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'right', true)
	scene_util.play_wait_action(twins_android, self, { dir = 'up', sfx = false },
			nil, nil, 1)

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle) 1초
	--시프티 (up, idle, idle) 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'up', true)
	scene_util.play_wait_action(twins_android, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil, nil, 1)

	-- 시프티 (down, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'down', false)

	--니프티 (left, idle, bomb_idle): 더이상 탐색가능한 경로를 찾을 수 없습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_2_1')

	--시프티 (down, idle, question): 이런 상황이라면 비효율적이지만 강행돌파도 고려를….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'question', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_2_2')

	--시프티(down, attack, idle) (jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(twin_b, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(twin_b, '01_small_jump_01')

	--니프티(down, attack, idle) (jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(twins_android, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(twins_android, '01_small_jump_01')

	--시프티(down, attack, release 2회): 적대 안드로이드 접근중! 빨리 숨어야 합니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twin_b)
	scene_util.set_emotion(twin_b, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_2_3')

	local twin_android_arrive_pos = self.marker.nifty(self.current_state, 2)
	local twin_android_b_arrive_pos = self.marker.shifty(self.current_state, 2)
	local move_list = {
		twins_android = {
			vector(twins_android.Position.x, 0, twin_android_arrive_pos.z),
			twin_android_arrive_pos,
		},

		twins_android_b = {
			vector(twin_b.Position.x, 0, twin_android_b_arrive_pos.z),
			twin_android_b_arrive_pos,
		},
	}

	local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	local move_end_key = 'twins_move'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android, move_list[twins_android.Name], 6, nil, self, { run = true, last_direction = 'down' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twin_b, move_list[twin_b.Name], 6, nil, self, move_end_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'down' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(run_sfx)

	-- 시프티, 니프티 (down, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twins_android)
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'down', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twin_b)
	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'down', false)

	character_util.set_position(staging_twins_android, twins_android.Position)
	scene_util.set_direction(staging_twins_android, 'down', false)

	character_util.set_position(twins_android, vector(999, 0, 999))

	character_util.set_position(staging_twins_android_b, twin_b.Position)
	scene_util.set_direction(staging_twins_android_b, 'down', false)

	character_util.set_position(twin_b, vector(999, 0, 999))

	-- 안드로이드 C 2초간 상단 7칸 이동
	local charcoal_area_camera_pos = self.marker.camera_pos(2, 1)
	local android_list = { self.character.charcoal_android_1, self.character.charcoal_android_2, self.character.charcoal_android_3 }
	local android_c_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down',
			charcoal_area_camera_pos, -1.5)
	character_util.set_position(android_list[3], android_c_pos)
	character_util.add_color(android_list[3], 'charcoal', unity_class.color.black, 0.8, 0)

	wp_util.move_async(android_list[3], self.marker.charcoal(1), 3, nil)

	--안드로이드 C(left, idle, idle): 누가 또 각도 조정을 바꿔놓은 탓입니다. 겨우 원상복구 해놨습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_list[3], self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_2_5')

	--안드로이드 C (right, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(android_list[3], 'right', false)

	--안드로이드 B(left, idle, bomb_idle): 그럼 다음 안드로이드가 또 바꿔 놓는 것 아닙니까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_list[2], self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = '01_swing_01' }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_2_6')

	--안드로이드 C (right, idle, idle) : 그건 그때 생각하면 됩니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_list[3], self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_2_7')

	local charcoal_android_move_end = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		-- 안드로이드 C 속도 4로 상단 4칸 이동

		wp_util.move_async(android_list[3], move_list, 4, nil)

		-- 그리드 밖에서 삭제
		character_util.set_position(android_list[3], vector(999, 0, 999))
		field_object_util.set_active_state(android_list[3], active_state_type.disabled)

		charcoal_android_move_end = true
	end)

	-- 카메라 1초간 플레이어(니프티) 에게 복귀
	camera_util.move_async(staging_twins_android.Position, 1, { end_target = staging_twins_android })

	--니프티(down, idle, release 2회): 저 방법입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staging_twins_android, self, { dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_2_8')

	while not charcoal_android_move_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 시프티 (left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(staging_twins_android_b, 'left', false)

	-- 니프티 0.5초간 좌측 1칸 이동
	-- 니프티 0.5초간 하단 1칸 이동

	wp_util.move_async(staging_twins_android,
			{
				vector(twin_android_arrive_pos.x, 0, staging_twins_android.Position.z),
				twin_android_arrive_pos,
			},
			4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	local apply_charcoal = function(fo, add_black_color)
		scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(fo, 'attack')

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.25)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.75)

		-- 니프티 0.5초간 좌측 1칸 뒷걸음질
		wp_util.move_async(fo,

		cannon_controller:turn_on()

		if add_black_color then

		wp_util.move_async(fo,
				fo.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
				nil, 0.5)

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.25)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_03')

		wait_for_sec((anim_duration * 0.75) + 0.5)
	end

	-- 니프티 (right, idle, attack) 애니메이션 1회
	-- (임시)
	-- 포탄 기믹 가동
	-- 포탄 기믹으로 포탄이 발사되어 니프티에게 타격
	-- 니프티 검은 틴트 상태로 변경
	-- 니프티 (right, idle, attack) 애니메이션 1회
	-- 포탄 기믹 꺼짐
	apply_charcoal(staging_twins_android, true)

	wp_util.move(staging_twins_android,

	wp_util.move_async(staging_twins_android_b,
			{
				vector(twin_android_arrive_pos.x, 0, staging_twins_android_b.Position.z),
				twin_android_arrive_pos,
			},
			nil, 1, { last_direction = 'right' })

	apply_charcoal(staging_twins_android_b, true)

	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'right', false)

	self.quest_marker:add({

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(twin_b, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'question')

	-- 시프티 (down, tired, push) (shake 0.03 / 0.5초)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bomb_holdup_fail_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(twin_b, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(twin_b, self, { name = 'push' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(twin_b)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'down',

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s1_4_7')

	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

	player_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state))
end

	self.fx:create_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android
	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b

	character_util.add_color(
			twins_android,
			'android_black_color',
			unity_class.color.black,
			0.8,
			0)

	character_util.add_color(
			twin_b,
			'android_black_color',
			unity_class.color.black,
			0.8,
			0)
end

function local_class:start()
	local first_quest_marker = self.marker.quest_marker(1)
	self.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'main_field',
			target = first_quest_marker
		},
	})

	self.controller.is_blacked = true

	local is_current_section_start = self.cs_controller.StartingInnerProgress == 1

	if is_current_section_start then
		self.controller:turn_off_android()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.character.box_android_1) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.character.box_android_2) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.escorting_androids and self.current_activity_state == self.activity_state.clear then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.section_end_event, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.fake_knight_event) and
			self.current_state == self.states.fake_knight then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_fake_knight_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.box_android_event) and
			self.current_state == self.states.enter_box_androids then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_box_android_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.object.passage_door_switch) and
			(self.current_state == self.states.followed_box_androids or
					(self.current_state == self.states.escorting_androids and self.current_activity_state == self.activity_state.none)) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.play_traverse_passage_event, self)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if (lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character.box_android_1) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character.box_android_2)) and
			self.current_activity_state == self.activity_state.play then
		self.current_activity_state = self.activity_state.failure

		sp_util.start_scene(self.mini_activity_fail_and_reset, self, e.Info.target)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:align_twins(speed, duration, scene_idx, pos_idx)
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android
	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b

	pos_idx = lua_helper.get_or_default(pos_idx, 1)

	local move_end_key = 'twin_align'
	local arrive_pos = self.marker.nifty(scene_idx, pos_idx)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android, arrive_pos, speed, duration, self, move_end_key)

	arrive_pos = self.marker.shifty(scene_idx, pos_idx)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twin_b, arrive_pos, speed, duration, self, move_end_key)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)
end

function local_class:enter_box_android_event()
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android
	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b
	local box_android_list = { self.character.box_android_1, self.character.box_android_2 }

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	-- 속도 4로 해당 위치로 정렬
	self:align_twins(4, nil, 2, 1)

	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'up', false)

	-- 카메라 1초간 6칸 위로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(self.marker.camera_pos(2, 1), 1)

	--안드로이드 A (right, idle, hold): 이 창고 장비 보급은 도대체 언제까지 계속해야 합니까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(box_android_list[1], self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_2_1')

	--안드로이드 B (left, idle, hold): 원래도 파츠 손실이 많았는데 이번 추락 사태로 더 심해졌습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(box_android_list[2], self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_2_2')

	--안드로이드 B (left, idle, hold): 창고에 여유 분의 복식과 골격 파츠를 채우려면 한참 남았습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(box_android_list[2], self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_2_3')

	--안드로이드 A (right, idle, hold): 이럴때일수록 장비를 좀 덜 태워먹었으면 좋겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(box_android_list[1], self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_2_4')

	start_coroutine(function()
		-- 안드로이드 A, B 속도 4 로 경로대로 이동
		local move_end_key = 'box_android_move'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(box_android_list[1],
				{ self.marker.box_android(1, 2), self.marker.box_android(1, 3), },
				4, nil, self, move_end_key)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(box_android_list[2],
				{ self.marker.box_android(2, 2), },
				4, nil, self, move_end_key)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

		start_coroutine(self.play_box_android_mumble_event, self)
	end)

	-- 경로 이동 1초 후
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 1초간 카메라 플레이어(니프티)에게 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--니프티 (right, idle, idle): 근처에 부유성 안드로이드들의 장비 창고가 있는 모양입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_2_5')

	--시프티 (left, idle, idle): 저 안드로이드를 따라가서 저희 파츠를 교체하면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_2_6')

	--니프티 (right, attack, cast): 더이상 몸에 위장 화약을 묻힐 필요는 없을 겁니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'right',
			'cast', 'attack', 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_2_7')

	self.current_state = self.states.followed_box_androids

	-- 메인 마커 위치 (-25.5, 0, 26.5)
	self.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'main_field',
			target = self.marker.quest_marker(3)
		},
	})

	local activity_cannon_list = {
		self.object.activity_cannon_1, self.object.activity_cannon_2,
		self.object.activity_cannon_3, self.object.activity_cannon_4,
		self.object.activity_cannon_5, self.object.activity_cannon_6,
		self.object.activity_cannon_7, self.object.activity_cannon_8,
	}

	for i = 1, #activity_cannon_list do
		local cannon_controller = activity_cannon_list[i].FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable()

		cannon_controller:turn_on()
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:play_box_android_mumble_event()
	local box_android_list = { self.character.box_android_1, self.character.box_android_2 }

	self.is_box_android_mumble = true

	while self.is_box_android_mumble do
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(box_android_list[1],
				{ key = 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_2_8', skip = false })

		if not self.is_box_android_mumble then
			break
		end

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(box_android_list[2],
				{ key = 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_2_9', skip = false })

		if not self:wait_for_sec_to_stop(1) then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:wait_for_sec_to_stop(sec)
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < sec do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 모든 시간 기다리지 않고 탈출
		if self.loop_escape then
			return false
		end

		if not self.is_box_android_mumble then
			return false
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 기다림 완료
	return true
end

function local_class:play_traverse_passage_event()
	local box_android_list = { self.character.box_android_1, self.character.box_android_2 }

	self.is_box_android_mumble = false
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.character.box_android_1)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.character.box_android_2)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	-- 전장 도어 개방 (pull opening X)
	-- 1초간 안드로이드 A에게 카메라 이동
	--message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s2_cannon_area_door', false))

	camera_util.move_async(box_android_list[1].Position, 1)

	-- 안드로이드 A(right, idle, hold): 누군지는 모르겠지만 감사합니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(box_android_list[1], self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_2_10')

	-- 카메라 0.5초간 플레이어(니프티)에게 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	self.quest_marker:remove()

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.current_state = self.states.escorting_androids

	self.current_activity_state = self.activity_state.play

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	-- 미니 액티비티 시작
	-- 안드로이드 A, B 오른쪽으로 이동 시작 (속도 3) (walk 애니메이션)
	start_coroutine(self.dodge_projectile_mini_activity, self)
end

function local_class:dodge_projectile_mini_activity()
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android
	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b
	local box_android_list = {
		{
			fo = self.character.box_android_1,
			arrive_pos = self.marker.box_android(1, 4),
		},
		{
			fo = self.character.box_android_2,
			arrive_pos = self.marker.box_android(2, 3),
		},
	}

	box_android_list[1].fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	box_android_list[2].fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- 안드로이드 A, B 오른쪽으로 이동 시작 (속도 3) (walk 애니메이션)
	wp_util.move(box_android_list[1].fo, box_android_list[1].arrive_pos, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_async(box_android_list[2].fo, box_android_list[2].arrive_pos, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

		box_android_list[2].fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

		character_util.add_listener(box_android_list[2].fo, self.controller)

	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b
	local box_android_list = { self.character.box_android_1, self.character.box_android_2 }

			box_list[i] = current_state.HoldTarget
		end

		if lua_helper.type_compare(npc.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)) and
				(lua_helper.reference_equals(npc.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget, self.object.box_1) or
						lua_helper.reference_equals(npc.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget, self.object.box_2)) then

			command_util.publish_throw(npc, npc.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget,
					direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(npc.Direction), npc.Position, 5, true)
		end
	end


	-- 0.5초간 포탄을 피격당한 안드로이드 에게 카메라 이동
	camera_util.move_async(target.Position, 0.5)

	-- 카메라 이동 끝난 후 2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 서큘러 페이드 아웃 0.8초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.8, 'linear')

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.activity_fail_count == (self.check_fail_count + 1) then
		local cannon_controller = self.object.activity_cannon_3.FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable()
		cannon_controller:turn_off()

		cannon_controller = self.object.activity_cannon_4.FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable()
		cannon_controller:turn_off()

		cannon_controller = self.object.activity_cannon_7.FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable()
		cannon_controller:turn_off()

		cannon_controller = self.object.activity_cannon_8.FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable()
		cannon_controller:turn_off()
	end

	-- HP 회복
	local current_party = get_user_party()
	for i = 0, current_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()

		heal_info.sender = party_member
		heal_info.target = party_member
		heal_info.heal = party_member.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.skipEffect = true

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

	end

	character_util.set_position(box_android_list[1], self.marker.box_android(1, 3))
	scene_util.set_direction(box_android_list[2], 'right', false)
	character_util.set_position(box_android_list[2], self.marker.box_android(2, 2))

	box_android_list[1].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	box_android_list[2].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'right', false)
	character_util.set_position(twins_android, reset_pos + vector(-0.25, 0, 0))

	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'right', false)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(box_android_list[1], self, 'right',

	--안드로이드 B (right, idle, bomb_idle): 대충 던져놓으면 아무나 와서 정리할 겁니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(box_android_list[2], self, 'right',
			{ name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = '01_swing_01' }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_3_2')

	--안드로이드 A,B (left, idle, idle) 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(box_android_list[1], 'left', true)
	scene_util.set_direction(box_android_list[2], 'left', false)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--안드로이드 B (left, idle, bomb_idle): 당신들은 왜 그렇게 포탄에 얻어 맞은 겁니까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(box_android_list[2], self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_3_3')

	--안드로이드 A (left, idle, nod 2회) : 맞습니다. 작업 간에 조금 더 조심해 주십시오.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(box_android_list[1], self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_3_4')

	--안드로이드 B (left, idle, release 2회): 이러니 저희가 계속 장비를 가져와야 하지 않습니까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(box_android_list[2], self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_3_5')

	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'down', false)


	local out_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down',
			self.marker.box_android(2, 3), -3)

	-- 안드로이드 A, B 속도 7로 하단으로 쭉 이동 (run 애니메이션)
	--그리드 밖에서 제거
	start_coroutine(function()
		local move_end_key = 'box_android_move'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(box_android_list[1],

				7, nil, self, move_end_key, { run = true })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(box_android_list[2],

	character_util.set_position(box_android_list[2], vector(999, 0, 999))

	character_util.set_position(twins_android, vector(999, 0, 999))

	field_object_util.set_active_state(twin_b, active_state_type.disabled)
	character_util.set_position(twin_b, vector(999, 0, 999))

	self.object.box_1.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	self.object.box_2.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	-- 리더 교체
	field_object_util.set_active_state(twin_android_maid, active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(twin_b_maid, active_state_type.enabled)
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(twin_android_maid, param, true)
	party_util.add_member(twin_b_maid)

	character_util.set_position(twin_android_maid, backup_pos_list[1])
	character_util.set_position(twin_b_maid, backup_pos_list[2])

	scene_util.set_direction(twin_android_maid, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b_maid, 'right', false)

	self:reset_summonables()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--니프티(down, idle, idle): 조금 어설프긴 하지만 속아 넘어갈겁니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_android_maid, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_3_7')

	--시프티(up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b_maid, 'up', false)

	-- 시프티 (up, idle, idle): 들킬 거였으면 진작에 들켰을 겁니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b_maid, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s2_3_8')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	--섹션 종료.
	self.controller:progress_section()
end

function local_class:burn_box_androids()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_catch_fire_01')

	local obj = self.character.box_android_1
	self.fire_fx_list[1] = self.fx.field_fire():Instantiate(obj.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, obj.Transform)

	obj = self.character.box_android_2
	self.fire_fx_list[2] = self.fx.field_fire():Instantiate(obj.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, obj.Transform)

	obj = self.object.box_1
	self.fire_fx_list[3] = self.fx.field_fire():Instantiate(obj.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, obj.Transform)

	obj = self.object.box_2
	self.fire_fx_list[4] = self.fx.field_fire():Instantiate(obj.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, obj.Transform)
end

function local_class:extinguish_box_androids()
	for i = 1, #self.fire_fx_list do
		if self.fire_fx_list[i] ~= nil then
			self.fire_fx_list[i]:Dispose()
			self.fire_fx_list[i] = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:reset_summonables()
	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.SummonCharacterGenerator.Instance:GenerateLocal(get_party_leader()))
end

return local_class

					this.data[i] = nil
				end

				this.data = nil
			end
		end
	}

	self.item_id = {

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.crt_filter_screen ~= nil then
		self.crt_filter_screen:Dispose()
		self.crt_filter_screen = nil
	end

	self.items:dispose_all()
	self.items = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_dyn_npcs()

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.object.last_switch) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.switch_area then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.end_event, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.computer_area_1) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.none then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_computer_area, self)

			return true
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.temporary_restricted_area) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.computer_area then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_restricted_area, self)

			return true
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.computer_area_2) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.computer_area then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.play_computer_event, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose_dyn_npcs()
	if self.past_scene_dyn_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.past_scene_dyn_npcs)
		self.past_scene_dyn_npcs = nil
	end
end

function local_class:align_twins(speed, duration, scene_idx, pos_idx)
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android_maid
	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b_maid

	pos_idx = lua_helper.get_or_default(pos_idx, 1)

	local move_end_key = 'twin_align'
	local arrive_pos = self.marker.nifty(scene_idx, pos_idx)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android, arrive_pos, speed, duration, self, move_end_key)

	arrive_pos = self.marker.shifty(scene_idx, pos_idx)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twin_b, arrive_pos, speed, duration, self, move_end_key)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)
end

function local_class:enter_computer_area()
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android_maid
	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b_maid
	local com_android_list = { self.character.computer_android_1, self.character.computer_android_2 }

	self.quest_marker:remove()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	self:align_twins(5, nil, 1, 1)

	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'down', false)

	self.current_state = self.states.computer_area

	-- 안드로이드 A (right, idle, release 2회): 거기, 가사 안드로이드!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(com_android_list[1], self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_1_1')

	-- 시프티 (left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'left', false)

	-- 니프티 (left, idle, bomb_idle): 네, 무슨 일을 도와드릴까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_1_2')

	-- 안드로이드 B (left, idle, idle): 낯간지럽게 왜 갑자기 친절하게 구는 겁니까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(com_android_list[2], self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_1_3')

	-- 안드로이드 A (right, idle, idle): 저번에 부탁한 안드로이드 식품 재료들이 창고에 준비됐으니 가져가십쇼.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(com_android_list[1], self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_1_4')

	-- 안드로이드 A (right, idle, cross_arm): 추락하면서 식량까지 타버려 며칠째 오일 한모금도 마시지 못했단 말입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(com_android_list[1], self, 'right',
			'cross_arm', nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_1_5')

	-- 안드로이드 B (left, idle, bomb_idle): 혹시 다른 일로 오신겁니까? 그러면 임무 조회를….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(com_android_list[2], self, 'left',
			{ name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = '01_swing_01' }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_1_6')

	-- 시프티 (right, idle, nod 2회): 아닙니다. 감사합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_1_7')

	self.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'main_field',
			target = self.marker.quest_marker(2)
		},
	})

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:enter_restricted_area()
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android_maid
	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b_maid

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--안드로이드 A (down, idle, idle) :설마 까먹은 겁니까? 빨리 챙겨서 가십시오.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.character.computer_android_1, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_1_8')

	local move_end_key = 'twins_android_move'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android,
			twins_android.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			nil, 0.5, self, move_end_key, { locked_dir = 'down' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twin_b,
			twin_b.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			nil, 0.5, self, move_end_key, { locked_dir = 'down' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	scene_util.set_direction(self.character.computer_android_1, 'right', false)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:play_computer_event()
	local twins_android = self.character.twins_android_maid
	local twin_b = self.character.twins_android_b_maid

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	self:align_twins(5, nil, 2, 1)

	--니프티 (down, idle, question): 적당히 챙겨가는 척 하면 될 것 같군요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twins_android, self, { dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			'question', nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_2_1')

	-- 니프티 0.5초간 0.5초칸 이동
	wp_util.move_async(twins_android, twins_android.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5), nil, 0.5)

	-- 니프티 (right, idle, eat) 0.5초
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	scene_util.play_wait_action(twins_android, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'eat' },
			nil,
			0.5)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)

	-- 시프티 (left, idle, idle) 1초
	scene_util.play_wait_action(twin_b, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			0.5)

	-- 시프티 (up, idle, idle) 0.5초
	scene_util.play_wait_action(twin_b, self,
			{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			0.5)

	-- 니프티 (left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'left', false)

	-- 시프티 (right, idle, release 2회): 잠시만 여길 보십시오.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_2_2')

	-- 니프티 (up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'left', false)

	-- 시프티 (up, idle, release 2회): 여기에도 아버지에 관한 자료가 남아있을지 모릅니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, 'up',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_2_3')

	-- 0.5초간 해당 대열로 정렬
	-- (1) 니프티 (left, idle, eat)
	-- (2) 시프티 (right, idle, eat)
	local move_end_key = 'twins_android_move'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twins_android,
			twins_android.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			nil, 0.5, self, move_end_key)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(twin_b,
			twin_b.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			nil, 0.5, self, move_end_key)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(twins_android, self, { name = 'eat' })
	scene_util.set_anim(twin_b, self, { name = 'eat' })

	-- eat 애니메이션 1초 재생
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)

	-- 니프티 (up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(twins_android, 'up', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twins_android)

	-- 시프티 (up, idle, idle): 데이터를 읽어 재생해보도록 하죠.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twin_b)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(twin_b, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_2_4')

	-- 0.8초 페이드 아웃
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 4 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.8, unity_class.color.black)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.past_scene_dyn_npcs = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(
			{
				neo_leader = 'nightmare_qc_neo_leader_past',

				researcher_2 = 'nightmare_qc_lab_researcher',

				dummy_android_1 = 'nightmare_qc_android_remains',
				dummy_android_2 = 'nightmare_qc_android_remains',
				dummy_android_3 = 'nightmare_qc_android_remains',
				dummy_android_4 = 'nightmare_qc_android_remains',
				dummy_android_5 = 'nightmare_qc_android_remains',
			}
	)

	self.crt_filter_screen = self.fx.crt_filter():Instantiate(
			stage_camera.transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.Transform)

	local researcher_1 = self.character.researcher_1
	local researcher_2 = self.past_scene_dyn_npcs['researcher_2']
	local neo_leader_past = self.past_scene_dyn_npcs['neo_leader']

	character_util.set_sorting_layer(neo_leader_past, 'Default', 5)

	local hold_target = self.character.dummy_android_6

	scene_util.set_direction(hold_target, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(hold_target, self, 'prostrate')
	scene_util.set_emotion(hold_target, self, 'damaged')

	-- 회상 씬 셋팅
	camera_util.move_async(self.marker.camera_pos(1, 1), 0.1)

	local left_start_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left',
			self.marker.researcher(1), -1.5)

	local apply_black_color = function(npc)
		character_util.add_color(npc, npc.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0.1)
	end

	apply_black_color(researcher_1)
	apply_black_color(researcher_2)

	local dummpy_npc = self.past_scene_dyn_npcs['dummy_android_1']
	apply_black_color(dummpy_npc)

	dummpy_npc = self.past_scene_dyn_npcs['dummy_android_1']
	apply_black_color(dummpy_npc)
	character_util.set_position(dummpy_npc, self.marker.dummy_andorid(1))
	scene_util.set_direction(dummpy_npc, 'right', false)

	dummpy_npc = self.past_scene_dyn_npcs['dummy_android_2']
	apply_black_color(dummpy_npc)
	character_util.set_position(dummpy_npc, self.marker.dummy_andorid(2))
	scene_util.set_direction(dummpy_npc, 'left', false)

	dummpy_npc = self.past_scene_dyn_npcs['dummy_android_3']
	apply_black_color(dummpy_npc)
	character_util.set_position(dummpy_npc, self.marker.dummy_andorid(3))
	scene_util.set_direction(dummpy_npc, 'right', false)

	dummpy_npc = self.past_scene_dyn_npcs['dummy_android_4']
	apply_black_color(dummpy_npc)
	character_util.set_position(dummpy_npc, self.marker.dummy_andorid(4))
	scene_util.set_direction(dummpy_npc, 'left', false)

	dummpy_npc = self.past_scene_dyn_npcs['dummy_android_5']
	apply_black_color(dummpy_npc)
	character_util.set_position(dummpy_npc, self.marker.dummy_andorid(5))
	scene_util.set_direction(dummpy_npc, 'right', false)

	character_util.set_position(hold_target, left_start_pos + vector(1, 0, 0))
	scene_util.set_direction(hold_target, 'right', false)

	character_util.set_position(neo_leader_past, left_start_pos + vector(0, 0, 1))
	scene_util.set_direction(neo_leader_past, 'right', false)

	character_util.set_position(researcher_1, left_start_pos)
	scene_util.set_direction(researcher_1, 'right', false)

	character_util.set_position(researcher_2, left_start_pos + vector(0, 0, -1))
	scene_util.set_direction(researcher_2, 'right', false)

	apply_black_color(hold_target)
	character_util.set_position(hold_target, left_start_pos + vector(1, 0, 0))
	scene_util.set_direction(hold_target, 'right', false)

	command_util.execute_holdup(researcher_1, hold_target, researcher_1.Position, nil, false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local computer_sound_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_computer_01',
															loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', fade_in_time = 4, volume = 0.7})

	-- 페이드 인 0.8초
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.8, unity_class.color.black)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	move_end_key = 'researcher_move'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(researcher_1,
			self.marker.researcher(1),
			nil, 3, self, move_end_key)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(researcher_2,
			self.marker.researcher(2),
			nil, 3, self, move_end_key)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	command_util.execute_throw(researcher_1, self.character.dummy_android_6, vector(1, 0, 0), researcher_1.Position, 4, true)

	-- (3)론이 2초간 우측 11칸 이동 (run 애니메이션)
	wp_util.move_async(neo_leader_past, self.marker.neo_leader_past(), nil, 2, { run = true })

	--론 (left, tired, cast): 지금 이게 몇 번째 안드로이드 폐기입니까…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_leader_past, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cast' }, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_2_5')

	--연구원1 (right, idle, idle): 어차피 양산형 기계들인데 무슨 상관이야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher_1, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_2_6')

	--연구원2 (right, idle, release 2회): 훈련에 실패한 기기들은 그냥 폐기하는 게 속도가 더 빠르다고.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher_2, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_2_7')

	--론 (left, tired, idle): 아무리 그래도 이 정도 손실이라면 테스트에 문제가….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_leader_past, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'idle' }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_2_8')

	--연구원1(right, idle, bomb_idle): 테스트는 문제 없어. 민첩성이 떨어지는 개체가 많을 뿐이라고.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher_1, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = '01_swing_01' }, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_2_9')

	--연구원2(left, idle, idle): 어서가자. 론 저녀석 원래 이런쪽으로는 민감한 녀석이라고.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(researcher_2, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_2_10')


	start_coroutine(function()
		-- (1), (2) 3초간 좌측 9칸 이동
		move_end_key = 'researcher_back_move'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(researcher_1,
				left_start_pos,
				nil, 3, self, move_end_key)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(researcher_2,
				left_start_pos + vector(0, 0, -1),
				nil, 3, self, move_end_key)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)
	end)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 이동 1초 후 론(left, tired, idle)(shake0.03/0.5초)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(neo_leader_past, 'left', false)
	character_util.shake(neo_leader_past, 0.03, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 론(left, tired, idle): 난… 이런 모습을 보기위해 안드로이드를 연구한 게 아니였어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_leader_past, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_2_11')

	-- 론 1초간 우측 1칸 이동 (walk 애니메이션)
	wp_util.move_async(neo_leader_past, neo_leader_past.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), nil, 1)

	--론(right, tired, eat): 안드로이드들은 장난감이 아니야….
	start_coroutine(function()
		local clang_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clang_01', loop = true })

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(clang_sfx)
	end)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_leader_past, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'eat', keep = true }, 'tired', 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_2_12')

	-- 1초간 카메라 사이즈 3으로 조정
	-- 카메라 1초간 론에게 이동
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 1)
	camera_util.move_async(neo_leader_past.Position, 1)

	-- 화면 shake 0.1 / 0.3초
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	--론(right, attack, eat): 그들은… 내가 만들어낸 새로운 <b>종</b>이란 말이다…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(neo_leader_past, self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'nm_qc_sector_tk_s3_2_13')

	-- 0.8초 페이드 아웃
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(computer_sound_sfx, 5)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.8, unity_class.color.black)

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 동적할당 했던 NPC 해제
	self:dispose_dyn_npcs()

	if self.crt_filter_screen ~= nil then
		self.crt_filter_screen:Dispose()
		self.crt_filter_screen = nil
	end

	-- 대기 시간 중 카메라 사이즈 4로 복귀
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.1)

	-- 대기 시간 중 카메라 플레이어(니프티)에게 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.1)

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class NightmareQueenCastleSectorTeatanHeroController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('NightmareQueenCastleSectorTeatanHeroController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = false,
		NormalSectionCount = 3,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	self.quest_id = 457

	self.character = {
		twin_a = function()
			return get_character('twins_android')
		end,
		twin_b = function()
			return get_character('twins_android_b')
		end
	}

	self.fo = {
		giant_tesla = function(index)
			return get_field_object('giant_tesla_coil_' .. index)
		end,
		transformer = function()
			return get_field_object('transformer_tesla')
		end,
		switch = function()
			return get_field_object('obelisk_switch')
		end,
	}

	---@class NightmareQueenCastleSectorTeatanHeroGiantTesla
	self.giant_tesla = {
		rays = {},
		ray_count = 0,
		on_child_idx = 0,

		---@param this self
		---@param idx number
		connect = function(this, idx)
			local from = self.fo.giant_tesla(idx)
			local to = self.fo.transformer()

			local from_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(from.Bounds.center, from.Position.y + from.Bounds.size.y)
			local to_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(to.Bounds.center, to.Position.y + to.Bounds.size.y)

			this.rays[idx] = CS.Oak.TeslaRayEffect.GetOrCreate(from, to)
			this.rays[idx]:SetRay(from_pos, to_pos, true)
			this.ray_count = this.ray_count + 1
		end,

		---@param this self
		---@param idx number
		disconnect = function(this, idx)
			if this.rays[idx] ~= nil then
				this.rays[idx]:SetDisappear()
				this.rays[idx] = nil

				local tesla = self.fo.giant_tesla(idx)
				tesla.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
				this.ray_count = this.ray_count - 1

				if this.ray_count == 0 then
					local transformer = self.fo.transformer()

					transformer.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

					--변압기 off 상태
					local on_target = transformer.Transform:GetChild(this.on_child_idx)
					on_target.gameObject:SetActive(false)
				end
 			end
		end,

		---@param this self
		---@param quest_progress QuestProgress
		init = function(this, quest_progress)
			local count = 3
			local scale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2

			if quest_progress == nil then
				return
			end

			for i = 1, count do
				local tesla = self.fo.giant_tesla(i)

				tesla.Transform.localScale = scale
				tesla.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(scale)
			end

			local transformer = self.fo.transformer()

			local cur_section = quest_progress.InnerProgress + 1

			if not quest_progress.IsComplete then
				for i = cur_section, count do
					local tesla = self.fo.giant_tesla(i)

					tesla.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

					this:connect(i)
				end

				transformer.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

				--변압기 on 표시
				local on_target = transformer.Transform:GetChild(this.on_child_idx)
				on_target.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			end
		end,

		---@param this self
		is_transformer_on = function(this)
			return this.ray_count > 0
		end,
	}

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		thunder = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_gimmick_cloud_thunder')
		end
	})
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	self.fx:load_async()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.giant_tesla:is_transformer_on() and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.fo.transformer()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self:transformer_event()
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)

	if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete then
		local switch = self.fo.switch()

		switch.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	self.giant_tesla:init(quest_progress)
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
end

function local_class:transformer_event()
	local twin_a = self.character.twin_a()
	local twin_b = self.character.twin_b()
	local respawn_pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('transformer_respawn_pivot')

	self.fx.thunder():Instantiate(twin_a.Position)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_thunder_02',
		parent = twin_a
	})

	character_util.set_direction(twin_a, direction_util.to_side_dir(twin_a.Direction))
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(twin_a, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_dead_anim(twin_a)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.8)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(twin_a)

	character_util.set_position(twin_a, respawn_pivot + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.5)
	character_util.set_position(twin_b, respawn_pivot + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(twin_a, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(twin_b, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1)
end

return local_class

		self:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.current_state])

		self:opening_scene()
	end):Then(function()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
		self.current_state = self.states.android_event
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state == self.states.android_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's1_android_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.transformer_event

		sp_util.start_scene(self.android_event, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.transformer_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's1_transformer_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.tesla_interact_event

		sp_util.start_scene(self.transformer_event, self)

		return true
	elseif not self.is_in_zone.block_zone and self.current_state < self.states.done and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's1_block_zone') then
		self.is_in_zone.block_zone = true

		sp_util.start_scene(self.block_zone_event, self):Then(function()
			self.is_in_zone.block_zone = false
		end)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local tesla = self.giant_tesla()

	if self.current_state == self.states.tesla_interact_event  then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, tesla) then
			self.current_state = self.states.done

			sp_util.start_scene(self.tesla_interact_event, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_npc_with_data(data)
	for i = 1, #data do
		local npc_preset = data[i]

		local npc
		if npc_preset.type == 'static' then
			if npc_preset.name == 'leader' then
				npc = get_party_leader()
			else
				npc = get_character(npc_preset.name)
			end
		else
			npc = self.dynamic_npcs:get(npc_preset.name)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

		if data[i].pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, data[i].pos)
		end

		if data[i].dir ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, data[i].dir)
		end

		if data[i].emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, data[i].emo)
		end

		if data[i].anim ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = data[i].anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if data[i].tint ~= nil then
			character_util.add_color(npc, npc.Name, data[i].tint, 1, 0)
		end

		if data[i].active ~= nil then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, data[i].active)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
		end
	end
end

		},

		[twins_android_b] = {

	}

	--니프티(down, idle, idle): 전력차단을 완료했습니다. 한동안 재가동은 힘들겁니다.
