function local_class:tutorial_scene()
	local company_1 = self.npc.company(1)
	local company_2 = self.npc.company(2)
	local company_3 = self.npc.company(3)

	local pivot = self.marker.dark_pivot()

	local invader_knight = self.npc.invader_knight()

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	--1초간 서큘러 페이드 인 장소 이동
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- 베스(silence) 이모티콘 버블
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(invader_knight, nil, 'silence')

	-- 베스(left,idle,bomb_idle): 아무것도 보이지 않는군…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(invader_knight, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_qs_lethal_company_s1_26', skip = true })

	-- A(right,idle,idle): 걱정 마, 여기 손전등이 있으니까!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(company_1, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_qs_lethal_company_s1_27', skip = true })

	-- A(right,idle,eat) 1초 재생 후 (attack) 애니메이션
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	scene_util.play_wait_action(company_1, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'eat' },
			nil,
			1)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)

	-- (attack) 재생 때 nm_qs_flash 스프라이트를 scale(0.7) 크기로 생성 1초간 2회 회전하며 포물선으로 1칸 앞으로 이동
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(company_1, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx_name = false, one_shot_sfx = false  })


	-- 이 후 스프라이트가 베스에게 흡수된 후 FX_get 이펙트 출력
	-- 아이템 명 출력 X
	local is_flash_consumed = false

	self.flash_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = company_1.Position,

		target = invader_knight.Position,

		item_id = 21342,

		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,

		scale = 0.7,

		skip_text = true,
		bounce_callback = function()
			quest_drop_item_util.consumed(self.flash_item, invader_knight)
			is_flash_consumed = true
		end
	})

	self.item_mask = self.controller.fx.stencil_mask():Instantiate(self.flash_item.Position + vector(0, 0.25, 0),
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.flash_item.SpriteTransform)

	--FIXME : 실제 먹어지는 타이밍과 다른거 같은데
	while not is_flash_consumed do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--해당 타이밍에 확실히 fx_dragon_warehouse_stencil_mask 제거할 것.
	self:dispose_item_mask()

	-- 흡수된 후 fx_dragon_warehouse_stencil_mask 이펙트가 플레이어에게 고정되어있다.
	-- 이 후 해당 스프라이트 베스에게 흡수 후 불빛이 베스에게 따라 붙음
	self.controller:set_stencil_effect(true)

	-- A(right,idle,idle): 자, 이제 이 아래에 부품들 보이지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(company_1, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_qs_lethal_company_s1_28', skip = true })

	-- A(down,idle,release 2회): 이 부품들이랑 똑같은 애들만 여기 가져다 주면 돼!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(company_1, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release', count = 2, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_qs_lethal_company_s1_29', skip = true })

	scene_util.set_direction(company_1, 'right', false)

	self.controller:add_company_npc_listener()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	-- 2섹션으로 진행 후 컨트롤 해제
	self.controller.progress_section()
end

function local_class:dispose_item_mask()
	if self.item_mask ~= nil then
		self.item_mask:Dispose()
	end
	self.item_mask = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:check_target_holdable(idx)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local holdable_object = self.target_holdable[idx].object
	local other_idx = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(idx == 1, 2, 1)

	--마지막 타겟 홀더블을 가져왔다면, 기믹에 맞아도 죽지 않도록 함.
	if self.target_holdable[other_idx].arrived then
		self.controller.immortal_to_gimmick = true
	end

	--탈출 npc 말 못 걸도록 예외 처리.
	self.controller.is_block_interact_reset_block = true

	-- 들고있었으면 놓아 줌.
	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget, holdable_object) then

		--자연스럽게 던지는걸로.
		command_util.publish_throw(leader, leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget,
				direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(leader.Direction), leader.Position, 3, true)

		--character_util.release_hold_object(leader,leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget)
	end

	if self.target_holdable[idx].held_up then
		--ThrownEndEvent 불리거나 / 높이 0이 되거나 / z한계선을 넘어 가거나 / 최대 2초(보험) 지날 때 까지 대기.
		local time_passed = 0
		local time_limit = 2

		while self.target_holdable[idx].held_up and
				time_passed < time_limit and
				holdable_object.Position.y > 0 and
				holdable_object.Position.z > self.get_holdable_limit_z() do

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self.target_holdable[idx].held_up = false
		message_system:SendSync(holdable_object, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)

		--만약 공중에서 멈췄으면 떨어뜨려 줌.
		while holdable_object.Position.y > 0 do

			local cur_y = holdable_object.Position.y - 10 * unity_class.time.deltaTime

			cur_y = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(cur_y < 0, 0, cur_y)

			holdable_object.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(holdable_object.Position, cur_y)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	--주울 수 없게 / 충돌 안되게 바꾸기.
	holdable_object.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	holdable_object.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.target_holdable[idx].arrived = true

	--탈출 npc 말 못 걸도록 예외 처리.
	self.controller.is_block_interact_reset_block = false
	self.controller:add_company_npc_listener()

	--죽는 연출 중이라면 기다림.
	while self.controller.is_on_hit_gimmick do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--루틴 두번 타는 것 방지.
	if self.target_holdable[other_idx].arrived and not self.to_next_section_routine then
		self.to_next_section_routine = true
		start_coroutine(self.to_next_section, self)
	end

end

function local_class:to_next_section()
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	self.controller:progress_section()
end

function local_class:setting_npc()
	for i = 1, self.controller.company_npc_count do
		local npc = self.controller.npc.company_npc(i)
		npc.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('company_npc_pos_1_' .. i)
		scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'left', false)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
	end

function local_class:setting_holdable_reset_pos()
	for i = 1, #self.target_holdable do
		self.target_holdable[i].reset_pos = self.target_holdable[i].object.Position
	end
	self.shovel_holdable.reset_pos = self.shovel_holdable.object.Position
end

function local_class:reset_holdable()
	for i = 1, #self.target_holdable do
		if not self.target_holdable[i].arrived then
			self.target_holdable[i].object.Position = self.target_holdable[i].reset_pos
		end
	end
	self.shovel_holdable.object.Position = self.shovel_holdable.reset_pos
end

--region Event
function local_class:on_event(e)

		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state <= self.states.open_door then
		local door = self.field_object.door()

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, door) then
			self.current_state = self.states.open_door
			start_coroutine(self.door_open_scene, self, door)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state <= self.states.open_door and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'company_s3_chasing_start_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.chasing_start
		sp_util.start_scene(self.chasing_start_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.chasing_start then
		if self.cur_monster_state ~= self.monster_state.chasing then
			local chasing_start_zone_count = 2
			for i = 1, chasing_start_zone_count do
				if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'company_chasing_zone_' .. i) then
					start_coroutine(self.start_chasing, self)
					return true
				end
			end
		else
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'company_chasing_end_zone') then
				self:stop_chasing()
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	local rope = self.field_object.rope()
	if self.current_state < self.states.ending and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, rope, 'company_holdable_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.ending
		start_coroutine(self.release_holdable_end_ending, self, rope)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:chasing_start_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local monster = self.controller.npc.monster()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_growl_dragon_01')

	wp_util.move_async(leader, vector(-0.5, 0, -34.5), nil,
			1, { last_direction = 'right' })

	-- 괴물 1초간 틴트 (0.0.0)->(255.255.255)로 변화
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_growl_wolf_01')
	character_util.remove_color(monster, monster.Name, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 괴물 (left,idle,unique/shout 1회 재생)
	scene_util.set_anim(monster, self, { name = 'unique/shout', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle', sfx_name = '01_roar_03' })

	-- 애니메이션 시작 0.2초 후 화면 shake 0.2/0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	-- 괴물 하울링 후 대기 시간 1초
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 괴물 속도 7로 유저 추격시작 (모션은 run사용)
	-- 추격 레인지는 반지름 4.5
	-- 플레이어가 추격 레인지를 벗어나면 (idle) 애니메이션 상태로 정지
	start_coroutine(self.chasing_check_routine, self, 0.5)

function local_class:start_chasing()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState) then
		while lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState) do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	if self.cur_monster_state ~= self.monster_state.none then
		return
	end

	local monster = self.controller.npc.monster()

	self.cur_monster_state = self.monster_state.wait
	while self.cur_monster_state == self.monster_state.wait do
		local dist = (leader.Position - monster.Position).magnitude

		if dist <= self.check_range_radius then
			start_coroutine(self.chasing_check_routine, self)
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:chasing_check_routine(wait_time)
	if self.cur_monster_state == self.monster_state.chasing then
		return
	end

	wait_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(wait_time, 0)

	if wait_time > 0 then
		wait_for_sec(wait_time)
	end

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local monster = self.controller.npc.monster()
	character_util.remove_anim(monster)

	monster.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.FollowEventCharacterController.Create(monster, '', 'player')

	self:play_monster_run_sfx()

	self.cur_monster_state = self.monster_state.chasing
	while self.cur_monster_state == self.monster_state.chasing do
		local dist = (leader.Position - monster.Position).magnitude

		if dist <= self.game_over_radius then
			self.cur_monster_state = self.monster_state.wait
			sp_util.start_scene(self.game_over, self)
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:stop_chasing()
	if self.cur_monster_state == self.monster_state.chasing then
		local monster = self.controller.npc.monster()
		monster.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()

		self:stop_monster_run_sfx()
		character_util.remove_anim(monster)
		character_util.look_at(monster, get_party_leader())
	end

	self.cur_monster_state = self.monster_state.none
end

function local_class:door_open_scene(door)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_ui = false })
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_name)

	-- 베스 (right,idle,eat) 1초
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			'eat', nil, 1)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door.Name, false))

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
end

function local_class:game_over()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local monster = self.controller.npc.monster()
	monster.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()

	-- 리더가 들고있는 홀더블 강제 내려놓기
	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)) then
		character_util.release_hold_object(leader, leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget)

		command_util.publish_throw(leader, leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget,
				direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(leader.Direction), leader.Position, 3, true)
	end

	-- 유저가 괴물과 닿았을 때 강제이벤트 충돌 레인지 반지름 1
	local dir = leader.Position.x > monster.Position.x and 'left' or 'right'
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, dir, false)

	-- 괴물 (attack) 애니메이션 재생
	self:stop_monster_run_sfx()
	scene_util.set_anim(monster, self, { name = 'attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle', sfx_name = '01_roar_04' })

	-- 접촉과 동시에 플레이어(side)로 방향 전환

	-- 괴물 (attack) 애니메이션 재생 0.2초 후 플레이어 (dead) 애니메이션 재생과 동시에 red_pulse+damage_squish_default
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0, 0.25, 0))
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(leader)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(leader)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'dead')

	-- (dead) 애니메이션 재생 시작 1초간  베스 검은틴트 0->50%까지 상승
	character_util.add_color(leader, leader.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.5, 1)

	-- (dead) 애니메이션 재생 2초 후 서큘러 페이드 아웃 후 서큘러 페이드 인 하단 표시된 지점에서 재시작
	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1)

	-- 재시작 지점 ( -21.5 , -47 )
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	leader.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('company_s3_reset_pos_1')
	character_util.remove_color(leader, leader.Name, 0)

	local rope = self.field_object.rope()
	rope.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('company_s3_item_pos_1')

	scene_util.set_direction(monster, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(monster, self, 'pounce_ready_loop')

	monster.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('company_s3_monster_pos_1')
	monster.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.1)

function local_class:release_holdable_end_ending(holdable_object)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--기믹에 맞아도 죽지 않도록 함.
	self.controller.immortal_to_gimmick = true
	self.controller.is_block_interact_reset_block = true

	-- 들고있었으면 놓아 줌.
	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget, holdable_object) then

		command_util.publish_throw(leader, leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget,
				direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(leader.Direction), leader.Position, 3, true)
	end

	message_system:SendSync(holdable_object, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)

	while holdable_object.Position.y > 0 do
		local cur_y = holdable_object.Position.y - 10 * unity_class.time.deltaTime
		cur_y = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(cur_y < 0, 0, cur_y)
		holdable_object.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(holdable_object.Position, cur_y)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	holdable_object.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	holdable_object.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.controller.is_block_interact_reset_block = false

	--죽는 연출 중이라면 기다림.
	while self.controller.is_on_hit_gimmick do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)
	self:ending_scene()
	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
end

function local_class:ending_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local company_npcs = { self.controller.npc.company_npc(1), self.controller.npc.company_npc(2) }
	character_util.look_at(leader, company_npcs[1])

	-- A(right,idle,success): 좋았어! 모든 부품들을 회수했다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(company_npcs[1], self, nil, 'success',
			nil, 'nm_qs_lethal_company_s3_4')

	-- 1초간 서큘러 페이드 아웃 후 1초간 서큘러 페이드 인 위치 이동
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	self.controller:remove_company_npc_listener()
	self.controller.cur_lab_state = self.controller.lab_state.outer
	self.controller:leave_lab_setting()

	-- 아이템 6개 옮기기
	do
		local inner_items = self.controller.inner_item

		local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('company_npc_pos_1_3') + vector(-0.5, 0, 1)
		local pos_list = { center_pos, center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0), center_pos + vector(1, 0, 0) }

		for i = 1, #inner_items do
			local item = inner_items[i].pooled

			if item ~= nil then
				item.Position = pos_list[i]
			end
		end

		center_pos = center_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
		pos_list = { center_pos, center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0), center_pos + vector(1, 0, 0) }

		local holdable_names = self.controller.target_holdable_names

		for i = 1, #holdable_names do
			local holdable_fo = get_field_object(holdable_names[i])
			holdable_fo.Position = pos_list[i]
		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.5 })
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	leader = get_party_leader()

	-- A(left,idle,release2회): 고마워! 이건 감사의 표시야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(company_npcs[1], self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qs_lethal_company_s3_5')

	-- A(get)포즈 1초 해당 시간동안 스타피스 A 위치에서 좌측 1칸 옆으로 위치로 이동함
	scene_util.set_anim(company_npcs[1], self, { name = 'get', loop = false })

	local star_piece = self.field_object.star_piece()
	local star_piece_pos = company_npcs[1].Position - vector(1, 0, 0)
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, company_npcs[1].Position, star_piece_pos)
	wait_for_sec(2)
	character_util.remove_anim(company_npcs[1])

	-- B(left,idle,cast): 일단 이 부품들 부터 반환하고 네가 원하는 걸 들어줄게!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(company_npcs[2], self, nil,
			'cast', nil, 'nm_qs_lethal_company_s3_6')

	-- 에필로그 연출
	self:show_epilogue_scene()

	-- 퀘스트 클리어
	self.controller:complete_quest({ run_fame_alignment = false })

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:show_epilogue_scene()
	local console = get_field_object('company_console')

	local wall = self.controller.get_wall()

	local on = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(wall.Transform, 'on')
	local off = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(wall.Transform, 'off')

	local company_npcs = {
		self.controller.npc.company_npc(1),
		self.controller.npc.company_npc(2),
		self.controller.npc.company_npc(3)
	}

	local function smoke_screen()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_smokescreen')
	end

	smoke_screen()

	-- 초록색 존에 진입시 강제 이벤트 카메라 A에게 1초간 이동
	camera_util.move_async(console.Position, 1)

	scene_util.set_group_direction(company_npcs, 'up', false)

	-- 콘솔(wall_ship_desk):여러분들은 수익 할당량을 충족하지 못했습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(console, 'nm_qs_lethal_company_post_1')

	-- 콘솔:따라서 여러분의 성과는 기준 미달로 평가되었습니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(console, 'nm_qs_lethal_company_post_2')

	-- A(up,idle,idle): 뭐라고? 우리가 썼던 부품들은 전부 가져왔잖아.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(company_npcs[1], 'nm_qs_lethal_company_post_3')

	-- 콘솔: 당신들은 연구를 위해 고용됐습니다. 연구 성과가 없다면 해고 입니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_02')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(console, 'nm_qs_lethal_company_post_4')

	-- B(up,idle,release2회): 아니… 웃기지마!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(company_npcs[2], self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_qs_lethal_company_post_5')

	-- 콘솔: 우리의 징계 절차에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(console, 'nm_qs_lethal_company_post_6')

	-- 우측에 표시된 벽 위치에  FX_Common_SmokeScreen 2개
	-- 이펙트 위치 ( -57 , -65) / ( -57,  -66 )
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	smoke_screen():Instantiate(vector(-57, 0, -65))
	smoke_screen():Instantiate(vector(-57, 0, -66))

	-- 벽을 wall_ship_brokenwall 레이어의 on->off로 변경된다.
	on.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	off.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	-- 벽이 변경될 때 화면 shake 0.2 / 0.5초
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	-- 벽이 변경될 때
	-- A(left,idle,embarrassed): 끄아아아아악!!
	-- 이때 B,C도 (left,idle,embarrassed)
	local move_end_key = 'move_end'

	for i = 1, #company_npcs do
		local npc = company_npcs[i]
		scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'embarrassed')

		-- A,B,C 방향/애니메이션 고정으로 1초간 우측 1칸 이동
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, npc.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, self, move_end_key, { locked_dir = 'left' })
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(company_npcs[1], 'nm_qs_lethal_company_post_7')

	-- 두 행동 끝날 때까지 대기
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- A,B,C 스파인 1초 2회 회전하며 속도 8로 우측 화면 밖으로 이탈됨
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
	for i = 1, #company_npcs do
		local npc = company_npcs[i]
		character_util.spine_rotate(npc, -720, 1)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, npc.Position + vector(9, 0, 0.5),
				8, nil, self, move_end_key, { locked_dir = 'left' })

		-- 이때 0.5초간 알파페이드 아웃
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 0, 0.5)
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	for i = 1, #company_npcs do
		local npc = company_npcs[i]
		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	-- 플레이어에게 1초간 카메라 복귀되고 컨트롤 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

function local_class:play_monster_run_sfx()
	self:stop_monster_run_sfx()

	self.monster_run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_wolf_step_01',
		max_distance = 7,
		parent = self.controller.npc.monster(),
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
	})
end

function local_class:stop_monster_run_sfx()
	if self.monster_run_sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	self.monster_run_sfx:Stop()
	self.monster_run_sfx = nil
end

return local_class

	--endregion Fx

	--region Dynamic_npc
	--동적 할당 정보
	self.dynamic_npcs = {
		opening_scene_npc = {
			npc_list = {},
			dynamic_npc_name = 'opening_npc_',
			dynamic_npc_data = nil
		},
		create_npcs = function(this)
			for name, npc_data in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'create_npcs' and name ~= 'dispose_all' and name ~= 'dispose_target' then

					local dynamic_npc_spec = {}

					for i = 1, #npc_data.dynamic_npc_data do

					end

					npc_data.npc_list = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(dynamic_npc_spec)

					for i = 1, #npc_data.dynamic_npc_data do
						npc_data.npc_list[npc_data.dynamic_npc_name .. i].Position = self.wait_pos

		end,
		dispose_target = function(target_list)
			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(target_list)
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			for name, npc_data in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'create_npcs' and name ~= 'dispose_all' and name ~= 'dispose_target' then
					if npc_data.npc_list then
						load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(npc_data.npc_list)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	}
	--endregion Dynamic_npc

	--region Sprite
	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			dollar = 21332,
			empty_bottle = 21329,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:ConsumeComplete()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

	--region Etc
	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.first_scene_zone_name = 's1_first_scene_zone'
	self.second_scene_zone_name = 's1_second_scene_zone'

		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')
	end
	self.save_weapon = nil

	self.fx_list = nil

		'pw_pixy_male_b',
		'pw_pixy_male_b',
		'pw_pixy_male_b',
		'pw_pixy_female_a',
		'pw_pixy_female_b',
		'pw_pixy_male_a',
	}
	self.dynamic_npcs.opening_scene_npc.dynamic_npc_data = opening_npc_specs

	self.dynamic_npcs:create_npcs()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self.fx:load_all()

	--편의점 술
	local item_3 = self.get_item(3)

	item_3.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	sp_util.start_scene(self.opening_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.fx_list then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if target then
				target:Dispose()
				target = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.sprite:dispose_all()

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.scene_2 and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.first_scene_zone_name) then

		--베스 (left, e/[emo]drunken , idle) : 비싼거 한잔 정도는 마셔줘야겠어…
		sp_util.start_scene(self.hungry_for_alcohol, self, 'nm_qs_main_s1_11', 1)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.scene_3 and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.first_scene_zone_name) then

		--베스 (left, e/[emo]drunken , idle) : 늘 먹던… 그 술을 사야겠어.
		sp_util.start_scene(self.hungry_for_alcohol, self, 'nm_qs_main_s1_28', 1)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.scene_4 and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.second_scene_zone_name) then
		--베스 (left, e/[emo]drunken , idle) : 여기만큼 마시기 좋은 장소는 없지.
		sp_util.start_scene(self.hungry_for_alcohol, self, 'nm_qs_main_s1_34_1', 2)

		return true
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.scene_2 and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_chair(1)) then
		self.current_state = self.states.scene_3

		--플레이어가 좌상단 의자 오브젝트를 인터렉트 하면, 하단의 이벤트 진행.
		--메인 퀘스트 마커 제거
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

		sp_util.start_scene(self.bar_chair_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.scene_3 and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_item(1)) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.convenience_store_scene, self, 1)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.scene_3 and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_item(2)) then

		sp_util.start_scene(self.convenience_store_scene, self, 2)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.scene_3 and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_item(3)) then
		--길을 막고 있던 강제 트리거 존 이벤트 제거.
		self.current_state = self.states.scene_4

		--플레이어가 좌상단 의자 오브젝트를 인터렉트 하면, 하단의 이벤트 진행.
		--메인 퀘스트 마커 제거
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

		sp_util.start_scene(self.convenience_store_scene, self, 3)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.scene_3 and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_item(4)) then

		sp_util.start_scene(self.convenience_store_scene, self, 4)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state < self.states.scene_3 and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_item(3)) then

		sp_util.start_scene(self.convenience_store_scene, self, 5, 3)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.scene_4 and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_chair(2)) then
		self.current_state = self.states.scene_5

		--플레이어가 좌상단 의자 오브젝트를 인터렉트 하면, 하단의 이벤트 진행.
		--메인 퀘스트 마커 제거
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

		sp_util.start_scene(self.park_chair_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:opening_scene()
	--self:opening_npc_setting()
	self.current_state = self.states.scene_1

	local start_pos = self.get_start_pos()
	local invader_knight = self.get_invader_knight()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	invader_knight.Position = start_pos

	--카메라는 최초 베스(플레이어)한테 포커싱 된 상태.
	--화면 2초에 걸쳐 일반 페이드 인 되는 동시에, 베스 (left, idle, unique/drunk_seat 2회) 애니메이션 출력
	local drunk_seat_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(invader_knight, 'unique/drunk_seat')

	scene_util.set_emotion(invader_knight, self, 'drunken')

	start_coroutine(function()

		scene_util.set_anim(invader_knight, self, 'seat')
	end)

		sfx_name = '01_amb_city_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 5, volume = 0.7 })

	--베스의 drunk_seat 자세 2회 끝나고 0.5초 이후, 하단의 이벤트 진행.

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(invader_knight, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'nm_qs_main_s1_4')

	--베스 (left, tired , seat) : 그 오염종족 꼰대들이 봤다면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(invader_knight, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'nm_qs_main_s1_5')

	--베스 (left, tired , seat) : 술 좀 그만 먹으라고 잔소리나 했을 테니까.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(invader_knight, self,
			nil,

			nil,

	--베스 (left, tired , seat) : …아무것도 모르는 주제에.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(invader_knight, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'nm_qs_main_s1_7')

	--베스 (left, tired , seat) : 이대로면… 당장 내일 죽어도 이상할 거 없겠군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(invader_knight, self,

	--이후 메인 퀘스트 마커는 하단의 구역을 가리킴.

	-- 2 = 바 내부 3 = 바 외부

	character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), 'left')

	character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), 'down')

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(loop_sfx, 2)

function local_class:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, height)
	local pos = {
		start_pos,
		start_pos + vector(0, height, 0),
		end_pos + vector(0, height, 0),
		end_pos
	}
	local a_pos, b_pos, c_pos, d_pos, e_pos, f_pos

	a_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[1], pos[2], progress)
	b_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[2], pos[3], progress)
	c_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[3], pos[4], progress)
	d_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(a_pos, b_pos, progress)
	e_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(b_pos, c_pos, progress)
	f_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(d_pos, e_pos, progress)

	return f_pos
end

function local_class:emp_scene()
	local invader_knight = self.npc.invader_knight()
	local little_girl = self.npc.little_girl()
	local ammi = self.npc.ammi()

	local pivot_pos = self.marker.emp_pivot()

	-- 격벽 안쪽의 트리거존으로 들어오면 격벽 닫히며 바로 이벤트 발동

	-- 격벽 안쪽으로 들어오면 1초간 카메라값 4로 줌인
	-- AMMI는 바로 후퇴한 뒤 2초 뒤 제거.


	-- 위쪽에서 들어오면 빨간색 루트로, 아래쪽에서 들어오면 파란색 루트로 0.5초간 이동 후 정렬.
	local ik_enter_pos = invader_knight.Position
	local lg_enter_pos = little_girl.Position
	local ik_wp_align
	local lg_wp_align
	local wp_last_direction
	if ik_enter_pos.z > pivot_pos.z then
		ik_wp_align = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(invader_knight, pivot_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 5), true)
		lg_wp_align = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(invader_knight, pivot_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 5), true)
		wp_last_direction = 'down'
	else
		ik_wp_align = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(invader_knight, pivot_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -5), true)
		lg_wp_align = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(invader_knight, pivot_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -5), true)
		wp_last_direction = 'up'
	end

	scene_util.set_emotion(invader_knight, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion(little_girl, self, 'attack')

	local party_align_key = 'party_align'
	local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(invader_knight, ik_wp_align, 7, nil, self, party_align_key,
			{ run = true, last_direction = wp_last_direction })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ammi_04')
	scene_util.set_emotion(ammi, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(ammi, self, 'unique/railgun_shoot_loop')

	--Stage Camera Shake (0.3,0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	--신디 이미지 경로로 7의 속도로 이동 시작
	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(little_girl)
	wp_util.move_async(little_girl, {
		pivot_pos,
		pivot_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0)
	}, 7, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = false })
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(dash_sfx)

	do
		local time_mod_key = 'ammi_lg_mod'
		--이후 타임스케일 0.2 (카메라는 AMMI를 따라 포커스 이동)
		local time_scale = 0.2
		local duration = 4
		local real_duration = duration * time_scale

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
		time_util.mod(time_mod_key, time_scale)

		--[0초 ~ 4초]

		--신디, AMMI 위의 경로로 4초간 이동
		--목표 위치
		--AMMI  x:-94.75 / y :-15.5
		--신디  x:-93 / y :-15.5
		dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_13', loop = true })

		scene_util.set_anim(ammi, self, { name = 'walk', sfx_name = '01_walk_robot_05' })
		wp_util.move(ammi, pivot_pos + vector(0.75, 0, 0), nil, real_duration, { run = true })
		wp_util.move_async(little_girl, pivot_pos + vector(3, 0, 0), nil, real_duration, { run = true, play_sfx = false })

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(dash_sfx)

		--[4초 ~ 6초]
		duration = 2
		real_duration = duration * time_scale

		--AMMI (right,attack,attack_ready_loop)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ammi_07')
		scene_util.set_emotion(ammi, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(ammi, self, 'attack_ready_loop')

		--신디 (left,surprise,idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(little_girl, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(little_girl, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.remove_anim(little_girl)

		--2초간 카메라값 2.5로 줌인
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2.5, real_duration)

		--타임 스케일 1로 복귀
		time_util.unmod(time_mod_key)
	end

	--동시 연출 - 0.5초
	do
		local duration = 0.5

		--AMMI (right,attack,attack 1회)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ammi_07')
		scene_util.set_anim(ammi, self, { name = 'attack', loop = false, keep = true, sfx_name = false, one_shot_sfx = false })

		--Stage Camera Shake (0.3,0.5)
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

		--신디 (left,damaged,prostrate) 자세로
		scene_util.set_direction(little_girl, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(little_girl, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(little_girl, self, 'prostrate')

		--0.5초간 1타일 오른쪽으로 점프
		--목표 위치  x:-91.5 / y :-15.5
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(little_girl, 1.5, duration)
		wp_util.move_async(little_girl, little_girl.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), nil, duration)

		--y축 값 0되면 피격 연출
		--red_pulse
		--damage_squish
		--캐릭터 하단에 fx_hit 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
		self:npc_hit(little_girl, true)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(ammi)

	--이후 0.5초간 카메라 값 4로 복귀 1.5로 줌인 + 신디에게로 포커스 전환 - (async)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(1.5, 0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(little_girl.Position, 0.5, { end_target = little_girl })

	--신디 (right,damaged,prostrate) 자세로 shake (0.03,1) -(async)
	scene_util.set_direction(little_girl, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(little_girl, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(little_girl, self, 'prostrate')
	character_util.shake(little_girl, 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--신디 (right,attack,prostrate)
	scene_util.set_direction(little_girl, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(little_girl, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(little_girl, self, 'prostrate')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--신디 (right,attack,prostrate) : 조금만 더…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(little_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'prostrate', keep = true },
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nm_qs_main_s10_7_1', skip = true, scale = 0.5 })


	----이후 0.5초간 카메라 값 4로 복귀 + 신디에게로 포커스 전환 - (async)
	--camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	--camera_util.move_async(little_girl.Position, 0.5, { end_target = little_girl })
	--
	----신디 (right,attack,idle) 마리오 점프로 기상
	--character_util.mario_jump_new(little_girl, 'right', 0.3, 0.5)
	--
	--wait_for_sec(0.3)

	local emp_unit = self.object.emp_unit()
	local emp_button = self.object.emp_button()
	do
		--타임 스케일 0.1
		local time_mod_key = 'jump_emp_button'
		local time_scale = 0.1

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 4 })
		time_util.mod(time_mod_key, time_scale)

		--[0초 ~ 3초]
		local duration = 3
		local real_duration = duration * time_scale
		--신디 (right,attack,walk4legs) 자세로 1타일 우측 이동 (목표 위치  x:-90.5 / y :-15.5)
		scene_util.set_direction(little_girl, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(little_girl, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(little_girl, self, 'walk4legs')
		wp_util.move(little_girl, emp_button.Position, nil, real_duration)

		--AMMI 우측 2.75타일타일 이동 (목표 위치  x:-92.25 / y :-15.5)
		scene_util.set_anim(ammi, self, { name = 'walk', sfx_name = '01_walk_robot_05' })
		wp_util.move_async(ammi, pivot_pos + vector(3.25, 0, 0), nil, real_duration)

		--신디 목표값 도달시 fx_lasthit 캐릭터 하단에 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_08')
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(little_girl.Position)

		--[3초 ~ 3.5초]
		duration = 0.5
		real_duration = duration * time_scale

		--CODE : 임의. ammi walk 애니메이션에서 멈춤
		ammi.SpineController.TimeScale = 0
		little_girl.SpineController.TimeScale = 0

		--Stage Camera Shake (0.3,0.5)
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(real_duration)

		--[3.5초 ~ 4초]
		duration = 0.5
		real_duration = duration * time_scale

		--카메라 포커스 0.5초간 EMP 기계로 이동 + 카메라값 4로 줌아웃
		camera_util.resize_to_default(real_duration)
		camera_util.move_async(emp_unit.Position, real_duration)


		--[4초 ~ 6초]
		duration = 2
		real_duration = duration * time_scale

		--EMP 장치 자체에 Shake (0.04,2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_die_robot_02')
		field_object_util.shake(emp_unit, 0.04, real_duration)
		wait_for_sec(real_duration)

		--타임 스케일 1로 복귀
		time_util.unmod(time_mod_key)
	end

	-- fx_emp_explosion 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lightning_strike_01')
	self.fx.emp_explosion():Instantiate(emp_unit.Position)

	--CODE 애니메이션 재생
	start_coroutine(function()
		local emp_unit_animator = emp_unit:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		emp_unit_animator:Play('on')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_emp_03')
		wait_for_sec(0.583)
		emp_unit_animator:Play('on_idle')
	end)

	--Stage Camera Shake (0.1,2)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 2)

	-- 슬로우 해제되며 AMMI 죽는 연출
	-- AMMI 나오다 말고 EMP 기기에 의해 무력화된다.
	-- AMMI (right,idle,damaged_2legs) - 2초
	ammi.SpineController.TimeScale = 1
	little_girl.SpineController.TimeScale = 1
	scene_util.set_emotion(little_girl, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(little_girl, self, 'prostrate')
	character_util.set_anim(ammi, { name = 'damaged', loop = true })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.set_anim(ammi, { name = 'dead', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.833)

	scene_util.set_anim(ammi, self, { name = 'dead_2' })

	--동시에 AMMI 위로 이펙트 fx_ammi_explosion 발동되며 제거
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lina_fire_explosion_01')
	self.fx.ammi_explosion():Instantiate(ammi.Position)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(ammi, active_state_type.disabled)
	ammi.Position = self.marker.nowhere()

	-- 카메라 포커스 1초간 헤일리로 전환. Stage Camera 값 3으로 줌인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 1)
	camera_util.move_async(little_girl.Position, 1, { end_target = little_girl })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 캐릭터 쉐이크 (0.01,1) 헤일리, mario jump로 일어나
	character_util.shake_and_wakeup(little_girl, 'left', 1, 'idle', true)

	-- 7의 속도로 베스에게 달려간다.
	-- 달려가며 대사 : 언니!! 괜찮아요?!
	character_util.set_emotion(little_girl, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.remove_anim(little_girl)
	local lg_speech_and_run_routine = true
	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(little_girl, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'nm_qs_main_s10_8', skip = true })
		lg_speech_and_run_routine = false
	end)

	local ik_tire_routine = true
	start_coroutine(function()
		-- 신디 달려옴과 동시에 베스 캐릭터 shake(0.04,1) 한 뒤
		character_util.set_emotion(invader_knight, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.shake(invader_knight, 0.01, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--(right,idle,idle) 자세로 전환.
		character_util.remove_anim(invader_knight)
		ik_tire_routine = false
	end)

	self.amb_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_amb_ship_01',
		loop = true,
		fade_in_time = 5,
		volume = 0.7
	})

	wp_util.move_async(little_girl, invader_knight.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 7, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

	while lg_speech_and_run_routine or ik_tire_routine do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 헤일리 (left,tired,cast) : 일어나지 마요…! 피가 너무 많이 나잖아요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(invader_knight, 0.01, 1)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(little_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nm_qs_main_s10_9', skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 베스 (right,attack,idle) : 너, 누가 그렇게 멍청하게….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(invader_knight, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nm_qs_main_s10_10', skip = true })

	--베스 대사 끝남과 동시에 다시 캐릭터 shkae (0.01,0.3) 한 뒤
	character_util.shake(invader_knight, 0.01, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--베스의 dead1 자세 시작과 동시에 신디 (left,scared,idle) 전환
	scene_util.set_direction(little_girl, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(little_girl, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(little_girl, self, 'idle')

	-- 베스 (right,tired,dead1) 자세로 쓰러진다.
	scene_util.set_direction(invader_knight, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(invader_knight, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(invader_knight, self, { name = 'dead1', keep = true, loop = false })

	--CODE : sfx key 지난 만큼
	wait_for_sec(1.333)

	--베스 dead 떄 카메라 shake에	01_impact_12
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_12')

	--베스 dead1 자세가 끝날 때 Stage Camera (0.1,0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	--신디 (left,scared,ilde) jump 1회
	character_util.normal_jump_async(little_girl, '01_player_jump_01')

	-- 헤일리 (left,tired,eat) : 언니! 언니!!!
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(little_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'eat', keep = true },
			{ name = 'scared', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nm_qs_main_s10_11', skip = true })

	-- 헤일리의 대사와 동시에 화면 페이드 아웃
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(equipping_sfx, 1)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:epilogue_scene()
end

function local_class:epilogue_scene()
	local invader_knight = self.npc.invader_knight()
	local pre_little_girl = self.npc.little_girl()
	local little_girl = self.npc.little_girl_hair_down()

	local pivot_pos = self.marker.emp_pivot()
	local food_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	local ribbon_pos = pivot_pos + vector(-7.5, 0, 1.5)
	local lg_pos = pivot_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	local ik_pos = pivot_pos + vector(-5, 0, 0)
	local cam_pos = pivot_pos + vector(-4, 0, 0)

	-- 초기 배치
	self.current_state = self.states.epilogue

	--ammi 비활성화
	do
		local is_create
		is_create, self.ammi_controller = global_table_util.try_get('Quest/Nightmare/QueenShip/Common/NightmareQueenShipAMMI')

		if is_create then
			self.ammi_controller.activate_ammi = false
		end
	end

	--exit 위치 옮겨줌
	local exit = get_field_object('exit_nightmare_queenship_3')
	exit.Position = vector(-95.5, 0, 25)

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'left_field', target = get_field_object('base_inner_4') },
		{ zone = 'down_field', target = get_field_object('base_inner_2') },
		{ zone = 'right_field', target = get_field_object('base_inner_1') },
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('exit_nightmare_queenship_3') },
	})

	-- 베스 (right,sleep_deep,prostrate)
	invader_knight.Position = ik_pos
	scene_util.set_direction(invader_knight, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(invader_knight, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(invader_knight, self, { name = 'prostrate' })

	--신디 (right,idle,eat)
	pre_little_girl.Position = lg_pos
	scene_util.set_direction(pre_little_girl, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(pre_little_girl, self, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim(pre_little_girl, self, { name = 'eat' })

	camera_util.move_async(self.marker.nowhere(), 0)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.door_name.emp_up, true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.door_name.emp_down, true))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--mall_cardboard_box
	--음식 위치에 배치
	self.box_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = food_pos,

		item_id = 21340,

		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,

		skip_text = false
	})

	--카메라 위치
	camera_util.move_async(cam_pos, 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--(카메라크기 3은 유지된 상태)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	--1.5초간 배경 틴트 50%로 페이드 인
	self.background_fade_controller:set_background_color(0, 0, 0)
	self.background_fade_controller:set_background_active(true)
	self.background_fade_controller:set_background_sorting_order('Default', 0)
	--연출중 40으로는 부족할 정도로 동선이 이동함.
	self.background_fade_controller:set_background_scale(100)

	--CODE : 배경 틴트에 맞춰 두 캐릭터 소팅 레이어 변경
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(pre_little_girl, 'Default', 1)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(invader_knight, 'Default', 1)

	self.background_fade_controller:set_background_alpha(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--신디 (down,idle,eat) - 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(pre_little_girl, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(pre_little_girl, self, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim(pre_little_girl, self, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--신디 4의 속도로 위의 경로로 이동
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pre_little_girl)
	wp_util.move_async(pre_little_girl, invader_knight.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 4)

	--신디 (left,tired,eat)
	scene_util.set_direction(pre_little_girl, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(pre_little_girl, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(pre_little_girl, self, 'eat')

	--1.5초간 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--배경 틴트 원복
	self.background_fade_controller:set_background_alpha(0)

	--CODE : 배경 틴트에 맞춰 두 캐릭터 레이어 원복
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(pre_little_girl, 'Default', 0)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(invader_knight, 'Default', 0)

	--(마족 소녀 스파인 제거)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(pre_little_girl)
	pre_little_girl.Position = self.marker.nowhere()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pre_little_girl)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(pre_little_girl, active_state_type.disabled)

	--(신디 위치에 머리 푼 마족 소녀 스파인 생성)
	--머리 푼 신디 (left,sleep,seat) 상태
	little_girl.Position = lg_pos
	scene_util.set_direction(little_girl, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(little_girl, self, 'sleep')
	scene_util.set_anim(little_girl, self, 'seat')
	field_object_util.set_active_state(little_girl, active_state_type.enabled)

	-- 리본 (임시) lorain_ribbon
	local stage_controller = get_stage_event_controller('NightmareQueenShip3Controller')
	stage_controller:setting_ribbon()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	---- 카메라 포커스는 베스를 기준으로

	local item_airdrop = function(duration)

		local item_pool = {

			21348,
			20665,

			vector(-1.8, 0, -0.3),
			vector(-1.5, 0, -0.7),
			vector(-2.1, 0, -0.3),

			vector(-2.6, 0, -1),
			vector(-3.2, 0, -0.2),
			vector(-2.8, 0, -0.5),
		}
		local items = {}
		local timer = 0
		local index = 1
		while remain > 0 or #items > 0 do
			if timer > 0.2 and remain > 0 then
				remain = remain - timer
				timer = 0

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
				local drop_pos = random_util.get_random_int(1, 8)
				local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
					item_id = item_pool[index],

					pos = food_pos + vector(0, 0.4, 0),

					target = food_pos + offset_pool[drop_pos],

					spr_scale = 0.6,

					loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				})

				table.insert(items, item)
				index = index + 1
				if index > 8 then
					index = 1
				end
			end

			if #items > 0 and items[1].SpriteTransform.position.y < 0.2 then

			end
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		end

		little_girl = function(inner_state, idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s11_' .. inner_state .. '_little_girl_' .. idx)
		end,

		invader_soldier = function(group_idx, char_idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s11_invader_soldier_' .. group_idx .. '_'  .. char_idx)
		end,

		blocked_passage = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s11_blocked_passage_pos')
		end,
	}

	self.fx = {
		cached_inst = {},

		vanishing = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,

		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,

		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,

		cache = function(this, fx)
			table.insert(this.cached_inst, fx)
		end,

		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if type_util.is_function(load_func) and
						name ~= 'load_all' and
						name ~= 'cache' and
						name ~= 'dispose' then

					load_func()
				end
			end
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			for i = 1, #this.cached_inst do
				this.cached_inst[i]:Dispose()
				this.cached_inst[i] = nil
			end

			this.cached_inst = nil
		end
	}

	-- item sprite
	-- 사용할 아이템들 sprite name
	self.item_sprite = {
	}

	-- item
	-- 사용할 아이템들 id
	self.item_id = {
	}

	self.items = {
		data = nil,
		add_item = function(this, item_id, unique_id, pos, target_pos, scale, create_on_character, dont_show_loot_text, local_scale)
			if this.data == nil then
				this.data = {}
			end

			create_on_character = lua_helper.get_or_default(create_on_character, false)
			target_pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(target_pos, nil)
			local_scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(local_scale, nil)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = pos,
				item_id = item_id,
				spr_scale = scale,
				unique_id = unique_id,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				show_on_character = create_on_character,
				skip_text = dont_show_loot_text,
				target = target_pos
			})

			if local_scale ~= nil then
				item.SpriteTransform.localScale = local_scale
				item.ShadowTransform.localScale = local_scale
			end

			table.insert(this.data, item)
		end,
		pop_item = function(this, unique_id)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for i, item in ipairs(this.data) do
					if item.UniqueId == unique_id then
						local pop_item = item

						table.remove(this.data, i)

						return pop_item
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end,

		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for i = 1, #this.data do
					quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.data[i])
					this.data[i] = nil
				end

				this.data = nil
			end
		end
	}

	self.event_info = {
		[self.states.discovered_by_invaders] = {
			invader_count_by_group = { 8, },
		}
	}

	self.s11_battle_group_name = 's11_battle_1'

	self.quest_progress = nil

	-- 환경음 sfx
	self.amb_loop_sfx = nil
end

end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated')

	self.quest_progress = self.cs_controller.QuestProgress

	local custom_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_key)

	if custom_state ~= 1 then
		self.amb_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_amb_ship_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 5, volume = 0.7 })

		start_coroutine(self.play_intro_scene, self)
	else
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({
			state = 'field',
			name = 'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/audio:bgm_queenship_main',
			volume = 1
		})

		start_coroutine(self.start_stage_immediately, self)
	end

	local target_pos = self.markers.blocked_passage()

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field_1', target = target_pos },
		{ zone = 'main_field_2', target = target_pos },
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil

	if self.amb_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.amb_loop_sfx)

		self.amb_loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.go_to_next_area and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's11_blocked_passage') then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.play_blocked_passage_event, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.getting_inside_server_rack and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's11_limit_area') then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.current_area_exit_restrict, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.getting_inside_server_rack and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.field_object.server_rack_button()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.discovered_by_invaders

		sp_util.start_scene(self.invaders_encounter_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.s11_battle_group_name then
		party_util.hide_field_ui_character_stats(0)

		sp_util.start_scene(self.post_battle_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--region npc setting
function local_class:set_current_scene_npc()
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[self.current_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			return
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.interaction then
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		end

		if npc_data.string ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.string) then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.string
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_1_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,
					npc_data.weapon_1_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_2_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2,
					npc_data.weapon_2_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.show_weapon then
			scene_util.show_weapon(npc)
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:play_intro_scene()
	local invader_knight = get_party_leader()
	local little_girl = self.characters.little_girl()

	local outside_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right',
			self.markers.invader_knight(1, 1), 1.5)

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	camera_util.move_async(self.markers.invader_knight(1, 1) + vector(-5, 0, 0), 0.1)

	camera_util.move_async(self.markers.invader_knight(1, 1), 0.2)

	-- 스테이지 진입 후 화면 출력1초에 걸쳐 fade in
	-- fade in 시작 0.5초 후 베스, 헤일리 위와 같은 동선으로 이동
	-- 베스 (left, idle, walk)
	-- 헤일리 (left, idle, walk)

	character_util.set_position(invader_knight, outside_pos)
	scene_util.set_direction(invader_knight, 'left', false)
	character_util.set_position(little_girl, outside_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0))
	scene_util.set_direction(little_girl, 'left', false)

	scene_util.hide_weapon(invader_knight)

	camera_util.move(self.markers.camera(1, 1), 0)

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 위 동선에 도착하면 베스 (left, idle, idle) 상태로 silence 이모티콘
	local move_end_key = 'party_align'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(invader_knight, self.markers.invader_knight(1, 1), 3, nil, self, move_end_key)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(little_girl, self.markers.little_girl(1, 1), 3, nil, self, move_end_key)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(invader_knight, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'silence')

	-- 베스 (right, idle, idle): 정말 끝까지 따라올거냐.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(invader_knight, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = '01_swing_01' },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_qs_main_s11_1_1', skip = true })

	-- 베스 (right, idle, idle): 여기서부터는 계속 싸우면서 나아가야 한다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(invader_knight, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_qs_main_s11_1_2', skip = true })

	-- 베스 (right, idle, bomb_idle): 혼자서 탈출 못하겠으면 어디 숨어있기라도 하는 게 더 안전할 거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(invader_knight, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_qs_main_s11_1_3', skip = true })

	-- 헤일리 (left, tired, idle): 혼자 숨어있다가 괴물들이 오면 어떻게 해요….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(little_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nm_qs_main_s11_1_4', skip = true })

	-- 헤일리 (left, tired, idle): 게다가 언니가 또 쓰러질지도 모르잖아요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(little_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'nm_qs_main_s11_1_5', skip = true })

	-- 베스 (right, idle, cross_arm) 상태로 (annoyed) 버블 이모티콘 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(invader_knight, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cross_arm' },
			nil,
			'annoyed')

	-- 베스 (right, idle, idle) : 그럴 일 없어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(invader_knight, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_qs_main_s11_1_6', skip = true })

	-- 베스 (right, idle, idle): 다시 말하지만, 내가 지켜줄 거란 기대는 하지 마라.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(invader_knight, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_qs_main_s11_1_7', skip = true })

	-- 헤일리 (left, smile, idle):네!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(little_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'nm_qs_main_s11_1_8', skip = true })

	scene_util.set_direction(invader_knight, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_knight)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(little_girl)

	self.current_state = self.states.go_to_next_area

	--현재 스테이트 저장
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_key, (self.current_state == self.states.go_to_next_area) and 1 or 0)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'field',
		name = 'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/audio:bgm_queenship_main',
		volume = 1
	})

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.amb_loop_sfx, 2)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1.5)
	scene_util.set_anim(invader_knight, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_knight)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

	self.amb_loop_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:start_stage_immediately()
	local invader_knight = get_party_leader()
	local little_girl = self.characters.little_girl()

	local start_pos = self.markers.start()

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	party_util.position_party(start_pos, 'left', 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1.5)
	scene_util.set_anim(invader_knight, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	self.current_state = self.states.go_to_next_area

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_knight)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

function local_class:play_blocked_passage_event()
	local invader_knight = get_party_leader()
	local little_girl = self.characters.little_girl()

	self.current_state = self.states.blocked_passage_event

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 2)

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	-- 1초 동안 정렬
	-- 도착 시 (down, idle, idle) 출력

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(little_girl, self.markers.little_girl(2, 1), nil, 1, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_qs_main_s11_2_2', skip = true })
